local controller_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Base/QuestControllerBase')

---@class DreamVillageCowardController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageCowardController', controller_base)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	-- 사용할 섹션 스크립트 정보. 주석 해제하고 사용
	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = true,
		NormalSectionCount = 1,
		HasPostSection = false
	}

	self.npc = {
		-- 기사(파티리더)
		knight = function()
			return get_party_leader()
		end,

		--도화
		twins_younger = function()
			return get_character('twins_younger')
		end,

		--겁쟁이
		coward = function()
			return get_character('coward')
		end,

		coward_epilogue = function()
			return get_character('pooled_dv_coward_1')
		end,

		--무사1~4
		samurai = function(idx)
			return get_character('coward_samurai_' .. idx)
		end,

		--부랑자
		ronin = function()
			return get_character('coward_ronin')
		end,

	}

	self.cached_leader = nil

	self.marker = {
		coward_start_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('coward_start_pos')
		end,

		thunder_breathing_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('coward_tb_pos')
		end,
		success_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('coward_success_pos')
		end,
		epilogue_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('coward_epilogue_pos')
		end,
		pot_pos = function(idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('coward_pot_pos_' .. idx)
		end,
		pre_pot_pos = function(idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('coward_pre_puzzle_pos_' .. idx)
		end,
		samurai_pos = function(idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('coward_samurai_pos_' .. idx)
		end,
		nowhere = function()
			return vector(999, 0, 999)
		end,
	}

	self.object = {
		pot = function(idx)
			return get_field_object('coward_pot_' .. idx)
		end,
		pre_pot = function(idx)
			return get_field_object('coward_pre_puzzle_' .. idx)
		end
	}

	self.zone_name = {
		start_zone = 'coward_start_zone',
		success_zone = 'coward_clear_zone',
	}

	self.pre_section_states = {
		none = 1,
		first_meet_before = 2,
		in_first_meet = 3,
		interact_before = 4,
		interact_retry = 5,
		pre_section_end = 6,
	}
	self.current_pre_section_state = self.pre_section_states.none

	self.is_in_start_zone = false

	--region 벌레 테이블
	self.bug_location_table = {}
	self.bug_pot_table = {}
	self.bug_pot_num = 40

	self.pre_bug_location_table = {}
	self.pre_bug_pot_table = {}
	self.pre_bug_pot_num = 6
	--endregion


	self.is_failed_before = false

	self.time_conversion = nil
	self.time_conversion_event_key = 'sub_coward'
	self.day_states = {
		daylight = 1,
		night = 2,
	}
	self.current_day_state = self.day_states.daylight
	self.is_in_time_change = false

	self.tc_progress_name = 'coward_daylight_progress'
	self.tc_cleared_name = 'coward_daylight_cleared'

	self.constants_data = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Main/DreamVillage/Coward/BugConstants.lua')

	self.flee_bugs = nil
	self.flee_bug_key = 'flee_bug_'
	self.flee_bug_total_count = 4
	self.flee_bug_cur_count = 1
	self.can_flee_bug = true
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_stage_start_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	self.super:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
	self:dispose_dynamic_bugs()
	self:dispose_flee_bugs()
	self:dispose_time_conversion()
end

function local_class:dispose_dynamic_bugs()
	if self.dynamic_bugs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.dynamic_bugs)
		self.dynamic_bugs = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_flee_bugs()
	if self.flee_bugs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.flee_bugs)
		self.flee_bugs = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_time_conversion()
	if self.time_conversion ~= nil then
		self.time_conversion:unregister_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key)
		--self.time_conversion = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event(e)
	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress == nil or
			not self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.IsComplete then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent), 'on_time_conversion_changed_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
		self:setting_bug_table()
		self:register_callback_time_conversion()

		start_coroutine(self.create_flee_bug,self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_time_conversion_changed_event(e)
	self.is_in_time_change = false

	return true
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if not self.can_flee_bug then
		return true
	end

	if self.current_day_state == self.day_states.daylight then
		if self:check_pot_in_bug_table(e.FieldObject) then
			start_coroutine(self.flee_bug_routine, self, self:return_bug_pot_table(e.FieldObject))

			return true
		elseif self:check_pre_pot_in_bug_table(e.FieldObject) then
			start_coroutine(self.flee_bug_routine, self, self:return_pre_bug_pot_table(e.FieldObject))

			return true
		end


	end

	return false
end

function local_class:create_flee_bug()
	local flee_bug_table = {}

	for idx = 1, self.flee_bug_total_count do
		flee_bug_table[self.flee_bug_key .. idx] = 'dv_coward_bug'
	end

	self.flee_bugs = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(flee_bug_table)

	for idx = 1, self.flee_bug_total_count do
		local flee_bug = self.flee_bugs[self.flee_bug_key .. idx]
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(flee_bug, field_ui_type.character_stats)
		flee_bug.Position = self.marker.nowhere()
		field_object_util.set_active_state(flee_bug, active_state_type.disabled)
	end

end

function local_class:flee_bug_routine(bug_table)
	local pos = bug_table.pos
	local direction = bug_table.direction
	local jump = bug_table.jump

	if self.flee_bugs ~= nil then
		local flee_bug = self.flee_bugs[self.flee_bug_key .. self.flee_bug_cur_count]

		self.flee_bug_cur_count = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(self.flee_bug_cur_count + 1 > self.flee_bug_total_count,
				1, self.flee_bug_cur_count + 1)

		flee_bug.Position = pos
		field_object_util.set_active_state(flee_bug, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.stop(flee_bug)

		local move_duration = 1.5

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01', parent = flee_bug })

		scene_util.set_anim(flee_bug, self, 'walk')

		if jump then
			character_util.jump(flee_bug, 1.5, 0.5)
		end

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(flee_bug, 0, move_duration)

		wp_util.move_async(flee_bug, pos + direction, nil, move_duration)

		flee_bug.Position = self.marker.nowhere()
		field_object_util.set_active_state(flee_bug, active_state_type.disabled)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(flee_bug, 1, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
end

function local_class:setting_bug_table()
	self.bug_info_table = self.constants_data.main_bug
	self.bug_pot_table = {}
	for idx = 1, #self.bug_info_table do
		local bug_info = self.bug_info_table[idx]
		local pot = self.object.pot(bug_info.key)
		self.bug_pot_table[pot] = {
			pos = self.marker.pot_pos(bug_info.key),
			direction = bug_info.direction,
			jump = bug_info.jump
		}
	end

	self.pre_bug_info_table = self.constants_data.pre_bug
	self.pre_bug_pot_table = {}
	for idx = 1, #self.pre_bug_info_table do
		local pre_bug_info = self.pre_bug_info_table[idx]
		local pre_pot = self.object.pre_pot(pre_bug_info.key)
		self.pre_bug_pot_table[pre_pot] = {
			pos = self.marker.pre_pot_pos(pre_bug_info.key),
			direction = pre_bug_info.direction,
			jump = pre_bug_info.jump
		}
	end
end

--본편
function local_class:check_pot_in_bug_table(pot)
	return self.bug_pot_table[pot] ~= nil
end

function local_class:return_pos_in_bug_table(pot)
	return self.bug_pot_table[pot].pos
end

function local_class:return_bug_pot_table(pot)
	return self.bug_pot_table[pot]
end

--프리
function local_class:check_pre_pot_in_bug_table(pot)
	return self.pre_bug_pot_table[pot] ~= nil
end

function local_class:return_pre_bug_pot_table(pot)
	return self.pre_bug_pot_table[pot]
end

function local_class:register_callback_time_conversion()
	self.time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')
	self.time_conversion:register_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key, {
		-- 낮
		daylight = function()
			self.current_day_state = self.day_states.daylight
			self.is_in_time_change = true
			start_coroutine(self.setting_daylight, self)
		end,
		-- 밤
		night = function()
			self.current_day_state = self.day_states.night
			self.is_in_time_change = true
			start_coroutine(self.setting_night, self)
		end
	}, true)
end

function local_class:setting_daylight()
	start_coroutine(self.set_coward_daylight, self)
	character_util.stop_shake(self.npc.coward())

	if self.dynamic_bugs ~= nil then
		for idx = 1, #self.bug_info_table do
			local bug = self.dynamic_bugs['dynamic_bug_' .. idx]
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(bug, 0, 1)
		end
	end

	if self.pre_dynamic_bugs ~= nil then
		for idx = 1, #self.pre_bug_info_table do
			local bug = self.pre_dynamic_bugs['pre_dynamic_bug_' .. idx]
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(bug, 0, 1)
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	for i = 1, self.bug_pot_num do
		local target = self.object.pot(i)
		local animator = target:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		target.Position = self.marker.pot_pos(i)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.enabled)
		animator:Play('daylight', -1, 0)
	end

	for i = 1, self.pre_bug_pot_num do
		local target = self.object.pre_pot(i)
		local animator = target:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		target.Position = self.marker.pre_pot_pos(i)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.enabled)
		animator:Play('daylight', -1, 0)
	end

	while self.is_in_time_change do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.dynamic_bugs ~= nil then
		for idx = 1, #self.bug_location_table do
			local bug = self.dynamic_bugs['dynamic_bug_' .. idx]
			field_object_util.set_active_state(bug, active_state_type.disabled)
			bug.Position = self.marker.nowhere()
		end

	end

	if self.pre_dynamic_bugs ~= nil then
		for idx = 1, #self.pre_bug_info_table do
			local bug = self.pre_dynamic_bugs['pre_dynamic_bug_' .. idx]
			field_object_util.set_active_state(bug, active_state_type.disabled)
			bug.Position = self.marker.nowhere()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:setting_night()
	local coward = self.npc.coward()
	if self.current_pre_section_state == self.pre_section_states.in_first_meet then
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(coward)
	end

	start_coroutine(self.set_coward_night, self)

	character_util.shake(coward, 0.01, 9999)

	for i = 1, self.bug_pot_num do
		local target = self.object.pot(i)
		local animator = target:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		animator:Play('night', -1, 0)
	end

	for i = 1, self.pre_bug_pot_num do
		local target = self.object.pre_pot(i)
		local animator = target:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		animator:Play('night', -1, 0)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	start_coroutine(function()
		--한번만 생성하고 그 이후엔 활성화만
		if self.dynamic_bugs == nil then
			local dynamic_bug_table = {}
			for idx = 1, #self.bug_info_table do
				dynamic_bug_table['dynamic_bug_' .. idx] = 'dv_coward_bug'
			end

			self.dynamic_bugs = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(dynamic_bug_table)
		else
			for idx = 1, #self.bug_info_table do
				local bug = self.dynamic_bugs['dynamic_bug_' .. idx]
				field_object_util.set_active_state(bug, active_state_type.enabled)
			end
		end

		for idx = 1, #self.bug_info_table do
			local bug = self.dynamic_bugs['dynamic_bug_' .. idx]
			local marker = self.marker.pot_pos(self.bug_info_table[idx].key)

			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(bug, field_ui_type.character_stats)

			bug.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(bug, 0, 0)
			bug.Position = marker
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(bug, 1, 1)
		end
	end)

	start_coroutine(function()
		--한번만 생성하고 그 이후엔 활성화만
		if self.pre_dynamic_bugs == nil then
			local dynamic_bug_table = {}
			for idx = 1, #self.pre_bug_info_table do
				dynamic_bug_table['pre_dynamic_bug_' .. idx] = 'dv_coward_bug'
			end

			self.pre_dynamic_bugs = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(dynamic_bug_table)
		else
			for idx = 1, #self.pre_bug_info_table do
				local bug = self.pre_dynamic_bugs['pre_dynamic_bug_' .. idx]
				field_object_util.set_active_state(bug, active_state_type.enabled)
			end
		end

		for idx = 1, #self.pre_bug_info_table do
			local bug = self.pre_dynamic_bugs['pre_dynamic_bug_' .. idx]
			local marker = self.marker.pre_pot_pos(self.pre_bug_info_table[idx].key)

			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(bug, field_ui_type.character_stats)

			bug.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(bug, 0, 0)
			bug.Position = marker
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(bug, 1, 1)
		end
	end)

	while self.is_in_time_change do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 1, self.bug_pot_num do
		local target = self.object.pot(i)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.disabled)
	end

	for i = 1, self.pre_bug_pot_num do
		local target = self.object.pre_pot(i)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.disabled)
	end
end

function local_class:set_npc_by_list(npc_info_list)
	for name, info_list in pairs(npc_info_list) do
		local npc = nil
		local pos = info_list.pos
		local direction = info_list.direction
		local anim = info_list.anim
		local emotion = info_list.emotion
		local remove_anim_and_emotion = info_list.remove_anim_and_emotion
		local hide_weapon = info_list.hide_weapon
		local oneline = info_list.oneline
		local alpha = info_list.alpha
		local crash_behaviour = info_list.crash_behaviour
		local tint = info_list.tint
		local remove_tint = info_list.remove_tint

		if name == 'china_hero' then
			npc = user_util.get_china_hero_character('china_hero_boy', 'china_hero_girl')
		elseif name == 'knight' then
			npc = user_util.get_knight_character('knight_female', 'knight_male')
		elseif name == 'party_leader' then
			npc = get_party_leader()
		else
			npc = get_character(name)
		end

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)

		if pos ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
		end

		if direction ~= nil then
			character_util.set_direction(npc, direction)
		end

		if anim ~= nil then
			if type_util.is_table(anim) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, anim)
			else
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = anim, sfx_name = false, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if emotion ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, emotion)
		end

		if hide_weapon ~= nil then
			character_util.hide_weapon(npc, hide_weapon)
		end

		if remove_anim_and_emotion then
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		end

		if oneline ~= nil then
			if oneline == 'nil' then
				npc.Interactable.Talk = nil
			else
				npc.Interactable.Talk = oneline
			end
		end

		if alpha ~= nil then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, alpha, 0)
		end

		if crash_behaviour ~= nil then
			npc.CrashBehaviour = crash_behaviour
		end

		if tint ~= nil then
			character_util.add_color(npc, npc.name, tint.color, tint.magnitude, 0)
		end

		if remove_tint ~= nil then
			character_util.remove_color(npc, npc.name, 0)
		end

	end
end

function local_class:set_coward_daylight()
	local coward = self.npc.coward()
	field_object_util.set_active_state(coward, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.stop(coward)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(coward, 0, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_color(coward, coward.Name, 0)

	if self.current_pre_section_state == self.pre_section_states.first_meet_before then
		local pivot_pos = self.marker.coward_start_pos()

		coward.Position = pivot_pos
		coward.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		coward.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		character_util.set_direction(coward, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(coward, self, 'scared')
		scene_util.set_anim(coward, self, 'cast')

	elseif self.current_pre_section_state == self.pre_section_states.interact_before then
		local pivot_pos = self.marker.coward_start_pos()

		coward.Position = pivot_pos
		coward.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
		coward.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

		scene_util.set_direction(coward, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(coward, self, 'scared')
		scene_util.set_anim(coward, self, 'cast')

		character_util.add_listener(coward, self)

	elseif self.current_pre_section_state == self.pre_section_states.retry_activity then
		local pivot_pos = self.marker.coward_start_pos()

		coward.Position = pivot_pos + vector(-2.5, 0, 0)
		coward.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
		coward.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

		character_util.add_listener(coward, self)
		character_util.set_direction(coward, 'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion(coward, self, 'cry')
		scene_util.set_anim(coward, self, 'cast')
	elseif self.current_pre_section_state == self.pre_section_states.pre_section_end then
		local pivot_pos = self.marker.coward_start_pos()

		coward.Position = pivot_pos + vector(-3, 0, 0)
		coward.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
		coward.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

		character_util.add_listener(coward, self)
		character_util.set_direction(coward, 'right')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(coward)

	end

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(coward, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(coward, 1, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)
end

function local_class:set_coward_night()
	local coward = self.npc.coward()
	character_util.stop(coward)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(coward, 0, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(coward, active_state_type.disabled)
end

function local_class:return_is_in_party_twins_younger()
	return user_party:Contains(self.npc.twins_younger())
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageCowardPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = DreamVillageCoward @
		Comment = 겁쟁이 퀘스트 의뢰 전 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type DreamVillageCowardController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	--self.available_stage_names = {}

	self.npc = self.controller.npc
	self.marker = self.controller.marker
	self.zone_name = self.controller.zone_name

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.cached_leader = nil

	self.sp_controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent), 'on_time_conversion_changed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.cached_leader = self.controller.npc.knight()
	self.controller.current_pre_section_state = self.controller.pre_section_states.first_meet_before
	self:setting_on_start()

	local created, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.coward()) then
		if self.controller.current_pre_section_state == self.controller.pre_section_states.interact_before then
			start_coroutine(self.interact_coward, self)

			return true
		elseif self.controller.current_pre_section_state == self.controller.pre_section_states.interact_retry then
			start_coroutine(self.re_interact_coward, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.cached_leader, self.zone_name.start_zone) then
		self.controller.is_in_start_zone = true

		if self.controller.current_pre_section_state == self.controller.pre_section_states.first_meet_before and
				self.controller.current_day_state == self.controller.day_states.daylight then
			start_coroutine(self.enter_first_meet_zone, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, self.cached_leader, self.zone_name.start_zone) then
		self.controller.is_in_start_zone = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_time_conversion_changed_event(e)
	if self.controller.current_pre_section_state == self.controller.pre_section_states.first_meet_before and
			self.controller.current_day_state == self.controller.day_states.daylight and
			self.controller.is_in_start_zone then
		start_coroutine(self.enter_first_meet_zone, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:setting_on_start()
	local pivot_pos = self.marker.coward_start_pos()
	local npc_info_list = {
		--겁쟁이 (left, scared, cast)
		coward = {
			direction = 'left',
			emotion = 'scared',
			anim = 'cast',
			pos = pivot_pos,
		},
	}
	self.controller:set_npc_by_list(npc_info_list)

	self.npc.coward().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	self.controller.is_in_time_change = false
end

function local_class:enter_first_meet_zone()
	local coward = self.npc.coward()
	local pivot_pos = self.marker.coward_start_pos()

	self.controller.current_pre_section_state = self.controller.pre_section_states.in_first_meet

	--낮에 존에 진입하면 비강제 이벤트 시작
	--존 안에서 밤-> 낮 전환하게 되어도 NPC 나오며 연출 시작

	--겁쟁이 왼쪽으로 1타일 이동 - 속도 2 / async
	character_util.remove_anim(coward)
	wp_util.move_async(coward, pivot_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0), 2)

	if self.controller.current_day_state == self.controller.day_states.night or
			self.controller.is_in_time_change then
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(coward)
		self.controller.current_pre_section_state = self.controller.pre_section_states.first_meet_before
		return
	end

	--겁쟁이 (left, scared, cast) : 신입 신고식을 한다고…?
	scene_util.set_emotion(coward, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(coward, self, 'cast')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(coward, self, 'left',
			nil, nil,
			{ key = 'dv_sub_coward_s1_1', skip = false })

	if self.controller.current_day_state == self.controller.day_states.night or
			self.controller.is_in_time_change then
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(coward)
		self.controller.current_pre_section_state = self.controller.pre_section_states.first_meet_before
		return
	end

	--겁쟁이 오른쪽으로 1타일 이동 - 속도 2 / async
	character_util.remove_anim(coward)
	wp_util.move_async(coward, pivot_pos, 2)

	if self.controller.current_day_state == self.controller.day_states.night or
			self.controller.is_in_time_change then
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(coward)
		self.controller.current_pre_section_state = self.controller.pre_section_states.first_meet_before
		return
	end

	--겁쟁이 (right, scared, cast) : 도대체 뭐지? 기습? 요괴 토벌? 엄청난 양의 훈련…?
	scene_util.set_emotion(coward, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(coward, self, 'cast')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(coward, self, 'right',
			nil, nil,
			{ key = 'dv_sub_coward_s1_2', skip = false })

	if self.controller.current_day_state == self.controller.day_states.night or
			self.controller.is_in_time_change then
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(coward)
		self.controller.current_pre_section_state = self.controller.pre_section_states.first_meet_before
		return
	end

	--겁쟁이 (left, scared, cast) : 그냥 이대로 집에 갈까…
	scene_util.set_emotion(coward, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(coward, self, 'cast')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(coward, self, 'left',
			nil, nil,
			{ key = 'dv_sub_coward_s1_3', skip = false })

	if self.controller.current_day_state == self.controller.day_states.night or
			self.controller.is_in_time_change then
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(coward)
		self.controller.current_pre_section_state = self.controller.pre_section_states.first_meet_before
		return
	end

	--겁쟁이 (left, scared, cast) 인터랙트 가능 상태로 전환 + 머리 위로 퀘스트 마커 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(coward, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(coward, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(coward, self, 'cast')

	coward.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
	coward.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.add_listener(coward, self.controller)

	-- 비강제 이벤트 다 봤는지 체크
	self.controller.current_pre_section_state = self.controller.pre_section_states.interact_before
end

function local_class:interact_coward()
	local coward = self.npc.coward()
	local knight = self.npc.knight()
	local twins_younger = self.npc.twins_younger()

	--겁쟁이 기준
	local pivot_pos = self.marker.coward_start_pos()

	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	--컨트롤 뺏기며 bgm 볼륨 0.6으로 재생 / 믹스 디폴트	bgm_dreamvillage_day
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--이후 겁쟁이에 인터랙트시 정렬 후 이벤트 시작 - 정렬 1.5초
	--플레이어 위 이미지와 같이 정렬 - 1.5초
	local is_in_party_twins_younger = self.controller:return_is_in_party_twins_younger()

	if is_in_party_twins_younger then
		wp_util.move(knight, pivot_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.move_async(twins_younger, pivot_pos + vector(2, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })
	else
		wp_util.move_async(knight, pivot_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })
	end

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--기사 0.5타일 왼쪽 이동 - 속도 1
	if is_in_party_twins_younger then
		wp_util.move(twins_younger, pivot_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 0),
				1, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
	end
	wp_util.move_async(knight, pivot_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
			1, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--기사 (left, idle, gauntlet_idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'idle')
	character_util.remove_anim(knight)
	character_util.set_anim(knight, { name = 'gauntlet_idle' })

	--다음 동작 동시 실행
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--겁쟁이 대사 연출 시 / 카메라 shake 에 재생	03_dialogue_negative_01 + 01_evolution_01

				--겁쟁이 (left ,scared, embarrassed) : 끼야아아악!!!

						{ key = 'dv_sub_coward_s1_4', skip = false })
			end,
			function()
				--겁쟁이 (left ,scared, embarrassed)
				scene_util.set_direction(coward, 'left', false)

			end

	--겁쟁이 (left, scared, walk4legs 자세 유지) : 누누누누구냐?! 요괴?! 신고식?! 코 앞으로 다가온 죽음?!

			nil, 'scared', 'dv_sub_coward_s1_5')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_cry_02')

	do

		--카메라 shake (0.3,0.3)

		--카메라 shake (0.3,0.3)

	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--다음 동작 동시 실행
	do
		--카메라 값 2로 줌인 - 0초 (즉시 적용)
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(2, 0)

		--카메라 shake (0.3,0.3)
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

		--겁쟁이 (right, cry, push) : [shout] 어쩐지 세상을 구할 것 같은!

	--기사 (left, smile, victory_get)

	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(coward, self, 'right',

	else

		--기사 (right, sleep_deep, idle) - 1초

		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'sleep_deep')

		scene_util.set_emotion(coward, self, 'cry')

end

function local_class:re_interact_coward()

	local knight = self.npc.knight()
	local twins_younger = self.npc.twins_younger()

	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)

	--겁쟁이 (right, tired, cast) : 저랑 같이 도장에 가 주실건가요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(coward, self, 'right',
			'cast', 'tired', 'dv_sub_coward_s1_37')

	local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.cs_controller.QuestId, false)

	if accepted then

		--기사 (left, attack, release 2회)
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

		--겁쟁이 (right, smile, idle) : 앞장서서 가주시면 따라가겠습니다!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(coward, self, 'right',
				nil, 'smile', 'dv_sub_coward_s1_40')

		--서클로 페이드 아웃 - 1.5초
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black)

		self.controller.current_pre_section_state = self.controller.pre_section_states.pre_section_end
		self.controller:activate_quest()
	else

		--기사 (left, doyagao, bomb_idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'doyagao')
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'bomb_idle')

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

		--겁쟁이 (right, cry, cast) : 날 조롱하러 온 거에요? 너무해! 너무해!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(coward, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'cast', keep = true }, { name = 'cry', keep = true },
				'dv_sub_coward_s1_41')

		--플레이어 컨트롤 해제.
		--재인터랙트시 다시 여기서부터 진행

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, self.cached_leader)
	end
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageCowardSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DreamVillageCoward @
		Comment = @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type DreamVillageCowardController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = { 'dreamvillage_2' }

	self.npc = self.controller.npc

	self.cached_leader = nil

	self.marker = self.controller.marker

	self.object = self.controller.object

	self.zone_name = self.controller.zone_name

	self.get_star_piece = function()
		return get_field_object('coward_star_piece')
	end

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		in_activity = 5,
		retry_activity = 6,
		fail_activity = 7,
		success_activity = 8,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
		star_piece = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_in_character')
		end,

		electric_loop = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_electric_loop')
		end,

		electric_end = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_electric_end')
		end,

		thunderclap_flash_loop = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_thunderclap_flash_loop')
		end,

		dash_smoke = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Dash_Smoke')
		end,

		-- ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/effects
		erina_dash = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_erina_dash')
		end,

	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, creator in pairs(this) do
					creator()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	self.tc_progress_name = 'coward_daylight_progress'
	self.tc_cleared_name = 'coward_daylight_cleared'
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	local created, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)

	self.cached_leader = self.npc.knight()
	self.controller.current_pre_section_state = self.controller.pre_section_states.pre_section_end

	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		self.current_state = self.states.retry_activity
		self:setting_on_start()
	else
		self.current_state = self.states.in_activity
		start_coroutine(self.start_in_pre_section, self)
	end
end

function local_class:setting_on_start()
	local pivot_pos = self.marker.coward_start_pos() + vector(-3, 0, 0)

	local coward = self.npc.coward()
	coward.Position = pivot_pos
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(coward)
	character_util.set_direction(coward, 'right')

	coward.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
	character_util.add_listener(coward, self.controller)

	self.controller.is_in_time_change = false
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.retry_activity and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.coward()) then

		self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.re_re_interact_coward, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.in_activity and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.cached_leader, self.zone_name.success_zone) then
		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.success_activity, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.in_activity and
			self.controller:check_pot_in_bug_table(e.FieldObject) then
		self.current_state = self.states.fail_activity
		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.fail_activity, self, self.controller:return_pos_in_bug_table(e.FieldObject))
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:start_in_pre_section()
	-- 1섹션으로 옮겨야 액티비티 진행
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	self:setting_activity()
	sp_util.start_scene(self.start_activity, self)
end

function local_class:re_re_interact_coward()
	local knight = self.npc.knight()
	local coward = self.npc.coward()
	local twins_younger = self.npc.twins_younger()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--겁쟁이 기준
	local pivot_pos = coward.Position

	--겁쟁이에게 재인터랙트시 아래와 같이 정렬 - 1초
	if user_party:Contains(twins_younger) then
		wp_util.move(knight, pivot_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.move_async(twins_younger, pivot_pos + vector(2, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })
	else
		wp_util.move_async(knight, pivot_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })
	end

	--기사, 도화 (left, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)

	--겁쟁이 (right, tired, idle) : 괜찮으시면 다시 가볼까요…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(coward, self, 'right',
			nil, 'tired', 'dv_sub_coward_s1_47')

	--기사 선택지 출력
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--(mercy) 다시 가보자.
		{ 'dv_sub_coward_s1_48', 'mercy' },
		--(brutal) 벌레도 무서워하는 녀석이랑 어딜 갈 수 있겠어?
		{ 'dv_sub_coward_s1_49', 'brutal' },
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then

		--(mercy) 다시 가보자.

		--기사 (down, idle, release 2회)
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

		--서클로 페이드 아웃 - 1.5초
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black)

		--액티비티 실행
		self:setting_activity()
		self:start_activity()
	else
		--(brutal) 벌레도 무서워하는 녀석이랑 어딜 갈 수 있겠어?

		--기사 (left, tired, cross_arm) annoyed 이모티콘 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(knight, self, 'left',
				'cross_arm', 'tired', 'annoyed')

		--겁쟁이 (right, tired, idle) : 혹시라도 마음이 바뀌시면 돌아와 주세요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(coward, self, 'right',
				nil, 'tired', 'dv_sub_coward_s1_50')

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

		self.current_state = self.states.retry_activity

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
	end
end

function local_class:setting_activity()
	local pivot_pos = self.marker.pot_pos(2) + vector(0.5, 0, 2.5)

	--컨트롤러 단의 필드오브젝트 파괴 시 이벤트 비활성화
	self.controller.can_flee_bug = false

	self.current_state = self.states.in_activity

	-- 도화가 파티에 있었는지 체크 및 npc 화
	local twins_younger = self.npc.twins_younger()
	character_util.convert_to_npc(twins_younger)
	local success_pos = self.marker.success_pos() + vector(1, 0, 0)

function local_class:fail_activity(bug_spawn_pos)
	local knight = self.npc.knight()
	local coward = self.npc.coward()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	--액티비티 실패 연출
	self.current_state = self.states.fail_activity

	--장애물 브레이커블과 상호작용 (듦, 던짐, 깨짐)이 있을 경우에 바로 실패 처리.

	--플레이어 컨트롤 그 자리에서 빼앗음.

	--상호작용된 브레이커블 위치에서 벌레가 튀어나와 겁쟁이 머리 위로 0.5초간 점프하며 올라감.
	--벌레 스파인 생성 위치 : 상호 작용된 브레이커블이 놓여있던 위치.
	--벌레 스파인 목표 위치 : 겁쟁이 스파인 머리 위.
	self.dynamic_bug = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async({ dynamic_bug = 'dv_coward_bug' })
	local bug = self.dynamic_bug['dynamic_bug']
	bug.Position = bug_spawn_pos
	field_object_util.set_active_state(bug, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.jump(bug, 1, 0.5)
	wp_util.move_async(bug, coward.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0), nil, 0.5)

	--겁쟁이 (down, idle, idle) shake (0.01, 1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(coward)
	character_util.set_direction(coward, 'down')
	character_util.shake(coward, 0.01, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--기사 (겁쟁이 방향, idle, idle)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
	character_util.look_at(knight, coward)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--겁쟁이 (down, idle, idle) shake (0.03, 1) : 끼…
	character_util.shake(coward, 0.03, 1)
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(coward, self, 'down',
			'idle', 'idle',
			'dv_sub_coward_s1_42_1')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--다음 동작 동시 실행

	--겁쟁이 (down, scared, embarrassed) : [shout] 끼야아아아악!!! 벌레!!!!!!
	--화면 shake (0.3,1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 1)
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(coward, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'embarrassed', keep = true },
			{ name = 'scared', keep = true },
			'dv_sub_coward_s1_43')

	--겁쟁이 (down, scared, embarrassed) : [shout] 기생충 감염돼서 죽을거야!!!!
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(coward, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'embarrassed', keep = true },
			{ name = 'scared', keep = true },
			'dv_sub_coward_s1_44')


	--CODE : 임의 처리. muted 추가.

	--페이드 아웃과 함께 재생	01_drown_01
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')

	--서클로 페이드 아웃 - 1.5초
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	if self.dynamic_bug ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.dynamic_bug)
		self.dynamic_bug = nil
	end

	camera_util.move_async(self.marker.coward_start_pos(), 0.1)

	--액티비티 이전으로 원복
	self:setting_fail_activity()

	--CODE : 임의 처리. 0.6으로 재생
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0.6 })

	--이후 서클로 페이드 인 되며 아래 위치로 정렬
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	--겁쟁이 (down, tired, idle) : 죄송해요. 기껏 같이 가주셨는데..
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(coward, self, 'down',
			'idle', 'tired', 'dv_sub_coward_s1_45')

	--겁쟁이 (down, tired, idle) : 벌레가 어디 있는지 미리 알고 피할 수 있다면 좋을텐데…

			nil, 'tired', 'dv_sub_coward_s1_46')

	scene_util.set_direction(coward, 'right', false)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--CODE: 임의 처리. 필드 불륨 1로 복귀.
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	self.current_state = self.states.retry_activity
	-- 밤/낮 버튼 활성화
	self.controller.time_conversion:conversion_active_setting(true)

	-- 밤/낮 버튼 활성화
	self.controller.time_conversion:conversion_active_setting(true)
	self.controller.time_conversion:unregister_callback(self.controller.time_conversion_event_key)

		self.master_book:create()

	local leader = self.get_leader()
	local ch_postfix = self.get_appendix_to_china_hero()

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(china_hero, self, nil,

		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(info.marker_name)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)

		character_util.set_direction(npc, info.dir)
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, info.emo)
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, info.anim)

			npc.Interactable.Talk = info.oneline
		end

		if info.listener then
			character_util.add_listener(npc, self)
		end
	end

			--이후 컨트롤 복귀
			self.current_state = self.states.before_muin_interact

			quest_icon_util.set_substage_icon(muin)

			return
		end

--무인 npc 5초 간격으로 원라인 출력
function local_class:muin_routine()
	if self.alive then
		self.is_ask = true
	else
		start_coroutine(self.eco_routine, self)
	end
end

function local_class:eco_routine()
	local muin = self.npc.muin()
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 3
	local toggle = true

	self.alive = true
	self.is_ask = true
	while not self.stage_end and self.is_ask do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		if time_passed < duration then
			local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

			time_passed = time_passed + dt
		else
			--무인은 대사 출력될 때마다 shake (0.02, 1초) 출력
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', parent = muin, loop = false })
			character_util.shake(muin, 0.02, 1)

			if toggle then
				--거기 누구 계시오?
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(muin, { key = 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_pre_1', skip = false })
			else
				--거 아무도 없소?
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(muin, { key = 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_pre_0', skip = false })
			end

			toggle = not toggle

			time_passed = time_passed - duration
		end
	end

	self.alive = false

	--스크린 플레이 상태가 아니면 remove
	if self.current_state ~= self.states.after_muin_interact then
		character_util.stop_shake(muin)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(muin)
	end
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	local npc_data = {
		sub_cyborg_muin = {
			dir = 'right',
			emo = 'sleep_deep',
			anim = 'prostrate',
			marker_name = 'sub_cyborg_pre_center_pos',
			offset = vector(3, 0, 10),
			listener = true,
		},
	}

	--npc
	self.controller:set_by_npc_data(npc_data)

	local muin = self.npc.muin()
	quest_icon_util.set_substage_icon(muin)
end

return local_class

			return user_util.get_china_hero_character('china_hero_boy', 'china_hero_girl')
		end,
		oneline = function(num)
			return get_character('s1_oneline_' .. num)
		end,
		guard = function(num)
			return get_character('s1_guard_npc_' .. num)
		end,
	}

	self.gimmick = {
		fake_exit = function()
			return get_field_object('s1_fake_exit')
		end,
		exit = function()
			return get_field_object('s1_house_outer_exit')
		end,
	}

	self.states = {
		before_entrance_enter = 1,
		before_oneline_enter = 2,
		before_exit_interact = 3,
		after_exit_interact = 4,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_entrance_enter

	self.appendix = ''
	self.stage_end = false

	self.patrol = self.controller.patrol
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
	--marker
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_enter_center_pos') },
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_exit_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gimmick.fake_exit()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.after_exit_interact
		sp_util.start_scene(self.exit_interact_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_entrance_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's1_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_oneline_enter
		sp_util.start_scene(self.china_hero_enter_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.before_oneline_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's1_oneline_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_exit_interact
		start_coroutine(self.oneline_enter_routine, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.stage_end = true
end

function local_class:exit_interact_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local china_hero = self.npc.get_china_hero()
	local npc_1 = self.patrol:get(16)
	local npc_2 = self.patrol:get(17)

	local appendix = self.appendix

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.7, 'linear')

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--set
	do
		--exit
		local exit = self.gimmick.exit()
		local reposition = exit.Interactable.OpenExitInfo.RePosition

		exit.Position = reposition

		--가짜 exit 제거
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.gimmick.fake_exit(), active_state_type.disabled)

		--player
		local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('door_exit_outer_pos')

		leader.Position = center_pos
		china_hero.Position = center_pos
		scene_util.set_group_direction({ leader, china_hero }, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_group_emotion({ leader, china_hero }, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_group_anim({ leader, china_hero }, self, 'walk4legs')

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(leader, 0, 0)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(china_hero, 0, 0)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc_1, active_state_type.enabled)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc_2, active_state_type.enabled)

		character_util.set_direction(npc_1, direction_constants.right)
		character_util.set_direction(npc_2, direction_constants.right)

		npc_1.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('patrol_4_1')
		npc_2.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('patrol_4_2')

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	end

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

					leader.Direction = direction_constants.left
					china_hero.Direction = direction_constants.right

					scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
					scene_util.set_emotion(china_hero, self, 'tired')

					--선산권사 (left, tired, bomb_idle)
					--유저 선택 [페이] : 땅이 울릴 때를 조심해야 돼. 움직이면 또 다시 발차기가 날라 올거요.
					--유저 선택 [메이] : 땅이 울릴 때를 조심해야 돼. 움직이면 또 다시 발차기가 날라 올거요.
					scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(china_hero, self, 'right',
							'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_12_1' .. self.china_hero_postfix)

					--선산권사 (left, tired, idle)
					--유저 선택 [페이] : 물건을 던져서 발차기를 유도하거나, 최대한 안 들키게 이동해야 하오.
					--유저 선택 [메이] : 물건을 던져서 유인하거나, 최대한 안 들키게 이동해야 돼.
					scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(china_hero, self, 'right',
							'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_12_2' .. self.china_hero_postfix)

					character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

					--이후 컨트롤 해제
					sp_util.exit_scene(nil, self.get_leader())

					return
				else
					--안 맞은 경우 10의 속도로 이동
					--벽 위로 넘어서 날아가기 가능
					blind.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(this.str, this.des, this.time_passed / this.duration)
				end

				----존 벗어나면 이동 끝났으니까 엎드림 상태로
				if this.time_passed >= this.duration then
					--화면 shake 0.3 세기로 0.5초간 출력
					camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)

					--fx_common_smokescreen출력
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wolf_boss_bomb_01')
					self.fx.common_smokescreen():Instantiate(blind.Position)

					blind.SpineController.TimeScale = 1

					--y축 0으로 조정
					blind.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(blind.Position, 0)

					--0.3초 이후 (진행 방향, idle, sleep) 출력
					wait_for_sec(0.3)
					scene_util.set_anim(blind, self, 'sleep')

					self.blind_event:change_state(self.blind_states.down)
				end
			end,

			enter = function(this)
				local leader = self.get_leader()
				local blind = self.get_blind()
				local china_hero = self.get_china_hero()

				--이모션 다시 설정
				scene_util.set_emotion(blind, self, 'attack')

				-- 걸린 애가 누구인가(브레이커블, 리더 중)
				if self.blind_event.breakable.crashed_fo then
					this.target = self.blind_event.breakable.crashed_fo
				else
					this.target = leader
				end

				self.blind_event.breakable.crashed_fo = nil

				--(breakable이 던져진 방향 or  플레이어 위치를 바라보며
				--(right/left), attack, gauntlet_kick2 출력 후 0.3초에서 정지)
				this.dir_vec = vector_util.get_x0z(vector_util.normalized(this.target.Position - blind.Position))

				if this.dir_vec.x < 0 then
					blind.Direction = direction_constants.left
				else
					blind.Direction = direction_constants.right
				end

				if this.target == leader then
					--플레이어 움직일 시 적발 연출
					--동시 연출
					sp_util.enter_scene()

					--카메라 shake 0.1세기로 0.3초간 출력
					camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

					--플레이어, 선산권사 1회 normal_jump
					character_util.normal_jump(leader)
					character_util.normal_jump(china_hero)

					--플레이어, 선산권사 (이진 방향, surprise, idle) 출력
					character_util.look_at(leader, blind)
					character_util.look_at(china_hero, blind)

					scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
					scene_util.set_emotion(china_hero, self, 'surprise')

					--플레이어 포커스로 카메라 5 크기로 0.3초에 걸쳐서 줌인
					camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 0.3)
					camera_util.move_async(leader.Position, 0.3)

					--플레이어 중심으로 이진이 위치한 방향에 shout 말풍선 1.5 크기로 한 번에 출력
					--1.5초간 출력
					--거기구나!!!
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

					if screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(blind.Position) then
						scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(blind, self.blind_event.speech_prefix .. 4,
								false, { scale = 1.5, life_time = 1.5 })
					else
						--리신을 향한 방향 벡터 크기 0.35로 정상화
						--viewport_pos 중앙이 (0.5, 0.5) 이기 때문에, 거기서 0.3 크기의 방향 벡터를 더한 위치를 말풍선의 출력 위치로 삼는다
						--화면 밖으로 안나가고 리신 위치에 따라 말풍선 출력하려고 함
						local vec = vector_util.normalized(blind.Position - leader.Position) * 0.35

						scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(blind, self.blind_event.speech_prefix .. 4,
								false, { scale = 1.5, life_time = 1.5,
								viewport_pos = vector(0.5 + vec.x, 0.5 + vec.z) })
					end

					--걸린 경우: 대사 한 번에 출력: 이쿠우우우우!!!
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
					speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(blind, { key = self.blind_event.speech_prefix .. 5,
																   skip = false, type_speed = 0 })
				elseif self.blind_event.breakable:contains(this.target) then
					--브레이커블 던진 경우: 랜덤으로 아래 대사 한 번에 출력
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')

					local idx = random_util.get_random_int(6, 8)
					speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(blind, { key = self.blind_event.speech_prefix .. idx,
																   skip = false })
				end

				--연출 시작 후 0.3초 뒤 y축 0.5로 조정
				scene_util.set_emotion(blind, self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim(blind, self, 'gauntlet_kick2')

				wait_for_sec(0.3)

				blind.SpineController.TimeScale = 0

				character_util.set_position(blind, vector_util.get_x0z(blind.Position, 0.5), true)

				do
					local zone = field_util.get_zone(self.blind_event.zone_name)
					local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_blindman')
					local speed = 15

					-- 목적지 구하기
					this.str = blind.Position

					if this.target == leader then
						this.des = leader.Position
					elseif self.blind_event.breakable:contains(this.target) then
						this.des = this.cal_zone_border_pos(blind.Position, center_pos, zone.Bounds.extents, this.dir_vec)
					end

					this.duration = (this.des - this.str).magnitude / speed
				end
			end,

			exit = function(this)
				this.time_passed = 0
				this.str = nil
				this.des = nil
				this.target = nil
				this.dir_vec = unity_class.vector3.zero
				this.is_hit = false
				this.is_enter_zone = false
			end,
		},

		---@class BlindStateFall
		down = {
			update = function(dt)
				local blind = self.get_blind()

				--동시 연출, 끝날 때가지 대기
				do
					--fx_common_smokescreen 출력 끝나면 shake 0.03세기로 0.3초간 출력, 끝날 때 까지 대기
					wait_for_sec(1.7)
					field_object_util.shake(blind, 0.03, 0.3)

					--이후 (진행 방향, idle, jump) 상태로 normal_jump 출력 후 (진행 방향, idle, idle) 상태 출력
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
					character_util.remove_emotion(blind)
					scene_util.set_anim(blind, self, 'jump')
					character_util.normal_jump_async(blind)

					--이후 ‘기본 자세’로 전환
					self.blind_event:change_state(self.blind_states.idle)
				end
			end,

			enter = function()

			end,

			exit = function()

			end,
		}
	}

	self.blind_event = {
		cur_state = self.blind_states.idle,

		speech_prefix = 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_blind_event_',
		zone_name = 's2_blind_event',

		breakable = {
			count = 10,

			prefix = 's2_blind_breakable_',

			crashed_fo = nil,

			get = function(this, idx)
				return get_field_object(this.prefix .. idx)
			end,

			contains = function(this, fo)
				if this.hashset == nil then
					this.hashset = create_lua_hashset()

					for idx = 1, this.count do
						this.hashset:add(get_field_object(this.prefix .. idx))
					end
				end

				return this.hashset:contains(fo)
			end,

			reset = function(this)
				for idx = 1, this.count do
					local fo = this:get(idx)

					-- 나가기 연출에 브레이커블 들고가서 연출 중에 떨어진 경우 등, (우선 해당 상황에서 브레이커블 안들도록 수정은 했으나)
					-- 다음에 다시 들어왔을 때 해당 브레이커블이 던져진 쪽으로 바로 킥이 드가므로 캐싱된 브레이커블 오브젝트 제거
					this.crashed_fo = nil

					-- 위치와 상태 리셋
					message_system:SendSync(fo, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
				end
			end
		},

		change_state = function(this, next_state)
			this.cur_state:exit()

			this.cur_state = next_state

			if next_state then
				next_state:enter()
			end
		end,

		reset = function(this)
			local blind = self.get_blind()
			local leader = self.get_leader()
			local china_hero = self.get_china_hero()

			--나감 처리
			self.current_state = self.states.before_blind_event_restart

			--0.75초에 걸쳐 circular fade in 되며 a 위치에서 재시작
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
			screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.75, 'linear')

			this.breakable:reset()

			--1.5초 대기
			wait_for_sec(1.5)

			blind.SpineController.TimeScale = 1

			do
				local respawn_pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_blind_respawn')

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(china_hero)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(blind)

				leader.Direction = direction_constants.left
				china_hero.Direction = direction_constants.right

				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
				scene_util.set_emotion(china_hero, self, 'tired')

				leader.Position = respawn_pivot + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.5
				china_hero.Position = respawn_pivot + unity_class.vector3.left * 0.5

				camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
			end

			camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
			self.walk_buff:remove(leader)
			self.walk_buff:remove(china_hero)

			--FIXME
			self.dash_buff:remove(leader)
			self.dash_buff:remove(china_hero)

			leader.CustomRunAnimationName = self.custom_run_animation_name

			stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(leader)

			local blind_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_blindman')
			blind.Position = blind_pos

			blind.Direction = direction_constants.left
			scene_util.set_anim(blind, self, 'seat')
			character_util.remove_emotion(blind)

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 1 })

			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.75, 'linear')

			character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
			character_util.remove_emotion(china_hero)
		end,
	}

	self.fx = {
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		lasthit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
		common_smokescreen = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_smokescreen')
		end
	}
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor(self.fx):load_async()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExitInteractTeleportStartEvent), 'on_exit_interact_teleport_start_event')

	start_coroutine(self.patrol.init, self.patrol)

	do
		local master = self.get_master()

		master.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_master_master')
		field_object_util.set_active_state(master, active_state_type.enabled)

		master.Direction = direction_constants.right
		scene_util.set_anim(master, self, 'eat')
	end

	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		local guard_1 = self.get_guard(1)
		local guard_2 = self.get_guard(2)

		local align_pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_guard_oneline_pivot')

		guard_1.Position = align_pivot + vector(-1, 0, 0)
		guard_2.Position = align_pivot + vector(0.5, 0, 0)

		guard_1.Direction = direction_constants.right
		guard_2.Direction = direction_constants.left

		field_object_util.set_active_state(guard_1, active_state_type.enabled)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(guard_2, active_state_type.enabled)
	end

	self.current_state = self.states.before_guard_oneline
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = get_field_object('master_house_entrance_outer') },
		{ zone = 'meditation_house_field', target = get_field_object('meditation_house_exit_inner') },
		{ zone = 'record_house_field', target = get_field_object('record_house_exit_inner') },
		{ zone = 'tunnel_field', target = get_field_object('tunnel_stair_outer_exit') },
		{ zone = 'storage_field', target = get_field_object('s1_house_outer_exit') },
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExitInteractTeleportStartEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

	self.current_state = self.states.done
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_guard_oneline and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_leader(), 's2_guard_oneline') then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_block_encounter

		start_coroutine(self.guard_oneline, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.before_block_encounter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_leader(), 's2_block_encounter') then
		self.current_state = self.states.in_block_encounter

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self:block_encounter_scene()

			self.current_state = self.states.before_blind_encounter
		end)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_leader(), 's2_blind_encounter') then
		--첫 진입
		if self.current_state == self.states.before_blind_encounter then
			self.current_state = self.states.in_blind_encounter

			sp_util.start_scene(function()
				self:blind_encounter_scene()

				self.current_state = self.states.before_blind_event_start
			end)

			return true
			--두번째, 세번째 이후 진입
		elseif (self.current_state == self.states.before_blind_event_start or
				self.current_state == self.states.before_blind_event_restart) then
			local is_restart = self.current_state == self.states.before_blind_event_restart

			self.current_state = self.states.in_blind_event_start

			start_coroutine(function()
				sp_util.enter_scene()
				--재시작이고, 들어가지 않는 것을 선택한 경우에는 false
				if self:blind_event_start_scene(is_restart) then
					self.current_state = self.states.in_blind_event

					sp_util.exit_scene(nil, self.get_leader())

					self:blind_event_routine()
				else
					self.current_state = self.states.before_blind_event_restart

					sp_util.exit_scene(nil, self.get_leader())
				end
			end)

			return true
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.in_blind_event and
			not (self.blind_event.cur_state == self.blind_states.kick and
			self.blind_states.kick.is_hit == true) then
		--이벤트 구역을 떠날 때 & 발차기 당해서 지나치는 경우 제외
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_leader(), 's2_blind_leave') then
			self.current_state = self.states.in_blind_event_leave

			sp_util.start_scene(function()
				-- 나가는 것을 선택했는지
				if self:blind_event_leave_scene() then
					self.current_state = self.states.before_blind_event_restart

					self.blind_event:reset()
				else
					self.current_state = self.states.in_blind_event
				end
			end)

			return true
			-- 성공 위치에 도달했을때
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_leader(), 's2_blind_success') then
			self.current_state = self.states.in_blind_event_success

			sp_util.start_scene(function()
				self:blind_event_success_scene()

				self.current_state = self.states.before_meet_master
			end)

			return true
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.before_meet_master then
		if self.controller.is_in_try_go_back == false and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_leader(), 's2_blind_wrong') then
			-- 다시 클리어한 이벤트 장소로 가려고 할 때
			self.controller.is_in_try_go_back = true

			sp_util.start_scene(function()
				self.controller:try_go_back_scene()

				self.controller.is_in_try_go_back = false
			end)

			return true
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_leader(), 's2_master') then
			-- 문주 집으로 갔을때
			self.current_state = self.states.in_meet_master

			sp_util.start_scene(function()
				self:meet_master_scene()

				self.controller:progress_section()
			end)

			return true
		end
		--문주가 탈출하는 시점
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.in_meet_master and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_master(), 's2_master_escape') then
		self.is_master_reached = true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if not self.patrol.is_in_fail_scene and
			e:GetParamAt(0) == self.patrol.detected_key then
		self.patrol.is_in_fail_scene = true

		local patrol = get_character(e:GetParamAt(1))

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self.patrol:fail_scene(patrol)

			self.patrol.is_in_fail_scene = false
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	--브레이커블 터질 때, 기본 ~ 경계 상태면
	if self.blind_event.breakable:contains(e.FieldObject) and
			self.current_state == self.states.in_blind_event and
			(self.blind_event.cur_state == self.blind_states.idle or
			self.blind_event.cur_state == self.blind_states.idle_to_aware or
			self.blind_event.cur_state == self.blind_states.aware) then
		-- 터진 fo에 등록
		self.blind_event.breakable.crashed_fo = e.FieldObject
	end
end

function local_class:on_exit_interact_teleport_start_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_meet_master and
			e.ExitHandleName == 'master_house_entrance_outer' then

		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
			{ zone = 'main_field', target = get_field_object('master_house_entrance_outer') },
			{ zone = 'meditation_house_field', target = get_field_object('meditation_house_exit_inner') },
			{ zone = 'record_house_field', target = get_field_object('record_house_exit_inner') },
			{ zone = 'tunnel_field', target = get_field_object('tunnel_stair_outer_exit') },
			{ zone = 'storage_field', target = get_field_object('s1_house_outer_exit') },
			{ zone = 'master_house_field', target = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_master_align') }
		})

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:guard_oneline()
	local guard_1 = self.get_guard(1)
	local guard_2 = self.get_guard(2)

	--3번 NPC (right, idle, idle): 야 그거 들었냐?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(guard_1, self, 'right',
			nil, nil,
			{ key = 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_oneline_1', skip = false })

	--3번 NPC (right, idle, idle): 지금 외출나갔다가 안 돌아온 애들만 13명이야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(guard_1, self, 'right',
			nil, nil,
			{ key = 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_oneline_2', skip = false })

	--4번 NPC (left, tired, crsoos_arm): 진짜 그 소문이 맞나?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(guard_2, self, 'left',
			'cross_arm', { name = 'tired', keep = true },
			{ key = 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_oneline_4', skip = false })

	--3번 NPC (right, idle, idle): 인체 실험 소문?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(guard_1, self, 'right',
			nil, nil,
			{ key = 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_oneline_5', skip = false })

	--4번 NPC (left, tired, idle): 아니겠지…? 괜히 불안하네….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(guard_2, self, 'left',
			nil, nil,
			{ key = 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_oneline_6', skip = false })

	--3번 NPC (right, attack, bomb_idle): 뭐가 문제야, 무슨 일이 생기면 바로 무공으로 처리하면 되잖아.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(guard_1, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'bomb_idle', keep = true },
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			{ key = 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_oneline_6_1', skip = false })

	--4번 NPC (right, tired, bomb_idle): 으… 수련 안하고도 강해지고 싶다. 그런 일 안 당하게….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(guard_2, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', nil,
			{ key = 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_oneline_7', skip = false })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guard_1)

	--이후 3번, 4번 NPC 위로 3의 속도로 (walk) 이동
	--카메라 그리드에서 사라지면 제거
	do
		local key = 's2_oneline_key'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(guard_1,
				screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('up', guard_1.Position),
				3, nil, self,
				key)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(guard_2,
				screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('up', guard_2.Position),
				3, nil, self,
				key)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, key)
	end

	field_object_util.set_active_state(guard_1, active_state_type.disabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(guard_2, active_state_type.disabled)
end

function local_class:blind_encounter_scene()
	local blind = self.get_blind()
	local china_hero = self.get_china_hero()
	local leader = self.get_leader()
	local ch_postfix = self.china_hero_postfix
	local align_pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_blind_encounter_pivot')

	--이진 (down, sleep_deep, seat)
	--위 빨간 존 진입 시 강제 이벤트 진행
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	--선산권사 (right, attack, idle) 말풍선 크기 0.7배로 출력
	--유저 선택 [페이] : 사제…! 잠시 이리로!
	--유저 선택 [메이] : 사제…! 잠시 이리로!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(china_hero, self, 'right',
			nil, 'attack', {
				key = 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_2' .. ch_postfix,
				scale = 0.7,
				skip = true
			})

	--플레이어 위와 같이 정렬
	--도착하면 카메라 0.3초에 걸쳐 플레이어, 선산권사 중간으로 포커스 이동
	--(이동 방향, idle, walk)
	--2의 속도
	--도착하자 마자 정렬
	do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, align_pivot + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.5, 2,
				nil, self)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(china_hero, align_pivot + unity_class.vector3.left * 0.5, 2,
				nil, self)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

		--선산권사 (right, idle, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(china_hero, 'right', false)

		--플레이어 (left, idle, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)

		camera_util.move_async(align_pivot, 0.3)
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--선산권사 (right, idle, idle)
	--유저 선택 [페이] : 저기 안에 있는 무인 보이시오?
	--유저 선택 [메이] : 저기 안에 있는 무인 보여?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(china_hero, 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_3' .. ch_postfix)

	--플레이어 (left, idle, idle) 상태, (question) 이모티콘 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'question')

	--플레이어 (right, idle, idle)출력
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', true)

	--0.2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 이진 포커스로 이동, 끝날 때까지 대기
	camera_util.move_async(blind.Position, 1)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 선산권사, 플레이어 중간으로 포커스 이동
	camera_util.move_async(align_pivot, 1)

	--0.2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--플레이어 (left, idle, idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', true)

	--0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--플레이어 (left, idle, nod 2회)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	--선산권사(right, idle, idle)
	--유저 선택 [페이] : 저 자는 맹인 무인, 이진이라 하네.
	--유저 선택 [메이] : 저 자는 맹인 무인, 이진이라는 사람이야.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(china_hero, 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_4' .. ch_postfix)

	--선산권사(right, idle, bomb_idle)
	--유저 선택 [페이] : 과거 무술대회에서 합을 겨룬 적이 있지...
	--유저 선택 [메이] : 과거 무술대회에서 합을 겨룬 적이 있지…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(china_hero, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_5' .. ch_postfix)

	--선산권사(right, idle, question)
	--유저 선택 [페이] : 이 문파에 몸을 담고 있는 줄은 몰랐군.
	--유저 선택 [메이] : 이 문파에 몸을 담고 있는 줄은 물랐어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(china_hero, self, 'right',
			'question', nil, 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_7' .. ch_postfix)

	--선산권사(right, idle, idle)
	--유저 선택 [페이] : 저자는 극도로 발달된 청각으로 무공을 사용하는 고수라오.
	--유저 선택 [메이] : 저자는 극도로 발달된 청각으로 무공을 사용하는 고수야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(china_hero, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_7_1' .. ch_postfix)

	--선산권사 (right,  tired, cross_arm)
	--유저 선택 [페이] : 쉽게 따돌리고 들어가긴 힘들 것 같은데….
	--유저 선택 [메이] : 쉽게 따돌리고 들어가긴 힘들 것 같은데….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(china_hero, self, 'right',
			'cross_arm', 'tired', 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_8' .. ch_postfix)

	--선산권사 (right, idle, idle)
	--유저 선택 [페이]: 잘 들으시오, 사제.
	--유저 선택 [메이]: 사제, 잘 들어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(china_hero, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_8_0' .. ch_postfix)

	local is_explain_end = false

	while not is_explain_end do
		--선산권사 (right, idle, idle)
		--유저 선택 [페이] : 그는 작은 소리도 놓치지 않소. <b>움직이면 우리를 인식할 거요.</b>
		--유저 선택 [메이] : 그는 작은 소리도 놓치지 않아. <b>움직이면 우리를 인식할 거야.</b>
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(china_hero, 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_8_1' .. ch_postfix)

		--선산권사(right, idle, idle)
		--유저 선택 [페이] : 공격 준비에 들어가면 <b>땅이 울리니 그때는 움직임을 멈추시오.</b>
		--유저 선택 [메이] : 공격 준비에 들어가면 <b>땅이 울리니까 그때는 멈춰야 해.</b>
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(china_hero, 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_9' .. ch_postfix)

		--선산권사(right, idle, idle)
		--유저 선택 [페이] : 아니면… <b>물건을 던져서 혼란을 주고 이동</b>하는 것도 좋겠군.
		--유저 선택 [메이] : 아니면… <b>물건을 던져서 혼란을 주고 이동</b>해도 좋겠네.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(china_hero, 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_9_1' .. ch_postfix)

		--플레이어 선택지
		do
			local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
				{ 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_choose_1', 'mercy' },
				{ 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_choose_2', 'forced' }
			})

			if result == 1 then
				--(mercy) 좋아. 가보자.
				--선택 시 컨트롤 복귀
				is_explain_end = true
			else
				--(normal) 한 번만 더 설명해 줘.
				--선택 시 아래 대사부터 다시 출력
			end
		end
	end

	--플레이어 (left, idle, nod 2회)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:blind_event_start_scene(is_restart)
	local leader = self.get_leader()
	local china_hero = self.get_china_hero()
	local blind = self.get_blind()
	local align_pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_blind_start_pivot')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	--재진입일 경우
	--위 빨간 1번 네모 진입 시 선택지 등장
	--(brutal) 물러난다.
	--플레이어, 선산권사 뒷걸음질로 1초간 1타일 이동
	--이후 컨트롤 복귀
	if is_restart then
		local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_choose_5', 'mercy' },
			{ 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_choose_6', 'brutal' }
		})

		--(mercy) 진입한다.
		--이벤트 시작 연출 진행 [월드 20] 사이보그 권법 서브 스테이지 기획서

		if result == 2 then
			--(brutal) 물러난다.
			--플레이어, 선산권사 뒷걸음질로 1초간 1타일 이동
			do
				local move_pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter('s2_blind_encounter',
						leader, 'left', 1)
				local diff = china_hero.Position - leader.Position

				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, move_pos,
						nil, 1, self,
						nil,{ locked_dir = 'right' })

				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(china_hero, move_pos + diff,
						nil, 1, self,
						nil,{ locked_dir = 'right' })

				wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

				music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

				return false
			end
		end
	end

	--이진 이벤트 진행
	--위 1번 빨간 네모에 진입하면 이벤트 시작 연출 진행
	--(right, idle, walk)
	--1의 속도
	--위치 도착하면 연출 진행
	do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, align_pivot + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.5, 1,
				nil, self)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(china_hero, align_pivot + unity_class.vector3.left * 0.5, 1,
				nil, self)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	if not is_restart then
		--플레이어, 선산권사 (right, scared, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'scared')
		scene_util.set_direction(china_hero, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(china_hero, self, 'scared')

		--아래 위치에 말풍선 출력
		--발소리를 듣자 하니… 본문 사제가 아니군.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_03')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(china_hero, 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_11', true,
				{ viewport_pos = vector(0.7, 0.7) })
	end

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 이진 포커스로 이동, 끝날 때까지 대기
	camera_util.move_async(blind.Position, 1)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if not is_restart then
		--이진 (left, idle, idle): 누군진 모르겠으나, 이쪽으로 온 걸 후회하게 될 거요.
		character_util.remove_anim(blind)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(blind, self, 'left',
				nil, nil,
				'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_12')

		--동시 출력
		--이진 (left, nil, gauntlet_handskill2, gauntlet_combo_attack, gauntlet_handskill3, gauntlet_kick 차례로 출력)
		--이진 포커스로 카메라 1초에 걸쳐 3.8의 크기로 줌인, 끝날 때까지 대기
		--위 두 연출 끝날때까지 대기
		do
			blind.Direction = direction_constants.left

			camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.8, 1)

			local anims = {
				'gauntlet_handskill2',
				'gauntlet_combo_attack',
				'gauntlet_handskill3',
				'gauntlet_kick'
			}

			local sounds = {
				'03_dialogue_china_01',
				nil,
				nil,
				'01_china_master_shout_01'
			}

			for i = 1, #anims do
				local sfx = sounds[i]

				if sfx then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(sfx)
				end

				scene_util.set_anim_async(blind, self, { name = anims[i], loop = false })
			end
		end

		--0.5초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(blind)

	--이진 (left, idle, idle): 청각을 넓히시오.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(blind, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_13')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(china_hero)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_china_drum_01')
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(6.5, 0.5)

	--최초 이진 위치에서 z축 +1 위치에 고정
	camera_util.move_async(blind.Position + unity_class.vector3.up, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_run', volume = 0.7 })

	--플레이어 컨트롤 가능 상태 돌입되며 명상원 이벤트 진행
	return true
end

function local_class:blind_event_routine()
	local leader = self.get_leader()
	local china_hero = self.get_china_hero()

	--이벤트 중 달리기, 공격 금지 상태
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	--걷기 속도 2의 속도
	self.walk_buff:add(leader)

	self.blind_event.cur_state = self.blind_states.idle
	self.blind_event.cur_state:enter()

	--FIXME: 달리기 속도 임시로 2로 조절
	self.dash_buff:add(leader)

	self.custom_run_animation_name = CS.Oak.CharacterExtensions.GetCustomRunAnimation(leader)
	self.custom_walk_animation_name = CS.Oak.CharacterExtensions.GetCustomWalkAnimation(leader)
	leader.CustomRunAnimationName = self.custom_walk_animation_name

	stage.SmokeManager:UnsetCharacterSmoke(leader)

	while self.current_state == self.states.in_blind_event or
			self.current_state == self.states.in_blind_event_leave or
			(self.current_state == self.states.in_blind_event_success and
			self.blind_event.cur_state == self.blind_states.kick) do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 중단 연출 중에는 그 상태에서 멈춰있도록 하되, 로직을 끝내지는 않는다(일시정지)
		-- 성공 시에 발차기를 하고 있다면, 리신 발차기가 끝날 때까지는 수행을 해야 한다...
		if self.current_state == self.states.in_blind_event or
				(self.current_state == self.states.in_blind_event_success and
				self.blind_event.cur_state == self.blind_states.kick) then
			-- 각 스테이트의 업데이트 로직
			self.blind_event.cur_state:update(dt)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.blind_event.cur_state:exit(nil)
end

function local_class:blind_event_leave_scene()
	--1번 빨간 존 진입 시
	--이벤트 진행 중일 경우
	--선택지 등장
	local leader = self.get_leader()
	local china_hero = self.get_china_hero()
	local align_pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_blind_leave_pivot')

	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_choose_3', 'normal' },
		{ 'dv_sub_cyborg_fighter_s2_choose_4', 'normal' }
	})

	if result == 1 then
		--(normal) 이곳을 벗어난다

		return true
	elseif result == 2 then
		--(normal) 남아 있는다.
		--선택시 0.5타일 뒷걸음질 이동
		local move_pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter('s2_blind_leave',
				leader, 'right', 0.5)
		local diff = china_hero.Position - leader.Position

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, move_pos, 1,
				nil, self, nil,
				{ locked_dir = 'left' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(china_hero, move_pos + diff, 1,
				nil, self, nil,
				{ locked_dir = 'left' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

		return false
	end
end
