	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	--넷째 아들 인터렉트
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_fourth_son_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.son(4)) then
		self.current_state = self.states.after_fourth_son_interact
		sp_util.start_scene(self.fourth_son_interact_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	--훈장 인터렉트
	if (self.current_state == self.states.after_first_son_enter or
			self.current_state == self.states.before_noble_interact) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.noble()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.noble_interact_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	--최초 존 엔터
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_pre_zone_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_etiquette_pre_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_fourth_son_interact
		start_coroutine(function()
			self:couple_talk_enter_scene()

			local male = self.npc.male()
			local female = self.npc.female()

			--종료 시 원라인 대사 지정
			male.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			male.Interactable.Talk = 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_4'

			female.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			female.Interactable.Talk = 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_5'
		end)

		return true
	end

	--셋째 아들 조우
	if self.current_state == self.states.after_fourth_son_interact and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_etiquette_son_1_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_third_son_enter
		start_coroutine(self.third_son_speech_routine, self)

		return true
	end

	--둘째 아들 조우
	if self.current_state == self.states.after_third_son_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_etiquette_son_2_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_second_son_enter
		start_coroutine(self.second_son_speech_routine, self)

		return true
	end

	--첫째 아들 조우
	if self.current_state == self.states.after_second_son_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_etiquette_son_3_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_first_son_enter
		start_coroutine(self.first_son_speech_routine, self)

		return true
	end

	--수련 모드 진입
	if self.training_current_state == self.training_state.pause and
			self.current_state > self.states.before_fourth_son_interact and
			self.current_state < self.states.before_noble_interact and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_etiquette_training_zone') then
		self.training_current_state = self.training_state.play
		self.walk_buff:add(get_party_leader())

		return true
	end

	--탈출 체크
	local zone_count = 6
	for i = 1, zone_count do
		local zone_name = 'sub_etiquette_out_area_' .. i
		if self.training_current_state == self.training_state.play and
				self.training_current_state ~= self.training_state.out and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), zone_name) then
			self.training_current_state = self.training_state.out
			sp_util.start_scene(self.fail_scene, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	--수련 모드 탈출
	if self.training_current_state == self.training_state.play and
			self.current_state > self.states.before_fourth_son_interact and
			self.current_state < self.states.before_noble_interact and
			type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_etiquette_training_zone') then

		--통과 기준 마커
		local finish_line_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_etiquette_center_pos')
		if self.current_state == self.states.after_first_son_enter and
				get_party_leader().Position.z < finish_line_pos.z then
			--수련 존 종료
			self.training_current_state = self.training_state.stop

			--탈출구 오픈
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('sub_etiquette_door_1', false))
		else
			--수련 존 나가기
			self.training_current_state = self.training_state.pause
		end

		self.walk_buff:remove(get_party_leader())

		return true
	end

	--형제들과 대화 중 도망치는지 체크
	for i = 1, #self.talk_leave_matching_data do
		local zone_name = self.talk_leave_matching_data[i].zone_name
		local target_state = self.talk_leave_matching_data[i].target_state

		if self.training_current_state == self.training_state.play and
				self.training_current_state ~= self.training_state.talk and
				self.current_state == target_state and
				type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), zone_name) then
			self.training_current_state = self.training_state.talk
			sp_util.start_scene(self.fail_scene, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_noble_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.npc.noble()) and
			string_helper.start_with(e.Info.sender.Name, '[breakable]') and
			e.Info.type == CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee then
		self.current_state = self.states.after_noble_damage
		sp_util.start_scene(self.soil_throw_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.stage_end = true
	self.controller.item:dispose()
end

	start_coroutine(self.training_routine, self)

--수련 모드 상태에서 탐색
function local_class:training_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	self.training_current_state = self.training_state.pause

	while self.training_current_state ~= self.training_state.stop and (not self.stage_end) do
		--플레이 존 안에서 이상 판정
		if self.training_current_state == self.training_state.play then
			local current_state = leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState

			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.IsAnyBattleActionActive(leader) then
				--액션 판정
				self.training_current_state = self.training_state.skill
				sp_util.start_scene(self.fail_scene, self)

			elseif current_state and lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState) and
					current_state.MoveMode == CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState.AnalogueMode.ImpactRun then
				--달리기 판정
				self.training_current_state = self.training_state.run
				sp_util.start_scene(self.fail_scene, self)
			else
				--선비한테 대화 하는 도중 다른 방향을 보는지 체크
				for i = 1, #self.talk_leave_matching_data do
					local target_direction = self.talk_leave_matching_data[i].target_direction
					local target_state = self.talk_leave_matching_data[i].target_state
					local current_direction = character_util.get_look_direction(leader)

					--다른 방향 보면 실패
					if self.current_state == target_state and
							current_direction ~= target_direction then
						self.training_current_state = self.training_state.talk
						sp_util.start_scene(self.fail_scene, self)

						break
					end
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:fail_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.npc.princess()
	local son_4 = self.npc.son(4)
	local is_left = princess.Position.x > leader.Position.x

	--형제들 speech 제거
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local brother = self.npc.son(i)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(brother)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(brother)
	end

	--카메라 shake(0.3, 0.2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)

	--가디언&공주(넷째 방향, scared, embarrassed, jump 1회)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.group_look_at({ leader, princess }, son_4)
	scene_util.set_group_emotion({ leader, princess }, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_group_anim({ leader, princess }, self, 'embarrassed')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, false)
	character_util.normal_jump(princess, false)

	--넷째(가디언 방향, mad, release)
	character_util.look_at(son_4, leader)
	scene_util.set_emotion(son_4, self, 'mad')
	scene_util.set_anim(son_4, self, 'release')

	--넷째(shout 말풍선, 위치(0.5, 0.5), 크기 1.3): 이런 무례한 자들을 봤나!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(son_4, self, nil,
			nil, nil, {
				key = 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_9',
				bubble_direction = 'none',
				viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.5),
				skip = true,
			})

	do
		local target_pos = is_left and leader.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0) or leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)

		--넷째(mad) 가디언 오른쪽 0.5칸 위치로 6의 속도로 뛰어서 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
		character_util.remove_anim(son_4)
		wp_util.move_async(son_4, target_pos, 6)
	end

	if is_left then
		scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'left', false)
	else
		scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'right', false)
	end

	--공주(right, sad, cast)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'sad')
	scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, 'cast')

	--가디언(right, damaged, prostrate)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'prostrate')

	--attack 키값마다 다음 동작 실행
	local attack_callback = function()
		--가디언 위치 기준 vector(0, 0.3, 0) 위치에 FX_hit 이펙트 생성
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
		self.fx.hit():Instantiate(leader.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

		--카메라 shake(0.2, 0.1)
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)
	end

	--넷째(left, mad, attack)
	if is_left then
		scene_util.set_direction(son_4, 'right', false)
	else
		scene_util.set_direction(son_4, 'left', false)
	end

	scene_util.set_emotion(son_4, self, 'mad')
	scene_util.set_anim(son_4, self, { name = 'attack', sfx_callback = attack_callback })

	--실패 조건에 따라 다른 대사 출력
	self:case_by_speech(son_4)

	--화면 1초간 페이드 아웃. 끝날 때까지 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	--NPC 이미지의 위치에 세팅
	do
		local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_etiquette_pos_4')
		local npc_data = {
			sub_etiqette_son_1 = {
				dir = 'left',
				emo = 'idle',
				anim = 'idle',
				marker_name = 'sub_etiquette_pos_1',
				offset = vector(0, 0, 0),
			},
			sub_etiqette_son_2 = {
				dir = 'right',
				emo = 'idle',
				anim = 'idle',
				marker_name = 'sub_etiquette_pos_2',
				offset = vector(0, 0, 0),
			},
			sub_etiqette_son_3 = {
				dir = 'right',
				emo = 'idle',
				anim = 'idle',
				marker_name = 'sub_etiquette_pos_3',
				offset = vector(0, 0, 0),
			},
			sub_etiqette_son_4 = {
				dir = 'down',
				emo = 'idle',
				anim = 'idle',
				marker_name = 'sub_etiquette_pos_4',
				offset = vector(0, 0, 1.5),
			},
			princess = {
				dir = 'left',
				emo = 'tired',
				anim = 'idle',
				marker_name = 'sub_etiquette_pos_4',
				offset = vector(4.5, 0, 0),
			}
		}

		self.controller:set_by_npc_data(npc_data)

		--가디언(left, damaged, prostrate)
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'prostrate')
		leader.Position = center_pos + vector(3.5, 0, 0)

		character_util.remove_anim(princess)

		--가디언 shake(0.01, 2)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(leader, 0.01, 2)

		for i = 1, 3 do
			local son = self.npc.son(i)
			son.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1, 1, 3))
		end
	end

	--화면 1초간 페이드 인. 끝날 때까지 대기
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--공주(left, idle, idle)
	--가디언(left, idle, idle, mario_jump 1회) 끝날 때까지 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ leader, princess })
	character_util.mario_jump_async(leader, 'left')

	self.training_current_state = self.training_state.pause
	self.walk_buff:remove(leader)

	--스테이트 초기화
	self.current_state = self.states.after_fourth_son_interact
end

function local_class:noble_interact_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local noble = self.npc.noble()

	--가디언&공주 이미지의 위치로 정렬. 끝날 때까지 대기
	party_util.align_party_ignore_deactivated_party_member(noble.Position, 'left', 0.5, 'linear')

	if self.current_state == self.states.after_first_son_enter then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_noble_interact

		--훈장(left, idle, idle): 오, 오래간만에 새 손님이로군.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noble, self, 'left',
				nil, nil, 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_36')

		--훈장(left, idle, release): 이 마을 사람들은 기초 관문조차 통과하지 못하는 자들이 많아서 말이야.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noble, self, 'left',
				'release', nil, 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_37')

		--가디언(right, smile, idle, jump 1회)
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
		character_util.normal_jump(leader, true)

		do
			local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })

			--훈장(right, idle, eat): 그래, 관문을 통과했으니 상을 줘야지….
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noble, self, 'right',
					'eat', nil, 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_38')

			eat_sfx:Stop()
			eat_sfx = nil
		end

		--0.5초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--가디언(right, tired, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')

		--훈장(left, idle, cast): 자, 받거라. 맛 좋은 떡이다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noble, self, 'left',
				'cast', nil, 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_39')

		--훈장(left, idle, throw 1회)
		scene_util.set_direction(noble, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(noble, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1, one_shot_sfx = '01_throw_01' })

		--떡 아이템 생성
		do
			--아이템 스프라이트: rice_cake
			--생성 위치: 훈장 위치
			--도착 위치: 가디언 위치
			--획득 대상: 가디언
			local rice_cake_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				item_id = 21416,
				spr_scale = 0.5,
				pos = noble.Position,
				target = leader.Position,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				show_on_character = false,
				skip_text = true,
			})

			wait_for_sec(0.6)

			quest_drop_item_util.consumed(rice_cake_item, leader)

			--획득시 체력 10 회복
			--초록색으로 pulse, 초록색 숫자 표시 등 일반적으로 체력이 회복될 때와 동일한 표현이 들어가야 합니다
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
			heal_info.heal = 10
			heal_info.sender = noble
			heal_info.target = leader

			command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

		end

		--2초 대기
		wait_for_sec(2)

		--훈장(left, idle, release): 왜, 싫으냐?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noble, self, 'left',
				'release', nil, 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_40')

		--훈장(left, idle, cross_arm): 원래 어른이 주면 그냥 감사합니다~ 하고 받는게다. 잘 알아 두거라.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noble, self, 'left',
				'cross_arm', nil, 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_41')

		--가디언(right, idle, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

		--훈장(left, idle, bomb_idle): 그래서, 무슨 연유로 이 늙은이를 찾아 왔는고?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noble, self, 'left',
				'bomb_idle', nil, 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_42')

		--훈장(left, greed, sing): 혹시 신규 원생으로 등록을…?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noble, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'sing', keep = true }, { name = 'greed', keep = true }, 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_43')

	else
		--훈장(left, idle, idle): 그래, 이번엔 또 무슨 일이냐?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noble, self, 'left',
				nil, nil, 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_54')

	end

	--가디언 선택지
	do
		--(mercy) 아이들이 축제에도 놀지 못하고 있는건 너무 불쌍해요.
		--(brutal) 등 뒤에 있는 저 반짝이는거 저 주세요.
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'dv_sub_etiquette_choose_1', 'mercy' },
			{ 'dv_sub_etiquette_choose_2', 'brutal' }
		})

		--훈장(left, attack, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(noble, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(noble, self, 'attack')
		character_util.remove_anim(noble)

		--가디언(right, idle, release)
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'release')

		--1초 대기
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--가디언(right, tired, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--훈장(left, attack, bomb_idle): 뭐어~? 나가서 놀게 해 달라고~?
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noble, self, 'left',
					'bomb_idle', 'attack', 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_44')

			--훈장(left, attack, cast2): 아직도 배울것이 산더미인데 그게 무슨 소리란 말이냐!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noble, self, 'left',
					'cast2', 'attack', 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_45')

			--훈장(left, attack, bomb_idle): 놀 거 다 놀고, 쉴 거 다 쉬면 어느 세월에 군자가 돼?
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noble, self, 'left',
					'bomb_idle', 'attack', 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_46')

		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			--훈장(left, attack, bomb_idle): 뭐어~? 이 보석을 달라고~?
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noble, self, 'left',
					'bomb_idle', 'attack', 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_48')

			--훈장(left, attack, cross_arm): 어찌 군자라는 자가 남의 재화를 탐한단 말이냐!
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noble, self, 'left',
					'cross_arm', 'attack', 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_49')

		end

		--카메라 shake(0.2, 0.1)
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)

		--훈장(left, attack, cast2, jump 2회): 내 눈에 흙이 들어가기 전까진 절대 안돼!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		start_coroutine(character_util.normal_double_jump, noble, false)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noble, self, 'left',
				'cast2', 'attack', 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_50')
	end

	--가디언(right, scared, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'scared')

	--훈장(left, idle, release): 쓸데없는 소리 말고, 온 김에 마당 청소나 좀 하고 가거라.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noble, self, 'left',
			'release', nil, 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_51')

	--훈장(left, attack, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(noble, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(noble, self, 'attack')

	--가디언(left, scared, cast)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', true)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--가디언(right, scared, cast)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', true)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--가디언(right, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	--훈장(left, attack, cast2): 어허! 원래 어른이 시키면 네~ 하고 따르는 거야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noble, self, 'left',
			'cast2', 'attack', 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_52')

	--훈장(left, attack, release): 자, 빨리빨리 움직여!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noble, self, 'left',
			'release', 'attack', 'dv_sub_etiquette_s1_53')

	--가디언 표정&애니메이션 제거
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
end

function local_class:move_async(fo, target_pos, speed, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local progress = 0
	local start_pos = fo.Position
	local distance = vector_util.distance(start_pos, target_pos)
	local to_duration = 0

	if type_util.is_number(speed) then
		to_duration = distance / speed
	end

	if type_util.is_number(duration) then
		to_duration = duration
	end

	while not self.stage_end do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		progress = time_passed / to_duration

		if time_passed < to_duration then
			fo.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
		else
			fo.Position = target_pos
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

return local_class

					quest_drop_item_util.rotate(sprite, -90, 0)
				elseif marker.direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
					quest_drop_item_util.rotate(sprite, 180, 0)
				elseif marker.direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
					quest_drop_item_util.rotate(sprite, 90, 0)
				end

				quest_drop_item_util.set_alpha_fade(sprite, 1, 0.3)
				wait_for_sec(1)

				quest_drop_item_util.set_alpha_fade(sprite, 0, 0.5)
				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(sprite)
			end,
		}
	})

	self.sp_controller = nil
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	quest_icon_util.pre_load()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self:start_setting()

	local created, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.character.merchant(), self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.character.female(), self.controller)
	quest_icon_util.remove(self.character.merchant())

	local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

	if time_conversion ~= nil then
		time_conversion:unregister_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and self.is_day_light and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'gc_pre_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.zone
		self.sp_controller:try_start_coroutine(self.female_talk, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state <= self.states.zone and
			(lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.character.female()) or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.character.merchant())) then
		self.current_state = self.states.talk

		local is_entered = self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.merchant_talk, self)
		if not is_entered then
			self.current_state = self.states.zone
		end

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.talk_end and
			(lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.character.female()) or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.character.merchant())) then
		self.current_state = self.states.request

		local is_entered = self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.request_talk, self)
		if not is_entered then
			self.current_state = self.states.talk_end
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_setting()
	do
		-- 밤/낮 세팅
		local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

		-- 콜백 등록
		time_conversion:register_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key, {
			-- 낮
			daylight = function()
				self.is_day_light = true
				self:show_merchant()
			end,
			-- 밤
			night = function()
				self.is_day_light = false
				self:hide_merchant()
			end
		}, true)
	end
end

function local_class:show_merchant()
	local merchant = self.character.merchant()
	local female = self.character.female()
	local thief = self.character.thief()

	--NPC 이미지의 위치에 초기 세팅
	--남자 상인(right, tired, cross_arm)
	character_util.set_position(merchant, self.marker.merchant_pos())
	character_util.set_direction(merchant, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(merchant, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(merchant, self, { name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false })
	--머리 위에 퀘스트 말풍선 출력중인  상태
	quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(merchant)

	--여자 상인(left, tired, idle)
	character_util.set_position(female, self.marker.female_pos())
	character_util.set_direction(female, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(female, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(female)

	--도둑 NPC 완전히 투명한 상태로
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(thief, 0, 0)
	thief.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)

	self.controller:show_time_conversion(false, function()
		character_util.add_listener(merchant, self.controller)
		character_util.add_listener(female, self.controller)
	end, { merchant, female })
end

function local_class:hide_merchant()
	local merchant = self.character.merchant()
	local female = self.character.female()

	quest_icon_util.remove(merchant)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(merchant, self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(female, self.controller)

	self.controller:hide_time_conversion(false, nil, { merchant, female })
end

function local_class:female_talk()
	local female = self.character.female()

	--정말 귀신이 곡할 노릇이란 말이죠….
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(female, 'dv_ghost_cap_pre_1', false)
end

function local_class:merchant_talk()
	local merchant = self.character.merchant()
	local female = self.character.female()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local twins_younger = self.character.twins_younger()

	--위의 비강제 이벤트 강제 종료
	quest_icon_util.remove(merchant)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(female)

	--남자 상인(left, idle, idle)
	--여자 상인(left, idle, idle)
	character_util.set_group_direction({ merchant, female }, 'left')
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ merchant, female })

	--카메라 1초간 이미지의 연두색 마름모 위치로 이동 시작
	camera_util.move(merchant.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 1)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--파티 이미지의 위치로 1초간 정렬. 끝날 때까지 대기
	do
		local wp_key = 'leader_wp'

		--파티 멤버 전원(right, idle, idle)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, merchant.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_younger, merchant.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--남자 상인(left, idle, idle): 아, 축제를 찾아오신 여행자님 이신가요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(merchant, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'dv_ghost_cap_pre_2')

	--남자 상인(left, idle, release): 축제 노점들은 마을 중앙 광장 쪽으로 가시면 있어요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(merchant, self, 'left',
			'release', nil, 'dv_ghost_cap_pre_3')

	--가디언(right, idle, bomb_idle) question 이모티콘 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'question')

	--남자 상인(left, tired, cast): 그게… 손님 분들께 말씀드릴만한 일은 아닌데….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(merchant, self, 'left',
			'cast', 'tired', 'dv_ghost_cap_pre_4')

	--남자 상인(left, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(merchant, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(merchant, self, 'tired')

	--여자 상인(left, idle, release): 여행자님께선 혹시 최근에 물건이 없어지거나 하신 일 없으신가요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(female, self, 'left',
			'release', nil, 'dv_ghost_cap_pre_5')

	--여자 상인(left, attack, cross_arm): 요 근래 좀도둑 하나가 기승을 부리고 있는데 이놈이 아주 골칫거리지 뭡니까.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(female, self, 'left',
			'cross_arm', 'attack', 'dv_ghost_cap_pre_6')

	--도둑 물건훔침 코루틴 시작
	start_coroutine(self.thief_routine, self)

	--남자 상인(left, attack, cast2): 하루가 멀다하고 동네 상인들 물건을 훔쳐대는데….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(merchant, self, 'left',
			'cast2', 'attack', 'dv_ghost_cap_pre_7')

	--남자 상인(left, tired, bomb_idle): 어찌나 신출귀몰한지 여태까지 얼굴 한 번 제대로 본 사람이 없을 정도입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(merchant, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'dv_ghost_cap_pre_8')

	--남자 상인(left, tired, cross_arm): 꼭 물건이 자기 스스로 걸어서 도망치는 것 같다니까요….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(merchant, self, 'left',
			'cross_arm', 'tired', 'dv_ghost_cap_pre_9')

	--남자 상인(right, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(merchant, 'right', false)

	--여자 상인(left, idle, nod 2회): 아무튼, 그래서 지금 이렇게 상인들끼리 당번을 정해서 창고를 지키고 있던 참입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(female, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'dv_ghost_cap_pre_10')

	--여자 상인(left, doyagao, bomb_idle): 제 아무리 그놈이래도 저희가 이렇게 지키고 있는데 훔칠 수 있겠어요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(female, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', 'doyagao', 'dv_ghost_cap_pre_11')

	--여자 상인(left, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(female, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(female, self, 'tired')

	--남자 상인(left, idle, nod 2회): …하지만 이것도 임시 방편일 뿐이지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(merchant, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'dv_ghost_cap_pre_12')

	--여자 상인(left, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(female, 'left', false)
	character_util.remove_emotion(female)

	--남자 상인(left, idle, release): 여행자님, 이 도둑놈 잡는것 좀 도와 주실 수 있을까요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(merchant, self, 'left',
			'release', nil, 'dv_ghost_cap_pre_13')

	--남자 상인(left, tired, cast): 이대로면 그녀석이 온 마을 물건들을 다 훔치고 말겁니다….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(merchant, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cast', keep = true },
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			'dv_ghost_cap_pre_14')

	while not self.thief_routine_clear do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self:quest_accept_routine()
end

function local_class:thief_routine()
	local thief = self.character.thief()
	local merchant = self.character.merchant()

	--카메라 1초간 이미지의 노란색 마름모 위치로 이동 시작
	camera_util.move(merchant.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 1), 1)

	--이미지의 위치에 도둑 NPC 완전히 투명한 상태로 배치
	character_util.set_position(thief, self.marker.thief_pos())

	local drop_item_routine = function(id)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_treasure_item_popup_01')
		local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
			item_id = id,
			pos = thief.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
			target = thief.Position,
			spr_scale = 0.5,
			loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter
		})

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		quest_drop_item_util.consumed(item, thief)
	end

	--0.3초 주기로 아이템 생성
	local item_ids = { 21436, 21437, 21438, 21439, 21440 }
	for i = 1, #item_ids do
		start_coroutine(drop_item_routine, item_ids[i])
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
	end

	--마지막 아이템이 생성된 후 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--카메라 1초간 이미지의 연두색 마름모 위치로 이동 시작
	camera_util.move(merchant.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 1)

	start_coroutine(self.foot_sprite.create, self.foot_sprite, 'gc_day_foot_pos_1')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	start_coroutine(self.foot_sprite.create, self.foot_sprite, 'gc_day_foot_pos_2')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	start_coroutine(self.foot_sprite.create, self.foot_sprite, 'gc_day_foot_pos_3')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	start_coroutine(self.foot_sprite.create, self.foot_sprite, 'gc_day_foot_pos_4')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	self.foot_sprite:create('gc_day_foot_pos_5')

	character_util.set_position(thief, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(thief, 1, 0)
	thief.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)

	self.thief_routine_clear = true
end

function local_class:request_talk()
	local merchant = self.character.merchant()
	local female = self.character.female()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local twins_younger = self.character.twins_younger()

	quest_icon_util.remove(merchant)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--남자 상인(left, smile, idle)
	--여자 상인(left, smile, idle)
	character_util.set_group_direction({ merchant, female }, 'left')
	scene_util.set_group_emotion({ merchant, female }, self, 'smile')
	character_util.remove_group_anim({ merchant, female })

	--카메라 1초간 이미지의 연두색 마름모 위치로 이동 시작
	camera_util.move(merchant.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 1)

	--파티 이미지의 위치로 1초간 정렬. 끝날 때까지 대기
	do
		local wp_key = 'leader_wp'

		--파티 멤버 전원(right, idle, idle)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, merchant.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_younger, merchant.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--남자 상인(left, smile, sing): 호, 혹시 마음이 바뀌신 건가요…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(merchant, self, 'left',
			'sing', 'smile', 'dv_ghost_cap_pre_18')

	--남자 상인(left, smile, sing)
	scene_util.set_emotion(merchant, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(merchant, self, 'sing')

	self:quest_accept_routine()
end

function local_class:quest_accept_routine()
	local merchant = self.character.merchant()
	local female = self.character.female()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.cs_controller.QuestId, false)
	self.current_state = self.states.talk_end

	--퀘스트 수락 처리
	if accepted then
		floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party.Leader, self.cs_controller.QuestSpec.QuestName, 0)

		--남자 상인(left, smile, cast)
		scene_util.set_emotion(merchant, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(merchant, self, 'cast')
		--여자 상인(left, smile, idle)
		scene_util.set_emotion(female, self, 'smile')
		character_util.remove_anim(female)
		--가디언(right, idle, nod 2회)
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

		--남자 상인(left, smile, cast2): 그럼 여행자님만 믿고 있겠습니다!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(merchant, self, 'left',
				'cast2', 'smile', 'dv_ghost_cap_pre_15')

		--남자 상인(right, smile, cast)
		character_util.set_direction(merchant, 'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion(merchant, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(merchant, self, 'cast')

		--카메라 0.5초간 가디언 위치로 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
		--이후 카메라 가디언 따라다님
		self.controller:activate_quest(0)
		--컨트롤 회복. 이벤트 종료
	else
		--여자 상인(left, tired, idle)
		scene_util.set_emotion(female, self, 'tired')
		character_util.remove_anim(female)
		--남자 상인(left, tired, idle): 역시 그렇겠죠. 다른 바쁜 일도 많으실테고….
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(merchant, self, 'left',
				'idle', 'tired', 'dv_ghost_cap_pre_16')

		--남자 상인(left, tired, release): 혹시라도 마음이 바뀌시면 말씀 부탁드립니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(merchant, self, 'left',
				'release', 'tired', 'dv_ghost_cap_pre_17')

		--남자 상인(left, tired, idle)
		scene_util.set_emotion(merchant, self, 'tired')
		--카메라 0.5초간 가디언 위치로 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
		--이후 카메라 가디언 따라다님
		quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(merchant)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

return local_class

				elseif marker.direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
					quest_drop_item_util.rotate(sprite, 180, 0)

					quest_drop_item_util.rotate(sprite, 90, 0)

				if not is_day_light then

				local index = 1

				while true do
					if not field_util.has_marker(marker_pre_fix .. index) then
						break
					end

					this:create(marker_pre_fix .. index)
					index = index + 1
				end

				if this.sprite_table == nil then
					return

				for _, sprite in pairs(this.sprite_table) do

				end

				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				for _, sprite in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(sprite)
				end

				this.sprite_table = nil
			end,
			dispose_all = function(this)

				end

--region mini game
function local_class:mini_game_start()
	self.game_data.is_playing = true

	self:game_start_setting()

	self:thief_move()
end

function local_class:game_start_setting()

	self.game_data.thief.hit_count = self.game_data.thief.hit_count + 1

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
	--도둑 1초간 투명도 0.2 되기 시작
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(thief, 0.2, 1)
	--도둑(left, damaged, damaged, jump 1회)
	character_util.set_direction(thief, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(thief, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(thief, self, 'damaged')
	character_util.normal_jump(thief, true)
	--jump async 아님
	--플레이어와 충돌한 경우
	if is_player_collision then
		--가디언(right, damaged, damaged, jump 1회)
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'damaged')
		character_util.normal_jump(leader)
		--jump async 아님
	end

	--0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--도둑(left, damaged, seat)
	scene_util.set_anim(thief, self, 'seat')
	--플레이어와 충돌한 경우
	if is_player_collision then
		--가디언(right, damaged, seat)
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'seat')
	end
	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--카메라 1초간 도둑 위치로 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(thief, 1)

	--도둑(left, damaged, seat): 아이고, 아파라….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(thief, 'dv_ghost_cap_s2_15')

	--도둑(left, doyagao, seat): …하지만 이정도는 기껏해야 감투를 조금 비뚤어지게 하는 정도밖에 안돼.
	scene_util.set_emotion(thief, self, 'doyagao')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(thief, 'dv_ghost_cap_s2_16')

	--해당 이벤트를 3회 이상 본 경우
	if self.game_data.thief.hit_count >= 3 then
		--도둑(left, doyagao, seat): 불이라도 붙으면 모를까….
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(thief, 'dv_ghost_cap_s2_17')
	end

	--도둑 1초간 완전히 투명해짐. 끝날 때까지 대기
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(thief, 0, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--도둑(left, idle, idle): 다시 한 번 잘~ 찾아봐라, 이 멍청아!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_laugh_evil_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(thief, 'dv_ghost_cap_s2_18')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

function local_class:thief_damage_event()
	local thief = self.game_data.thief.npc
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	self.game_data.is_playing = false

	--카메라 shake(0.3, 0.2)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
	--도둑(right, damaged, prostrate, jump 1회)
	--jump async 아님

	scene_util.set_emotion(thief, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(thief, self, 'prostrate')
	character_util.normal_jump(thief)
	character_util.stop(thief)
	thief.CrashBehaviour.NPCCrashSfxHandleName = '01_hit_npc_01'

	--도둑 1초간 투명도 0.6 되기 시작
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(thief, 0.6, 1)

	local fire_fx = self.fx.fire():Instantiate(thief.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform.position,
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, thief.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)

	--도둑(shout 말풍선, 말풍선 크기 1.3, 위치 (0.5, 0.75)): 으악!
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(thief, 'dv_ghost_cap_s2_19',
			true, { scale = 1.3, viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.75) })

	--카메라 1초간 도둑 위치로 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(thief, 1)

	--도둑 shake(0.02, 999)
	scene_util.shake(thief, 0.02, 999)
	--도둑(right, scared, prostrate): 히이익…! 가, 감투에 불이 붙었잖아…?
	scene_util.set_emotion(thief, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(thief, 'dv_ghost_cap_s2_20')

	--도둑(scared) mario jump. 끝날 때까지 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(thief, thief.Direction, 0.5, 0.3)

	--도둑(left, scared, cast): 이, 일단 도망쳐야겠어. 이 잡동사니들이 중요한 게 아냐…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(thief, self, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(thief, 'dv_ghost_cap_s2_21')

	--도둑(scared, run)
	character_util.remove_anim(thief)
	--달릴 때 먼지구름 이펙트가 나타나야 함
	--이미지의 경로를 따라 7의 속도로 달려서 이동
	--방 중앙으로 우선 이동 후 왼쪽으로 이동해 그리드 바깥으로 나감
	local run_marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('gc_thief_run_pos')
	local marker_4_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.game_data.thief.marker_pre_fix .. 4)
	local marker_7_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.game_data.thief.marker_pre_fix .. 7)
	local wp = {}

	if thief.Position.z > run_marker_pos.z then
		table.insert(wp, vector(thief.Position.x, 0, marker_4_pos.z))
		table.insert(wp, marker_4_pos)
		table.insert(wp, run_marker_pos)
		table.insert(wp, run_marker_pos + vector(-8, 0, 0))
	else
		table.insert(wp, marker_7_pos)
		table.insert(wp, run_marker_pos)
		table.insert(wp, run_marker_pos + vector(-8, 0, 0))
	end

	wp_util.move(thief, wp, 7, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

	--스타피스 생성
	star_piece_util.appear(get_field_object('ghost_cap_star_piece'), thief.Position)

	--생성 위치: 도둑 현재 위치
	--도착 위치: 방 중앙
	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--도둑이 그리드 바깥으로 나갈 때까지 반복
	local drop_item_routine = function(id)
		local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
			item_id = id,
			--생성 위치: 도둑 현재 위치
			pos = thief.Position,
			--도착 위치: 도둑 현재 위치 + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
			target = thief.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
			loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter
		})

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		--생성 후 1초 뒤 1초간 투명도 0이 되며 사라짐
		quest_drop_item_util.set_alpha_fade(item, 0, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)
	end

	--0.3초 주기로 아이템 생성
	local item_ids = { 21436, 21437, 21438, 21439, 21440 }

	start_coroutine(function()
		for i = 1, #item_ids do
			if screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(thief.Position) then
				start_coroutine(drop_item_routine, item_ids[i])
				wait_for_sec(0.3)
			end
		end
	end)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--카메라 2초간 가디언 위치로 이동 시작
	camera_util.move_to_target(leader, 2, { end_target = leader })
	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)
	--가디언(left, idle, idle)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	--도둑이 그리드 밖으로 나갈 때까지 대기
	while screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(thief.Position) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--카메라 shake(0.2, 0.1)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)
	--(여)마을 사람(shout 말풍선, 말풍선 크기 1.2, 위치 (0.25, 0.75)): 으아악! 반투명 요괴다!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_victim_scream_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(thief, 'dv_ghost_cap_s2_22',
			true, { scale = 1.2, viewport_pos = vector(0.25, 0.75) })

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--(남)마을 사람(일반 말풍선, 위치(0.25, 0.25)): 잠깐, 저거… 전에 도둑맞았던 우리 집 도자기 아냐?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(thief, 'dv_ghost_cap_s2_23',
			true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.25, 0.25) })

	--(여)마을 사람(일반 말풍선, 위치(0.25, 0.5)): 그러고 보니…! 내 노리개도 저기 있네!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(thief, 'dv_ghost_cap_s2_24',
			true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.25, 0.5) })

	--카메라 shake(0.4, 0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
	--(공통)마을 사람(shout 말풍선, 말풍선 크기 1.4, 위치 (0.25, 0.75)): 저 요괴놈을 잡아라!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(thief, 'dv_ghost_cap_s2_25',
			true, { scale = 1.4, viewport_pos = vector(0.25, 0.75) })

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(thief, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	character_util.stop_shake(thief)
	fire_fx:Dispose()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	self.controller:complete_quest({
		run_complete_ui = true,
		run_fame_alignment = false,
		return_control = true,
		run_chapter_end_ui = false,
	})
end

function local_class:set_near_pos()
	local min_dist = 999999
	local move_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)

	for i = 1, 9 do
		local marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.game_data.thief.marker_pre_fix .. i)
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(marker_pos - self.game_data.thief.npc.Position)
		local dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)

		if min_dist > dist then
			min_dist = dist
			move_pos = marker_pos
		end
	end

	character_util.set_position(self.game_data.thief.npc, move_pos)
end

function local_class:thief_move()
	local thief = self.game_data.thief.npc
	local map_pos = {
		{ x = 1, y = 1 }, { x = 3, y = 1 }, { x = 5, y = 1 },
		{ x = 1, y = 3 }, { x = 3, y = 3 }, { x = 5, y = 3 },
		{ x = 1, y = 5 }, { x = 3, y = 5 }, { x = 5, y = 5 }
	}

	local map = {
		{ 0, 2, 0, 2, 0 },
		{ 2, 1, 2, 1, 2 },
		{ 0, 2, 0, 2, 0 },
		{ 2, 1, 2, 1, 2 },
		{ 0, 2, 0, 2, 0 },
	}

	local cur_index = self.game_data.thief.cur_marker_index
	local next_index = cur_index

	while self.game_data.thief.cur_marker_index == next_index do
		next_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, 9)
	end

	local start = self:node(map_pos[cur_index].x, map_pos[cur_index].y, 0, nil) -- 시작 노드 (x, y, 비용, 부모 노드)
	local goal = self:node(map_pos[next_index].x, map_pos[next_index].y, 0, nil) -- 목표 노드 (x, y, 비용, 부모 노드)

	local path = self:a_star(start, goal, map)

	-- 경로를 찾지 못할 경우는 없지만 혹시 모르니 return
	if path == nil then
		return
	end

	self.foot_sprite:dispose_all()
	local cur_pos = thief.Position

	for i, node in ipairs(path) do
		local next_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.foot_sprite.marker_pre_fix .. node.x .. '_' .. node.y)
		local look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(next_pos - cur_pos)

		if map[node.x][node.y] == 2 then
			self.foot_sprite:create(next_pos, look_dir)
		end

		cur_pos = next_pos
	end

	character_util.set_position(thief, field_util.get_marker_pos(
			self.game_data.thief.marker_pre_fix .. next_index))

	self.game_data.thief.cur_marker_index = next_index
end
--endregion mini game

--region a star
-- 거리 계산 함수 (맨해튼 거리)
function local_class:heuristic(node, goal)
	return math.abs(node.x - goal.x) + math.abs(node.y - goal.y)
end

function local_class:node(x, y, cost, parent)
	local cur_node = {}

	cur_node.x = x
	cur_node.y = y
	cur_node.cost = cost
	cur_node.parent = parent

	return cur_node
end

-- A* 알고리즘 함수
function local_class:a_star(start, goal, map)
	local open_list = {}
	local closed_list = {}

	table.insert(open_list, start)

	while #open_list > 0 do
		-- 현재 노드 선택
		local current = table.remove(open_list, 1)

		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			-- 경로 재구성
			local path = {}
			while current do
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				current = current.parent
			end
			return path
		end

		table.insert(closed_list, current)

		-- 이웃 노드 탐색
		for _, offset in ipairs({ { x = 0, y = 1 }, { x = 1, y = 0 }, { x = 0, y = -1 }, { x = -1, y = 0 } }) do
			local neighbor_x, neighbor_y = current.x + offset.x, current.y + offset.y

			-- 지도 범위 및 장애물 체크
			if map[neighbor_y] and map[neighbor_y][neighbor_x] and map[neighbor_y][neighbor_x] ~= 1 then
				local neighbor = self:node(neighbor_x, neighbor_y, current.cost + 1, current)

				local is_in_closed_list = false
				for _, cur_node in ipairs(closed_list) do
					if cur_node.x == neighbor.x and cur_node.y == neighbor.y then
						is_in_closed_list = true
						break
					end
				end

				if not is_in_closed_list then
					table.insert(open_list, neighbor)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return nil -- 경로를 찾지 못한 경우
end
--endregion a star

return local_class

			end)

function local_class:need_skip()
	return false

function local_class:enter()
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent), 'on_time_conversion_changed_event')

	self.time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

	-- 초기 Item, NPC 셋팅
	self:set_items()
	self:set_pre_npc()
	self:set_current_scene_npc()

	local _, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)

	-- 낮/밤 콜백 셋팅
	self:set_time_conversion_register_callback()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent))

	if self.time_conversion ~= nil then
		self.time_conversion:unregister_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key)
	end

	self.items:dispose_all()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.refuse_request and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.characters.china_chef()) then
		self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.retry_quest_start, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_grain_tea_pre_enter')
			and self.current_state == self.states.none and self.day_state == 'daylight' then
		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.play_working_china_chef_event, self, false)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_time_conversion_changed_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and self.day_state == 'daylight' and
			zone_util.contains_fo('sub_grain_tea_pre_enter', get_party_leader(), false) then
		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.play_working_china_chef_event, self, true)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:set_time_conversion_register_callback()
	do
		-- 밤/낮 세팅
		-- 콜백 등록
		self.time_conversion:register_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key, {
			-- 낮
			daylight = function()
				self.day_state = 'daylight'

				start_coroutine(function()
					local china_chef = self.characters.china_chef()
					local master = self.characters.master()

					local npc_list = nil

					character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(china_chef, 0, 1)

					wait_for_sec(1)

					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(china_chef)
					if self.current_state == self.states.refuse_request then
						character_util.set_position(china_chef, self.markers.china_chef(1, 5))
						scene_util.set_direction(china_chef, 'left', false)
					end
					character_util.remove_color(china_chef, china_chef.Name, 0)

					if self.current_state == self.states.none then
						npc_list = {
							china_chef, master,
							self.characters.male_guest(1), self.characters.male_guest(2), self.characters.female_guest(1), self.characters.female_guest(2)
						}
					elseif self.current_state == self.states.refuse_request then
						npc_list = {
							china_chef, master,
						}
					end

					self.controller:show_time_conversion(false, function()
						if self.current_state == self.states.refuse_request then
							character_util.add_listener(china_chef, self.controller)
						end
					end, npc_list)

					field_ui_manager:SetUI(china_chef, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

					if self.current_state == self.states.refuse_request then
						character_util.add_listener(china_chef, self.controller)
					end
				end)
			end,
			-- 밤
			night = function()
				self.day_state = 'night'

				start_coroutine(function()
					local china_chef = self.characters.china_chef()
					local master = self.characters.master()

					local npc_list = nil

					if self.current_state == self.states.none then
						npc_list = {
							china_chef, master,
							self.characters.male_guest(1), self.characters.male_guest(2), self.characters.female_guest(1), self.characters.female_guest(2)
						}
					elseif self.current_state == self.states.refuse_request then
						npc_list = {
							china_chef, master,
						}
					end

					local wait_hiding = true
					self.controller:hide_time_conversion(false, function()
						wait_hiding = false
					end, npc_list)

					while wait_hiding do
						coroutine.yield(nil)
					end

					field_object_util.set_active_state(china_chef, active_state_type.visible)
					wait_for_sec(0.5)

					scene_util.set_direction(china_chef, 'down', false)
					scene_util.set_emotion(china_chef, self, 'empty')
					character_util.set_position(china_chef, self.markers.china_chef(1, 1))
					character_util.add_color(china_chef, china_chef.Name, unity_color({ 0.2, 0.6, 1, 0.5 }), 1, 0)
					character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(china_chef, 0.5, 1)
					china_chef.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.1)

					wait_for_sec(1)

					field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(china_chef, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

					if self.current_state == self.states.refuse_request then
						character_util.remove_relate_event(china_chef, self.controller)
					end
				end)
			end
		}, true)
	end
end

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc()
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[self.current_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)

		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.interaction then
			npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		end

		if npc_data.string ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.string) then
			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.string
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.weapon_1_id then
			character_util.set_equipment(npc, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1,
					npc_data.weapon_1_id, true)
		end

		if npc_data.weapon_2_id then
			character_util.set_equipment(npc, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2,
					npc_data.weapon_2_id, true)
		end

		if npc_data.show_weapon then
			scene_util.show_weapon(npc)
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:play_working_china_chef_event(already_inside)
	local china_chef = self.characters.china_chef()
	local master = self.characters.master()

	local guest_group = {
		{ male = self.characters.male_guest(1), female = self.characters.female_guest(1) },
		{ male = self.characters.male_guest(2), female = self.characters.female_guest(2) }
	}
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	-- 항아리 체크
	for i = 1, self.breakable_num do
		local breakable_object = self.field_object.breakable(i)

		stage.DropManager:AddToNoDrop(breakable_object)

		if breakable_object.ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
			breakable_object.Position = self.markers.jar(i)

			self.fx:reset():Instantiate(breakable_object.Position)

			breakable_object.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:Heal(breakable_object.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP)

			field_object_util.set_active_state(breakable_object, active_state_type.enabled)
		end
	end

	-- 트리거 존에 진입하면 위 이미지와 같이 기사 (up, idle, idle)로 정렬 - 2초
	local move_end_key = 'party_align'

	local arrive_pos = nil

	if not already_inside then
		arrive_pos = self.markers.leader(1, 1)
	else
		local pivot_1 = self.markers.male(1, 1) + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
		local pivot_2 = self.markers.male(2, 1) + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
		local center_pos = self.markers.center()

		if leader.Position.z > pivot_1.z then
			if leader.Position.z > pivot_2.z then
				arrive_pos = { vector(center_pos.x, 0, leader.Position.z), self.markers.leader(1, 1) }
			elseif leader.Position.z <= pivot_2.z then
				arrive_pos = { vector(leader.Position.x, 0, center_pos.z), center_pos, self.markers.leader(1, 1) }
			end
		else
			arrive_pos = { vector(center_pos.x, 0, leader.Position.z), self.markers.leader(1, 1) }
		end
	end

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, arrive_pos, 4, nil, self, move_end_key, { last_direction = 'up' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 명인 (right, sleep, prostrate) sleep 이모티콘
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(master, self, nil,
			nil, nil, 'sleep')

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)


	-- 카메라 포커스 린에게 이동 - 1.5초
	camera_util.move_async(china_chef.Position, 1.5)

	-- 린 (down, idle, idle) : 곡물차 두 잔 시키셨죠?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(china_chef, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'dv_grain_tea_pre_1_1')

	local male = guest_group[2].male
	local female = guest_group[2].female

	local items = {}

	local function serving_beer()
		scene_util.set_direction(china_chef, 'down', false)

		self.items:add_item(self.item_id.drink, self.item_id.unique_pre_fix .. 'temp_' .. 1,
				china_chef.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0), nil, 1, true, false,
				quest_drop_item_drop_type.move)

		self.items:add_item(self.item_id.drink, self.item_id.unique_pre_fix .. 'temp_' .. 2,
				china_chef.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0), nil, 1, true, false,
				quest_drop_item_drop_type.move)

		local serving_end_pos_1 = china_chef.Position + vector(-0.3, 0.7, -1)
		local serving_start_pos_1 = china_chef.Position + vector(-0.3, 0.7, 0)
		local serving_end_pos_2 = china_chef.Position + vector(0.3, 0.7, -1)
		local serving_start_pos_2 = china_chef.Position + vector(0.3, 0.7, 0)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_pancakehouse_01')

		local drink_1 = self.items:pop_item(self.item_id.unique_pre_fix .. 'temp_' .. 1)
		local drink_2 = self.items:pop_item(self.item_id.unique_pre_fix .. 'temp_' .. 2)

		local sync = true

		drink_2.Position = serving_start_pos_2

		start_coroutine(function()
			while sync do
				drink_2.Position = vector(drink_2.Position.x, drink_2.Position.y, drink_1.Position.z)

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			drink_2.Position = serving_end_pos_2
		end)

		scene_util.show_serving_async(china_chef, drink_1, 0.5, {
			start_pos = serving_start_pos_1, end_pos = serving_end_pos_1
		})

		sync = false

		return { drink_1, drink_2 }
	end

	local drink_item_list = serving_beer()

	wp_util.move(china_chef, self.markers.china_chef(1, 1) + vector(0, 0, 0.5), 1, nil, { locked_dir = 'down' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 여1, 남1 아이템 획득 연출
	drink_item_list[1].ConsumeTarget = female

	drink_item_list[2].ConsumeTarget = male

	-- 여2 (right, smile, seat) : 햐, 이게 셴 시의 명물인 곡물차야?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(female, self, nil,
			nil, nil, 'dv_grain_tea_pre_1_2')

	-- 남2 (left, smile, seat) : 내가 이거 마시려고 여기까지 왔다고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(male, self, nil,
			nil, nil, 'dv_grain_tea_pre_1_3')

	-- 기사에게 포커스 이동 - 1.5초
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1.5)

	-- 기사 6타일 위쪽 이동 - 속도 4 / 카메라 기사 따라감
	wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 6), 4, nil)

	-- 린 (left, idle, idle ) jump 1회
	scene_util.set_direction(china_chef, 'left', false)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(china_chef, true)

	-- 다음 동작 동시 실행
	--   린 2.5타일 좌측 이동 - 속도 4 / run 자세
	local move_end = false

	start_coroutine(function()
		wp_util.move_async(china_chef, self.markers.china_chef(1, 2), 4, nil, { run = true })

		move_end = true
	end)

	--   카메라 포커스 린 팔로우.

	while stage_camera.LookAtPosition.x < china_chef.Position.x do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	camera_util.move(china_chef.Position, 0.5, { end_target = china_chef })

	while not move_end do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 린 (down, idle, release 2회) : 어서오세요! 자리 치우고 안내해드릴게요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(china_chef, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'dv_grain_tea_pre_1_4')

	-- 린 2.5 타일 좌측, 1타일 아래 이동 - 속도 4
	local move_list = {
		china_chef.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, 0),
		china_chef.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, -0.5),
	}
	wp_util.move_async(china_chef, move_list, 4, nil, { run = true })

	-- 린 (right, idle, eat) - 1초
	--  린에게로 (green_paprika_dish) 아이템 흡수되며, 아이템 획득 연출.
	local food = nil
	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		food = self.items:pop_item(self.item_id.unique_pre_fix .. 3)
		food.ConsumeTarget = china_chef
	end)

	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
		loop = true,
	})

	scene_util.play_wait_action(china_chef, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			'eat',
			nil,
			1)

	equipping_sfx:Stop()
	equipping_sfx = nil

	-- 린 1타일 위쪽 이동 - 속도 1
	wp_util.move_async(china_chef, self.markers.china_chef(1, 3), 1, nil, { locked_dir = 'down' })

	-- 린 (down, idle, idle) : 여기 앉으시면 됩니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(china_chef, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'dv_grain_tea_pre_1_5')

	-- 린 (down, idle, idle) : 차림표 보시고 주문하실 때 말씀해주세요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(china_chef, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'dv_grain_tea_pre_1_6')

	-- 기사 (left, smile, idle) rowdy 이모티콘 출력
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self, 'left',
			nil, 'smile', 'rowdy')

	-- 기사 0.5타일 왼쪽 이동 - 속도1
	local knight_move_pos = self.markers.leader(1, 2)
	wp_util.move_async(leader, vector(knight_move_pos.x + 1, 0, knight_move_pos.z), 1, nil)

	local jump_time = 0.75
	local jump_height = 1.7

	-- 기사 아래 이미지와 같이 의자 위로 jump 후 (left, smile, seat) 자세로 전환
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'get')
	character_util.jump(leader, jump_height, jump_time)
	character_util.move_to_async(leader, self.markers.leader(1, 2), jump_time)

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'seat')

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}
	--endregion Sprite

	--region Fx
	self.fx = {
		get = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get')
		end,
		smoke = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_SmokeScreen')

			end
		end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.assistant_manager = assistant_manager(self)

	self.fx:load_all()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_state = self.states.start

	local animator_fo = self.get_interact_pot(1)
	animator_fo.transform:Find('fx').gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local pot_1 = self.get_interact_pot(1)
	local pot_2 = self.get_interact_pot(2)
	pot_1.Position = self.get_center_pos(1) + vector(4.5, 0, -0.5)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(pot_2, active_state_type.disabled)

	do
		-- 밤/낮 세팅
		-- 콜백 등록
		self.time_conversion:register_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key, {
			-- 낮
			daylight = function()
				self:show_daylight()
			end,
			-- 밤
			night = function()
				self:hide_night()
			end
		}, true)
	end

	local created, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('sub_grain_tea_2', {
		{ zone = 'restaurant', target = self.get_character.chef() },
	})
	--animator_fo.transform:Find('fx').transform:Find('fire').gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('sub_grain_tea_2')

	if self.time_conversion ~= nil then
		self.time_conversion:unregister_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key)
	end

	self.assistant_manager:exit()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state <= self.states.scene_1 and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_character.chef()) then
		self.sp_controller:try_start_coroutine(self.assistant_interact_scene, self)

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.scene_2 and
			(lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_interact_item_wall(1)) or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_interact_item_wall(2)) or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_interact_item_wall(3)) or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_interact_item_wall(4)) or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_interact_item_wall(5)) or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_interact_item_wall(6)) or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_interact_item_wall(7)) or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_interact_item_wall(8)) or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_interact_pot(1))) then
		self.sp_controller:try_start_coroutine(self.assistant_manager.interact_fo, self.assistant_manager, e.Target.Name)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.scene_3 and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_character.chef()) then
		self.sp_controller:try_start_coroutine(self.re_assistant_interact_scene, self)
	end

	return true
end
--endregion event

--region Custom
function local_class:show_daylight()
	local chef = self.get_character.chef()

	start_coroutine(function()
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(chef, 0, 1)

		wait_for_sec(1)
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('sub_grain_tea_2', {
			{ zone = 'restaurant', target = self.get_character.chef() },
		})

		if self.current_state <= self.states.scene_1 then
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(chef)

			scene_util.set_direction(chef, 'left', false)
		elseif self.current_state == self.states.scene_3 then
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(chef)

			scene_util.set_direction(chef, 'left', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(chef, self, 'tired')
			scene_util.set_anim(chef, self, 'cast')
		end

		character_util.add_color(chef, 'dark_tint', unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 }), 1, 0)

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(chef, 1, 1.5)

		character_util.add_listener(chef, self.controller)
	end)
end

function local_class:hide_night()
	local chef = self.get_character.chef()

	start_coroutine(function()
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(chef, 0, 1)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('sub_grain_tea_2')

		if self.current_state <= self.states.scene_1 then
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(chef)

			scene_util.set_direction(chef, 'down', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(chef, self, 'empty')
		elseif self.current_state == self.states.scene_3 then
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(chef)

			scene_util.set_direction(chef, 'down', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(chef, self, 'empty')
		end

		character_util.add_color(chef, 'dark_tint', unity_color({ 0.2, 0.6, 1, 1 }), 1, 0)

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(chef, 0.5, 1)

		character_util.remove_relate_event(chef, self.controller)
	end)
end

function local_class:game_start_routine(is_easy_mode)
	self.current_state = self.states.scene_2

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_character.chef(), self.controller)

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('sub_grain_tea_2')

	self.assistant_manager:enter(is_easy_mode)
	self.assistant_manager:start()

	local animator_fo = self.get_interact_pot(1)
	--animator_fo.transform:Find('fx').transform:Find('fire').gameObject:SetActive(true)

	local chef = self.get_character.chef()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(chef, 'left', false)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(chef)

	leader.Position = chef.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)

	chef.Position = chef.Position + vector(3, 0, 0)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	camera_util.resize_to_default_async(0)

	--서클로 페이드 인 - 1.5초
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1.5, interpolations_constants.linear)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--린 (left, idle, idle) : 그럼 바로 불을 지필게요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chef, self.controller,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'dv_grain_tea_s2_15')

	--린 (right, idle, eat) - 자세 유지
	scene_util.set_direction(chef, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(chef, self, 'eat')

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_catch_fire_01')

	--[GIMMICK]witch_cauldron에 fire fx가 켜짐.
	animator_fo.transform:Find('fx').gameObject:SetActive(true)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 경기 시작 카운트
	local start_count = 3
	local start_count_string_key = 'nm_ds_sub_maid_cafe_activity_count'
	local title_mod = 2.1
	for i = start_count, 1, -1 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:Format(start_count_string_key, i), title_mod)

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	self.is_playing = true

	--self:remove_equipment(leader)
	self:hide_button()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_car_crash', state = 'event' })

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.assistant_manager:item_check(self.assistant_manager.pattern_data[1])
	end)

	start_coroutine(self.update_routine, self)
end

function local_class:update_routine()
	if not self.is_playing then
		return
	end

	local time_passed = 0

	timer_util.start_timer(
			{ duration = self.time_limit, handler = self, callback = 'timer_finished' })

	self.miss_item_game_end = false

	self.is_game_clear = false

	while self.is_playing do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		--self.assistant_manager:update(dt)

		if time_passed >= self.time_limit then
			self:game_end(false)
		elseif self.miss_item_game_end then
			self:game_end(false, true)
		elseif self.is_game_clear then
			self:game_end(true)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--self:show_equipment(get_party_leader(), self.save_weapon.weapon1, self.save_weapon.weapon2)

	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomButton1 | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)

	-- 밤/낮 버튼 비활성화
	self.time_conversion:conversion_active_setting(true)

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseOptionButton = true

function local_class:game_end(is_clear, miss_item)
	miss_item = lua_helper.get_or_default(miss_item, false)

	self.is_playing = false

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('sub_grain_tea_2', {
		{ zone = 'restaurant', target = self.get_character.chef() },
	})

	-- 타이머 정지
	self:timer_finished()

	self.assistant_manager:state_reset()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.leader)
	character_util.add_listener(self.get_character.chef(), self.controller)

	if is_clear then
		--성공
		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_character.chef(), self.controller)

		sp_util.start_scene(self.game_cleared_scene, self)
	else
		--실패
		character_util.add_listener(self.get_character.chef(), self.controller)

		start_coroutine(self.game_failed_scene, self, miss_item)
	end
end

--[액티비티 성공 연출]
function local_class:game_cleared_scene()

--[액티비티 실패 연출]

	miss_item = lua_helper.get_or_default(miss_item, false)

	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	self.current_state = self.states.scene_3

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local chef = self.get_character.chef()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	if not miss_item then
		--타임 오버
		--플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗음

		--기사 린 방향으로 정렬
		character_util.look_at(leader, chef)

		camera_util.move_async(chef.Position, 1)

		animator_fo.transform:Find('fx').gameObject:SetActive(false)

		--린 (right, surprise, idle) jump 2회
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(chef)

		scene_util.set_emotion(chef, self, 'surprise')

		character_util.normal_jump_async(chef, '01_small_jump_01')
		character_util.normal_jump_async(chef, '01_small_jump_01')

				{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
				'embarrassed',
				'damaged',
				'dv_grain_tea_s2_17')

		--린 (right, tired, idle)
		--1초 대기
		scene_util.play_wait_action(chef, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				'tired',
				1)

		--린 (플레이어 방향, tired, idle) : 이러면 재료들의 익힘 정도가 모두 달라져 버린다구요…!

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chef, self,

				nil,
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
				'tired',
				'dv_grain_tea_s2_17_2')

		--린 (플레이어 방향, tired, idle) : 다음엔 조금만 더 빨리 부탁드릴게요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chef, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				'tired',
				'dv_grain_tea_s2_18')

		--페이드 아웃 - 1.5초
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	else
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(chef)

		--재료 미스
		--플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗음

		--기사 린 방향으로 정렬
		character_util.look_at(leader, chef)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		--다음 동작 동시 실행
		--카메라 Shake (0.3,0.3)
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

		--린 (right, surprise, idle) jump 2회 : 앗! 그 재료가 아니에요!
		character_util.normal_jump_async(chef, '01_small_jump_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(chef, '01_small_jump_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chef, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				'surprise',
				'dv_grain_tea_s2_19')

		--린 (right, tired, idle)
		--1초 대기
		scene_util.play_wait_action(chef, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				'tired',
				1)

		--린 (플레이어 방향, tired, cast) : 이런 건 황혼 808이 아니에요…!
		character_util.look_at(chef, leader)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chef, self,
				nil,
				{ name = 'cast', keep = true },
				{ name = 'tired', keep = true },

				{ name = 'cast', keep = true },
				{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
				'dv_grain_tea_s2_19_2')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1.5, interpolations_constants.linear)

	chef.Position = chef.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0)

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(chef, 'left', false)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(chef)

	leader.Position = chef.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	camera_util.resize_to_default_async(0)

	scene_util.set_anim(chef, self, 'cast')
	scene_util.set_emotion(chef, self, 'tired')

	local animator_fo = self.get_interact_pot(1)
	animator_fo.transform:Find('fx').gameObject:SetActive(false)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(leader, false)
	local disabled_control = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)
			~ CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Move)
			~ CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash)
			~ CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact)

	message_system:SendSync(leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	field_ui_util.hide_default_single_ui()

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	scene_util.hide_weapon(leader)

	self.time_conversion:conversion_active_setting(false)

function local_class:re_assistant_interact_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local chef = self.get_character.chef()

	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	wp_util.move_async(leader, chef.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 2, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

	--기사 선택지 출력
	local choose_result = nil

	if not (self.minigame_count >= 3) then
		--린 (left, tired, cast) : 다음엔 잘할 수 있을거에요! 다시 한 번 해볼까요?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chef, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				'dv_grain_tea_s2_20')

		--기사 선택지 출력
		choose_result = choose_util.play_async({
			--(mercy) : 조금만 더 빠르게 하면 될 것 같아!
			{ 'dv_grain_tea_s2_choose_3', 'mercy' },
			--(brutal) : 조금만 쉴래…
			{ 'dv_grain_tea_s2_choose_4', 'brutal' },
		})
	else
		--[3회째 실패 후 재시작 연출]
		--린 (left, tired, cast) : 계속 이러면 요리를 평생 완성하지 못할 것 같은데…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chef, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				'dv_grain_tea_s2_20_1')

		--린 (left, tired, cast) : 레시피를 더 간단하게 해서 진행해볼까요?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chef, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				'dv_grain_tea_s2_20_2')

		choose_result = choose_util.play_async({
			--(mercy) : 조금만 더 빠르게 하면 될 것 같아!
			{ 'dv_grain_tea_s2_choose_3', 'mercy' },
			--(brutal) : 조금만 쉴래…
			{ 'dv_grain_tea_s2_choose_4', 'brutal' },
			--(intellect) 쉽게쉽게 가자.
			{ 'dv_grain_tea_s2_choose_7', 'intellect' },
		})
	end

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--(mercy) : 조금만 더 빠르게 하면 될 것 같아!
		--기사 (right, idle, nod 2회)
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		--서클로 페이드 아웃 - 1.5초
		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1.5, interpolations_constants.linear)

		camera_util.resize_to_default_async(0)

		--주방보조 액티비티 시작
		self:game_start_routine(false)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		--(brutal) : 조금만 쉴래…
		--기사 (right, tired, idle) sweat 이모티콘 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				'tired',
				'sweat')

		--린 (left, tired, nod 2회) : 알겠어요. 저는 여기서 기다릴게요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chef, self,
				nil,
				{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
				'tired',
				'dv_grain_tea_s2_22')

		scene_util.set_anim(chef, self, 'cast')
		scene_util.set_emotion(chef, self, 'tired')

		--플레이어 컨트롤 해제.
		--이후 재 인터랙트 시 여기부터 다시 반복
		self.current_state = self.states.scene_3

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field',
											 name = 'ondemand/v3_10_dreamvillage/preload:bgm_dreamvillage_day' })

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
	elseif choose_result == 3 then
		--(intellect) 쉽게쉽게 가자.
		--기사 (right, tired, nod 2회)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		--린 (left, tired, nod 2회) : 맛은 조금 떨어지겠지만… 그렇게라도 해봐요!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chef, self,
				nil,
				{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
				'tired',
				'dv_grain_tea_s2_22_1')

		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1.5, interpolations_constants.linear)

		camera_util.resize_to_default_async(0)

		--이지모드 진행
		self:game_start_routine(true)
	end
