--region minigame
function assistant_manager:init(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	self.leader = nil

	--scene_1은 스타트
	-- 게임 재료 투입 순서
	-- 감자 양파 두리안 피망 버섯 맨드레이크
	-- 0, 5, 3, 4, 8, 2, 7
	self.states = nil

	self.current_state = nil

	self.pattern_data = nil

	--region FieldObject
	--요리 공간
	--1 == 당근, 2 == 버섯,
	--3 == 양파, 4 == 두리안,
	--5 == 감자, 6 == 새 알,
	--7 == 맨드레이크, 8 == 피망
	--인터렉트용 월
	self.get_interact_item_wall = self.controller.get_interact_item_wall

	--냄비
	self.get_interact_pot_wall = function(number)
		return get_field_object('sub_gt_interact_pot_' .. number)
	end

	--아이템 묶음용 월 (들기용)
	self.get_item_container = function()
		return get_field_object('sub_gt_item_container')
	end

	--길막용 월
	self.get_block_wall = function(number)
		return get_field_object('sub_gt_block_wall_' .. number)
	end

	--endregion FieldObject

	--region Sprite
	self.sprite = {
		sprite_info = {
			carrot = 21444,
			mushroom = 21445,
			onion = 21446,
			durian = 21447,
			potato = 21448,
			egg = 21449,
			mandrake = 21450,
			paprika = 21451,
		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}

	--재료 관련 저장 풀 (테이블 + string)
	self.ingredient_pool = nil
	--endregion Sprite

	--region Fx
	self.fx = self.controller.fx
	--endregion Fx

	self.item_data = nil

	self.player = nil

	self.state = nil

	self.player_hold_height = 1.4

	self.wait_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.interact_item_count = 8

	self.fx_list = nil
end

function assistant_manager:enter(is_easy_mode)
	self.is_easy_mode = is_easy_mode

	--1 == 당근, 2 == 버섯,
	--3 == 양파, 4 == 두리안,
	--5 == 감자, 6 == 새 알,
	--7 == 맨드레이크, 8 == 피망

	--scene_1은 스타트
	-- 게임 재료 투입 순서
	-- 감자 양파 두리안 피망 버섯 맨드레이크
	-- 0, 5, 3, 4, 8, 2, 7
	if not self.is_easy_mode then
		-- 기본 모드
		self.states = {
			none = 0,
			scene_1 = 1,
			scene_2 = 2,
			scene_3 = 3,
			scene_4 = 4,
			scene_5 = 5,
			scene_6 = 6,
			clear = 7
		}
		self.current_state = self.states.none

		self.pattern_data = {
			0, 5, 3, 4, 8, 2, 7
		}
	else
		-- 이지 모드
		self.states = {
			none = 0,
			scene_1 = 1,
			scene_2 = 2,
			scene_3 = 3,
			scene_4 = 4,
			clear = 5
		}
		self.current_state = self.states.none

		-- 감자 달걀 당근 맨드레이크
		self.pattern_data = {
			0, 5, 6, 1, 7
		}

		self.fx_list = {}
	end

	self.sprite.sprite_table = {}
	self.sprite.sprite_table_origin_parent = {}

	self.chef = self.controller.get_character.chef()
	self.leader = get_party_leader()

	self.state = {
		normal = 1,
		holding = 2,
		finished_dish_holding = 3,
	}

	self.player = {
		current_state = self.state.normal,
		hold_item_number = nil
	}

	self.ingredient_pool = {
		{},
		{},
		{},
		{},
		{},
		{},
		{},
		{},
	}

	self.item_container = self.get_item_container(1)

	local attach_item_container_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.leader.Position,
			self.player_hold_height)

	self.item_container.Position = attach_item_container_pos

	self.item_container.Transform:SetParent(self.leader.transform)
end

function assistant_manager:start()
	self.current_state = self.states.scene_1
	self:enable_publish_interact_fo()
	self:pre_setting()
	self.time_passed = 0

	--미니게임 진행한 횟수
	self.controller.minigame_count = self.controller.minigame_count + 1
end

function assistant_manager:exit()
	if self.fx_list then
		for _, target in pairs(self.fx_list) do
			if target then
				target:Dispose()
				target = nil
			end
		end

		self.fx_list = nil
	end

	self.sprite:dispose_all()

	self:disable_publish_interact_fo()
end

function assistant_manager:enable_publish_interact_fo()
	for idx = 1, self.interact_item_count do
		local target = self.get_interact_item_wall(idx)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.enabled)
		target.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	local pot = self.get_interact_pot_wall(1)
	pot.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.item_container, active_state_type.enabled)

	local block_wall_1 = self.get_block_wall(1)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(block_wall_1, active_state_type.enabled)

	local block_wall_2 = self.get_block_wall(2)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(block_wall_2, active_state_type.enabled)
end

function assistant_manager:disable_publish_interact_fo()
	for idx = 1, self.interact_item_count do
		local target = self.get_interact_item_wall(idx)
		target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.disabled)
	end

	local pot = self.get_interact_pot_wall(1)
	pot.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.item_container, active_state_type.disabled)

	local block_wall_1 = self.get_block_wall(1)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(block_wall_1, active_state_type.disabled)

	local block_wall_2 = self.get_block_wall(2)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(block_wall_2, active_state_type.disabled)
end

function assistant_manager:pop_pool_sprite_name(number)
	self:return_pool_sprite()

	table.remove(self.ingredient_pool[number], 1)

	return number
end

function assistant_manager:return_pool_sprite()
	if self.player.hold_item_number and
			table_util.is_empty(self.ingredient_pool[self.player.hold_item_number]) then
		table.insert(self.ingredient_pool[self.player.hold_item_number], 'sub_gt_interact_item_wall_' .. self.player.hold_item_number)
	end
end

function assistant_manager:item_interact_event(number)
	local item_number = self:pop_pool_sprite_name(tonumber(number))

	if self.player.hold_item_number then
		self:state_reset()
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_holdup_01')
	character_util.set_anim(self.leader, { name = 'hold_loop', upper = true })

	self:common_enable_ingredients_interact_event(item_number)

	self.player.current_state = self.state.holding
	self.player.hold_item_number = item_number
end

function assistant_manager:pot_interact_event(number)
	if number then
		--아이템을 들고 있을 경우
		start_coroutine(self.throw_scene, self, number)
	else
		--아이템을 들고 있지 않을 경우
		start_coroutine(self.not_holding_scene, self)
	end
end

--포트에 던지는 이벤트
function assistant_manager:throw_scene(number)
	--기사 throw 애니메이션 출력
	scene_util.set_anim(self.leader, self.controller, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })
	local save_item_number = self.player.hold_item_number
	--들고 있는 아이템 스프라이트 냄비로 던져짐.
	local item = self.sprite.sprite_table['sub_gt_interact_item_wall_' .. number]
	self:return_pool_sprite(number)

	if self.player.hold_item_number then
		self:state_reset(item.Position)
	end

	local start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.leader.Position, self.player_hold_height)
	local end_pos = self.get_interact_pot_wall(1).Bounds.center

	coroutine_util.while_each_frame(0.5, function(progress)
		local pos = self:bezier_curves(start_pos, end_pos, progress, 1)

		item.Position = pos
	end)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wolf_boss_bomb_01')

	--fx_smoke 출력되며 아이템 사라짐.
	self.fx.smoke():Instantiate(end_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5))

	--아이템 들고 있음
	if not self:item_check(save_item_number) then
		self.controller.miss_item_game_end = true
	end

	--기사 초기 상태로 전환

end

function assistant_manager:item_check(target_item_number)
	if self.is_easy_mode then
		return self:easy_item_check(target_item_number)
	else
		return self:normal_item_check(target_item_number)
	end
end

function assistant_manager:normal_item_check(target_item_number)
	--0, 5, 3, 4, 8, 2, 7
	if self.current_state == self.states.scene_1 and
			target_item_number == self.pattern_data[1] then
		self.current_state = self.current_state + 1

		--린 (right, idle, eat) : 일단 감자를 가지고 와주세요!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.chef, self.controller,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'dv_grain_tea_s2_23', skip = false })

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.scene_2 and
			target_item_number == self.pattern_data[2] then
		self.current_state = self.current_state + 1

		--린 (right, idle, eat) : 다음은 양파!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.chef, self.controller,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'dv_grain_tea_s2_24', skip = false })

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.scene_3 and
			target_item_number == self.pattern_data[3] then
		self.current_state = self.current_state + 1

		--린 (right, idle, eat) : 다음은 두리안!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.chef, self.controller,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'dv_grain_tea_s2_25', skip = false })

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.scene_4 and
			target_item_number == self.pattern_data[4] then
		self.current_state = self.current_state + 1

		--린 (right, idle, eat) : 다음은 피망!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.chef, self.controller,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'dv_grain_tea_s2_26', skip = false })

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.scene_5 and
			target_item_number == self.pattern_data[5] then
		self.current_state = self.current_state + 1

		--린 (right, idle, eat) : 다음은 버섯!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.chef, self.controller,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'dv_grain_tea_s2_27', skip = false })

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.scene_6 and

function assistant_manager:bezier_curves(start_pos, end_pos, progress, height)
	local pos = {
		start_pos,
		start_pos + vector(0, height, 0),
		end_pos + vector(0, height, 0),
		end_pos
	}
	local a_pos, b_pos, c_pos, d_pos, e_pos, f_pos

	a_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[1], pos[2], progress)
	b_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[2], pos[3], progress)
	c_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[3], pos[4], progress)
	d_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(a_pos, b_pos, progress)
	e_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(b_pos, c_pos, progress)
	f_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(d_pos, e_pos, progress)

	return f_pos
end

function assistant_manager:interact_fo(target_name)
	local string_length = string.len(target_name)

	local number = string.sub(target_name, string_length, string_length)

	-- _1 _2 와 같은 인덱스 제거
	local sub_target_name = string.sub(target_name, 1, string_length - 2)

	if self.player.current_state == self.state.normal then
		--기본 상태 (아무 것도 들고 있지 않은 상태)
		if sub_target_name == 'sub_gt_interact_item_wall' then
			--당근인 경우 들어 올림
			self:item_interact_event(number)
		elseif target_name == 'sub_gt_interact_pot_1' then
			self:pot_interact_event()
		end

		return
	elseif self.player.current_state == self.state.holding then
		--재료를 들고 있는 상태
		if target_name == 'sub_gt_interact_pot_1' then
			self:pot_interact_event(self.player.hold_item_number)
		elseif sub_target_name == 'sub_gt_interact_item_wall' then
			--야채인 경우
			self:item_interact_event(number)

			return
		end
	end
end

---@param interval table vector x, y, z 값이 dictionary 형태로 존재 (없을 시 false)
---@param is_get_fx boolean get 이펙트 출력 유무
function assistant_manager:common_enable_ingredients_interact_event(item_number, interval, is_get_fx)
	local interval = lua_helper.get_or_default(interval, false)
	local is_get_fx = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_get_fx, true)

	local target = self.sprite.sprite_table['sub_gt_interact_item_wall_' .. item_number]

	if not target then
		return
	end

	if interval then
		target.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.leader.Position + vector(interval.x, 0, interval.z), self.player_hold_height + interval.y)
	else
		target.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.leader.Position, self.player_hold_height)
	end

	if is_get_fx then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_get_drop_item_01')
		self.fx.get():Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(self.leader.Position, self.player_hold_height))

		local target_pos = target_data.pos
		local target_dir = target_data.dir
		local target_emo = target_data.emo
		local target_anim = target_data.anim
		local target_tint = target_data.tint
		local target_shake = target_data.shake
		local target_is_anim_loop = target_data.is_anim_loop
		local target_effect = target_data.effect
		local target_alpha = target_data.alpha
		local target_function = target_data.coroutine_function
		local target_listener = target_data.listener

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

		character_util.set_anim_time_scale(target, 1)

		if target_emo then
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, target_emo)
		end

		if target_listener then
			character_util.add_listener(target, self.controller)
		end

		if target_anim then
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = target_anim, loop = target_is_anim_loop, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		if target_shake then
			scene_util.shake(target, 0.03, 9999, false)
		end

		if target_tint then

		if target_alpha then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(target, target_alpha, 0)
		end

		if target_effect then
			local fx = target_effect():Instantiate(target.Position)
			self.fx_list[target.Name] = fx
		end

		if target_function then
			start_coroutine(function()
				target_function(target)
			end)
		end

	end
end

				upper = true,
				scale = 0.5,
				count = 2
			})
end

local controller_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Base/QuestControllerBase')

---@class DreamVillageMainController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageMainController', controller_base)

local util = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Main/DreamVillage/Common/CommonUtil')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	-- 사용할 섹션 스크립트 정보. 주석 해제하고 사용
	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = false,
		NormalSectionCount = 27,
		HasPostSection = false
	}

	self.quest_name = 'dream_village_main'

	--region Section 1, 2, 3

	self.amb_sfx = {
		handler = nil,

		---@type fun(this:self, sfx_name:string, volume:number,mix:number):AudioSourceHolder
		play = function(this, sfx_name, volume, mix)
			if this.handler == nil then
				this.handler = music_player_util.play_sfx({
					sfx_name = sfx_name, volume = volume, fade_in_time = mix, loop = true, type_priority = 'event'
				})
			end

			return this.handler
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self, volume:number,mix:number)
		change_volume = function(this, volume, mix)
			if this.handler == nil then
				return
			end

			music_player_util.change_sfx_volume(this.handler, volume, mix)
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self, fade_time:number)
		stop = function(this, fade_time)
			if this.handler == nil then
				return
			end

			if type_util.is_number(fade_time) then
				music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(this.handler, fade_time)
			else
				music_player_util.stop_sfx(this.handler)
			end

			this.handler = nil
		end,
	}

	--endregion Section 1, 2, 3

	--#region 19, 20섹션
	self.companion_walls = {
		insts = {},

		add = function(this, inst)
			table.insert(this.insts, inst)
		end,

		get = function(this, idx)
			return this.insts[idx]
		end,

		remove_by_idx = function(this, idx)
			if this.insts[idx] ~= nil then
				this.insts[idx]:Dispose()
				this.insts[idx] = nil
			end
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			for k, v in ipairs(this.insts) do
				if v ~= nil then
					v:Dispose()
					v = nil
				end
			end

			this.insts = nil
		end
	}
	--#endregion
end

function local_class:load_resource()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.companion_walls:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
	self.amb_sfx:stop()

local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageMainSection10')

local event_zone_name = 's10_event_zone'
local library_zone_name = 's10_library_event_zone'

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DreamVillageMain @
		Comment = 서고 안에서 강림을 발견하는 연출 @
		Index = 9 @
		NextSections = 10 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type DreamVillageMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'dreamvillage_2'

	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		library_event = 2,
		show_reaper = 3,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.fx = {
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,

		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,

		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	self.npc = {
		-- 도화
		twins_younger = function()
			return get_character('twins_younger')
		end,
		-- 강림
		reaper = function()
			return get_character('reaper_1')
		end,
	}

	self.time_conversion_event_key = 'main_s10'

	self.is_enter_event_zone = false

	self.sp_controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:load_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent), 'on_time_conversion_changed_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_jump_exit_pos_1') },
		{ zone = 'cave_field', target = get_field_object('cave_outer') },
		{ zone = 'library_way_field', target = get_field_object('library_inner_1') },
		{ zone = 'library_field', target = field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_reaper_pos_1') },
	})

	local created, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

	if self.time_conversion ~= nil then
		self.time_conversion = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, library_zone_name) then

		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.enter_library_event_zone, self)

		return true

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.library_event and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, event_zone_name) then

		if self.time_conversion:is_daylight() then
			self.is_enter_event_zone = true
			self.time_conversion.is_reset_control = false
		else
			self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.enter_reaper_zone, self)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, leader, event_zone_name) then
		self.is_enter_event_zone = false
		self.time_conversion.is_reset_control = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_time_conversion_changed_event(_)
	if self.current_state == self.states.library_event and
			self.is_enter_event_zone and
			self.time_conversion.is_reset_control == false then
		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.enter_reaper_zone, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:enter_library_event_zone()

local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageMainSection12')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DreamVillageMain @
		Comment = @
		Index = 11 @
		NextSections = 12 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type DreamVillageMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'dreamvillage_3'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		gacha_box = 2,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.quest_marker_name = 'main_quest'

	-- npc
	self.characters = {
		male_hulk = function()
			return get_character('male_hulk')
		end,
		twins_younger = function()
			return get_character('twins_younger')
		end,
		twins_older = function()
			return get_character('twins_older')
		end
	}

	-- marker
	self.markers = {
		male_hulk_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s12_male_hulk_pos')
		end,
		leader_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s12_leader_pos')
		end,
		twins_younger_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s12_twins_younger_pos')
		end,
		twins_older_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s12_twins_older_pos_' .. number)
		end,
	}

	self.fo = {
		gacha_box = function()
			return get_field_object('s12_gacha_box')
		end
	}

	-- fx
	self.fx = setmetatable({
		dead = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, func in pairs(this) do
					func()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	-- 밤낮 이벤트 키
	self.time_conversion_event_key = 'main_s12'
	-- 뽑기 아이템 id
	self.stick_item_id = 21363
	-- 복주머니 아이템 id
	self.luckybag_item_id = 21366
	-- 꽝 아이템 id
	self.paper_item_id = 21367
	-- 행운의 편지 아이템 id
	self.latter_item_id = 21368
	-- 뽑기 주머니 아이템 id
	self.sack_item_id = 21426

	self.sp_controller = nil
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
end

function local_class:start()
	self:start_setting()

	local created, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)
end

function local_class:exit()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.characters.twins_older(), self.controller)
	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_name)

	local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

	if time_conversion ~= nil then
		time_conversion:unregister_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.twins_older()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.gacha_box

		local is_entered = self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.gacha_box_event, self)
		if not is_entered then
			self.current_state = self.states.none
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_setting()
	do
		-- 밤/낮 세팅
		local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

		-- 콜백 등록
		time_conversion:register_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key, {
			-- 낮
			daylight = function()
				self:show_twins_older()
			end,
			-- 밤
			night = function()
				self:hide_twins_older()
			end
		}, true)
	end
end

function local_class:show_twins_older()
	local twins_older = self.characters.twins_older()
	local male_hulk = self.characters.male_hulk()

	--서화 right, smile, idle
	character_util.set_position(twins_older, self.markers.twins_older_pos(1))
	character_util.set_direction(twins_older, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(twins_older, self, 'smile')
	character_util.remove_anim(twins_older)

	--아저씨(남) right, smile, idle
	character_util.set_position(male_hulk, self.markers.male_hulk_pos())
	character_util.set_direction(male_hulk, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(male_hulk, self, 'smile')
	character_util.remove_anim(male_hulk)

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.quest_marker_name, {
		{ zone = 'village_field', target = twins_older }
	})

	self.controller:show_time_conversion(false, function()
		character_util.add_listener(twins_older, self.controller)
	end, { twins_older, male_hulk })
end

function local_class:hide_twins_older()
	local twins_older = self.characters.twins_older()
	local male_hulk = self.characters.male_hulk()

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_name)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(twins_older, self.controller)

	self.controller:hide_time_conversion(false, nil, { twins_older, male_hulk })
end

function local_class:add_gacha_item(item_pos, item_id)
	local id = lua_helper.get_or_default(item_id, self.stick_item_id)
	local item_scale = 0.6
	local rotate_angle = 45

	if id == self.sack_item_id then
		item_scale = 0.8
		rotate_angle = 110
	elseif id ~= self.stick_item_id then
		item_scale = 1
		rotate_angle = 0
	end

	local gacha_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = item_pos,
		item_id = id,
		spr_scale = item_scale,
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		show_on_character = true,
		skip_text = true
	})

	quest_drop_item_util.rotate(gacha_item, rotate_angle, 0)

	return gacha_item
end

function local_class:give_item(item_id, from, to)
	scene_util.set_anim(from, self, { name = 'release', count = 1, sfx_name = '01_throw_01' })
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	local item_scale = 0.6

	if item_id == self.sack_item_id then
		item_scale = 0.8
	end

	local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = from.Position,
		target = to.Position,
		item_id = item_id,
		spr_scale = item_scale,
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		show_on_character = true,
		skip_text = true
	})

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	quest_drop_item_util.consumed(item, to)
end

	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.characters.male_hulk(), active_state_type.disabled)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.characters.twins_older(), self.controller)
	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_name)

		time_conversion:unregister_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key)

		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.twins_older()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.stone_statue

		local is_entered = self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.stone_statue_event, self)
		if not is_entered then
			self.current_state = self.states.none
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_setting()
	do
		-- 밤/낮 세팅
		local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

		-- 콜백 등록
		time_conversion:register_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key, {
			-- 낮
			daylight = function()
				self:show_twins_older()
			end,
			-- 밤
			night = function()
				self:hide_twins_older()
			end
		}, true)
	end

local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageMainSection15')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DreamVillageMain @
		Comment = @
		Index = 14 @
		NextSections = 15 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type DreamVillageMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'dreamvillage_3'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		reaper_talk = 2,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.quest_marker_name = 'main_quest'

	-- npc
	self.characters = {
		twins_younger = function()
			return get_character('twins_younger')
		end,
		reaper = function()
			return get_character('reaper')
		end
	}

	-- marker
	self.markers = {
		leader_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s15_leader_pos')
		end,
		twins_younger_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s15_twins_younger_pos')
		end,
		reaper_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s15_reaper_pos')
		end
	}

	-- 밤낮 이벤트 키
	self.time_conversion_event_key = 'main_s15'

	self.sp_controller = nil
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
end

function local_class:start()
	self:start_setting()

	local created, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)
end

function local_class:exit()
	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_name)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.characters.reaper(), self.controller)

	local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

	if time_conversion ~= nil then
		time_conversion:unregister_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.reaper()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.reaper_talk

		local is_entered = self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.reaper_talk_event, self)
		if not is_entered then
			self.current_state = self.states.none
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_setting()
	do
		-- 밤/낮 세팅
		local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

		-- 콜백 등록
		time_conversion:register_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key, {
			-- 낮
			daylight = function()
				self:show_reaper()
			end,
			-- 밤
			night = function()
				self:hide_reaper()
			end
		}, true)
	end
end

function local_class:show_reaper()
	local reaper = self.characters.reaper()

	--칠득이 down, dumb_idle, idle
	--아래에서 칠득이는 dumb_idle/dumb_smile 둘 중 하나의 표정으로만 있어야 합니다.
	character_util.set_position(reaper, self.markers.reaper_pos())
	character_util.set_direction(reaper, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(reaper, self, 'dumb_smile')
	character_util.remove_anim(reaper)

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_name)
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.quest_marker_name, {
		{ zone = 'village_field', target = get_field_object('exit_2_1') },
		{ zone = 'forest', target = get_field_object('exit_3_1') },
		{ zone = 'cave', target = self.characters.reaper() },
	})

	self.controller:show_time_conversion(false, function()
		character_util.add_listener(reaper, self.controller)
	end, { reaper })
end

function local_class:hide_reaper()
	local reaper = self.characters.reaper()

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_name)
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.quest_marker_name, {
		{ zone = 'village_field', target = get_field_object('exit_2_1') },
		{ zone = 'forest', target = get_field_object('exit_3_1') },
		{ zone = 'cave', target = self.markers.reaper_pos() },
	})

	character_util.remove_relate_event(reaper, self.controller)

	self.controller:hide_time_conversion(false, nil, { reaper })
end

local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageMainSection17')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DreamVillageMain @
		Comment = @
		Index = 16 @
		NextSections = 17 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type DreamVillageMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = { 'dreamvillage_4' }

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		intro = 1,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.intro

	-- 퀘스트 마커 이름
	self.quest_marker_name = 'dreamvillage_main'

	-- character
	self.characters = {
		princess = function()
			return get_character('princess')
		end,

		-- 저승사자 강림
		reaper = function()
			return get_character('reaper')
		end,
	}

	-- field object
	self.field_object = {
	}

	-- marker
	self.markers = {
		camera      = function(inner_state, idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s17_' .. inner_state .. '_camera_' .. idx)
		end,

		leader = function(inner_state, idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s17_' .. inner_state .. '_knight_' .. idx)
		end,

		princess = function(inner_state, idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s17_' .. inner_state .. '_princess_' .. idx)
		end,

		reaper = function(inner_state, idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s17_' .. inner_state .. '_reaper_' .. idx)
		end,
	}

	self.fx = {
		cached_inst = {},

		cache = function(this, fx)
			table.insert(this.cached_inst, fx)
		end,

		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if type_util.is_function(load_func) and
						name ~= 'load_all' and
						name ~= 'cache' and
						name ~= 'dispose' then

					load_func()
				end
			end
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			for i = 1, #this.cached_inst do
				this.cached_inst[i]:Dispose()
				this.cached_inst[i] = nil
			end

			this.cached_inst = nil
		end
	}

	-- item sprite
	-- 사용할 아이템들 sprite name
	self.item_sprite = {
	}

	-- item
	-- 사용할 아이템들 id
	self.item_id = {
	}

	self.items = {
		data = nil,
		add_item = function(this, item_id, unique_id, pos, target_pos, scale, create_on_character, dont_show_loot_text, local_scale)
			if this.data == nil then
				this.data = {}
			end

			create_on_character = lua_helper.get_or_default(create_on_character, false)
			target_pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(target_pos, nil)
			local_scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(local_scale, nil)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = pos,
				item_id = item_id,
				spr_scale = scale,
				unique_id = unique_id,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				show_on_character = create_on_character,
				skip_text = dont_show_loot_text,
				target = target_pos
			})

			if local_scale ~= nil then
				item.SpriteTransform.localScale = local_scale
				item.ShadowTransform.localScale = local_scale
			end

			table.insert(this.data, item)
		end,
		pop_item = function(this, unique_id)
			if this.data ~= nil then
				for i, item in ipairs(this.data) do
					if item.UniqueId == unique_id then
						local pop_item = item

						table.remove(this.data, i)

						return pop_item
					end
				end
			end

			return nil
		end,

		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.data ~= nil then
				for i = 1, #this.data do
					quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(this.data[i])
					this.data[i] = nil
				end

				this.data = nil
			end
		end
	}

	-- 환경음
	self.ambi_sfx = nil
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
end

function local_class:start()
	-- 초기 NPC 셋팅
	self:set_pre_npc()
	self:set_current_scene_npc()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	-- 인트로 이벤트 시작
	start_coroutine(self.play_intro_scene, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil

	if self.ambi_sfx ~= nil then
		self.ambi_sfx:Stop()
		self.ambi_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

--region npc setting
function local_class:set_pre_npc()
	-- npc 초기 셋팅 데이터 테이블
	self.pre_npc_data = {
		[self.states.intro] = {
			[1] = {
				pos = self.markers.leader(1, 1),
				name = 'leader',
				dir = 'right',
				emo = 'attack',
				anim = 'release',
			},

			[2] = {
				pos = self.markers.reaper(1, 1),
				name = 'reaper',
				dir = 'left',
				emo = 'sleep_deep',
				anim = 'cross_arm',
			},
		},
	}
end

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc()
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[self.current_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)

		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.interaction then
			npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		end

		if npc_data.string ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.string) then
			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.string
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.weapon_1_id then
			character_util.set_equipment(npc, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1,
					npc_data.weapon_1_id, true)
		end

		if npc_data.weapon_2_id then
			character_util.set_equipment(npc, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2,
					npc_data.weapon_2_id, true)
		end

		if npc_data.show_weapon then
			scene_util.show_weapon(npc)
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end
	end)
end
--endregion

function local_class:play_intro_scene()
	local leader= user_party.Leader
	local princess= self.characters.princess()
	local reaper= self.characters.reaper()

	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	camera_util.move(self.markers.camera(1, 1), 0)

	self.ambi_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_amb_village_02', volum = 0.6, loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', fade_in_time = 5 })

	-- 어두운 상태에서 카메라 2초간 페이드 인 실행.
	-- 플레이어 right, attack, release를 2초간 유지.
	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')

	screen_util.fade_in_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 페이드 인 완료 후 플레이어 (right, attack, cast2), 2초간 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cast2' },
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			2)

	-- 플레이어 (right, attack, idle),
	-- 강림 (left, sleep_deep, cross_arm), 2초간 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	scene_util.play_wait_action(reaper, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cross_arm', keep = true },
			{ name = 'sleep_deep', keep = true },
			2)

	-- 플레이어 (right, idle, idle), 강림 (left, sleep_deep, cross_arm) 유지 상태 적용.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	--강림 (left, sleep_deep, cross_arm) : 불찰이군… 모든 일에는 순서가 있는 법인데…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'left',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'dv_main_s17_1_1')

	--강림 (left, sleep_deep, cross_arm) : 내 짧은 생각으로 도화 소저를 혼란스럽게 한 것 같소.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cross_arm', keep = true, one_shot_sfx = false }, { name = 'sleep_deep', keep = true }, 'dv_main_s17_1_2')

	-- 플레이어 선택지 출력
	-- (mercy) 그런 이야기를 들었다면 나라도…
	-- (forced) 저승사자라서 인간 감수성이 부족했나봐?
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'dv_main_s17_1_3_1', 'mercy' }, { 'dv_main_s17_1_4_1', 'forced' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 플레이어 (right, tired, cast) annoyed 이모티콘 사용 후 완료까지 대기.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self, 'right',
				'cast', 'tired', 'annoyed')

		--강림 (left, tired, cross_arm) : …그렇겠지. 누구에게나 이별은 힘겨운 일일 테니…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false }, 'tired', 'dv_main_s17_1_3_2')

	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		-- 플레이어 (right, doyagao, bomb_idle) happy 이모티콘 사용 후 완료까지 대기.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self, 'right',
				'bomb_idle', 'doyagao', 'happy')

		-- 강림 (left, tired, cross_arm) : …나도 아직 미숙하군. 이제껏 수많은 영혼을 인도했건만…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false }, 'tired', 'dv_main_s17_1_4_2')
	end

	--강림 (left, tired, idle) : 도화 소저가 언니의 죽음을 모르고 있었을 줄이야….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'left',
			nil, 'tired', 'dv_main_s17_1_5')

	--강림 (left, tired, idle) : 소중한 언니의 부고를… 그런 식으로 전하게 되다니….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'left',
			nil, 'tired', 'dv_main_s17_1_6')

	--강림 (left, sleep_deep, cross_arm 유지) silence 이모티콘 실행 완료까지 대기.
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(reaper, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cross_arm', keep = true }, 'sleep_deep', 'silence')

	--강림 (left, sleep_deep, cross_arm 유지) : 결국 바쿠를 막는 것이 최우선이오.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'left',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'dv_main_s17_1_7')

	--강림 (left, sleep_deep, cross_arm 유지) : 그 자매를 위해서라도… 순리대로….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'left',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'dv_main_s17_1_8')

	--강림 (left, attack, cross_arm 유지 X) : 서화 소저의 영혼을 바쿠로부터 구해 성불시켜야 하오.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false }, 'attack', 'dv_main_s17_1_9')


	-- (mercy) 그럼, 이제 서화에게 가는 거야?
	-- (brutal) 아직 안하고 뭐하는 거야!
	choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'dv_main_s17_1_10_1', 'mercy' }, { 'dv_main_s17_1_11_1', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 플레이어 (right, smile, cast2) rowdy 이모티콘 사용 후 완료까지 대기.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self, 'right',
				'cast2', 'smile', 'rowdy')

		-- 강림 (left, sleep_deep, idle) : 당장은 아니오.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'left',
				nil, 'sleep_deep', 'dv_main_s17_1_10_2')

	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		-- 플레이어 (right, attack, release 2회) angry 이모티콘 사용 후 완료까지 대기.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'angry')

		-- 강림 (left, tired, idle) : 이미 시도해 보았고… 똑같은 잘못을 반복할 생각은 없소.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'left',
				nil, 'tired', 'dv_main_s17_1_11_2')
	end

	--강림 (left, idle, idle) : 그녀의 영혼은 바쿠에게 구속되어 있어 내 인도가 닿지 않았소.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'dv_main_s17_1_12')

	--강림 (left, tired, idle) : 힘으로라도 바쿠를 분리시키려 하다가… 오히려 내가 당하고 말았지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'left',
			nil, 'tired', 'dv_main_s17_1_13')

	--강림 (left, tired, idle) : 게다가 꿈의 세계가 오래 지속된 만큼… 바쿠의 힘은 그때보다 더 강대해져 있을거요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'left',
			nil, 'tired', 'dv_main_s17_1_14')

		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self, 'right',

		-- 강림 (left, sleep_deep, idle) : 내가 부족한 것이지… 모든 저승사자의 능력이 부족한 건 아니오.

		-- 강림 (left, attack, idle) : 지금부터라도 계책을 세워야지.

	--강림 (left, sleep_deep, idle) : ……잘 생각해보면, 바쿠는 이 지역의 전설적인 요괴요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'left',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'dv_main_s17_1_18')

	--강림 (left, sleep_deep, idle) : 모토리 산의 영혼 술사 가문과 대대로 대립해 왔겠지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'left',

	choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({

	--강림 (left, attack, jump 1회) : 분명히 요괴에게 구속된 영혼을 구할 방법이 있을 것이오!
	character_util.normal_jump(reaper, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'dv_main_s17_1_28')

	-- 대사 종료하면 강림 down, attack, run 상태로 3의 속도로 이동. 강림 화면 벗어나면 제거.
	-- 강림 이탈 후 스테이지 시작 연출 실행.
	-- 연출 완료 후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀. 섹션 종료.
	local arrive_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down',

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			wp_util.move_async(reaper, arrive_pos, 3, nil)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			-- 플레이어 중심을 향해 카메라 1초간 이동.
			camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
		end)
	})

	character_util.set_position(reaper, vector(999, 0, 999))

	self.ambi_sfx:FadeOut(1)
	self.ambi_sfx = nil
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name), 1.5)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

	self.controller:progress_section()
end

				item.SpriteTransform.localScale = local_scale

			end

			table.insert(this.data, item)

		pop_item = function(this, unique_id)

				for i, item in ipairs(this.data) do
					if item.UniqueId == unique_id then
						local pop_item = item

						table.remove(this.data, i)

						return pop_item
					end
				end
			end

			return nil
		end,

		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.data ~= nil then
				for i = 1, #this.data do
					quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(this.data[i])
					this.data[i] = nil
				end

				match = true,

				contents = {

					'dv_main_s18_book_story_4_2',
					'dv_main_s18_book_story_4_3',
					'dv_main_s18_book_story_4_4',

			book_7 = 7,

				state = self.item_state.no_book,

				read = false,

				play_event = false,

				contents = {
					'dv_main_s18_bookcase_1_1',
					'dv_main_s18_bookcase_1_2',
				}
			},

			[2] = {
				state = self.item_state.fixed,
				inserted_shelf_num = 2,
				read = false,

				play_event = false,

				contents = {
					'dv_main_s18_bookcase_2_1',

			local book_info = nil

			if area == 'secret' then
				book_info = this.secret_books[book_idx]
			elseif area == 'puzzle' then
				book_info = this.puzzle_books[book_idx]
			end

			if book_info ~= nil then
				if book_info ~= nil and book_info.contents ~= nil then
					for i = 1, #book_info.contents do

						-- 첫 나레이션 나올때만 사운드 재생
						if area == 'puzzle' and pick_up == true then
							if i == 1 then
								music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_paper_01')
							end
						end

						field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = book_info.contents[i] })

						if book_info.read ~= nil and not book_info.read then
							if i == 1 then

					end

		end,

					loop = true, player_priority = 'npc',
				})

				scene_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left', false)
				scene_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, self, { name = 'eat' })

				-- 임의로 1초 대기
				wait_for_sec(1)

				-- 0.5초 뒤 해당 스프라이트 흡수
				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				book.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader

				-- 플레이어 left, idle, idle를 실행한 후 나레이션 출력
				character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

				book_info.state = self.item_state.has_book

				equipping_sfx:Stop()
				equipping_sfx = nil

				this:read_book('puzzle', book_idx, true)
			end
		end,

	self.time_conversion_event_key = 'main_section_18'

	self.custom_state_key = 'main_s18_save'

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.quest_progress = quest_util.get_started_quest(441)

	self.current_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_state_key)

	if self.current_state < self.states.find_soulbinder_book then
		self.current_state = self.states.older_twin_waiting
	elseif self.current_state >= self.states.find_soulbinder_book then
		self.current_state = self.states.find_soulbinder_book

		local library_gate = self.field_object.library_gate()

		animator_util.play(library_gate, 'gate_open')
		field_object_util.set_active_state(library_gate, active_state_type.visible)
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_hold_up_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')

	-- 초기 NPC 셋팅
	self:set_pre_npc()
	self:set_current_scene_npc()

	if self.current_state == self.states.older_twin_waiting then
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
			{ zone = 'hotel_inside', target = self.field_object.inner_exit('hotel') },
			{ zone = 'village', target = self.field_object.outer_exit('forest') },
			{ zone = 'forest', target = self.markers.older(1, 1) + vector(0, 1, 0) },
		})
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.find_soulbinder_book then
		self:set_book_puzzle_event(false)

		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('field_1_door_1'))
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('field_1_door_2'))
	end

	for i = 1, #self.book_event_info.puzzle_books do
		local bookcase = self.field_object.puzzle_bookcase(i)

		bookcase.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	local other_bookcase = self.field_object.opened_puzzle_bookcase_3()

	other_bookcase.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	for i = 1, #self.book_event_info.secret_books do
		local bookcase = self.field_object.secret_bookcase(i)

		bookcase.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	self:change_bookcase_state(self.field_object.puzzle_bookcase(1), false)

	self:change_bookcase_state(self.field_object.puzzle_bookcase(3), false)

	self:change_bookcase_state(self.field_object.puzzle_bookcase(5), false)

	local _, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)

	self:set_time_conversion_register_callback()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

	if self.time_conversion ~= nil then
		self.time_conversion:unregister_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key)
	end

	self.items:dispose_all()
	self.cashed_fx_list:dispose(true)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.find_soulbinder_book then
		if string.find(e.Target.Name, self.book_event_info.interact_book_pre_fix) then
			local book_idx = tonumber(string.match(e.Target.Name, "%d+$"))

			if self.day_state == 'daylight' then
				self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.pick_up_book_on_the_ground, self, book_idx)
			elseif self.day_state == 'night' then
				self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.interact_bookcase_at_night, self)
			end

			return true
		elseif string.find(e.Target.Name, self.book_event_info.interact_bookcase_pre_fix) then
			local book_idx = tonumber(string.match(e.Target.Name, "%d+$"))

			if self.day_state == 'daylight' then
				self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.interact_bookcase, self, book_idx)
			elseif self.day_state == 'night' then
				self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.interact_bookcase_at_night, self)
			end

			return true
		end
	else
		if self.current_state > self.states.find_soulbinder_book then
			if self.current_state == self.states.discovered_secret_area and
					type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.field_object.opened_puzzle_bookcase_3()) then

				if self.day_state == 'daylight' then
					self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.interact_bookcase_when_book_puzzle_cleared, self, 3, false)
				elseif self.day_state == 'night' then
					self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.interact_bookcase_at_night, self)
				end

				return true
			end

			local book_idx = tonumber(string.match(e.Target.Name, "%d+$"))

			if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.field_object.puzzle_bookcase(book_idx)) then

				if self.day_state == 'daylight' then
					self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.interact_bookcase_when_book_puzzle_cleared, self, book_idx, true)
				elseif self.day_state == 'night' then
					self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.interact_bookcase_at_night, self)
				end

				return true
			elseif self.current_state == self.states.discovered_secret_area and
					type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.field_object.secret_bookcase(book_idx)) then

				if self.day_state == 'daylight' then
					start_coroutine(self.interact_secret_bookcases, self, book_idx)
				elseif self.day_state == 'night' then
					self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.interact_bookcase_at_night, self)
				end

				return true
			end

		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's18_older_twin_event_1')
			and self.current_state == self.states.older_twin_waiting and self.day_state == 'daylight' then
		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.play_first_older_twin_event, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's18_older_twin_event_2')
			and self.current_state == self.states.second_meeting_with_older_twin and self.day_state == 'daylight' then
		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.play_second_older_twin_event, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's18_restricted_area_1') and
			self.current_state == self.states.find_soulbinder_book then
		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.enter_current_area_exit_restrict, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.field_object.jar_on_book()) then
		if not self.book_event_info.show_5th_book then
			self.book_event_info.show_5th_book = true

			self:set_book_object_active(5)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if e.FieldObject == self.field_object.jar_on_book() then
		if not self.book_event_info.show_5th_book then
			self.book_event_info.show_5th_book = true

			self:set_book_object_active(5)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_time_conversion_register_callback()
	do
		-- 밤/낮 세팅
		self.time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

		local older_twin = self.characters.older()

		-- 콜백 등록
		self.time_conversion:register_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key, {
			-- 낮
			daylight = function()
				self.day_state = 'daylight'

				if self.current_state == self.states.older_twin_waiting then
					quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
						{ zone = 'hotel_inside', target = self.field_object.inner_exit('hotel') },
						{ zone = 'village', target = self.field_object.outer_exit('forest') },
						{ zone = 'forest', target = self.markers.older(1, 1) + vector(0, 1, 0) },
					})
				elseif self.current_state >= self.states.find_soulbinder_book then
					start_coroutine(self.play_older_twin_loop_moving, self, 0.5)
				end

				start_coroutine(function()
					-- 서화 활성화
					character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(older_twin, 0, 0)
					character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(older_twin, 1, 1)

					wait_for_sec(1)

					field_object_util.set_active_state(older_twin, active_state_type.enabled)
				end)

			end,
			-- 밤
			night = function()
				self.day_state = 'night'

				if self.current_state == self.states.older_twin_waiting then
					quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
						{ zone = 'hotel_inside', target = self.field_object.inner_exit('hotel') },
						{ zone = 'village', target = self.field_object.outer_exit('forest') },
						{ zone = 'forest', target = self.markers.older(1, 1) + vector(0, 1, 0) },
					})
				elseif self.current_state >= self.states.find_soulbinder_book then
					character_util.stop(older_twin)
					speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(older_twin)

					self.older_twin_moving_loop = false
				end

				start_coroutine(function()
					-- 서화 비활성화
					character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(older_twin, 0, 1)

					wait_for_sec(1)

					field_object_util.set_active_state(older_twin, active_state_type.disabled)
				end)
			end
		}, true)
	end
end

--region npc setting
function local_class:set_pre_npc()
	-- npc 초기 셋팅 데이터 테이블
	self.pre_npc_data = {
		[self.states.older_twin_waiting] = {
			[1] = {
				pos = self.markers.older(1, 1),
				name = 'older_twin',
				dir = 'left',
				emo = 'tired',
				anim = 'cross_arm',
			},
		},
	}
end

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc()
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[self.current_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)

		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.interaction then
			npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		end

		if npc_data.string ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.string) then
			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.string
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.weapon_1_id then
			character_util.set_equipment(npc, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1,
					npc_data.weapon_1_id, true)
		end

		if npc_data.weapon_2_id then
			character_util.set_equipment(npc, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2,
					npc_data.weapon_2_id, true)
		end

		if npc_data.show_weapon then
			scene_util.show_weapon(npc)
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end
	end)
end
--endregion

function local_class:play_first_older_twin_event()
	local older_twin = self.characters.older()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

	-- 플레이어 존 엔터 시 지정된 위치에 up, idle, idle로 정렬.
	local move_end_key = 'party_align'

	local arrive_pos = self.markers.leader(1, 1)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, arrive_pos, 4, nil, self, move_end_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	--서화 (left, tired, cross_arm) : 으음… 이상하다. 도화는 어디로 간 거지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(older_twin, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'sleep_deep', keep = true }, 'tired', 'dv_main_s18_1_1')

	--서화 (left, tired, cross_arm) : 나랑 축제에 가기로 했었는데… 까먹은 건가?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(older_twin, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false }, 'tired', 'dv_main_s18_1_2')

	-- 아래 2개 연출 동시에 실행.
	-- 서화 (right, smile, idle, jump 1회) 상태 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	scene_util.set_direction(older_twin, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(older_twin, self, 'smile')
	character_util.normal_jump(older_twin, true)

	--플레이어 (left, smile, cast2) notice 이모티콘 사용 후 완료까지 대기.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self, 'left',
			'cast2', 'smile', 'notice')

	--서화 (right, smile, idle) : 아, 용사님이시군요! 오늘도 저희와 함께 축제에 가려고 오셨을까요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(older_twin, self, 'right',
			nil, 'smile', 'dv_main_s18_1_3')

	-- 플레이어 선택지 출력
	-- (mercy) 오늘은 서화를 만나러 온 거야!
	-- (forced) 도화는 다른 남자랑 데이트 중일테니 걱정 마.
	choose_util.play_choose_sampling_without_replacement({
		{
			key = 'dv_main_s18_1_4_1',
			tendency = 'mercy',
			choose_end = true,
			cb_func = function()
				--플레이어 (left, smile, cast2) rowdy 이모티콘 사용 후 완료까지 대기.
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
				scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self, 'left',
						'cast2', 'smile', 'rowdy')

				--서화 (right, idle, idle) : 네? 제가 뭘 도와드릴 수 있을 까요…?
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(older_twin, self, 'right',
						nil, nil, 'dv_main_s18_1_4_2')
			end,
		},
		{
			key = 'dv_main_s18_1_5_1',
			tendency = 'forced',
			choose_end = true,
			cb_func = function()
				--플레이어 (left, smile, sing) happy 이모티콘 사용 후 완료까지 대기.
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
				scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self, 'left',
						'sing', 'smile', 'happy')

				-- 서화 (right, surprise, idle, jump 1회) : 데이트! 나한테 말도 없이 도화가요?
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(older_twin, self, 'right',
						nil, 'surprise', 'dv_main_s18_1_5_2')

				--서화 (right, tired, idle) : 장난이시죠? 도화가 저 몰래 그럴리 없으니까….
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(older_twin, self, 'right',
						nil, 'tired', 'dv_main_s18_1_5_3')

				--서화 (right, attack, idle) : 속은 셈 칠테니, 본론을 말해주세요!
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(older_twin, self, 'right',
						nil, 'attack', 'dv_main_s18_1_5_4')

			end,
		},
	})

	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'dv_main_s18_1_6', 'mercy' } })

	-- 플레이어 (left, attack, cast2) record_lahn 이모티콘 사용 후 완료까지 대기.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'cast2' })
	character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(leader.Transform, nil, 'custom', 'emoticon_bubble_record_lahn.png')

	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 플레이어 (left, attack, release 2회) 상태 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

	--서화 (right, idle, idle) : …과거 영혼 술사들의 기록이요? 음……
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(older_twin)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(older_twin, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'dv_main_s18_1_7')

	--서화 (right, sleep_deep, cross_arm) silence 이모티콘 사용 후 완료까지 대기.
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(older_twin, self, 'right',
			'cross_arm', 'sleep_deep', 'silence')

	--서화 (right, attack, jump 1회) : 아 맞다! 생각났어요!
	character_util.normal_jump(older_twin, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(older_twin, self, 'right',
			nil, 'attack', 'dv_main_s18_1_8')

	--서화 (right, sleep_deep, idle) : 어머님께서도 자신이 영혼 술사로 계신 동안 진행했던 영혼술들은 모두 기록하셔서…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(older_twin, self, 'right',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'dv_main_s18_1_9')

	--서화 (right, attack, idle) : 역대 영혼 술사들의 기록이 담긴 곳에 보관해뒀다고 들었어요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(older_twin, self, 'right',
			nil, 'attack', 'dv_main_s18_1_10')

function local_class:play_older_twin_loop_moving(start_delay)
	if start_delay ~= nil then
		wait_for_sec(start_delay)
	end

	local older_twin = self.characters.older()

	local pos_1 = self.markers.older(3, 1)
	local pos_2 = self.markers.older(3, 2)

	self.older_twin_moving_loop = true

	scene_util.set_direction(older_twin, 'up', false)
	character_util.set_position(older_twin, pos_2)

	older_twin.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	local behaviour = {
		cur_behaviour_idx = 1,
		max_behaviour_idx = 2,

		[1] = {
			route = { vector(pos_1.x, 0, pos_2.z), pos_1 },
			func = function()
				-- 서화 (up, idle, cross_arm) : 으음… 여기 기록들은 조금씩 비어있네…
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(older_twin, self, { dir = 'up', sfx = false },
						{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false }, nil, { key = 'dv_main_s18_loop_ment_1_1', skip = false })

				if not self.older_twin_moving_loop then
					return
				end

				-- 서화 (up, idle, cross_arm) : 동생이랑 분명 관리를 했을 텐데…
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(older_twin, self, { dir = 'up', sfx = false },
						{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false }, nil, { key = 'dv_main_s18_loop_ment_1_2', skip = false })

				-- 이후 서화 2번 위치까지 idle, walk(속도 4)를 실행하여 2번 위치까지 이동.
				if not self.older_twin_moving_loop then
					return
				end
			end
		},
		[2] = {
			route = { vector(pos_2.x, 0, pos_1.z), pos_2 },
			func = function()
				-- 서화 (right, idle, cross_arm) : 으음… 21대째 기록… 27대째 기록…
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(older_twin, self, { dir = 'right', sfx = false },
						{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false }, nil, { key = 'dv_main_s18_loop_ment_1_3', skip = false })

				if not self.older_twin_moving_loop then
					return
				end

				-- 서화 (right, idle, cross_arm) : 엄마의 기록은 어디에 있을까…?
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(older_twin, self, { dir = 'right', sfx = false },
						{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false }, nil, { key = 'dv_main_s18_loop_ment_1_4', skip = false })

				if not self.older_twin_moving_loop then
					return
				end
			end
		},
	}

	local get_reverse_idx = function(input_idx)
		return ((behaviour.max_behaviour_idx + 1) - input_idx)
	end

	local reverse_idx = nil

	while self.older_twin_moving_loop do
		behaviour.cur_behaviour_idx = 1
		reverse_idx = get_reverse_idx(behaviour.cur_behaviour_idx)

		wp_util.move_async(older_twin, behaviour[behaviour.cur_behaviour_idx].route, 4, nil)

		behaviour[behaviour.cur_behaviour_idx].func()

		behaviour.cur_behaviour_idx = 2
		reverse_idx = get_reverse_idx(behaviour.cur_behaviour_idx)

		if not self.older_twin_moving_loop then
			return
		end

		wp_util.move_async(older_twin, behaviour[behaviour.cur_behaviour_idx].route, 4, nil)

		behaviour[behaviour.cur_behaviour_idx].func()

		if not self.older_twin_moving_loop then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end
