			if npc_preset.name == 'leader' then
				npc = get_party_leader()
			else
				npc = get_character(npc_preset.name)
			end
		else
			local group = self.dynamic_npcs:get_group(npc_preset.group_name)
			npc = group[npc_preset.name]
		end

		character_util.hide_weapon(npc, true)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

		if data[i].pos ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(npc, data[i].pos)
		end

		if data[i].dir ~= nil then
			character_util.set_direction(npc, data[i].dir)
		end

		if data[i].emo ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, data[i].emo)
		end

		if data[i].anim ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = data[i].anim, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageMainSection3')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DreamVillageMain @
		Comment = @
		Index = 2 @
		NextSections = 3 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type DreamVillageMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'dreamvillage_1'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		before_loaded = 1,
		before_bridge_event = 2,
		in_bridge_event = 3,
		before_enter_village = 4,
		in_enter_village = 5,
		done = 99
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_loaded

	self.get_knight = function()
		return get_party_leader()
	end

	self.get_princess = function()
		return get_character('princess')
	end

	self.get_keeper = function()
		return get_character('s4_keeper')
	end

	self.get_enter_village_pivot_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s3_enter_village_pivot')
	end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')

	local enter_village_pivot_pos = self.get_enter_village_pivot_pos()

	--퀘스트 마커는 다리 건너 방(마을 구경 이벤트 방)의 중앙 지점으로.
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.controller.quest_name, self.cs_controller.QuestId, true,
			enter_village_pivot_pos)

	--존 엔터 전 마을 주민들 미리 세팅.
	--여관 주인 up, idle, idle
	local keeper = self.get_keeper()
	local offset = vector(-5.5, 0, 1)

	keeper.Position = enter_village_pivot_pos + offset
	scene_util.set_direction(keeper, direction_constants.left, false)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(keeper, active_state_type.enabled)
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		self.controller.amb_sfx:play('01_amb_forest_01', 0.9, 1)
	end

	self.current_state = self.states.before_bridge_event
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_bridge_event and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_s3_bridge_event') then
		self.current_state = self.states.in_bridge_event

		start_coroutine(function()
			local valid_checker = function()
				return self.current_state == self.states.in_bridge_event
			end

			-- 이벤트가 정상 종료된 경우 상태 전환(비정상 종료 시 이미 다른 쪽에서 전환된 상태)
			if self:bridge_event(valid_checker) then
				self.current_state = self.states.before_enter_village
			end
		end)

		return true
	elseif (self.current_state == self.states.in_bridge_event or
			self.current_state == self.states.before_enter_village) and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_s3_enter_village') then
		self.current_state = self.states.in_enter_village

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self.controller.amb_sfx:stop(4)
			self.controller.amb_sfx:play('01_amb_village_02', 1, 5)
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', name = 'ondemand/v3_10_dreamvillage/preload:bgm_dreamvillage_day', volume = 0.6, mix = 8 })

			self:enter_village_scene()

			self.controller.amb_sfx:stop(1)
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

			quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_name)

			self.controller:progress_section()
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state ~= self.states.before_loaded then
		if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'bridge_grid') then
			self.controller.amb_sfx:stop(4)
			self.controller.amb_sfx:play('01_blizzard_04', 0.7, 4)
			return true
		elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'after_forest_grid') then
			self.controller.amb_sfx:stop(4)
			self.controller.amb_sfx:play('01_amb_forest_01', 0.9, 4)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:bridge_event(valid_checker)
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	if not valid_checker() then
		return false
	end

	--공주 : 길고 예쁜 다리야.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(princess, 'dv_main_s3_1', false)

	if not valid_checker() then
		return false
	end

	--공주 : 다리 건너에 마을이 있는 걸까?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(princess, 'dv_main_s3_2', false)

	if not valid_checker() then
		return false
	else
		return true
	end
	--대사 끝나기 전 아래 존 이벤트 시작되면 말풍선 제거하고 곧바로 진행.
end

function local_class:enter_village_scene()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local keeper = self.get_keeper()

	local pivot_pos = self.get_enter_village_pivot_pos()

	local remove_speech = function(npc)
		local bubble = speech_bubble.instance:Get(npc)

		if bubble ~= nil then
			bubble:ResetBubble()
		end
	end

	-- 앞에 말하는 중에 시작했으면 말풍선 제거
	remove_speech(princess)

	--존 이벤트로 진행.
	--아래 연출 동시 진행.
	do
		local camera_pos = self.get_enter_village_pivot_pos()

		--1초간 기사, 공주 위 그림 위치로 정렬.
		--정렬 완료하면 up, idle, idle로.
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, pivot_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -1.5), nil,
				1, self, nil,
				{ last_direction = direction_constants.up })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, pivot_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -1.5), nil,
				1, self, nil,
				{ last_direction = direction_constants.up })

		--카메라 사이즈는 5로 줌아웃.
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 1)

		--카메라 포커스는 1초간 여관주인에게로 이동.
		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 1)

		--각 동작 모두 끝날 때까지 대기
		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

function local_class:on_event(e)

		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.after_prophet_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc:prophet()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_find_info
		sp_util.start_scene(self.money_box_interact_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_hotel_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's4_hotel_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_prophet_interact
		sp_util.start_scene(self.hotel_enter_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.before_prophet_interact and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's4_prophet_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_burn_money_box
		sp_util.start_scene(self.prophet_enter_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.before_find_info and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's4_last_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.after_find_info
		sp_util.start_scene(self.last_enter_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_burn_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_burn_money_box and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gimmick:money_box()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.after_prophet_interact
		sp_util.start_scene(self.money_box_burn_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.after_prophet_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.gimmick.money_box()) then
		self.fx:moneybox_break():Instantiate(e.OldPosition)
		self.broken_wait = false
		return true
	end
	return false
end

	self.stage_end = true
end

	--강림(right, dumb_smile, idle) : 뭔가…? 저는 뭔가는 모르겠어요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'right',

	--공주(left, embarrassed, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'embarrassed')

	--기사 left, sleep_deep, bomb_idle 1초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self,
			nil,
			'bomb_idle',
			'sleep_deep',
			1)

	--공주(left, damaged, cast) : 그… 그게 아니라… 영혼술사를 알고 있냐고 물은 건데….

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
			'cast', 'damaged', 'dv_main_s4_32')

	--강림(right, dumb_idle, idle) : 잠깐. 저한테 모르는 걸 물어보신 거여요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'right',
			nil, 'dumb_idle', 'dv_main_s4_33')

	--강림(right, dumb_smile, bomb_idle) : 어유, 모르는 건 제가 아니라 예언가 아저씨한테 가보셔요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', 'dumb_smile', 'dv_main_s4_34')

	--강림(left, dumb_smile, release) : 쩌어어기 골목에 계시는데… 정말 똑똑한 아저씨예요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reaper, self, 'left',
			'release', { name = 'dumb_smile', keep = true }, 'dv_main_s4_35')

	--대사 시작과 동시에 공주 스파인 shake.
	--공주(left, tired, idle) : 그… 그게….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.normal_shake(princess, 0.3, false)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
			nil, 'tired', 'dv_main_s4_36')

	--공주(left, tired, nod 1회) : …그래, 알겠어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 1 }, 'tired', 'dv_main_s4_37')

	--이후 강림은 원라인 상태로 남는다.
	--강림(남)(left, dumb_smile, bomb_idle) : 모르는 건 저기 골목에 있는 예언가 아저씨한테 물어보셔요,
	scene_util.set_anim(reaper, self, 'dumb_smile')
	reaper.Interactable.Talk = 'dv_main_s4_37_1'

	--컨트롤 돌려줌.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--퀘스트 마커는 엉터리 예언가에게로.
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ leader, princess })

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:prophet_enter_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local prophet = self.npc:prophet()
	local princess = self.npc:princess()
	local money_box = self.gimmick:money_box()
	local guard_1 = self.npc.guard(1)
	local guard_2 = self.npc.guard(2)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 4)

	--머니박스 세팅
	money_box.CombustibleBehaviour = CS.Oak.CombustibleBehaviour()

	--퀘스트 마커는 엉터리 예언가의 돈상자에게로.
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field_1', target = self.gimmick:money_box(), },
		{ zone = 'hotel_inside', target = get_field_object('hotel_outer_exit'), },
	})

	--존 엔터하면 이벤트 진행.
	--기사 공주 right, tired, idle.
	scene_util.set_group_direction({ leader, princess }, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_group_emotion({ leader, princess }, self, 'tired')

	--가드1(left, attack, idle) : 거기! 도대체 어디로 돌아온 거야?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(guard_1, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'dv_main_s4_37_2')

	--가드1(left, attack, release) : 지금은 예언가님 휴식시간이라고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(guard_1, self, 'left',
			'release', 'attack', 'dv_main_s4_37_3')

	scene_util.set_direction(guard_1, 'right', false)

	--예언가(left, sleep_deep, idle) : 잠깐.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prophet, self, 'left',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'dv_main_s4_37_4')

	--카메라 포커스 1초간 예언가에게로 이동.
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(prophet, 1)

	--예언가(left, idle, bomb_idle) : 이리오거라, 길을 잃고 헤매이는 방랑자여.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prophet, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'dv_main_s4_37_5')

	--기사, 공주 속도 4로 위 경로 따라 이동.
	do
		local wp_key = 'align'
		local speed = 4
		local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s4_prophet_center_pos')

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, {
			center_pos + vector(-4, 0, -1.5),
			center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -1.5),
		}, speed, nil, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'up' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, {
			center_pos + vector(-4, 0, -1.5),
			center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -1.5),
		}, speed, nil, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'up' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--공주(up, idle, idle) : 무… 물어보고 싶은 게 있는데….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'dv_main_s4_38')

	--동시 연출.
	do
		local wait = true

		--카메라 shake 0.1, 0.3
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

		--기사, 공주 up, idle, idle, jump 1회
		character_util.normal_jump(leader, '01_player_jump_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(princess, false)

		start_coroutine(function()
			--카메라 0.3초만에 2.5로 줌인.
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(2.5, 0.3)

			wait = false
		end)

		--예언가(right, attack, katana_attack 1회, 끝나고 자세 유지.) : 이 세상은 모두 가짜다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prophet, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'katana_attack', loop = false }, 'attack', { key = 'dv_main_s4_41' })

		while wait do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end


	--동시 연출.
	do
		local wait = true

		--카메라 shake 0.1, 0.3
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

		start_coroutine(function()
			--카메라 포커스 0.3초간 왼쪽으로 0.5칸 이동.
			camera_util.move_async(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 0.3)

			wait = false
		end)

		--예언가(left, attack, katana_attack 1회, 끝나고 자세 유지.) : 가짜 세계가 왜 존재하는 지 너는 알고 있느냐!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prophet, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'katana_attack', loop = false, keep = true }, 'attack', { key = 'dv_main_s4_42', scale = 0.8 })

		while wait do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	--공주 스파인 shake 0.5초
	--공주(up, idle, idle) : 그… 그게….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.normal_shake(princess, 0.5, false)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, { key = 'dv_main_s4_43' })


	--동시 연출.
	do
		local wait = true

		--카메라 shake 0.1, 0.3
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

		start_coroutine(function()
			--카메라 포커스 0.3초간 오른쪽으로 0.5칸 이동.
			camera_util.move_async(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.3)
			wait = false
		end)

		--예언가(down, attack, cast2) : 그것은 죽음의 진실을 받아들이지 못했기 때문이다…!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prophet, self, 'down',
				'cast2', 'attack', { key = 'dv_main_s4_44', scale = 0.8 })

		while wait do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	--카메라 shake 0.1, 0.3
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_energy_fist_01')
	--예언가(down, attack, spear_attack 1회, 끝나고 자세 유지.) : 고요한 죽음이 숨겨져 있다! 고요하게!! 조용하게!!
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(prophet, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'spear_attack', loop = false }, 'attack', { key = 'dv_main_s4_45', scale = 0.8 })

	--공주(up, idle, idle) : 시… 시끄러워…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'dv_main_s4_45_1')

	--기사 right, tired, idle로 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')

	--공주(left, tired, idle) : $name…! 다른 사람을 찾아보는게…
	scene_util.normal_shake(princess, 0.5, false)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
			nil, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'dv_main_s4_46')

	--예언가(down, sleep_deep, idle) : 멈춰라! 이제 가르침의 시간이니!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prophet, self, 'down',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'dv_main_s4_47')

	--예언가(down, attack, bomb_idle) : 이 가짜 세계에서 깨어나기 위해서는 뭐가 필요하다고 생각하느냐?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prophet, self, 'down',
			'bomb_idle', 'attack', 'dv_main_s4_48')

	--기사 right, sleep_deep, cross_arm
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cross_arm')

	--가디언 선택지
	do
		--(intellect)강인한 육체
		--(forced)고결한 영혼
		--(brutal)재밌는 이름
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'dv_main_s4_choose_5', 'intellect' },
			{ 'dv_main_s4_choose_6', 'forced' },
			{ 'dv_main_s4_choose_7', 'brutal' },
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--기사 right, attack, cast2, jump 2회
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast2')

			character_util.normal_double_jump(leader, true)

			--기사 right, attack, bomb_idle
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bomb_idle')

			--0.5초 대기.
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			--카메라 shake 0.1, 0.3
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
			--예언가(down, mad, cast2, jump 1회) : 육체는 스스로 깨어나지 못한다! 가위에 짓눌린 자여!!
			character_util.normal_jump(prophet, true)
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prophet, self, 'down',
					'cast2', 'mad', 'dv_main_s4_48_1')

		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			--기사 right, sleep_deep, cast
			--1초 대기
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
			scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self,
					nil,
					'cast',
					'sleep_deep',
					1)

			--기사 right, attack, bomb_idle
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bomb_idle')

			--0.5초 대기.
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			--카메라 shake 0.1, 0.3
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

			--아래 연출 동시에 진행.
			--예언가(down, mad, cast2, jump 1회) : 육체는 두고 영혼만 깨어난다는 거냐! 오오! 유체이탈!!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
			character_util.normal_jump(prophet, true)
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prophet, self, 'down',
					'cast2', 'mad', 'dv_main_s4_48_2')

		elseif choose_result == 3 then
			--기사 right, smile, sing
			--1초 대기
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
			scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self,
					nil,
					'sing',
					'smile',
					1)

			--기사 right, smile, bomb_idle
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bomb_idle')

			--0.5초 대기.
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			--카메라 shake 0.1, 0.3
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

			--예언가(down, mad, cast2, jump 1회) : 이름 따위가 그렇게 중요하더냐? 명예욕으로 가득찬 똥덩어리!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
			character_util.normal_jump(prophet, true)
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prophet, self, 'down',
					'cast2', 'mad', 'dv_main_s4_48_3')
		end

		--기사 right, tired, idle.
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	end

	--예언가(down, sleep_deep, nod 1회 0.5배속.) : 그대의 생각은 아주 편협하군.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prophet, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 1, scale = 0.5 }, 'sleep_deep', 'dv_main_s4_49')

	--예언가(남)(down, idle, idle) : 에헴, 이제 그건 저기에 넣어놓고 가거라.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prophet, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'dv_main_s4_49_1')

	--예언가 down, idle, bow_idle
	scene_util.set_anim(prophet, self, 'bow_idle')

	--가디언 right, tired, idle, question 이모티콘.
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self,
			'right',
			nil,
			'tired',
			'question')

	--예언가(down, attack, release 2회) : 어허! 어서 내 놓거라.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prophet, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'dv_main_s4_50')

	--공주 기사 표정만 attack으로 변경.
	scene_util.set_group_emotion({ leader, princess }, self, 'attack')

	--예언가(down, attack, bomb_idle) : 내가 준 가르침에 대한 감사의 표시 말이다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prophet, self, 'down',
			'bomb_idle', 'attack', 'dv_main_s4_51')

	--공주(left, attack, idle) : 저… 정답도 안 알려줬으면서!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'dv_main_s4_52')

	--예언가(down, attack, cast2) : 어허! 틀렸다는 것만으로도 이미 가르침을 준 것이거늘!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prophet, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'cast2', keep = true }, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'dv_main_s4_53')

	--예언가 down, attack, cast2, jump 1회
	character_util.normal_jump(prophet, '01_jump_01')

	--아래 연출 동시에 진행
	--가드들이 1초간 위 경로 따라서 움직인다.
	do
		local duration = 1
		local wp_key = 'guard_move'

		character_util.remove_group_anim({ guard_1, guard_2 })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_soldiers_01')

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(guard_1, {
			guard_1.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5),
		}, nil, duration, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(guard_2, {
			guard_2.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5),
		}, nil, duration, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		--카메라 사이즈 1초간 4로 복귀.
		camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--가드들 서로를 바라보며 attack, idle로 서 있는다.
	scene_util.set_group_emotion({ guard_1, guard_2 }, self, 'attack')

	--기사 left, scared, idle.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)

	--공주 right, scared, idle.
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_group_emotion({ leader, princess }, self, 'scared')

	--가디언 선택지
	do
		local choose = true

		--(mercy)1만 골드를 준다.
		--(brutal)거절한다.
		local branches = {
			{ 'dv_main_s4_choose_8', 'mercy' },
			{ 'dv_main_s4_choose_9', 'brutal' },
		}

		while choose do
			local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(branches)

			if choose_result == 1 then
				--가디언 left, tired, nod 1회 0.5배속.
				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
				scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1, scale = 0.5 })

				--가디언 left, tired, release 1회.
				scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
				scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 1, one_shot_sfx = '01_throw_01' })

				--동시에 coin 오브젝트가 기사에게서 튀어나와 돈상자로 이동한다.
				local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
					pos = leader.Position,
					target = money_box.Position,
					item_id = self.gold_item_id,
					loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
					show_on_character = true,
				})

				wait_for_sec(0.6)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_get_drop_gold_01')

				--도착한 뒤, 1초간 알파페이드 아웃되어 사라진다.
				quest_drop_item_util.set_alpha_fade(item, 0, 1)
				wait_for_sec(1)

				--사라지기 시작하면서 돈상자 위에 10000골드 획득 문구 띄워준다.
				quest_drop_item_util.consumed(item, money_box)

				local name = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData'):GetSpec(self.gold_item_id).Name
				CS.Oak.FieldUIFloatingText.Get(money_box):JustPrintItemName(game_string:GetString(name))

				--예언가(down, sleep_deep, nod 2회) : 그대는 도리를 아는 자로구나.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prophet, self, 'down',
						{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'sleep_deep', 'dv_main_s4_54')

				--이후 다시 예언가에게 인터랙트 하면 원라인으로 존재.
				--예언가(down, sleep_deep, idle) : 그대는 도리를 아는 자로구나.
				character_util.remove_relate_event(prophet, self.controller)
				prophet.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
				prophet.Interactable.Talk = 'dv_main_s4_54'

				--컨트롤 해제.
				character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ leader, princess })

				choose = false
			elseif choose_result == 2 then
				--기사 left, attack, release 3회
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 3 })

				--예언가(down, mad, cast2) : 어딜 그냥 가려고 하는 것이냐!
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prophet, self, 'down',
						'cast2', 'mad', 'dv_main_s4_56')

				--기사, 공주 scared, idle로 전환.(각자의 방향은 유지)
				scene_util.set_group_emotion({ leader, princess }, self, 'scared')

				--예언가(down, mad, cast2, jump 2회) : 대가를 지불해라!!
				start_coroutine(character_util.normal_double_jump, prophet, '01_jump_01')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prophet, self, 'down',
						'cast2', 'mad', 'dv_main_s4_57')

				--선택지 다시 뜨고, 이 선택지 제거.
				table.remove(branches, 2)
			end
		end
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:money_box_burn_scene()
	local prophet = self.npc:prophet()
	local money_box = self.gimmick:money_box()

	--돈 상자 데미지 설정
	self.broken_wait = true
	money_box.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.PotDamagedBehaviour()
	money_box.DamagedBehaviour.BreakSfxHandleName = '02_break_wood_01'


	--불에 타는 순간 예언가 left, surprise, idle, jump 1회.
	scene_util.set_direction(prophet, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(prophet, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(prophet, '01_player_jump_01')
	prophet.Interactable.Talk = nil

	--불이 붙는 순간부터 컨트롤 뺏고 카메라 포커스 1초간 돈상자에게로 이동.
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(money_box, 1)

	while self.broken_wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--튀어나온 골드들은 아래 위치에 배치
	--gold_coin_bundle 아이템으로 배치.
	do
		local from = money_box.Position
		local offset_list = {
			vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5),
			vector(0, 0, -0.5),
			vector(0.5, 0, -0.5),
		}

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_get_drop_gold_01')

		for i = 1, #offset_list do
			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = from,
				target = from + offset_list[i],
				item_id = self.gold_item_id,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				show_on_character = false,
			})

			table.insert(self.gold_item_data, item)
		end
	end

	--예언가 왼쪽으로 0.5초만에 1칸 이동.
	wp_util.move_async(prophet, prophet.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			nil, 0.5)

	self.eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', parent = prophet, loop = true })

	--예언가(left, cry, eat) : 내 피같은 돈들이…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prophet, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'eat', keep = true },
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			{ key = 'dv_main_s4_58', skip = false })

	--카메라 포커스 1초간 기사에게로 복귀.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--이 상태에서 예언가에게 다시 인터랙트하면 이벤트 진행.
	character_util.add_listener(prophet, self.controller)

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field_1', target = self.npc:prophet(), },
		{ zone = 'hotel_inside', target = get_field_object('hotel_outer_exit'), },
	})
end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

--도화 서화 노는 연출
function local_class:play_routine()
	local girl = self.npc:soulpower_girl()
	local sister = self.npc:soulpower_sister()

	while not self.stage_end do
		--도화 left, smile, cast2, jump 2회.
		scene_util.set_anim(girl, self, { name = 'cast2', one_shot_sfx = false })
		character_util.normal_double_jump(girl, false)

		if self.stage_end then
			return
		end

		--1초 대기.
		wait_for_sec(1)

		if self.stage_end then
			return
		end

		--서화 right, tired, nod 2회.
		scene_util.set_emotion(sister, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(sister, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2, one_shot_sfx = false })

		if self.stage_end then
			return
		end

		--도화 left, attack, release 3회.
		scene_util.set_emotion(girl, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(girl, self, { name = 'release', count = 3, sfx_name = nil })

		if self.stage_end then
			return
		end

		--도화 left, smile, bomb_idle 1초.
		scene_util.set_emotion(girl, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(girl, self, { name = 'bomb_idle', one_shot_sfx = false })

		wait_for_sec(1)

		if self.stage_end then
			return
		end

		--서화 right, smile, idle
		scene_util.set_emotion(sister, self, 'smile')

		--도화 left, smile, cast
		scene_util.set_emotion(girl, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(girl, self, { name = 'bomb_idle', one_shot_sfx = false })

		--1초 대기.
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--이후, 처음부터 반복.
	end
end

function local_class:last_enter_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.npc:princess()
	local fake_boy = self.npc:fake_boy()
	local fake_girl = self.npc:fake_girl()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 4)

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

	--1초간 기사 공주 정렬.
	do
		local duration = 1
		local wp_key = 'group_walk'
		local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s4_last_center_pos')

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, target_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -1.5),
				nil, duration, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, target_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -1.5),
				nil, duration, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fake_girl, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'smile', 'dv_main_s4_97')

	--카메라 포커스 1초간 영혼술사 집 오브젝트에게로 이동.

		local duration = 1
		local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_house_center_pos')

	end

	--2초 대기.

	--대사 시작과 동시에 기사 공주 right, idle, idle
	scene_util.set_group_direction({ leader, princess }, 'right', true)

	--여자꼬마(right, smile, idle) : 저희는 이만 돌아갈게요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fake_girl, self, 'right',
			nil, 'smile', 'dv_main_s4_98')

	--남자꼬마(right, attack, idle) : 중요한 일이면 잘 하세요.

			nil, 'attack', 'dv_main_s4_99')

	--기사 left, idle, idle

	--공주(right, smile, nod 2회) : 정말 고마워!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'smile', 'dv_main_s4_100')

	--꼬마 둘 다 위 쪽 그리드 너머로 속도 5로 퇴장.
	do
		local speed = 5
		local wp_key = 'kid_end_move'
		local boy_wp = {
			fake_boy.Position + vector(0, 0, 3),
			fake_boy.Position + vector(2, 0, 3),
			screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('up', fake_boy.Position + vector(2, 0, 3), 2),
		}

		local girl_wp = {
			fake_girl.Position + vector(0, 0, 3),
			fake_girl.Position + vector(2, 0, 3),
			screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('up', fake_girl.Position + vector(2, 0, 3), 2),
		}

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fake_boy, boy_wp,
				speed, nil, self, wp_key)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fake_girl, girl_wp,
				speed, nil, self, wp_key)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(fake_boy, active_state_type.disabled)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(fake_girl, active_state_type.disabled)

		--5섹션을 위해 강림도 제거.
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.npc.reaper(), active_state_type.disabled)
	end

	--대사 시작과 동시에 기사도 right, idle, idle로 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', true)

	--공주(left, idle, idle) : 어서 가보자, $name!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'dv_main_s4_101')

	--섹션 종료.
	self.controller:progress_section()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

function local_class:start()

		{ zone = 'main_field_1', target = get_field_object('soulpower_area_inner_exit'), },
		{ zone = 'main_field_2', target = self.gimmick:house_gate(), },
		{ zone = 'hotel_inside', target = get_field_object('hotel_outer_exit'), },
	})

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_gate_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gimmick.house_gate()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_door_enter
		sp_util.start_scene(self.gate_interact_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.before_girl_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.soulpower_girl()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.after_girl_interact
		sp_util.start_scene(self.soulpower_girl_interact_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_door_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's5_house_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_girl_interact
		sp_util.start_scene(self.house_enter_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

			direction = 'right',

		},

	}

	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.npc.princess(), active_state_type.disabled)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.object.obstacle(1), active_state_type.enabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.object.obstacle(2), active_state_type.enabled)

			self.tc_manager.time_zone.night or self.tc_manager.time_zone.daylight

	self.tc_manager.is_bgm_transition = true

function local_class:set_npc_by_list(npc_info_list)
	for name, info_list in pairs(npc_info_list) do
		local npc = nil
		local pos = info_list.pos
		local direction = info_list.direction
		local anim = info_list.anim
		local emotion = info_list.emotion
		local remove_anim_and_emotion = info_list.remove_anim_and_emotion
		local hide_weapon = info_list.hide_weapon
		local oneline = info_list.oneline
		local alpha = info_list.alpha
		local crash_behaviour = info_list.crash_behaviour
		local tint = info_list.tint
		local remove_tint = info_list.remove_tint

		if name == 'china_hero' then
			npc = user_util.get_china_hero_character('china_hero_boy', 'china_hero_girl')
		elseif name == 'knight' then
			npc = user_util.get_knight_character('knight_female', 'knight_male')
		elseif name == 'party_leader' then
			npc = get_party_leader()
		else
			npc = get_character(name)
		end

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)

		if pos ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
		end

		if direction ~= nil then
			character_util.set_direction(npc, direction)
		end

		if anim ~= nil then
			if type_util.is_table(anim) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, anim)
			else
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = anim, sfx_name = false, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if emotion ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, emotion)
		end

		if hide_weapon ~= nil then
			character_util.hide_weapon(npc, hide_weapon)
		end

		if remove_anim_and_emotion then
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		end

		if oneline ~= nil then
			if oneline == 'nil' then
				npc.Interactable.Talk = nil
			else
				npc.Interactable.Talk = oneline
			end
		end

		if alpha ~= nil then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, alpha, 0)
		end

		if crash_behaviour ~= nil then
			npc.CrashBehaviour = crash_behaviour
		end

		if tint ~= nil then
			character_util.add_color(npc, npc.name, tint.color, tint.magnitude, 0)
		end

		if remove_tint ~= nil then
			character_util.remove_color(npc, npc.name, 0)
		end

	end
end

			return vector(999, 0, 999)
		end,
	}

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,

		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,

		shadow = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_character_event_shadow')
		end,

		cwp_knight_fire = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cwp_championknight_fire')
		end,

	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, func in pairs(this) do
					func()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	--region Sprite
	self.sprite = {
		sprite_info = {
			champion_sword = 21362
		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)
			skip_text = lua_helper.get_or_default(skip_text, true)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}
	--endregion Sprite

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		on_start = 2,
		infinite_run = 3,
		twins_younger_scene = 4,
	}
	self.current_state = self.states.on_start

	self.tc_manager = nil
	self.tc_event_key = 'main_s8'

	self.teleport_count = 0

	self.sp_controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self:get_tc_manager()

	-- 6섹션에 막아놓은 도어 그대로 막아놓음
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.object.door(3).Name, false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.object.door(4).Name, false))

	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_stage_loaded_event')
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.marker.infinite_end_pos() },
	})

	--페이드 아웃 관련
	start_coroutine(function()
		self.is_get, self.background_fade_controller = global_table_util.try_create_background_fade_controller()

		--asset_path, asset_name 디폴트 값 사용
		self.background_fade_controller:load_async()
	end)

	self.cached_leader = self.npc.knight()

	local created, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent))

	self:unblock_infinite_field()

	--스프라이트 dispose
	self.sprite:dispose_all()

	--페이드 아웃 관련
	if self.background_fade_controller ~= nil then
		self.background_fade_controller:dispose_loaded()
	end

	--도어 오픈
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.object.door(3).Name, false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.object.door(4).Name, false))

	self.background_fade_controller = nil
	self.is_get = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(_)
	if not self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		return false
	end

	if self.tc_manager ~= nil then
		self.tc_manager:set_vignette()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.on_start and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's7_infinite_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.infinite_run
		self:setting_infinite_run()
		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.infinite_run and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's7_infinite_end_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.infinite_run
		self:teleport_to_infinite_reset_pos()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:setting_infinite_run()
	local stage_event_controller = get_stage_event_controller('DreamVillage2Controller')
	stage_event_controller:block_infinite_field()
end

function local_class:unblock_infinite_field()
	local stage_event_controller = get_stage_event_controller('DreamVillage2Controller')
	stage_event_controller.virtual_wall:dispose()
end

function local_class:teleport_to_infinite_reset_pos()
	local stage_event_controller = get_stage_event_controller('DreamVillage2Controller')
	stage_event_controller:teleport_to_infinite_reset_pos()

	self.teleport_count = self.teleport_count + 1

	if self.teleport_count == 2 then
		--기사 아래로 2회 반복시 컨트롤 뺏지 않고 이벤트 진행.
		--기사 tired로 question 이모티콘.
		start_coroutine(function()
			local knight = self.npc.knight()
			scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')
		end)
	elseif self.teleport_count >= 4 then
		self.current_state = self.states.twins_younger_scene
		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

		self:unblock_infinite_field()

		self.sp_controller:start_coroutine_delayed(self.twins_younger_scene, self)
	end
end

function local_class:get_tc_manager()
	self.tc_manager = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

	-- 밤으로 값 변경
	self.tc_manager.current_time_zone = 2
end

function local_class:time_conversion()
	local current_time_zone = self.tc_manager.current_time_zone == self.tc_manager.time_zone.daylight and
			self.tc_manager.time_zone.night or self.tc_manager.time_zone.daylight

	self.tc_manager:changing_elements(current_time_zone)
	self.tc_manager:changed_elements()
end

--LaboseWorld/DemonGod/Section3.lua 발췌
function local_class:gimmick_tutorial_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	--기믹 버튼 튜토리얼 등장
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(leader, false)

	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)

	message_system:SendSync(leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield()

	field_ui_util.hide_default_single_ui()

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	self.tc_manager.is_system_active = true
	self.tc_manager:conversion_active_setting(true)
	self.tc_manager.is_use_time_conversion = false

	-- FIXME : 클릭하더라도 해당 요청은 무시됐을 것이지만... 혹시 모르니 기믹쪽을 통해서 막아야 함
	qte_play_util.show_action_tap(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomButton1, false, 1, true)

	local wait_check = false
	local touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.CustomFunction1TouchDown or
					e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightShoulderDown then
				wait_check = true
				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	message_system:Subscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'callback')
	message_system:Subscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	while not wait_check do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	--기사 피리 부는 Fx에	01_event_dv_01
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_dv_01', 0.5)

	self.tc_manager.conversion_effect():Instantiate(leader.Position)
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(leader, '[base]weapon1', self.tc_manager.pipe_item_name)

	--아래 연출들 동시에 진행

	--카메라 포커스 1초간 위로 3칸 이동.
	camera_util.move(self.marker.scene_pos() + vector(0, 0, 4.25), 1)

	--카메라 사이즈 1초간 5로 줌아웃.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 1)

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'rifle_idle')

	local ghosts = {
		self.npc.s6_ghost(1),
		self.npc.s6_ghost(2),
	}
	for i = 1, #ghosts do
		local npc = ghosts[i]
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, 0, 1)
	end

	--밤 > 낮 전환과 함께 BGM 볼륨 0.6으로 전환, 믹스 6초	bgm_dreamvillage_night > bgm_dreamvillage_day
	self:time_conversion()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	for i = 1, #ghosts do
		local npc = ghosts[i]
		npc.Position = self.marker.nowhere()
		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.disabled)
	end

	leader:RefreshWeaponAttachments()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	self.tc_manager.is_use_time_conversion = true
end

		local remove_anim_and_emotion = info_list.remove_anim_and_emotion
		local hide_weapon = info_list.hide_weapon
		local oneline = info_list.oneline
		local alpha = info_list.alpha
		local crash_behaviour = info_list.crash_behaviour
		local tint = info_list.tint
		local remove_tint = info_list.remove_tint

		end

		if remove_anim_and_emotion then

		end

		if oneline ~= nil then
			if oneline == 'nil' then
				npc.Interactable.Talk = nil

			end

		end

		end

		if remove_tint ~= nil then
			character_util.remove_color(npc, npc.name, 0)
		end

	end
end

		end,

				end

		}
	})

		end,
		after_battle_pivot = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s8_ab_pivot')
		end,

			return vector(999, 0, 999)
		end,

	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		princess_and_reaper_scene_before = 2,
		before_battle = 3,
		after_battle = 4,
	}

	self.battle_group_name = 's8_battle'

		daylight = 1,
		night = 2,
	}

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent), 'on_time_conversion_changed_event')

	self:register_callback_time_conversion()
end

function local_class:start()
	self:activate_time_conversion_button(true)

	local created, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)

	--퀘스트 마커는 이벤트 전투가 있는 곳으로 설정.
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.marker.after_battle_pivot() },
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

	if self.current_state == self.states.princess_and_reaper_scene_before and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's8_pr_zone') then
		self.is_in_pr_zone = true
		self.time_conversion.is_reset_control = false
		if self.current_day_state == self.day_states.daylight then
			self.current_state = self.states.before_battle
			self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.princess_and_reaper_scene, self)
		end
		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.before_battle and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's8_battle') then
		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

		return true
	end

	return false
end
function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.princess_and_reaper_scene_before and
			type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), 's8_pr_zone') then
		self.is_in_pr_zone = false
		self.time_conversion.is_reset_control = true
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		party_util.hide_field_ui_character_stats(0)
		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.after_battle_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_time_conversion_changed_event(e)
	self.is_in_time_change = false

	return true
end

function local_class:activate_time_conversion_button(is_active)
	local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')
	time_conversion.is_system_active = true
	time_conversion:conversion_active_setting(is_active)
end

function local_class:register_callback_time_conversion()
	self.time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')
	self.time_conversion:register_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key, {
		-- 낮
		daylight = function()
			self.current_day_state = self.day_states.daylight
			self.is_in_time_change = true
			start_coroutine(self.setting_daylight, self)
		end,
		-- 밤
		night = function()
			self.current_day_state = self.day_states.night
			self.is_in_time_change = true
		end
	}, true)
end

function local_class:setting_daylight()
	while self.is_in_time_change do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_in_pr_zone and
			self.current_state == self.states.princess_and_reaper_scene_before and
			self.time_conversion.is_reset_control == false then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_battle
		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.princess_and_reaper_scene, self)
	end
end

function local_class:princess_and_reaper_scene()
	--도화/기사 중앙 기준
	local pivot_pos = self.marker.princess_and_reaper_pivot()
	local princess_pos = self.marker.princess_pos()

	local knight = self.npc.knight()
	local twins_younger = self.npc.twins_younger()

	--컨트롤 뻇길 때 BGM 볼륨 0.6으로 조절, 믹스 디폴트값	bgm_dreamvillage_day
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--도화와 기사는 1초간 위쪽 위치로 정렬.'
	local ty_pos = pivot_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
	local knight_pos = pivot_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0)

	wp_util.move(twins_younger, ty_pos, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'up' })
	wp_util.move(knight, knight_pos, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'up' })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--기사 (up, idle, idle), jump 1회, notice 이모티콘.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(knight, '01_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(knight, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'notice')

	--카메라 포커스 1초간 공주에게로 이동.
	camera_util.move_async(princess_pos, 1, { ignorecamreagrids = true })

	--1초 대기 후
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--카메라 포커스 1초간 기사에게 복귀.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--기사 (left, idle, idle).
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)

	--도화 (right, tired, idle) : 칠득이 아저씨도… 처음 이 세계에 왔을 땐 참 똑똑했는데….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_younger, self, 'right',
			nil, 'tired', 'dv_main_s8_1')

	--기사 선택지
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--(mercy)정말이야?
		{ 'dv_main_s8_2', 'mercy' },
		--(intellect)지금도 똑똑하던데?
		{ 'dv_main_s8_3', 'intellect' },
	})
	if choose_result == 1 then
		--(mercy)정말이야?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')

		--기사 (left, tired, bomb_idle) 1초
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'bomb_idle')

		wait_for_sec(1)

		--기사 (left, tired, idle).
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')
		character_util.remove_anim(knight)

		--도화 (right, tired, nod 1회, 0.4배속) : 네, 뭔가… 무서운 느낌도 들었었는데…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_younger, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'nod', count = 1 }, 'tired', 'dv_main_s8_4')
	else
		--(intellect)지금도 똑똑하던데?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')

		--기사 (left, smile, attack) 2회
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'attack', count = 2 })

		--기사 (left, smile, idle).
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')
		character_util.remove_anim(knight)

		--도화 (right, tired, nod 1회, 0.4배속) : 요… 용사님만이 알아차릴 수 있는 무언가가 있나보군요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_younger, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'nod', count = 1, scale = 0.4 },
				'tired', 'dv_main_s8_5')

	end

	--기사 (left, attack, idle).
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
	character_util.remove_anim(knight)

	--도화 (right, tired, bomb_idle) : 가… 같이 계시던 공주님께는 꿈 세계에 대한 걸 말씀드리지 않는 게 좋겠어요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_younger, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'dv_main_s8_6')

	--도화 (right, tired, cast) : 공주님도 기억이 잘못 날아가면…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_younger, self, 'right',
			'cast', 'tired', 'dv_main_s8_7')

	--아래 연출 동시에 진행.

		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
		character_util.normal_jump(knight, '01_player_jump_01')

	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'damaged')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'cast')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--기사 (up, idle, idle).
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'up', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	--도화 (right, attack, cast) : 괘… 괜찮을 거예요. 우리가 구해낼 거니까!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_younger, self, 'right',
			'cast', 'attack', 'dv_main_s8_9')

	--컨트롤 복귀에 BGM 볼륨 1로 조절, 믹스 디폴트값	bgm_dreamvillage_day
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	--컨트롤 해제.

	--퀘스트 마커는 그대로 유지.
	self.time_conversion.is_reset_control = true
	self.time_conversion:unregister_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key)
end

function local_class:after_battle_scene()
	-- 연두색 마름모(기사/도화 중앙 위치)
	local pivot_pos = self.marker.after_battle_pivot()

	local knight = self.npc.knight()
	local twins_younger = self.npc.twins_younger()

	--1초간 화면이 검게 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	--페이드 인 전 세팅

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--기사 (right, idle, idle)
	local knight_pos = pivot_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	knight.Position = knight_pos

	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	--도화 (left, tired, cast).
	local ty_pos = pivot_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)
	twins_younger.Position = ty_pos
	wp_util.move_async(twins_younger, ty_pos, 7)
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_younger, 'left', false)

	scene_util.set_emotion(twins_younger, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(twins_younger, self, 'cast')

	--각자 위 위치에 맞게 배치.

	--카메라 포커스는 기사와 도화의 중앙 지점(연두색 마름모 지점)으로.

	--1초간 화면이 검게 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	--도화 (left, tired, cast) : 괘… 괜찮으세요…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_younger, self, 'left',
			'cast', 'tired', 'dv_main_s8_10')

	--표정 애니 유지.

	--가디언 선택지
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--(mercy)이런 피래미 쯤이야.
		{ 'dv_main_s8_11', 'mercy' },
		--(forced)전투 한 번에 위험수당 만 골드!
		{ 'dv_main_s8_12', 'forced' },
	})
	if choose_result == 1 then

		--(mercy)이런 피래미 쯤이야.

		--기사 (right, attack, victory_get) 1회, 끝나고 자세 유지
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'victory_get')

		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(knight, 'victory_get')
		wait_for_sec(anim_duration)

		--1초 대기.
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--기사 (right, smile, idle).
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')
		character_util.remove_anim(knight)

		--도화 (left, attack, idle), jump 1회 : 피… 피래미…! 이런 강한 요괴들을…!
		character_util.normal_jump(twins_younger, '01_jump_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_younger, self, 'left',
				'idle', 'attack', 'dv_main_s8_13')
	else
		--(forced)전투 한 번에 위험수당 만 골드!

		--기사 (right, doyagao, release) 3회
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'doyagao')
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'release', count = 3 })

		--기사 (right, doyagao, bomb_idle) 1초.
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'doyagao')
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'bomb_idle')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--기사 (right, smile, idle).
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')
		character_util.remove_anim(knight)

		--도화 (left, tired, idle) : 아… 알뜰하시네요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_younger, self, 'left',
				nil, 'tired', 'dv_main_s8_14')

	end

	--도화 (left, sleep_deep, idle), silence 이모티콘.
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(twins_younger, self, 'left',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'silence')

	--기사 (right, idle, idle).
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)

local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageMainSection9')
local event_zone_name = 's9_event_zone'

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DreamVillageMain @
		Comment = 서고로 가는 길 이벤트 @
		Index = 8 @
		NextSections = 9 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type DreamVillageMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'dreamvillage_2'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		start_puzzle = 2,
		ending = 3,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.npc = {
		-- 도화
		twins_younger = function()
			return get_character('twins_younger')
		end,
	}

	self.field_object = {
		hole = function()
			return get_field_object('s9_hole')
		end
	}

	self.switch_condition = {
		s9_sunmoon_switch = false,
		s9_star_switch = false,
		s9_sun_switch = false,
		s9_moon_switch = false,
	}

	self.sp_controller = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')

	local created, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)
end

function local_class:start()
	self:start_setting()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region Event

function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, event_zone_name) then
		self.current_state = self.states.start_puzzle
		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.enter_section_event_zone, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	if self.current_state ~= self.states.start_puzzle then
		return false
	end

	local switch_name = e.SwitchObject.Name

	if self.switch_condition[switch_name] == nil then
		return false
	end

	self.switch_condition[switch_name] = e.IsTurningOn

	for _, value in pairs(self.switch_condition) do
		if value == false then
			return true
		end
	end

	self.current_state = self.states.ending
	self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.ending_scene, self)
	return true
end

--endregion Event

function local_class:start_setting()
	do
		-- hole 들어가지 못하도록 수정
		local hole_fo = self.field_object.hole()

		hole_fo.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallBehaviour.Instance
		hole_fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
		hole_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(self.controller.quest_name,
				self.cs_controller.QuestSpec.QuestId, true, hole_fo)
	end
end

function local_class:ending_scene()
	local hole_fo = self.field_object.hole()

	self.current_state = self.states.ending

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_name)

	do
		-- hole 원복
		hole_fo.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.HoleBehaviour()
		hole_fo.FieldObjectBehaviour.TargetMarkerName = 's9_hole_pos_1'
		hole_fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.HoleCrashBehaviour.Instance
		hole_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.HoleInteractable()
	end

	-- 카메라 포커스 1초간 가운데 exit 오브젝트로 이동.
	camera_util.move_async(hole_fo.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), 1)

	--문 열릴 때 1회 재생	01_door_01
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_door_01')

	-- 문 열리는 exit 오브젝트 애니메이션 실행.
	local animator = hole_fo:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	animator:Play('open')

	-- 1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	self.controller:progress_section()

	-- 컨트롤 해제.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

		end,

	}

function local_class:load_resource()
	local created, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))

	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.super:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event(e)
	if self.available_stage_names ~= stage.Name then
		return
	end

	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress ~= nil and self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress < 2 then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')

		self:button_setting()
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.cs_controller.CurrentLuaSection and self.cs_controller.CurrentLuaSection.on_touch_event then
		self.cs_controller.CurrentLuaSection:on_touch_event(e)
	end

	if not self.s2_button_event_on and
			not self.is_button_down and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.CustomFunction1TouchDown then
		self.is_button_down = true

		local is_entered = self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.time_conversion_scene, self)

		if not is_entered then
			self.is_button_down = false
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if self.cs_controller.CurrentLuaSection and self.cs_controller.CurrentLuaSection.on_gamepad_event then
		self.cs_controller.CurrentLuaSection:on_gamepad_event(e)
	end

	if not self.s2_button_event_on and
			not self.is_button_down and e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightShoulderDown then
		self.is_button_down = true

		local is_entered = self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.time_conversion_scene, self)

		if not is_entered then
			self.is_button_down = false
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	if self.available_stage_names ~= stage.Name then
		return
	end

	local wolf_list = { self.get_museum_npc.wolf(), self.get_museum_npc.goblin_wolf() }
	local scale_list = { 4, 3.6 }
	for i = 1, #wolf_list do
		local wolf = wolf_list[i]
		wolf.SpineController.ShadowScale = scale_list[i]
	end

	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress ~= nil and self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress < 2 then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_stage_start_event')

		--idle 애니메이션은 loop = false 로 설정해도 기본 움직임이 있어 time_scale = 0 으로 세팅
		self:set_animal_anim_time_scale(0)
		self:set_animal_gray_tint()
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))
end

function local_class:set_time_zone(is_daylight, normalized_time)
	local animator_fo = get_field_object('visual_controller')
	local animator = animator_fo:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	local animation_name = is_daylight and 'daylight' or 'night'
	normalized_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(normalized_time, 0)
	animator:Play(animation_name, -1, normalized_time)

	local light_gimmick_manager = get_or_create_global_table('Gimmick/LightGimmickManager')
	light_gimmick_manager.override_ray = is_daylight and 1 or 2
end

function local_class:button_setting()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local ui_type = CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomButton1
	-- 버튼 아이콘 모양
	local button_icon_name = 'actbtn_ic_act_flute.png'

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(leader, ui_type)
	local button = field_ui_manager:GetUI(leader)[ui_type]
	button:SetIcon(button_icon_name)

	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		local icon = button.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIGamepadIcon))
		icon.TargetKey = CS.GamepadKey.RightShoulder
		icon:Set()
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageNightAtTheMuseumPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = DreamVillageNightAtTheMuseum @
		Comment = @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type DreamVillageNightAtTheMuseumController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'dreamvillage_3'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		interact = 3
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.character = {
		museum_knight = function()
			return get_character('museum_knight')
		end,
		twins_younger = function()
			return get_character('twins_younger')
		end
	}

	self.fo = {
		box = function()
			return get_field_object('museum_costume_box')
		end
	}

	self.marker = {
		box_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('museum_item_pos')
		end,
		male_8_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('museum_day_group_2_pos_8')
		end,
		male_9_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('museum_day_group_2_pos_9')
		end
	}

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		dead = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, func in pairs(this) do
					func()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	-- 밤낮 이벤트 키
	self.time_conversion_event_key = 'museum_pre'

	--sprite
	self.item_sprite = setmetatable({
		sprite_id = 21432,
		sprite = nil
	}, {
		__index = {
			create = function(this, pos)
				if this.sprite ~= nil then
					return
				end

				this.sprite = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
					item_id = this.sprite_id,
					pos = pos,
					loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				})

				quest_drop_item_util.set_alpha_fade(this.sprite, 0, 0)
				quest_drop_item_util.set_alpha_fade(this.sprite, 1, 1)
			end,
			consume = function(this, target)
				if this.sprite == nil then
					return
				end

				quest_drop_item_util.consumed(this.sprite, target)
				this.sprite = nil
			end,
			remove = function(this)
				if this.sprite == nil then
					return
				end

				quest_drop_item_util.set_alpha_fade(this.sprite, 0, 1)

				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(this.sprite)
				this.sprite = nil
			end,
			dispose = function(this)
				quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(this.sprite)
				this.sprite = nil
			end
		}
	})

	self.sp_controller = nil
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self:start_setting()

	local created, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.fo.box().Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	self.item_sprite:dispose()

	local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

	if time_conversion ~= nil then
		time_conversion:unregister_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fo.box()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.interact

		local is_entered = self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.sub_stage_open_event, self)
		if not is_entered then
			self.current_state = self.states.none
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_setting()
	do
		-- 밤/낮 세팅
		local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

		-- 콜백 등록
		time_conversion:register_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key, {
			-- 낮
			daylight = function()
				self.fo.box().Position = self.marker.box_pos()
				self.item_sprite:create(self.marker.box_pos())
			end,
			-- 밤
			night = function()
				self.fo.box().Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				self.item_sprite:remove()
			end
		}, true)
	end
end

--A 지점 인터렉트 시 실행
function local_class:sub_stage_open_event()
	local get_male = function(pos)
		local bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(pos, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5)

		for i = 1, 5 do
			local npc = get_character('museum_museum_male_' .. i)

			if CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(bound, npc.Position) then
				return npc
			end
		end
	end

	local male_8 = get_male(self.marker.male_8_pos())
	local male_9 = get_male(self.marker.male_9_pos())

	local box = self.fo.box()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local twins_younger = self.character.twins_younger()
	local museum_knight = self.character.museum_knight()

	--플레이어 (left, idle, idle) 로 지정된 위치 정렬.
	local wp_key = 'leader_wp'

	camera_util.move(box.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 1)
	--1초간 위 위치로 정렬
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, box.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
			nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_younger, box.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
			nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	--플레이어 (left, attack, eat)를 4초간 실행.
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'eat')

	--2초 시점에서 늑대탈 알바복 스프라이트(임시 : aw_cloth) A 지점에서부터 생성하여 1초 안에 플레이어를 향해 획득됨.
	wait_for_sec(2)

	self.item_sprite:consume(leader)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)
	--플레이어 박물관 알바탈 기사 스파인으로 변경.
	--Fx_dead 이펙트 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wolf_boss_bomb_01')
	self.fx.dead():Instantiate(leader.Position)
	--플레이어 (right, smile, victory_get) 상태를 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	character_util.set_position(museum_knight, leader.Position)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_position(leader, vector(999, 0, 999))

	scene_util.set_direction(museum_knight, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(museum_knight, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(museum_knight, self, 'victory_get')
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--완료 후 애니메이션 유지 상태.
	--0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--아래의 사항 동시에 실행.
	--NPC 8, 9 (down, attack, jump 1회) 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	scene_util.set_group_emotion({ male_8, male_9 }, self, 'attack')
	character_util.group_normal_jump({ male_8, male_9 }, true)
	--플레이어 (left, tired, cross_arm) question 이모티콘 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(museum_knight, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cross_arm', keep = true },
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			'question')

	--0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_direction(museum_knight, 'up')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(museum_knight)
	--NPC 8 (down, attack, release 2회) : 뭐야 너. 신입이었어?!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(male_8, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'dv_night_at_the_museum_pre_15')

	--카메라 연두 지점으로 1초에 걸쳐 패닝.
	camera_util.move_async(male_8.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 1)

	--NPC 9 (down, attack, jingak 1회) : 신입이었으면 얼른 왔어야지 뭐하는 거야?!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(male_9, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'jingak', count = 1 }, 'attack', 'dv_night_at_the_museum_pre_16')

	--NPC 8 (down, tired, cross_arm) : 하 진짜. 나도 다 죽었다. 옛날이었으면….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(male_8, self, 'down',
			'cross_arm', 'tired', 'dv_night_at_the_museum_pre_17')

	--NPC 9 (left, attack, jump 1회) : 아이고 선배! 그만해 얘가 뭘 알겠어.
	character_util.normal_jump(male_9, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(male_9, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'dv_night_at_the_museum_pre_18')

	--NPC 9 (down, attack, release 2회) : 신입! 다른 건 봐줄테니까. 당장 야간근무 교대해!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_female_shout_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(male_9, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'dv_night_at_the_museum_pre_19')

	--이후 서브 스테이지 오픈 연출 실행.
	stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({
		substage_name = 'substage_20_3',
		substage_open_string_key = 'dv_night_at_the_museum_pre_narration',
		recover_bgm = false
	})

	--연출 실행하여 화면이 보이지 않는 타이밍에, 스파인 이전으로 원복.
	character_util.set_position(leader, museum_knight.Position)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')

	character_util.set_position(museum_knight, vector(999, 0, 999))

	--NPC 8 (down, tired, idle) : 최대한 빨리 와라. 교대 밀리면 나도 늦어지니까.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(male_8, self, 'down',
			nil, 'tired', 'dv_night_at_the_museum_pre_20')

	--NPC 9 (down, attack, idle) : 혼나기 싫으면 얼른 가. 알았지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(male_9, self, 'down',
			nil, 'attack', 'dv_night_at_the_museum_pre_21')

	--NPC 8, 9 각기 원라인 실행되던 시점의 상태로 복귀
	--8 : 박물관 알바(down, smile, idle)
	--9 : 박물관 알바(down, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(male_8, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_emotion(male_9, self, 'tired')

	--카메라 연두 지점으로 1초에 걸쳐 패닝.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 복귀.
	self.controller:activate_quest()
end
