function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	local created, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)
end

function local_class:start()
	self.sp_controller:start_coroutine_delayed(function()
		self:set_npc_presets_for_state()

		self:set_npc_with_data(self.npc_presets[self.current_state])

		self:set_sign_board()

		if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
			sp_util.enter_scene()

			self:start_scene()

			self.current_state = self.states.is_exhibit_checked_scene

			sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for _, event_group in pairs(self.sign_board) do
		local sign_board = event_group.fo
		if not event_group.is_interacted and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, sign_board) then
			event_group.is_interacted = true
			local is_entered = self.sp_controller:try_start_coroutine(function()
				sp_util.enter_scene()

				quest_marker_util.remove(sign_board.Name)

				event_group.scene(self, sign_board)

				self:clear_check()

				sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
			end)

			if not is_entered then
				event_group.is_interacted = false
			end

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_npc_presets_for_state()
	local start_pos = self.pivot_pos.start_pos()

	self.npc_presets = {
		[self.states.start_scene] = {
			{
				type = 'static',
				name = 'leader',
				pos = start_pos + vector(0, 0, 8.5),
				dir = 'down',
			},
			{
				type = 'static',
				name = 'museum_male',
				pos = start_pos + vector(-1, 0, 8.5),
				dir = 'down',
				emo = 'attack'
			},
		}
	}
end

function local_class:set_npc_with_data(data)
	for i = 1, #data do
		local npc_preset = data[i]

		local npc
		if npc_preset.type == 'static' then
			if npc_preset.name == 'leader' then
				npc = get_party_leader()
			else
				npc = get_character(npc_preset.name)
			end
		else
			npc = self.dynamic_npcs:get(npc_preset.name)
		end

		character_util.hide_weapon(npc, true)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

		if data[i].pos ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(npc, data[i].pos)
		end

		if data[i].dir ~= nil then
			character_util.set_direction(npc, data[i].dir)
		end

		if data[i].emo ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, data[i].emo)
		end

		if data[i].anim ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = data[i].anim, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
	end
end

function local_class:set_sign_board()
	for _, event_group in pairs(self.sign_board) do
		local sign_board = event_group.fo
		sign_board.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(sign_board.Name, 448, false, sign_board)
	end
end

function local_class:start_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local museum_male = self.controller.get_museum_npc.museum_male()
	local pivot_pos = self.pivot_pos.start_pos()

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ name = 'bgm_steampunk_basement', state = 'field' })
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(leader, 0, { end_target = leader })
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--아래 연출 동시에 실행
	--플레이어 (down, idle, walk) 상태로 엑시트 지점으로부터 나와 지정된 지점까지 4초에 걸쳐 이동.
	--NPC 1 (down, attack, walk) 상태로 엑시트 지점으로부터 나와 지정된 지점까지 4초에 걸쳐 이동.
	local wp = {
		pivot_pos,
		pivot_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0),
	}

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				local duration = 4
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader,
						wp[1], nil, duration, self, nil,
						{ run = false })

				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(museum_male,
						wp[2], nil, duration, self, nil,
						{ run = false })

				wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
			end,
			function()
				wait_for_sec(0.3)

				--NPC 1 (down, attack, walk) : 넌 진짜 운좋은줄 알아. 선배들이 얼마나 무서운지 모르지?
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(museum_male, self, 'down',
						'walk', 'attack', 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s1_1')
			end
	)

	--위 동시 동작 완료 후 이어서 진행.

	--NPC 1 (down, attack, idle) : 나때는 진짜 교대 늦으면 아주…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(museum_male, self, 'down',
			nil, 'attack', 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s1_2')

	--아래 연출 동시에 실행
	--플레이어 (left, idle, idle) 상태 적용.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)

	--NPC 1 (right, doyagao, idle) : 에휴, 됐다. 너한테 뭘 말하냐. 의미도 없는데.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(museum_male, self, 'right',
			nil, 'doyagao', 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s1_3')

	--NPC 1 (right, idle, idle) : 아무튼 오늘은 박물관 행동 강령 점검이니까. 후딱 끝내자.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(museum_male, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s1_4')

	--NPC 1 (right, idle, idle) : 딴짓하다 나한테 걸리면… 알지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(museum_male, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s1_5')

	--플레이어 (left, smile, nod 2회) 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	--NPC 1 (right, idle, idle) : 허이구. 웃상이냐? 웃는 건 참 잘하네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(museum_male, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s1_6')

	--NPC 1 (right, attack, idle) : 얼른 출발해! 나 빨리 퇴근해야 돼!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(museum_male, self, 'right',
			nil, 'attack', 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s1_7')

	--이후 스테이지 시작 연출 실행.

	--플레이어 파티에 NPC 팔로워로 합류.

	--실행 완료 후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀.
	music_player:PlayStageIntroMusic()
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 1 })

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name), 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'victory_get')

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(museum_male)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
end

			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}
	--endregion Sprite

	--region Button
	self.is_button_touch = false

	self.button_icon_name = 'actbtn_ic_act_flute.png'

	self.button_event_on = false

	self.ui_type = CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomButton1

--region Event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.start and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_interact_wall(1)) then

		self.current_state = self.states.scene_1

		quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

		self.controller.s2_button_event_on = true

		self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.start_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.CustomFunction1TouchDown and
			self.button_event_on then
		self.is_button_touch = true

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightShoulderDown and
			self.button_event_on then
		self.is_button_touch = true

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'minigame_success' then
		self.current_state = self.states.scene_3

		start_coroutine(self.minigame_success_scene, self)

		return true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'minigame_failed' then
		start_coroutine(self.minigame_failed_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_state == self.states.scene_1 and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.trigger_zone_name .. 1) then
		self.current_state = self.states.scene_2

		self.trigger_in = true

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:activity_start(is_first)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local wolf = self.get_character.wolf()

	--처음이 아닐경우
	if not is_first then
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(wolf, 'right', false)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(wolf)

		leader.Position = self.save_pos[1]
		wolf.Position = self.save_pos[2]

		--페이드 아웃 - 1
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end

	self.wolf_run_manager:start()

	self.is_playing = true

	self.is_clear = false

	start_coroutine(self.update_routine, self)
end

function local_class:update_routine()
	local time_passed = 0

	self.is_playing = true

	while self.is_playing do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		if self.trigger_in then
			self.is_clear = true
			self.is_playing = false

			break
		end

		if self.is_playing and
				not self.wolf_run_manager:update(dt) then
			self.is_playing = false
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.wolf_run_manager:exit()

	if self.is_clear then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(get_party_leader(), { 'minigame_success' }))
	else
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(get_party_leader(), { 'minigame_failed' }))
	end
end
function local_class:rope_connect(duration, start_pos, end_pos)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	self.pooled_hook_shot = self.fx.hook_shot():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.hook_shot = self.pooled_hook_shot:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.HookShot))
	self.hook_shot.Head.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		local diff = (end_pos - start_pos)
		local direction = diff.normalized
		self.hook_shot:SetFromTo(start_pos, cur_pos + direction * 1)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:rope_pull_and_dispose(duration, start_pos, end_pos, stop_progress)
	coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
		local cur_length = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(1.15, 7, progress)
		local diff = (end_pos - start_pos)
		local direction = diff.normalized

		if stop_progress then
			if progress > stop_progress then
				return false
			end
		end

		self.hook_shot.HeadLength = cur_length
		self.hook_shot:SetFromTo(start_pos, end_pos + direction * 1)
	end)

	if self.pooled_hook_shot then
		self.pooled_hook_shot:Dispose()
		self.pooled_hook_shot = nil
		self.hook_shot = nil
	end
end

function local_class:minigame_failed_scene()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local wolf = self.get_character.wolf()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if not self.is_move_playing then
		--거대 늑대 기본 게임오버 스펙
		--플레이어 컨트롤 돌아온 시점에서부터, 거대 늑대의 중심으로부터 4x4 영역에 진입 시 실행합니다.
		--아래의 연출을 동시에 실행
		scene_util.set_anim(wolf, self, 'attack_ready')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'embarrassed')

		wait_for_sec(1)

		--위 연출 완료 후 다음 연출을 동시에 실행.
		--거대 늑대 (바라보는 방향, idle, attack)를 실행.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wolf_boss_jump_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(wolf, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

		--플레이어 일반 피격 연출 실행
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(leader)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(leader)

		--Fx_lasthit를 플레이어 중심으로 출력.
		self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(leader.Bounds.center)

		--화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

		--플레이어 (거대 늑대 방향, hurt, dead)를 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
		leader.Direction = direction_util.to_side_dir(leader.Direction)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'hurt')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'dead', loop = false, keep_anim = true })

		--플레이어 dead가 모두 실행된 시점에서 화면 2초에 걸쳐 페이드 아웃.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	else
		--플레이어가 돌진 진행중인 늑대에게 접촉할 시 순서대로 실행.
		--피격된 시점에 아래 연출 동시에 실행.

		--플레이어 일반 피격 연출 실행
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(leader)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(leader)

		--Fx_lasthit를 플레이어 중심으로 출력.
		self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(leader.Bounds.center)

		--화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

		--플레이어 (right, hurt, dead)를 실행.
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'hurt')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'dead', loop = false, keep_anim = true })

		wait_for_sec(1)

		--1초 진행된 시점에서 화면 1초에 걸쳐 페이드 아웃.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		character_util.stop(wolf)
		--페이드 인 시, 거대 늑대 돌진 시작점에서 진행.
	end

	self:activity_start()

	--페이드 인 시, 늑대 추격파트 시작 지점으로 원복.
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:npc_setting(npc_data)
	for _, target_data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local target = target_data.target
		local target_pos = target_data.pos
		local target_dir = target_data.dir
		local target_emo = target_data.emo
		local target_anim = target_data.anim
		local target_tint = target_data.tint
		local target_shake = target_data.shake
		local target_is_anim_loop = target_data.is_anim_loop
		local target_effect = target_data.effect
		local target_alpha = target_data.alpha
		local target_function = target_data.coroutine_function
		local target_listener = target_data.listener

		field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.enabled)

		target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()

		character_util.set_position(target, target_pos)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

		scene_util.set_direction(target, target_dir, false)

		character_util.set_anim_time_scale(target, 1)

		if target_emo then
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, target_emo)
		end

		if target_listener then
			character_util.add_listener(target, self.controller)
		end

		if target_anim then
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = target_anim, loop = target_is_anim_loop, one_shot_sfx = false, sfx_name = false })
		end

		if target_shake then
			scene_util.shake(target, 0.03, 9999, false)
		end

		if target_tint then
			character_util.add_color(target, 'dark_tint', target_tint.color, target_tint.magnitude, 0)
		end

		if target_alpha then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(target, target_alpha, 0)
		end

		if target_effect then
			local fx = target_effect():Instantiate(target.Position)
			self.fx_list[target.Name] = fx
		end

		if target_function then
			start_coroutine(function()
				target_function(target)
			end)
		end

		--target.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)
	end
end

function wolf_run_manager:start()
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.pattern_count = nil
	self.cur_pattern_number = nil
	self.cur_speed = nil
	self.cur_pos = nil
	self.game_end = false
	self.attack_range = nil

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.pattern_count = #self.activity_pattern_data
	self.cur_pattern_number = (self.pattern_count > 0) and 1 or 0

	self.cur_speed = self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].speed and
			self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].speed or self.cur_speed

	self.cur_pos = self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].pos

	self.game_end = false

	self.wolf.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.wolf.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true

	self.cur_state = self.states.wait

	self.anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(self.wolf, 'pounce_ready')

	scene_util.set_anim(self.wolf, self.controller, 'pounce_ready_loop')

	self.attack_range = attack_range_util.create_rect(
			self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].attack_range_pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0),
			self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].attack_range_size, nil, nil,
			CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

	attack_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)

	local pos = self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].attack_range_pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0)
	local tile_height = field:GetTileInfoAt(pos):GetHeightAt(pos)

	attack_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, pos, tile_height)

	if self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].attack_range_rotate then
		self.attack_range.transform.rotation = self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].attack_range_rotate
	end

	--차징
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wolf_boss_breath_01')
	attack_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].wait_duration)

	self.wolf.Hitbox = self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].hit_box
end

function wolf_run_manager:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.cur_state == self.states.set then
		--다음 패턴 세팅
		self.cur_pattern_number = self.cur_pattern_number + 1

		if self.cur_pattern_number > self.pattern_count then
			self.game_end = true
			self.controller.is_clear = true

			return false
		else
			self.cur_pos = self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].pos
		end

		-- 방향 세팅
		scene_util.set_direction(self.wolf, self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].dir)

		self.time_passed = 0

		self.attack_range = attack_range_util.create_rect(
				self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].attack_range_pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0),
				self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].attack_range_size, nil, nil,
				CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

		if self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].attack_range_rotate then
			self.attack_range.transform.rotation = self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].attack_range_rotate
		end

		--차징
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wolf_boss_breath_01')

		self.attack_range:Show(self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].wait_duration)

		self.wolf.Hitbox = self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].hit_box

		--각 돌진 지점 시작 시간에 맞춰 늑대는 아래 상태를 적용.
		--(진행방향, idle, pounce_ready)를 실행.
		--완료되면 (진행방향, idle, pounce_ready_loop) 상태 유지.

		--대기 상태로 돌입
		self.cur_state = self.states.wait
	elseif self.cur_state == self.states.move then
		-- 돌진
		if self:check_next_move_routine() then
			--이동 종료 후 세팅 상태로 돌입
			self.cur_state = self.states.anim_set
		end

		if self.attack_range then
			attack_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range)
			self.attack_range = nil
		end

		if self.game_end then
			--character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.wolf)
			self.controller.is_clear = false

			return false
		end

		self.cur_direction = (self.cur_pos - self.wolf.Position).normalized

		local velocity = self.cur_direction * self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].speed * dt

		local change_pos = self.wolf.Position + velocity

		self.wolf.Position = change_pos
		--CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.wolf, self.cur_direction, self.cur_speed * dt)
	elseif self.cur_state == self.states.wait and
			self:check_time(self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].wait_duration) then
		--어택 레인지 대기

		self.time_passed = 0

		--돌진 시작
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wolf_boss_slash_01')

		character_util.remove_anim(self.wolf)
		scene_util.set_anim(self.wolf, self.controller, {
			name = 'pounce', loop = false,
			scale = self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].anim_scale })

		-- 무브 상태로 돌입
		self.cur_state = self.states.move
	elseif self.cur_state == self.states.anim_set then
		scene_util.set_anim(self.wolf, self.controller, { name = 'pounce_ready', loop = false })

		self.time_passed = 0

		self.cur_state = self.states.anim_wait
	elseif self.cur_state == self.states.anim_wait then
		-- 애니메이션이 끝날 때 까지 대기
		if self:check_time(self.anim_duration * 0.95) then
			scene_util.set_anim(self.wolf, self.controller, 'pounce_ready_loop')

			self.cur_state = self.states.set
		end
	end

	--충돌 체크 (true면 종료)
	-- 언제나 체크
	if self:check_collision() then
		self.controller.is_clear = false
		if self.cur_state == self.states.move then
			self.controller.is_move_playing = true

			-- 돌진 시 마저 가도록
			start_coroutine(function()
				wp_util.move_async(self.wolf, self.cur_pos, self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].speed, nil,
						{ last_direction = self.wolf.Direction, locked_dir = self.wolf.Direction })

				self.controller.is_move_playing = false
			end)
		end

		return false
	end

	return true
end

function wolf_run_manager:check_next_move_routine()
	if (self.wolf.Position - self.cur_pos).magnitude < 0.3 then
		self.wolf.Position = self.cur_pos
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function wolf_run_manager:check_time(check_time)
	if self.time_passed > check_time then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function wolf_run_manager:check_collision()
	if self:aabb(self.wolf.Bounds, self.leader.Bounds) then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

function wolf_run_manager:aabb(a, b)
	return a.min.x <= b.max.x and a.max.x >= b.min.x
			and a.min.z <= b.max.z and a.max.z >= b.min.z
end

function wolf_run_manager:exit()
	if not is_unity_null(self.wolf) then
		self.wolf.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
		self.wolf.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1.1, 0.75, 1.1))
	end

	if self.attack_range then
		attack_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range)
		self.attack_range = nil
	end
end

--endregion WolfRun

return local_class

end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WatchingCameraGridChangedEvent), 'on_event')

	local big_wolf = self.controller.get_museum_npc.wolf()
	big_wolf.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_stage_loaded_event')
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	-- 시작할 때 까악까악 소리 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crow_02', loop = true, duration = 4, fade_out_time = 1 })

	self:set_event_list()

	local is_clear = true
	for _, value in pairs(self.event_list) do
		value:start()

		if value:is_clear_event() == false then
			is_clear = false
		end
	end

	if not is_clear then
		return
	end

	self:set_all_sub_event_clear()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WatchingCameraGridChangedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent))

	if self.event_list ~= nil then
		for _, value in pairs(self.event_list) do
			value:dispose()
		end

		self.event_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_state < self.states.ending and self.event_list ~= nil then
		for _, value in pairs(self.event_list) do
			value:on_event(e)
		end
	end

	local big_wolf = self.controller.get_museum_npc.wolf()

	if self.current_state == self.states.all_event_clear and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, big_wolf) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_big_wolf_after_all_event_clear, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(_)
	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		self.controller:set_time_zone(false, 1)
	end
end

function local_class:set_event_list()
	if self.event_list ~= nil then
		return
	end

	local path = 'Quest/Main/DreamVillage/NightAtTheMuseum/S3NightMuseumEvent/NightMuseumEvent'
	local event_list = get_or_create_global_variable(path)

	self.event_list = {}
	for key, event in pairs(event_list) do
		self.event_list[key] = event(self, false)
	end
end

function local_class:check_all_clear()

		if value:is_clear_event() == false then

	character_util.normal_jump(chris, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(chris, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_43')

function local_class:set_all_sub_event_clear()
	self.current_state = self.states.all_event_clear
	local wolf = self.controller.get_museum_npc.wolf()
	wolf.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	character_util.add_listener(wolf, self)

	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo('s3_quest_marker', 448, false, wolf)
end

-- 거대 늑대 인터렉트 시 이벤트 진입.
function local_class:interact_big_wolf_after_all_event_clear()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local goblin_wolf = self.controller.get_museum_npc.goblin_wolf()
	local chris = self.controller.get_museum_npc.chris()
	local big_wolf = self.controller.get_museum_npc.wolf()

	self.current_state = self.states.ending

	for _, value in pairs(self.event_list) do
		value:exit()
	end

	quest_marker_util.remove('s3_quest_marker')

	local pos = big_wolf.Position + vector(2.5, 0, 0)

	-- 플레이어, 크리스 (left, idle, walk) 상태로 1초간 지정된 위치까지 이동.
	wp_util.move(chris, pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
			nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_async(leader, pos,
			nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })

	scene_util.set_direction(big_wolf, 'right', false)

	-- 크리스 (left, idle, idle) : 오 늑대 친구! 기다리고 있었구나!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(chris, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_46')

	-- 늑대 (right, idle, idle, jump 2회) heart 이모티콘 출력 후 완료까지 대기.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_guild_dog_01')
	start_coroutine(character_util.normal_double_jump, big_wolf, true)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(big_wolf, nil, 'heart')

	-- 플레이어 (left, idle, victory_get) 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, keep_anim = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 1초 대기
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 플레이어 (left, attack, get) 상태로, 거대 늑대의 중앙 위치까지 1초를 소모하여 jump로 이동.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(big_wolf, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'get')
	character_util.jump(leader, 2, 1, 0.5)
	wp_util.move_async(leader, big_wolf.Position + vector(0, 1.5, 0), nil, 1)

	stage_camera:SetTarget(nil)

	goblin_wolf.Position = big_wolf.Position
	goblin_wolf.Direction = big_wolf.Direction
	field_object_util.set_active_state(goblin_wolf, active_state_type.enabled)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(leader, active_state_type.disabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(big_wolf, active_state_type.disabled)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 탑승 플레이어 (right, idle, idle, jump 2회) thumbsup 이모티콘 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wolf_boss_breath_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(goblin_wolf, 'right', false)
	start_coroutine(character_util.normal_double_jump, goblin_wolf, '01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(goblin_wolf, nil, 'thumbs_up')

	-- 크리스 (left, idle, sing) : 훌륭해! 이제 친구들을 모을 차례군!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chris, self, nil, 'sing', nil,
			'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_47')

	-- 화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

	-- 크리스 (right, idle, victory_get) : [shout] 박물관의 모두! 우리 친구를 도와줘!
	-- 크기 : 1.5배
	-- 위치 : x 0.8 / y 0.5
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(chris, self, nil, 'victory_get', nil, {
		key = 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_48',
		scale = 1.5,
		skip = true,
		viewport_pos = vector(0.7, 0.5)
	})

	local snowman_list = {}
	local snowman_count = 3

	-- 고대 설산 주민 dv_museum_ancient_snowman
	local start_pos = vector(56.5, 0, 42)
	for i = 1, snowman_count do
		local snowman = self.controller.get_museum_npc.ancient_snowman(i)
		snowman.Position = start_pos + vector((i - 1), 0, 0)
		scene_util.set_direction(snowman, 'up', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(snowman, self, 'attack')
		field_object_util.set_active_state(snowman, active_state_type.enabled)
		table.insert(snowman_list, snowman)
	end

	local elf_list = {}
	local elf_count = 3

	-- 고대 사막 주민 dv_museum_ancient_desertelf
	start_pos = start_pos - vector(0, 0, 2)
	for i = 1, elf_count do
		local elf = self.controller.get_museum_npc.ancient_desertelf(i)
		elf.Position = start_pos + vector((i - 1), 0, 0)
		scene_util.set_direction(elf, 'up', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(elf, self, 'attack')
		field_object_util.set_active_state(elf, active_state_type.enabled)
		table.insert(elf_list, elf)
	end

	-- 고양이 dv_museum_cat
	local cat = self.controller.get_museum_npc.cat()
	cat.Position = vector(57, 0, 57)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(cat)
	scene_util.set_direction(cat, 'down', false)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(cat, active_state_type.enabled)

	-- 크리스 대사 종료하면 NPC 집합 연출들을 동시에 진행.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'event', mix = 1.5 })

	-- 화면 0.1 세기로 5초간 shake 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_04')
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 4)

	-- 화면 6 크기로 5초간 줌 아웃.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(7, 4)

	-- 설산 주민 1 ~ 3 / 사막 주민 1 ~ 3 이 (up, idle, walk) 상태로 화면 바깥에서부터 지정된 위치까지 5초간 이동.
	for i = 1, snowman_count do
		local snowman = snowman_list[i]
		wp_util.move(snowman, snowman.Position + vector(0, 0, 5),
				nil, 4, { last_direction = 'left' })
	end

	for i = 1, elf_count do
		local elf = elf_list[i]
		wp_util.move(elf, elf.Position + vector(0, 0, 5),
				nil, 4, { last_direction = 'left' })
	end
	-- 이동 완료하면 (left, attack, idle 상태로 전환.)

	-- 고양이(down, idle, walk) 상태로 화면 바깥에서부터 지정된 위치까지 5초간 이동.
	-- 이동 완료하면 (left, attack, idle 상태로 전환.)
	wp_util.move(cat, cat.Position - vector(0, 0, 5),
			nil, 4, { last_direction = 'left' })

	-- 화면 중심 연두 위치로 5초간 이동.
	local camera_pos = vector(54.5, 0, 50)
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 4)

	scene_util.set_emotion(cat, self, 'attack')

	-- 크리스 (left, idle, cast) : 좋아, 모두들…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chris, self, nil, 'cast',
			nil, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_49')

	-- 크리스 (left, idle, victory_get) : [shout] 저 전시관 문을 열게 도와줘!
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(chris, self, nil, 'victory_get',
			nil, { key = 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_50', skip = true, scale = 1.5 })

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	wait_all_lua(
			{
				-- 카메라 중심이 연두인 상태에서, 빨강 위치(16타일)까지 8초에 시간에 걸쳐 이동 시작.
				camera_util.move_async, camera_pos - vector(16, 0, 0), 8
			},
			function()
				-- 설산 주민 / 사막 주민 출발 순차적으로 진행.
				local move_key = 's3_move_key'
				-- 모든 주민들 (left, smile, walk) 상태로 4초간 좌측으로 8타일 이동 시작.

				-- 3초 시점에 설산 주민3 / 사막 주민3 (down, smile, idle)를 실행하여 현재 위치에 정지.
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(snowman_list[3], snowman_list[3].Position - vector(6.5, 0, 0),
						nil, 3, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'down', end_callback = function()
							music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')
							scene_util.set_emotion(snowman_list[3], self, 'smile')
						end })
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(elf_list[3], elf_list[3].Position - vector(6.5, 0, 0),
						nil, 3, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'down', end_callback = function()
							scene_util.set_emotion(elf_list[3], self, 'smile')
						end })

				-- 3.5초 시점에 설산 주민2 / 사막 주민2 (down, smile, cast2)를 실행하여 현재 위치에 정지.
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(snowman_list[2], snowman_list[2].Position - vector(7.5, 0, 0),
						nil, 3.5, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'down', end_callback = function()
							music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')
							scene_util.set_emotion(snowman_list[2], self, 'smile')
						end })
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(elf_list[2], elf_list[2].Position - vector(7.5, 0, 0),
						nil, 3.5, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'down', end_callback = function()
							scene_util.set_emotion(elf_list[2], self, 'smile')
						end })

				-- 4초 시점에 설산 주민1 / 사막 주민1 (down, smile, cast2)를 실행하여 현재 위치에 정지.
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(snowman_list[1], snowman_list[1].Position - vector(8.5, 0, 0),
						nil, 4, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'down', end_callback = function()
							music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')
							scene_util.set_emotion(snowman_list[1], self, 'smile')
						end })
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(elf_list[1], elf_list[1].Position - vector(8.5, 0, 0),
						nil, 4, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'down', end_callback = function()
							scene_util.set_emotion(elf_list[1], self, 'smile')
						end })

				-- 4초 시점에는 모든 인원들이 스위치를 밟아 도어가 열림.
				wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

				-- 문이 열림
				local door_name = 's3_door_1_'
				local door_count = 2
				for i = 1, door_count do
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(door_name .. i, false))
				end
			end,
			function()
				-- 고양이 출발 순차적으로 진행.

				-- 점프 위치
				-- vector(54.5, 3, 54.25)

				-- 고양이 (left, attack, get) 상태로 지정된 wall 오브젝트 위로 4의 높이로 jump를 1초간 실행하여 이동.
				scene_util.set_anim(cat, self, 'get')
				character_util.jump(cat, 2, 1, 0.5)
				wp_util.move_async(cat, vector(54.5, 3, 54.25), nil, 1)

				-- 고양이 보라색 wall 지점까지 4초간 (지정 방향, smile, walk)로 이동.
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(cat)
				scene_util.set_emotion(cat, self, 'attack')
				wp_util.move_async(cat, {
					vector(45.5, 3, 54.25),
					vector(45.5, 3, 52.25),
					vector(41.5, 3, 52.25),
					vector(41.5, 3, 53.25)
				}, nil, 4)

				-- 고양이 도착한 위치에서 (left, attack, get) 상태로 지정된 위치까지 1의 높이로 jump를 1초간 실행하여 이동.
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_cat_meow_01')
				scene_util.set_anim(cat, self, 'get')
				character_util.jump(cat, 2, 1, 0.5)
				wp_util.move_async(cat, vector(37, 0, 53), nil, 1)

				-- 이후 고양이는 스위치를 누른 상태가 됨.
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')
				character_util.remove_anim(cat)

				-- 6초 시점에는 고양이가 도어에 도착하여 열림
				-- 문이 열림
				local door_name = 's3_door_2_'
				local door_count = 2
				for i = 1, door_count do
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(door_name .. i, false))
				end
			end,
			function()
				scene_util.set_direction(goblin_wolf, 'left', false)
				-- 7초 대기.
				wait_for_sec(7)

				-- 탑승 플레이어 (left, idle, pounce)를 1초간 실행하여 지정된 위치까지 이동.
				local move_key = 's3_wolf_move_key'

				-- 14타일을 1초에 진행하는 것 기준으로, 0.7초 시점에 wall 위치에 FX_Common_SmokeScreen이 실행되어, 해당 오브젝트를 제거함.
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wolf_boss_jump_01')
				scene_util.set_anim(goblin_wolf, self, { name = 'pounce', loop = false })
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(goblin_wolf, goblin_wolf.Position - vector(14, 0, 0),
						nil, 0.9, self, move_key)
				wait_for_sec(0.6)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wolf_boss_bomb_01')

				camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)
				self.fx.smoke():Instantiate(vector(41.5, 0, 49.5))

				local obj_count = 4

				for i = 1, obj_count do
					local obj_fo = self.get_block_obj(i)
					field_object_util.set_active_state(obj_fo, active_state_type.disabled)
				end

				-- 목표에 도착하면 (left, idle, idle) 상태 적용.
				wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(goblin_wolf)

				-- 늑대 도착으로 8초로 완료.
			end
	)

	-- 연출 모두 종료되면 이어서 진행.
	-- 1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

	-- 크리스 : [shout] 대단해 친구!
	-- 크기 : 1.5배
	-- 위치 : x 0.8 / y 0.5
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(chris, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_51', true, {
		scale = 1.5,
		viewport_pos = vector(0.7, 0.5)
	})

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_heroic_moment', state = 'event' })

	wait_all_lua(
			{
				camera_util.move_async, goblin_wolf.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, 0), 3
			},
			{
				camera_util.resize_to_default, 3
			},
			function()
				-- 크리스 (left, idle, run) 상태로 화면 우측에서부터 지정된 위치까지 6의 속도로 이동.
				wp_util.move_async(chris, {
					chris.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), chris.Position + vector(-20, 0, 1) }, 6, nil,
						{ last_direction = 'down', run = true, play_sfx = true })
			end
	)

	-- 크리스 (down, idle, cast) : 정말 환상적인 팀워크였어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chris, self, nil, 'cast',
			nil, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_52')

	-- 크리스 (down, idle, sing) : 마치 내 과거의 편린을 본 것 같아! 과거 리리스와도 이렇게….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chris, self, nil, 'sing',
			nil, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_53')

	-- 크리스 (down, idle, idle) : …추억에 젖을 때가 아니지. 진짜 내 친구가 저기에 있는 걸!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(chris, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_54')

	-- 아래의 연출 동시에 실행

	-- 탑승 플레이어 스파인 dv_museum_wolf[거대 늑대]로 변경.

	-- 늑대 상단 위치에서부터 dv_museum_goblin_leader[플레이어]가 (left, idle, get) 상태로 지정된 위치까지 1초에 걸려 이동.

	-- 플레이어 (right, idle, idle, jump 1회) 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	big_wolf.Direction = goblin_wolf.Direction
	big_wolf.Position = goblin_wolf.Position

	leader.Direction = goblin_wolf.Direction
	character_util.set_position(leader, goblin_wolf.Position + vector(0.25, 1.5, 0), true)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(big_wolf, active_state_type.enabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(leader, active_state_type.enabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(goblin_wolf, active_state_type.disabled)

	goblin_wolf.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'get')
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	character_util.jump(leader, 3, 1, 0.5)

	pos = vector(36, 0, 49.5)
	wp_util.move_async(leader, pos, nil, 1, { y_mode = 'flying' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	character_util.set_position(leader, pos, false)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 플레이어 (right, idle, idle, jump 1회) 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 거대 늑대 (left, idle, idle, jump 2회) heart 이모티콘 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_guild_dog_01')
	start_coroutine(character_util.normal_double_jump, big_wolf, '01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(big_wolf, nil, 'heart')

	-- 0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 5 })

	-- 아래의 항목 동시에 실행.
	local move_end_key = 's3_ending_move_key'

local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageNightAtTheMuseumSection4')

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type DreamVillageNightAtTheMuseumController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'substage_20_3'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		start = 2,
		scene_1 = 3,
		scene_2 = 4,
		scene_3 = 5,
		scene_4 = 6,
		scene_5 = 7,
		done = 999,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	--region Character
	self.get_character = self.controller.get_museum_npc
	--endregion Character

	--region FieldObject
	self.get_interact_wall = function(number)
		return get_field_object('s4_interact_wall_' .. number)
	end
	--endregion FieldObject

	--region Marker
	self.get_center_pos = function(number)
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_center_pos_' .. number)
	end
	--endregion Marker

	--region Fx
	self.fx = {
		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
		hook_shot = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('hookshot')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}
	self.fx_list = nil
	--endregion Fx

	--region Dynamic_npc
	--동적 할당 정보
	self.dynamic_npcs = {
		trigger_first_npc = {
			npc_list = {},
			dynamic_npc_name = 'trigger_first_npc_',
			dynamic_npc_data = nil
		},
		create_npcs = function(this)
			for name, npc_data in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'create_npcs' and name ~= 'dispose_all' and name ~= 'dispose_target' then
					-- 적 동적 생성
					local dynamic_npc_spec = {}

					for i = 1, #npc_data.dynamic_npc_data do
						dynamic_npc_spec[npc_data.dynamic_npc_name .. i] = npc_data.dynamic_npc_data[i]
					end

					npc_data.npc_list = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(dynamic_npc_spec)

					for i = 1, #npc_data.dynamic_npc_data do
						npc_data.npc_list[npc_data.dynamic_npc_name .. i].Position = self.wait_pos
					end
				end
			end
		end,
		dispose_target = function(target_list)
			load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(target_list)
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			for name, npc_data in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'create_npcs' and name ~= 'dispose_all' and name ~= 'dispose_target' then
					if npc_data.npc_list then
						load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(npc_data.npc_list)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	}
	--endregion Dynamic_npc

	--region Sprite
	self.sprite = {
		sprite_info = {
			rope = 21433,
			flower = 21415,
		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}
	--endregion Sprite

	--region Etc
	self.wait_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)

	--트리거 존
	self.trigger_zone_name = 's4_trigger_zone_'

	-- 메인 퀘스트 id
	self.main_quest_id = 448

	self.quest_marker_name = 's4_start_marker'
	--endregion Etc

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_interact_wall(1)) then

		self.sp_controller:try_start_coroutine(self.ending_scene, self)

		return true

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_state ~= self.states.done and
			not self.is_loop_trigger_scene
			and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.trigger_zone_name .. 2) then
		start_coroutine(self.trigger_2_zone_event, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state ~= self.states.done and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.trigger_zone_name .. 1) then

		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.trigger_1_zone_event, self)

		return true

			false,
			interact_wall.Position + vector(0, 1, 0))

	self:npc_setting(npc_data)

function local_class:npc_setting(npc_data)
	for _, target_data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local target = target_data.target
		local target_pos = target_data.pos
		local target_dir = target_data.dir
		local target_emo = target_data.emo
		local target_anim = target_data.anim
		local target_tint = target_data.tint
		local target_shake = target_data.shake
		local target_is_anim_loop = target_data.is_anim_loop
		local target_effect = target_data.effect
		local target_alpha = target_data.alpha
		local target_function = target_data.coroutine_function
		local target_listener = target_data.listener

		field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.enabled)

		target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()

		character_util.set_position(target, target_pos)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

		scene_util.set_direction(target, target_dir, false)

		if target_emo then
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, target_emo)
		end

		if target_listener then
			character_util.add_listener(target, self.controller)
		end

		if target_anim then
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = target_anim, loop = target_is_anim_loop, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		if target_shake then
			scene_util.shake(target, 0.03, 9999, false)
		end

		if target_tint then
			character_util.add_color(target, 'dark_tint', target_tint.color, target_tint.magnitude, 0)
		end

		if target_alpha then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(target, target_alpha, 0)
		end

		if target_effect then
			local fx = target_effect():Instantiate(target.Position)
			self.fx_list[target.Name] = fx
		end

		if target_function then
			start_coroutine(function()
				target_function(target)
			end)
		end

		--target.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)
	end
end
--endregion Setting

local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageNightAtTheMuseumSection5')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @

		Comment = 전시품과 작별 인사 후 낮으로 전환 @
		Index = 4 @

]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type DreamVillageNightAtTheMuseumController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'substage_20_3'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		start_scene = 1,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.start_scene

	-- 위치 기준 값
	self.pivot_pos = {
		start_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_start_pos')
		end,
		monkey_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_monkey_pos')
		end,
	}

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		flute_sing = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_flute_sing')
		end,
	})

	self.item = {
		id = 21364,
		get_complete = false
	}

	self.stage_event_controller = nil
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestItemGetEvent), 'on_quest_item_get_event')
	self.controller:set_time_zone(false, 0)

	local _, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)
end

function local_class:start()
	self.stage_event_controller = get_stage_event_controller('DreamVillageNightAtTheMuseumController')

	self.sp_controller:start_coroutine_delayed(function()
		self:set_npc_presets_for_state()

		self:set_npc_with_data(self.npc_presets[self.current_state])

		if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')

			sp_util.enter_scene()
		else
			message_system:Subscribe(self.stage_event_controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

			self.stage_event_controller:crow_and_turtle_move_setting()
			self.stage_event_controller:cat_setting()
			self.stage_event_controller:goblin_setting()
			self.stage_event_controller:ancient_snowman_setting()
			self.stage_event_controller:ancient_desertelf_setting()
			self.stage_event_controller:wolf_setting()
		end

		self:start_scene()

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestItemGetEvent))

	self.stage_event_controller = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

	if e.ItemId == self.item.id then

function local_class:set_npc_with_data(data)
	for i = 1, #data do
		local npc_preset = data[i]

		local npc
		if npc_preset.type == 'static' then
			if npc_preset.name == 'leader' then
				npc = get_party_leader()
			else
				npc = get_character(npc_preset.name)
			end
		else
			npc = self.dynamic_npcs:get(npc_preset.name)
		end

		character_util.hide_weapon(npc, true)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

		if data[i].pos ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(npc, data[i].pos)
		end

		if data[i].dir ~= nil then
			character_util.set_direction(npc, data[i].dir)
		end

		if data[i].emo ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, data[i].emo)
		end

		if data[i].anim ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = data[i].anim, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
	end
end

	--크리스 (right, idle, cast) : 완벽해! 이제 그럼 친구도 꿈에 그리던…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chris, self, 'right',

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chris, self, 'right',
			'victory_get', nil, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s5_3')

	--링고 (up, idle, run) 상태로 2타일 상단으로 0.5초를 소모하여 이동.
	local wp = bard.Position + vector(0, 0, 2)

	--링고 (right, idle, sing) : 좋았어! 퇴근에 어울리는 노래를…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bard, self, 'right',
			'sing', nil, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s5_4')

	--크리스 (right, idle, idle) : 물론 퇴근 뒤에는 출근이 반복되어, 퇴직을 하지 않는 이상 크게 무의미한 일이라고 생각하지만….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chris, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s5_5')

	--크리스 (right, idle, bomb_idle) : 그래도 당장은 좋은 일이잖아. 안그래?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chris, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s5_6')

	--크리스 (right, idle, idle) : 그렇게 된 걸로, 이제 작별의 시간이 되었네!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chris, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s5_7')

	--링고 (right, idle, idle, jump 1회) : 아쉬움이 남지 않도록 모두의 얼굴을 봐두는 것도 좋아!
	character_util.normal_jump(bard, true)

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')

	--나레이션 : 이제 박물관의 영원할 것 같던 악몽을 끝내고, 아침을 보낼 수 있게 되었습니다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s5_narration_1' })

	--이후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀.

	--5섹션 종료. 이후 6섹션 엔딩 파트로 이동.

	--이후 링고 / 크리스 아래의 원라인 상태로 배치.
	--크리스 (left, idle, sing) : 그럼 링고, 마지막 약속을 지켜볼까?
	--링고 (right, smile, sing) : 좋아! 내 템포에 자연스럽게 끼어들 수 있지?
	self.stage_event_controller:chris_setting()

	self.stage_event_controller:monkey_setting()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	self.controller:progress_section()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageNightAtTheMuseumSection6')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DreamVillageNightAtTheMuseum @
		Comment = 엔딩 @
		Index = 5 @
		NextSections = 6 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type DreamVillageNightAtTheMuseumController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'substage_20_3'

	self.conversion_effect = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_flute_sing')
	end

	self.is_button_down = false
	self.is_button_active = false
	self.is_screen_play = false

	self.sp_controller = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')

	self.conversion_effect()
	self.controller:set_time_zone(false, 1)
end

function local_class:start()
	local _, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)

	self.is_button_active = true
	self.controller:button_setting()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if not self.is_button_down and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.CustomFunction1TouchDown then
		self.is_button_down = true

		local is_entered = self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.ending_scene, self)

		if not is_entered then
			self.is_button_down = false
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if self.is_button_active and not self.is_button_down and
			e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightShoulderDown then
		self.is_button_down = true

		local is_entered = self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.ending_scene, self)

		if not is_entered then
			self.is_button_down = false
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:ending_scene()
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local museum_male = self.controller.get_museum_npc.museum_male()

	--플레이어가 밤 / 낮 버튼 누를 시. 밤 → 낮으로 진행되며, 화면 2초에 걸쳐 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_dv_01', 0.7)
	self.conversion_effect():Instantiate(leader.Position)

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(leader, '[base]weapon1', 'gimmick_flute')

	--플레이어 (down, sleep_deep, rifle_idle) 상태로 gimmick_flute 장착.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'rifle_idle')

	screen_util.fade_out_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local complete_scene_pos = vector(3000, 0, 0)
	camera_util.move_async(complete_scene_pos, 0)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.controller:complete_quest({
		run_complete_ui = true,
		run_fame_alignment = false,
		return_control = false,
		run_chapter_end_ui = false,
	})

	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	self.controller:set_time_zone(true, 0)

	--암전된 상태에서 배치된 모든 스파인들 애니메이션 정지 적용.
	local exhibit = {
		wolf = self.controller.get_museum_npc.wolf(),
		turtle = self.controller.get_museum_npc.turtle(),
		crow = self.controller.get_museum_npc.crow(),
		chris = self.controller.get_museum_npc.chris(),
		monkey = self.controller.get_museum_npc.monkey(),
		bard = self.controller.get_museum_npc.bard(),
		goblin_1 = self.controller.get_museum_npc.goblin_leader(),
		goblin_2 = self.controller.get_museum_npc.goblin(1),

		goblin_4 = self.controller.get_museum_npc.goblin(3),
		ancient_snowman_1 = self.controller.get_museum_npc.ancient_snowman(1),
		ancient_snowman_2 = self.controller.get_museum_npc.ancient_snowman(2),
		ancient_desertelf_1 = self.controller.get_museum_npc.ancient_desertelf(1),
		ancient_desertelf_2 = self.controller.get_museum_npc.ancient_desertelf(2),
		rich_male = self.controller.get_museum_npc.rich_male(),
		cat = self.controller.get_museum_npc.cat(),
	}

	for _, fo in pairs(exhibit) do
		character_util.set_anim_time_scale(fo, 0)
	end

	self.controller:set_animal_gray_tint(exhibit)

	character_util.stop(exhibit.turtle)
	character_util.stop(exhibit.crow)

	--줌 3으로 확대된 상태.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 0)

	--NPC 1번 (진행방향, sleep_deep, walk) 로 지정된 경로를 2의 속도로 이동 시작.
	local wp = {}
	for idx = 1, 5 do
		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_npc_pos_' .. idx)
		table.insert(wp, pos)
	end

	local speech_routine = true

	museum_male.Position = wp[1]
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(museum_male, wp, 2, nil, self, nil,
			{ run = false, end_callback = function()
				speech_routine = false
			end })

	field_object_util.set_active_state(museum_male, active_state_type.enabled)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(leader, active_state_type.disabled)

	camera_util.move_to_target_async(museum_male, 0, { end_target = museum_male })

	scene_util.set_emotion(museum_male, self, 'sleep_deep')

	--화면 페이드 인 2초에 걸쳐서 진행.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_trickery_theme', mix = 2 })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--해당 과정에서 아래의 대사를 스킵 가능하게 반복 실행.
	while speech_routine do
		--NPC 1번 : 에휴… 또 출근이냐 진짜아….
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(museum_male, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s6_1')

		if not speech_routine then
			break
		end

		--NPC 1번 : 난 왜 출근같은 걸 해야 하는 거야….
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(museum_male, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s6_2')

		if not speech_routine then
			break
		end

		--NPC 1번 : 보나마나 신입이 또 깽판을 쳐놨겠지…?
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(museum_male, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s6_3')

		if not speech_routine then
			break
		end

		--NPC 1번 : 에휴 하기싫어… 하기싫다고오….
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(museum_male, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s6_4')

		if not speech_routine then
			break
		end

		--NPC 1번 : 평생 놀고먹는 백수나 하고 싶은데…,.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(museum_male, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s6_5')

		if not speech_routine then
			break
		end

		--NPC 1번 : 이렇게 출근해서 신입 뒷바라지나 하고….
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(museum_male, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s6_6')

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

	--이후 마지막 지점에 도착하면 완료.

	--NPC 1번 (down, sleep_deep, idle) sleep 이모티콘 출력 후 완료까지 대기.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_sleep_02')

	--NPC 1번 (down, tired, idle) : 어우 귀찮아… 신입… 제대로 정리하고 갔….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(museum_male, self, 'down',

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--NPC 1번 (left, idle, idle) 실행.
	scene_util.set_direction(museum_male, 'left')

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--NPC 1번 (up, idle, idle) 실행.
	scene_util.set_direction(museum_male, 'up')

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--NPC 1번 (right, attack, idle) 실행.
	scene_util.set_direction(museum_male, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(museum_male, self, 'attack')

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--NPC 1번 (down, attack, idle) 실행.
	scene_util.set_direction(museum_male, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(museum_male, self, 'attack')

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--카메라 6의 크기까지 0.2초에 걸쳐 줌 아웃 실행.

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_red_hood', state = 'event' })

	--NPC 1번 (down, surprise, cast2) : [shout] 이게 도대체 뭔 일이야!!!!!
	--1.5배 실행.
	--카메라 shake 0.3 / 0.3 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_12')
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(museum_male, self, nil,

			{ key = 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s6_8', scale = 1.5, skip = true })

	--아래의 엔딩 연출 동시에 실행

	--화면 12초에 걸쳐서 페이드 아웃 실행.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'muted', mix = 12 })
	screen_util.fade_out(12, unity_class.color.black)

	--NPC 1번 대사 시간대별로 실행

	--0초 시점에 실행
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--NPC 1번 (left, mad, release 2회) : [shout] 이건 대체 왜 나와있는 건데?!
				scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(museum_male, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
						{ name = 'release', keep = true }, { name = 'mad', keep = true },
						{ key = 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s6_9', skip = false })
			end,
			function()
				--4초 시점에 실행
				wait_for_sec(4)
			end
	)

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--NPC 1번 (right, mad, jingak) : [shout] 이놈들을 또 언제 탈출시킨 거야?!
				scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(museum_male, self, { dir = 'right', sfx = false },
						{ name = 'jingak', keep = true, loop = true, sfx_name = '02_hit_projectile_01' },
						{ name = 'mad', keep = true },
						{ key = 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s6_10', skip = false })
			end,
			function()
				--4초 시점에 실행
				wait_for_sec(4)
			end
	)

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--NPC 1번(down, mad, cast2) : [shout] 신입 어디있어! 신입!! 신입!!!
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_kid_girl_shout_01')
				scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(museum_male, self, 'down',
						{ name = 'cast2', keep = true }, { name = 'mad', keep = true },
						{ key = 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s6_11', scale = 1.5 })
			end,
			function()
				--8초 시점에 실행
				wait_for_sec(4)
			end
	)

	--12초에 맞춰 종료.
	CS.Oak.Game.Instance:StageToLobby(true)
end

return local_class

local controller_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Base/QuestControllerBase')

---@class DreamVillageOniGirlController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageOniGirlController', controller_base)

local util = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Main/DreamVillage/Common/CommonUtil')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	-- 사용할 섹션 스크립트 정보. 주석 해제하고 사용
	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = true,
		NormalSectionCount = 1,
		HasPostSection = true
	}

	self.clear_check = false

	self.characters = {
		oni_girl = function()
			return get_character('oni_girl')
		end,
		oni_girl_wheelchair = function()
			return get_character('onigirl_wheelchair')
		end,
		twins_younger = function()
			return get_character('twins_younger')
		end
	}

	self.time_conversion_event_key = 'oni_girl_controller'
end

function local_class:load_resource()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	local progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.cs_controller.QuestId)

	self.pre_start_check = progress == nil
	self.clear_check = progress ~= nil and progress.IsComplete

	if not self.clear_check then
		self:start_setting()
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
	local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

	if time_conversion ~= nil then
		time_conversion:unregister_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key)
	end
end

-- 밤/낮 시간 전환할 때, 캐릭터를 등장 시켜주는 함수
function local_class:show_time_conversion(immediately, callback, ...)
	util.show_time_conversion(immediately, callback, ...)
end

function local_class:hide_time_conversion(immediately, callback, ...)
	util.hide_time_conversion(immediately, callback, ...)
end

function local_class:start_setting()
	do
		-- 밤/낮 세팅
		local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

		-- 콜백 등록
		time_conversion:register_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key, {
			-- 낮
			daylight = function()
				self:show_oni_girl()
			end,
