local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageOniGirlSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DreamVillageOniGirl @
		Comment = @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type DreamVillageOniGirlController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'dreamvillage_3'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		talk = 2,
		race_fail = 3,
		race_start = 4,
		race_out = 5,
		race_finish = 6,
		race_end = 7
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.race_fail

	self.characters = {
		oni_girl = function()
			return get_character('oni_girl')
		end,
		twins_younger = function()
			return get_character('twins_younger')
		end,
		oni_girl_wheelchair = function()
			return get_character('onigirl_wheelchair')
		end
	}

	self.markers = {
		oni_girl_first_move_count = 6,
		oni_girl_marker_count = 16,
		oni_girl_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('oni_girl_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		leader_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('oni_girl_leader_pos')
		end
	}

	self.fo = {
		door_count = 8,
		door_name = 'lana_door_',
		rock_count = 1,
		rock = function(number)
			return get_field_object('lana_rock_' .. number)
		end,
		switch_count = 8,
		switch = function(number)
			return get_field_object('lana_light_switch_' .. number)
		end,
		gimmick_count = 14,
		gimmick = function(number)
			return get_field_object('lana_gimmick_' .. number)
		end
	}

	self.time_conversion_event_key = 'oni_girl_s1'

	-- fx
	self.fx = setmetatable({
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		cloud_thunder = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_pw_cloud_thunder_player_elec')
		end,
		oni_girl_trail = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_onigirl_trail')
		end,
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, func in pairs(this) do
					func()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	self.check_level_down = false
	self.game_fail_count = 0
	self.oni_girl_speed = { 3.8, 4.2 }

	self.sp_controller = nil
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self:start_setting()

	local created, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	local oni_girl = self.characters.oni_girl()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(oni_girl, self.controller)

	local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

	if time_conversion ~= nil then
		time_conversion:unregister_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.race_fail
			and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.oni_girl_wheelchair()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.talk

		local is_entered = self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.request_talk, self)
		if not is_entered then
			self.current_state = self.states.race_fail
		end

		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.race_finish and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'oni_girl_leader_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.race_end
		sp_util.start_scene(self.activity_clear_talk, self)

		return true
	end

	if (self.current_state == self.states.race_start or self.current_state == self.states.race_finish) and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'oni_girl_race_out_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.race_out
		sp_util.start_scene(self.activity_out_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_setting()
	do
		-- 밤/낮 세팅
		local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

		-- 콜백 등록
		time_conversion:register_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key, {
			-- 낮
			daylight = function()
				self:show_oni_girl()
			end,
			-- 밤
			night = function()
				self:hide_oni_girl()
			end
		}, true)
	end

	if not self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		start_coroutine(self.start_activity, self)
	end
end

function local_class:show_oni_girl()
	local oni_girl_wheelchair = self.characters.oni_girl_wheelchair()

	if self.controller.pre_start_check then
		self.controller.pre_start_check = false
		return
	end

	character_util.set_position(oni_girl_wheelchair, field_util.get_marker_pos('oni_girl_start_pos'))
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_wheelchair, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_wheelchair, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(oni_girl_wheelchair)

	self.controller:show_time_conversion(false, function()
		character_util.add_listener(oni_girl_wheelchair, self.controller)
	end, { oni_girl_wheelchair })
end

function local_class:hide_oni_girl()
	local oni_girl_wheelchair = self.characters.oni_girl_wheelchair()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(oni_girl_wheelchair, self.controller)

	self.controller:hide_time_conversion(false, nil, { oni_girl_wheelchair })
end

function local_class:start_activity()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local oni_girl = self.characters.oni_girl()
	local oni_girl_wheelchair = self.characters.oni_girl_wheelchair()
	local twins_younger = self.characters.twins_younger()

	--0.7초에 걸쳐 circular fade out
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.7, 'linear')

	--휠체어 라나 아래 위치에 정렬
	--(right, idle, wheelchair_only)
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_wheelchair, self, 'empty')
	scene_util.set_anim(oni_girl_wheelchair, self, 'wheelchair_only')
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(oni_girl_wheelchair, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(oni_girl_wheelchair, self.controller)

	--플레이어, 라나 아래 위치에 정렬
	--(left, idle, idle)
	character_util.set_position(oni_girl, self.markers.oni_girl_pos(1))
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl)

	character_util.set_position(leader, oni_girl.Position + vector(0, 0, -1))
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	character_util.set_position(twins_younger, oni_girl.Position + vector(1, 0, -1))
	character_util.set_direction(twins_younger, 'left')

	self:gimmick_reset()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('lana_game_door'))

	--액티비티 진행할 때는 카메라 4.5크기 상태
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(4.5, 0)
	--1초 대기
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.7, 'linear')

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--라나 (left, tired, idle): 그럼… 출발한다!
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(oni_girl, 'dv_oni_girl_s1_1')
	--이후 액티비티 시작
	local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')
	time_conversion:conversion_active_setting(false)

	self.current_state = self.states.race_start

	oni_girl.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
			{ name = 'ondemand/v2_10_futurecastle_part2/audio/music:bgm_lana_02', state = 'event', mix = 0 })
	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)

	start_coroutine(self.game_routine, self)
end

function local_class:oni_girl_routine()
	local oni_girl = self.characters.oni_girl()
	local wp = {}

	for i = 2, self.markers.oni_girl_first_move_count do
		table.insert(wp, self.markers.oni_girl_pos(i))
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.current_state ~= self.states.race_start then
		return
	end

	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, self, 'damaged')
	wp_util.move_async(oni_girl, wp, self.oni_girl_speed[1], nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

	if self.current_state ~= self.states.race_start then
		return
	end

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--라나 (down, damaged, idle): 후… 후… 후….
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01', parent = oni_girl })
				character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'down')
				scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, self, 'damaged')
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(oni_girl, { key = 'dv_oni_girl_s1_2', type_speed = 0 })
			end,
			function()
				wait_for_sec(1.2)
			end
	)

	if self.current_state ~= self.states.race_start then
		return
	end

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--라나 (left, smile, idle)[대사 한번에 출력]: 생각보다 괜찮은데?
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gatcha_point_01', parent = oni_girl })
				character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'left')
				scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, self, 'smile')
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(oni_girl, { key = 'dv_oni_girl_s1_3', type_speed = 0 })
			end,
			function()
				wait_for_sec(1.2)
			end
	)

	if self.current_state ~= self.states.race_start then
		return
	end

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--라나 (left, smile, idle)[대사 한번에 출력]: 더 빨리 뛰어볼까?
				character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'left')
				scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, self, 'smile')
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(oni_girl, { key = 'dv_oni_girl_s1_3_1', type_speed = 0 })
			end,
			function()
				wait_for_sec(1.0)
			end
	)

	if self.current_state ~= self.states.race_start then
		return
	end

	wp = {}

	for i = self.markers.oni_girl_first_move_count + 1, self.markers.oni_girl_marker_count do
		table.insert(wp, self.markers.oni_girl_pos(i))
	end

	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, self, 'smile')
	wp_util.move_async(oni_girl, wp, self.oni_girl_speed[2], nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

	if self.current_state ~= self.states.race_start then
		return
	end

	--라나 빨간 네모 위치에 도달하면 (left, tired, cast) 상태 출력
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(oni_girl, self, 'cast')

	self.current_state = self.states.race_finish
	if zone_util.contains_fo(field:GetZone('oni_girl_leader_zone'), get_party_leader()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.race_end
		sp_util.start_scene(self.activity_clear_talk, self)
	end
end

function local_class:game_routine()
	start_coroutine(self.oni_girl_routine, self)

	while self.current_state == self.states.race_start do
		self:check_collision_object()

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.race_fail then
		start_coroutine(self.race_fail_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:check_collision_object()
	local oni_girl = self.characters.oni_girl()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(oni_girl.Position, 0.5)

	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if CS.BoundsExtensions.IsOverlappingXZ(oni_girl.Bounds, fo.Bounds) then
			-- 벽충돌
			if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle and
					not CS.Oak.ICrashBehaviourExtensions.IsEthereal(fo.CrashBehaviour) then
				self:collision_fail()
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:collision_fail()
	local oni_girl = self.characters.oni_girl()

	self.current_state = self.states.race_fail
	character_util.stop(oni_girl)
end

function local_class:gimmick_reset()
	for i = 1, self.fo.gimmick_count do
		message_system:SendSync(self.fo.gimmick(i).FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
	end

	for i = 1, self.fo.switch_count do
		message_system:SendSync(self.fo.switch(i).FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
	end

	-- switch 리셋 한 프레임 기다린 후 door close 필요
	coroutine.yield()

	for i = 1, self.fo.rock_count do
		message_system:SendSync(self.fo.rock(i), CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
	end

	for i = 1, self.fo.door_count do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.fo.door_name .. i))
	end
end

function local_class:race_fail_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local oni_girl = self.characters.oni_girl()
	local oni_girl_wheelchair = self.characters.oni_girl_wheelchair()
	local twins_younger = self.characters.twins_younger()

	sp_util.enter_scene()

	--플레이어 (라나 방향으로 전환, tried, idle) 출력
	character_util.look_at(leader, oni_girl)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')

	--라나 도어나 바위에 부딪히면 fx_hit와 동시에 dead 애니메이션 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	self.fx.hit():Instantiate(oni_girl.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	--up 상태라면 right 상태로 dead출력
	character_util.set_side_direction(oni_girl)
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(oni_girl, self, 'dead')
	--카메라 0.5초간 라나에게 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(oni_girl, 0.5)

	--2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--화면 1초간 fade out
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--실패 이벤트 진행
	--라나, 플레이어 위의 위치에 정렬
	--라나 (right, tired, idle)
	--플레이어 (left, idle, idle)
	oni_girl.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl)
	character_util.set_position(oni_girl, vector(999, 0, 999))

	character_util.set_position(oni_girl_wheelchair, field_util.get_marker_pos('oni_girl_start_pos'))
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_wheelchair, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_wheelchair, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(oni_girl_wheelchair)
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(oni_girl_wheelchair, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	character_util.set_position(leader, oni_girl_wheelchair.Position + vector(1, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	character_util.set_position(twins_younger, oni_girl_wheelchair.Position + vector(1, 0, -1))
	character_util.set_direction(twins_younger, 'left')

	self:gimmick_reset()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('lana_game_door'))

	--0.5초 대기
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.move_async(oni_girl_wheelchair.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.5)

	--화면 1초간 fade in
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0.6, mix = 1 })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.game_fail_count = self.game_fail_count + 1

	--라나 (right, tired, idle): 역시… 나에겐 무리였어.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(oni_girl_wheelchair, 'dv_oni_girl_s1_27')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	--이후 컨트롤 해제
	self.current_state = self.states.race_fail

	character_util.add_listener(oni_girl_wheelchair, self.controller)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')
	time_conversion:conversion_active_setting(true)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)
end

function local_class:activity_out_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local oni_girl = self.characters.oni_girl()
	local oni_girl_wheelchair = self.characters.oni_girl_wheelchair()
	local twins_younger = self.characters.twins_younger()

	character_util.stop(oni_girl)
	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 라나 쪽으로 이동
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(oni_girl, 1)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--라나 (right, tired, idle): 어? 그만 달리는거야?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, 'right',
			'idle', { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'dv_oni_girl_s1_33')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl)

	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_wheelchair, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_wheelchair, self, 'tired')

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')

	character_util.set_position(twins_younger, oni_girl_wheelchair.Position + vector(1, 0, -1))
	character_util.set_direction(twins_younger, 'left')

	self:gimmick_reset()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('lana_game_door'))

	--0.5초 대기
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.move_async(oni_girl_wheelchair.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.5)

	--화면 0.7에 걸쳐 fade in
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 1, mix = 1 })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.7, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.current_state = self.states.race_fail
	character_util.add_listener(oni_girl_wheelchair, self.controller)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')
	time_conversion:conversion_active_setting(true)
end

function local_class:request_talk()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local oni_girl_wheelchair = self.characters.oni_girl_wheelchair()
	local twins_younger = self.characters.twins_younger()

	sp_util.enter_scene()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--라나 인터렉트 시 라나 왼쪽으로 1타일 간격으로 0.5초에 걸쳐 정렬
	do
		local wp_key = 'leader_wp'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, oni_girl_wheelchair.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_younger, oni_girl_wheelchair.Position + vector(1, 0, -1),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		--카메라 라나, 플레이어 사이로 0.5초에 걸쳐 포커스
		camera_util.move_async(oni_girl_wheelchair.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.5)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--라나 (right, tired, idle): 설마 또 달리자고 온거야?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(oni_girl_wheelchair, 'dv_oni_girl_s1_32')

	self:choose_talk()
end

function local_class:choose_talk()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local oni_girl_wheelchair = self.characters.oni_girl_wheelchair()

	if not self.check_level_down and self.game_fail_count >= 3 then
		--휠체어 탄 라나(right, damaged, idle): 너무 많이 달려서 힘들어….
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_wheelchair, self, 'right',
				'idle', 'damaged', 'dv_oni_girl_s1_35')

		--휠체어 탄 라나(right, tired, idle): 조금 천천히 달려도 될까?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_wheelchair, self, 'right',
				'idle', 'tired', 'dv_oni_girl_s1_36')

		--플레이어 선택지
		do
			local choose_result_2 = choose_util.play_async({
				--(mercy) 나약한 소리 집어 치워!
				{ 'dv_oni_girl_s1_37', 'mercy' },
				--(normal) 그럴래? 사실 나도 힘들어.
				{ 'dv_oni_girl_s1_39', 'normal' },
			})

			if choose_result_2 == 1 then
				--플레이어 (left, attack, attack 2회 후 hold_loop 1.5초간 출력)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'attack', count = 2 })

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
				scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'hold_loop')
				wait_for_sec(1.5)

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
				--휠체어 탄 라나(right, tired, idle) 상태에서 shake 0.03/1초: 알겠어… 다시 열심히 뛰어볼게
				scene_util.shake(oni_girl_wheelchair, 0.03, 1)
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_wheelchair, self, 'right',
						'idle', 'tired', 'dv_oni_girl_s1_38')
			else
				--플레이어 (left, smile, nod 2회 후 idle 출력)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
				scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
				--휠체어 탄 라나 (right, idle, idle): 나를 위해 일부러 힘든 척하는 거지?
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(oni_girl_wheelchair, 'dv_oni_girl_s1_40')

				--휠체어 탄 라나 (right, idle, idle): 고마워… 그럼 조금만 천천히 뛸게.
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(oni_girl_wheelchair, 'dv_oni_girl_s1_41')

				--해당 선택지 선택하면 난이도 조절되며 고정
				--초기 달리기 속도
				--3.2 → 3
				--중간 달리기 속도
				--3.8 → 3.5
				self.oni_girl_speed = { 2.4, 2.8 }
				self.check_level_down = true
			end
		end

		self:start_activity()
		return
	end


	--플레이어 선택지 등장
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--(mercy) 다시 가보자고!
		{ 'dv_oni_girl_s1_28', 'mercy' },
		--(brutal) 바빠서 힘들 것 같아.
		{ 'dv_oni_girl_s1_30', 'brutal' },
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--플레이어 (left, attack, victroy_get 1회 출력)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'victory_get')
		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		--이후 다시 액티비티 진행
		self:start_activity()
	else
		--플레이어 (left, tired, cast 1.5초간 출력)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast')
		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		--라나 (right, tired, idle): 그래, 잘 생각했어.
		scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_wheelchair, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(oni_girl_wheelchair, 'dv_oni_girl_s1_31')
		--이후 컨트롤 해제
		self.current_state = self.states.race_fail

		character_util.add_listener(oni_girl_wheelchair, self.controller)
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

		local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')
		time_conversion:conversion_active_setting(true)

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)
	end
end

function local_class:start_setting()

			daylight = function()
				self:show_princess()
			end,
			-- 밤
			night = function()
				self:hide_princess()
			end
		}, true)
	end
end

function local_class:show_princess()
	local princess = self.characters.princess()
	local kid_male = self.characters.kid_male()
	local kid_female = self.characters.kid_female()
	local quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.cs_controller.QuestId)
	local immediate = false

	if quest ~= nil and quest.IsComplete and quest.Grade == 0 then
		--공주(right, attack, bomb_idle) : 얘들아! 나랑 놀자!
		character_util.set_position(princess, kid_male.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, 'bomb_idle')
		princess.Interactable.Talk = 'dv_sub_princess_post_1'

		--여자 꼬마(left, smile, idle) : 그럴까?
		character_util.set_direction(kid_female, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(kid_female, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(kid_female, self, 'idle')
		kid_female.Interactable.Talk = 'dv_sub_princess_post_2'

		--남자 꼬마(right, attack, idle) : 꺼져.
		character_util.set_direction(kid_male, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(kid_male, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(kid_male, self, 'idle')
		kid_male.Interactable.Talk = 'dv_sub_princess_post_3'
	elseif quest ~= nil and quest.IsComplete then
		--공주(right, doyagao, bomb_idle) : 트… 특별히 나랑 놀 기회를 줄게!
		character_util.set_position(princess, kid_male.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'doyagao')
		scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, 'bomb_idle')
		princess.Interactable.Talk = 'dv_sub_princess_post_4'

		--여자 꼬마(left, smile, idle) : 같이 놀자는 거지?
		character_util.set_direction(kid_female, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(kid_female, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(kid_female, self, 'idle')
		kid_female.Interactable.Talk = 'dv_sub_princess_post_5'

		--남자 꼬마(right, attack, idle) : 꺼져.
		character_util.set_direction(kid_male, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(kid_male, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(kid_male, self, 'idle')
		kid_male.Interactable.Talk = 'dv_sub_princess_post_6'
	end

	if not self.controller.quest_clear_check then
		self.controller.quest_clear_check = true
		immediate = true
	end

	self.controller:show_time_conversion(immediate, function()
	end, { princess, kid_male, kid_female })
end

function local_class:hide_princess()
	local princess = self.characters.princess()
	local kid_male = self.characters.kid_male()
	local kid_female = self.characters.kid_female()

	self.controller:hide_time_conversion(false, nil, { princess, kid_male, kid_female })
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('DreamVillagePrincessSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @

]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type DreamVillagePrincessController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'dreamvillage_3'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		princess_talk = 2,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	-- npc
	self.characters = {
		princess = function()
			return get_character('princess')
		end,
		twins_younger = function()
			return get_character('twins_younger')
		end,
		kid_male = function()
			return get_character('kid_male_friend')
		end,
		kid_female = function()
			return get_character('kid_female_friend')
		end
	}

	self.time_conversion_event_key = 'sub_princess_s1'

	self.sp_controller = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.characters.kid_male().Interactable.Talk = 'dv_sub_princess_s1_1'
	self.characters.kid_female().Interactable.Talk = 'dv_sub_princess_s1_2'
end

function local_class:start()
	self:start_setting()

	local created, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)
end

function local_class:exit()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.characters.princess(), self.controller)

	local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

	if time_conversion ~= nil then
		time_conversion:unregister_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.princess()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.princess_talk

		local is_entered = self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.princess_talk_event, self)

		if not is_entered then
			self.current_state = self.states.none
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_setting()
	do
		-- 밤/낮 세팅
		local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

		-- 콜백 등록
		time_conversion:register_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key, {
			-- 낮
			daylight = function()
				self:show_princess()
			end,
			-- 밤
			night = function()
				self:hide_princess()
			end
		}, true)
	end
end

function local_class:show_princess()
	local princess = self.characters.princess()
	local kid_male = self.characters.kid_male()
	local kid_female = self.characters.kid_female()

	self.controller:show_time_conversion(false, function()
		character_util.add_listener(princess, self.controller)
	end, { princess, kid_male, kid_female })
end

function local_class:hide_princess()
	local princess = self.characters.princess()
	local kid_male = self.characters.kid_male()
	local kid_female = self.characters.kid_female()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(princess, self.controller)

	self.controller:hide_time_conversion(false, nil, { princess, kid_male, kid_female })
end

function local_class:princess_talk_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.characters.princess()
	local twins_younger = self.characters.twins_younger()
	local kid_male = self.characters.kid_male()

	--1초간 기사, 도화 위 위치로 정렬.
	do
		local wp_key = 'leader_wp'

		--1초간 위 위치로 정렬
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, princess.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_younger, princess.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--공주(right, tired, idle) : 음… 같이 놀고 싶은데….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'right',
			nil, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'dv_sub_princess_s1_3')

	--기사 right, idle, release 2회
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

	--공주 left, smile, idle, jump 1회
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'smile')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(princess, true)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--공주(left, smile, bomb_idle) : 아, $name(이)랑 도화구나.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', 'smile', 'dv_sub_princess_s1_4')

	--도화(right, tired, cast) : 표… 표정이 안 좋아 보이셨어요. 무슨 일 있으신가요?
	--표정 유지
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_younger, self, 'right',
			'cast', { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'dv_sub_princess_s1_5')

	--공주(left, tired, idle) : 아, 그게….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
			nil, 'tired', 'dv_sub_princess_s1_6')

	--공주(right, tired, idle) : 저기 쟤네 보여…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'right',
			nil, 'tired', 'dv_sub_princess_s1_7')

	--카메라 포커스 1초간 남자꼬마에게로 이동.
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(kid_male, 1)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--카메라 포커스 1초간 기사에게로 복귀.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--공주 left, tired, idle.
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'tired')
	--가디언 선택지
	do
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--(mercy)우리 길 안내해줬던 애들!
			{ 'dv_sub_princess_s1_8', 'mercy' },
			--(brutal)엄청 심술궂게 생겼어요.
			{ 'dv_sub_princess_s1_10', 'brutal' }
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--기사 right, smile, bomb_idle
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bomb_idle')
			--1초 대기
			wait_for_sec(1)

			--기사 right, smile, idle.
			character_util.remove_anim(leader)
			--공주(left, smile, nod 2회) : 맞아. 우리가 도….
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
					{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'smile', 'dv_sub_princess_s1_9')
		else
			--기사 right, attack, release 3회
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
			scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 3 })

			--기사 right, attack, idle.
			character_util.remove_anim(leader)
			--공주(left, tired, idle) : 너무 그러지 마. 길안내도 해줬었잖아.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',

					if item.UniqueId == unique_id then

						table.remove(this.data, i)

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
	if self.mirror_event_info.mirror_shard_item_id == e.Item.ItemId then
		self.mirror_event_info.cur_mirror_shard_count = self.mirror_event_info.cur_mirror_shard_count + 1

		start_coroutine(function()
			local item_idx = tonumber(string.match(e.Dropper.Name, "%d+$"))
			local shift_amount = 0

			while self.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_encode >> shift_amount > 0 do
				shift_amount = shift_amount + 8
			end

			if self.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_encode ~= -1 then
				self.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_encode = self.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_encode | (item_idx << shift_amount)
			else
				self.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_encode = item_idx
			end

			local quest_progress = quest_util.get_started_quest(450)

			quest_util.set_custom_state(quest_progress, self.custom_state_key, self.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_encode)
		end)

		sp_util.start_scene(self.get_mirror_shard_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_item_get_event')

	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent))
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	local quest_progress = quest_util.get_started_quest(450)

	if quest_progress == nil or quest_progress.IsComplete then
		self.mirror_event_info.cur_event_state = self.mirror_event_state.seen_second_event
	elseif quest_progress.InnerProgress == 2 then
		self.mirror_event_info.cur_event_state = self.mirror_event_state.never_seen
	elseif quest_progress.InnerProgress == 3 then
		self.mirror_event_info.cur_event_state = self.mirror_event_state.seen_first_event
	end
end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	local shard_info = self.mirror_event_info.mirror_shard_info
	screen_util.item_get_event(shard_info.item_name, shard_info.title,
			shard_info.sub_title, shard_info.desc)
end

function local_class:end_flashback(tint_key, used_fx_list, used_sfx_list, character_list, camera_return_pos)
	-- 사용한 사운드 제거
	if used_sfx_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #used_sfx_list do
			used_sfx_list[i]:FadeOut(1)
			used_sfx_list[i] = nil
		end
	end

	--화면 1초간 하얀색으로 페이드 아웃. 끝날 때까지 대기
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	-- 사용한 스크린 이펙트 제거
	if used_fx_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #used_fx_list do
			used_fx_list[i]:Dispose()
			used_fx_list[i] = nil
		end
	end

	used_fx_list = nil

	-- 화면 틴트 제거
	field_util.remove_tint(tint_key, 0)

	-- 회상 이벤트에 사용한 NPC vector(999, 0, 999)보내기
	local monster = self.characters.mirror_monster()

	for i = 1, #character_list do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character_list[i])

		local return_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(character_list[i], monster) then
			return_pos = self.markers.mirror_monster(1, 1)

			scene_util.set_direction(character_list[i], 'left', false)

			character_util.remove_color(character_list[i], character_list[i].Name, 0)
		end

		character_util.set_position(character_list[i], return_pos)
	end

	-- 카메라 위치를 원래로 이동
	camera_util.move(camera_return_pos, 0.01)

	local current_party = get_user_party()

	for i = 0, current_party.Count - 1 do
		field_object_util.set_active_state(current_party[i], active_state_type.enabled)
	end

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

end

return local_class

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_encode = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_state_key)

	local shift_amount = 0

	while self.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_encode >> shift_amount > 0 do
		table.insert(self.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_index_list, (self.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_encode >> shift_amount) & 0xFF)

	end

	character_util.set_position(monster, self.controller.markers.mirror_monster(1, 1))

function local_class:replay_select_event()
	local akayuki = self.controller.characters.akayuki()
	local kunoichi = self.controller.characters.kunoichi()
	local ninja_leader = self.controller.characters.ninja_leader()
	local monster = self.controller.characters.mirror_monster()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	-- 카메라 1초간 이미지의 연두색 마름모 위치로 이동 시작
	-- 파티 멤버 전원 1초간 이미지의 위치로 정렬. 끝날 때까지 대기
	-- 파티 멤버 전원(right, idle, idle)
	camera_util.move(self.controller.markers.camera(1), 1)

	local move_end_key = 'party_align'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, self.controller.markers.leader(1), nil, 1, self, move_end_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(akayuki, self.controller.markers.akayuki(1), nil, 1, self, move_end_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(kunoichi, self.controller.markers.kunoichi(1), nil, 1, self, move_end_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(ninja_leader, self.controller.markers.ninja_leader(1), nil, 1, self, move_end_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	-- 0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 달수(left, idle, release): 기억을 다시 한 번 보시겠습니까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(monster, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release' }, nil, 'dv_sealed_cave_post_1_1')

	-- (intellect) 흑선에 대한 기억을 본다.
	-- (force) 침입자에 대한 기억을 본다.
	--   기억 회복 2 이벤트를 본 이후에 해당 선택지 활성화
	-- (normal) 물러난다

	local choose_branch = {
		{ 'dv_sealed_cave_post_1_2', 'intellect' }, { 'dv_sealed_cave_post_1_3', 'forced' }, { 'dv_sealed_cave_post_1_4', 'normal' }
	}

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(choose_branch)

	local intro_event = function()
		-- 달수(left, idle, cast): 알겠습니다. 자, 이쪽을 보세요….
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(monster, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'cast' }, nil, 'dv_sealed_cave_post_1_5')

		-- 달수(left, idle, cast2)
		scene_util.set_anim(monster, self, 'cast2')

		-- 화면 1초간 페이드 아웃. 끝날 때까지
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)
	end

	if choose_result == 1 then
		intro_event()

		local current_party = get_user_party()

		for i = 0, current_party.Count - 1 do
			field_object_util.set_active_state(current_party[i], active_state_type.disabled)
		end

		local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
		local check_star_piece = false

		if star_piece.ActiveState == active_state_type.enabled then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(star_piece, active_state_type.disabled)

			check_star_piece = true
		end

		self.controller:play_dark_immortal_n_fairy_event()

		if check_star_piece then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(star_piece, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		-- 화면 1초간 페이드 인. 끝날 때까지 대기
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 1 })
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		-- 달수(left, idle, idle): …여기까지 입니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(monster, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'idle' }, nil, 'dv_sealed_cave_post_1_6')

	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		intro_event()

		local current_party = get_user_party()

		for i = 0, current_party.Count - 1 do
			field_object_util.set_active_state(current_party[i], active_state_type.disabled)
		end

		local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
		local check_star_piece = false

		if star_piece.ActiveState == active_state_type.enabled then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(star_piece, active_state_type.disabled)

			check_star_piece = true
		end

		self.controller:play_white_knight_n_fairy_event()

		if check_star_piece then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(star_piece, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		-- 화면 1초간 페이드 인. 끝날 때까지 대기
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 1 })
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		-- 달수(left, idle, idle): …여기까지 입니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(monster, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'idle' }, nil, 'dv_sealed_cave_post_1_6')
	elseif choose_result == 3 then
		-- 달수(left, idle, nod 2회): 알겠습니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(monster, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'dv_sealed_cave_post_1_7')
	end

	-- 카메라 1초간 가디언 위치로 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	-- 이후 카메라 가디언 따라다님
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	-- 파티 멤버 전원 표정&애니메이션 제거
	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(monster)
end

return local_class

--[[QuestAttribute

]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type DreamVillageSealedCaveController
	self.controller = controller

	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	--self.available_stage_names = {}

	self.quest_progress = quest_util.get_started_quest(450)

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		find_mirror_shard = 1,
	}

	-- field object
	self.field_object = {
		west_door = function() return get_field_object('west_door') end,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.find_mirror_shard

	self.field_tint_keys = {
		memory_1 = 'dark_immortal_n_fairy',
	}

	-- custom state key
	self.custom_state_key = 'save_mirror_shard_num'
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.controller.fx:load_all()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_item_get_event')

	-- 거울 조각 갯수 체크
	self.controller.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_encode = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_state_key)

	local shift_amount = 0

	while self.controller.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_encode >> shift_amount > 0 do
		table.insert(self.controller.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_index_list, (self.controller.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_encode >> shift_amount) & 0xFF)
		shift_amount = shift_amount + 8
	end

	local is_current_section_start = self.cs_controller.StartingInnerProgress == 2

	for i = 1, #self.controller.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_index_list do
		local num = self.controller.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_index_list[i]

		self.controller.mirror_event_info.cur_mirror_shard_count = self.controller.mirror_event_info.cur_mirror_shard_count + 1

		field_object_util.set_active_state(get_field_object('mirror_shard_' .. num), active_state_type.disabled)
	end

	if is_current_section_start then
		if self.controller.mirror_event_info.cur_mirror_shard_count >= 1 then
			quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('sub_sealed_cave', {
				{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.controller.characters.mirror_monster() },
			})
		end
	end

	local monster = self.controller.characters.mirror_monster()

	field_object_util.set_active_state(monster, active_state_type.enabled)

	scene_util.set_direction(monster, 'left', false)
	character_util.set_position(monster, self.controller.markers.mirror_monster(1, 1))
	scene_util.set_anim(monster, self, 'seat')
	character_util.add_listener(monster, self.controller)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent))

	if self.crt_filter_screen ~= nil then
		self.crt_filter_screen:Dispose()
		self.crt_filter_screen = nil
	end

	if self.glitch_effect_screen ~= nil then
		self.glitch_effect_screen:Dispose()
		self.glitch_effect_screen = nil
	end

	if self.glitch_effect_no_white ~= nil then
		self.glitch_effect_no_white:Dispose()
		self.glitch_effect_no_white = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.controller.characters.mirror_monster()) then
		self:check_play_event()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
	start_coroutine(function()
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('sub_sealed_cave', {
			{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.controller.characters.mirror_monster() },
		})
	end)
end

function local_class:check_play_event()
	if self.controller.mirror_event_info.cur_mirror_shard_count == 0 and self.controller.mirror_event_info.cur_event_state == self.controller.mirror_event_state.never_seen then
		start_coroutine(self.play_monster_oneline, self)
	elseif self.controller.mirror_event_info.cur_mirror_shard_count == 1 then
		if self.controller.mirror_event_info.cur_event_state == self.controller.mirror_event_state.never_seen then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.play_first_memory_recovery_event, self)
		end
	elseif self.controller.mirror_event_info.cur_mirror_shard_count == 2 then
		if self.controller.mirror_event_info.cur_event_state == self.controller.mirror_event_state.never_seen then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.play_first_memory_recovery_event, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:play_monster_oneline()
	local monster = self.controller.characters.mirror_monster()

	-- 달수(left, idle, seat): …기억이 뭐더라?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(monster,

	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_item_get_event')

	-- 거울 조각 갯수 체크
	self.controller.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_encode = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_state_key)

	local shift_amount = 0

	while self.controller.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_encode >> shift_amount > 0 do
		table.insert(self.controller.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_index_list, (self.controller.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_encode >> shift_amount) & 0xFF)
		shift_amount = shift_amount + 8
	end

	local is_current_section_start = self.cs_controller.StartingInnerProgress >= 3

	for i = 1, #self.controller.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_index_list do
		local num = self.controller.mirror_event_info.save_mirror_shard_index_list[i]

		if is_current_section_start then
			self.controller.mirror_event_info.cur_mirror_shard_count = self.controller.mirror_event_info.cur_mirror_shard_count + 1
		end

		field_object_util.set_active_state(get_field_object('mirror_shard_' .. num), active_state_type.disabled)
	end

	if is_current_section_start then
		if self.controller.mirror_event_info.cur_mirror_shard_count == 2 then
			quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('sub_sealed_cave', {
				{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.controller.characters.mirror_monster() },
			})
		end
	end

	local monster = self.controller.characters.mirror_monster()

	field_object_util.set_active_state(monster, active_state_type.enabled)

	scene_util.set_direction(monster, 'left', false)
	character_util.set_position(monster, self.controller.markers.mirror_monster(1, 1))
	scene_util.set_anim(monster, self, 'seat')
	character_util.add_listener(monster, self.controller)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent))

	if self.crt_filter_screen ~= nil then
		self.crt_filter_screen:Dispose()
		self.crt_filter_screen = nil
	end

	if self.glitch_effect_screen ~= nil then
		self.glitch_effect_screen:Dispose()
		self.glitch_effect_screen = nil
	end

	if self.glitch_effect_no_white ~= nil then
		self.glitch_effect_no_white:Dispose()
		self.glitch_effect_no_white = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.controller.characters.mirror_monster()) then
		self:check_play_event()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
	start_coroutine(function()
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('sub_sealed_cave', {
			{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.controller.characters.mirror_monster() },
		})
	end)
end

function local_class:check_play_event()
	if self.controller.mirror_event_info.cur_mirror_shard_count == 1 then
		if self.controller.mirror_event_info.cur_event_state == self.controller.mirror_event_state.seen_first_event then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.replay_select_event, self)

	scene_util.set_direction(kunoichi, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(ninja_leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(kunoichi, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
	scene_util.set_anim_async(ninja_leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	-- 파티 멤버 전원(right, idle, idle)
	party_util.set_direction('right')
	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

	--달수(left, smile, release): 잠시만요, 어르신들!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(monster, self, 'left',
			'release', 'smile', 'dv_sealed_cave_s4_1_21')

	--달수(left, smile, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(monster, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(monster, self, 'smile')

	--카메라 1초간 이미지의 연두색 마름모 위치로 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	camera_util.move_async(self.controller.markers.camera(1), 1)

	--달수(left, smile, eat): 이걸 받아 주십쇼. 쇤네의 조각들을 모두 찾아주신 것에 대한 보답입니다.
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(monster, self, 'left',
			'eat', 'smile', 'dv_sealed_cave_s4_1_22')

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	eat_sfx = nil

	--달수(left, smile, get)
	scene_util.set_direction(monster, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(monster, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(monster, self, 'get')

	-- 스타피스가 달수 위치에서 생성되어 달수 위치 기준 vector(0, 0, -1.5) 위치에 떨어진다. 끝날 때까지 대기
	local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, monster.Position, monster.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5))

	wait_for_sec(2)

	--달수(left, smile, cast2): 언제든 또 놀러오십쇼, 어르신들! 어르신들은 언제든지 환영입니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(monster, self, 'left',
			'cast2', 'smile', 'dv_sealed_cave_s4_1_23')

	--달수(left, smile, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(monster, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(monster, self, 'smile')

	--가디언(right, idle, nod 2회) 끝날 때까지 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	-- 카메라 1초간 가디언 위치로 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	-- 이후 카메라 가디언 따라다님
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	-- 파티 멤버 전원 표정&애니메이션 제거
	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(monster)

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('sub_sealed_cave')

	-- 상태 변경
	self.controller.mirror_event_info.cur_event_state = self.controller.mirror_event_state.seen_second_event

	self.current_state = self.states.clear

	self.controller:complete_quest({ run_fame_alignment = false })
end



function local_class:replay_select_event()
	local akayuki = self.controller.characters.akayuki()
	local kunoichi = self.controller.characters.kunoichi()
	local ninja_leader = self.controller.characters.ninja_leader()
	local monster = self.controller.characters.mirror_monster()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	-- 카메라 1초간 이미지의 연두색 마름모 위치로 이동 시작
	-- 파티 멤버 전원 1초간 이미지의 위치로 정렬. 끝날 때까지 대기
	-- 파티 멤버 전원(right, idle, idle)
	camera_util.move(self.controller.markers.camera(1), 1)

	local move_end_key = 'party_align'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, self.controller.markers.leader(1), nil, 1, self, move_end_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(akayuki, self.controller.markers.akayuki(1), nil, 1, self, move_end_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(kunoichi, self.controller.markers.kunoichi(1), nil, 1, self, move_end_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(ninja_leader, self.controller.markers.ninja_leader(1), nil, 1, self, move_end_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	-- 0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 달수(left, idle, release): 기억을 다시 한 번 보시겠습니까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(monster, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release' }, nil, 'dv_sealed_cave_post_1_1')

	-- (intellect) 흑선에 대한 기억을 본다.
	-- (force) 침입자에 대한 기억을 본다.
	--   기억 회복 2 이벤트를 본 이후에 해당 선택지 활성화
	-- (normal) 물러난다

	local choose_branch = {
		{ 'dv_sealed_cave_post_1_2', 'intellect' }, { 'dv_sealed_cave_post_1_3', 'forced' }, { 'dv_sealed_cave_post_1_4', 'normal' }
	}

	if self.controller.mirror_event_info.cur_event_state == self.controller.mirror_event_state.seen_first_event then
		choose_branch[2] = choose_branch[3]
		choose_branch[3] = nil
	end

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(choose_branch)

	local intro_event = function()
		-- 달수(left, idle, cast): 알겠습니다. 자, 이쪽을 보세요….
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(monster, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'cast' }, nil, 'dv_sealed_cave_post_1_5')

		-- 달수(left, idle, cast2)
		scene_util.set_anim(monster, self, 'cast2')

		-- 화면 1초간 페이드 아웃. 끝날 때까지 대기
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)
	end

	if choose_result == 1 then
		intro_event()

		local current_party = get_user_party()

		for i = 0, current_party.Count - 1 do
			field_object_util.set_active_state(current_party[i], active_state_type.disabled)
		end

		self.controller:play_dark_immortal_n_fairy_event()

		-- 화면 1초간 페이드 인. 끝날 때까지 대기
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 1 })
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		-- 달수(left, idle, idle): …여기까지 입니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(monster, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'idle' }, nil, 'dv_sealed_cave_post_1_6')

	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		if self.controller.mirror_event_info.cur_event_state > self.controller.mirror_event_state.seen_first_event then
			intro_event()

			local current_party = get_user_party()

			for i = 0, current_party.Count - 1 do
				field_object_util.set_active_state(current_party[i], active_state_type.disabled)
			end

			self.controller:play_white_knight_n_fairy_event()

			-- 화면 1초간 페이드 인. 끝날 때까지 대기
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 1 })
			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			-- 달수(left, idle, idle): …여기까지 입니다.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(monster, self, 'left',
					{ name = 'idle' }, nil, 'dv_sealed_cave_post_1_6')

		else
			-- 달수(left, idle, nod 2회): 알겠습니다.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(monster, self, 'left',
					{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'dv_sealed_cave_post_1_7')
		end
	end

	-- 카메라 1초간 가디언 위치로 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	-- 이후 카메라 가디언 따라다님
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	-- 파티 멤버 전원 표정&애니메이션 제거
	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(monster)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageShadowHousePreSection')

local event_zone_name = 'shadow_house_zone'

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = DreamVillageShadowHouse @
		Comment = @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type DreamVillageShadowHouseController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = { 'dreamvillage_2' }

	self.npc = {
		-- 기사(파티리더)
		knight = function()
			return get_party_leader()
		end,

		--도화
		twins_younger = function()
			return get_character('twins_younger')
		end,

		--남자 1
		man_1 = function()
			return get_character('sh_man_1')
		end,

		--여자 1
		girl_1 = function()
			return get_character('sh_girl_1')
		end,
	}

	self.object = {
		letter_object = function()
			return get_field_object('sh_letter_object')
		end,
		house_door_open = function()
			return get_field_object('sh_house_door_open')
		end,
		house_door_close = function()
			return get_field_object('sh_house_door_close')
		end,
	}

	self.marker = {
		sh_pivot_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('sh_pivot_pos')
		end,
		nowhere = function()
			return vector(999, 0, 999)
		end,
	}

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		before_throw_letter_scene = 2,
		after_throw_letter_scene = 3,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_throw_letter_scene

	self.time_conversion_event_key = 'pre_shadow_house'
	self.quest_marker_constants_key = 'shadow_house'

	self.leader = nil
	self.is_enter_event_zone = false
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent), 'on_time_conversion_changed_event')

	self.leader = self.npc.knight()
end

function local_class:start()
	self.time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

	local girl_1 = self.npc.girl_1()
	field_object_util.set_active_state(girl_1, active_state_type.enabled)
	girl_1.Position = self.marker.sh_pivot_pos()

	self.time_conversion:register_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key, {
		-- 낮
		daylight = function()
			quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_constants_key)

			--레벨 복구
			field_ui_manager:SetUI(girl_1, field_ui_type.character_stats)

			if self.current_state == self.states.after_throw_letter_scene then
				quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.quest_marker_constants_key, {
					{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.object.letter_object().Position },
				})
			elseif self.current_state == self.states.before_throw_letter_scene then
				start_coroutine(self.set_npc_daylight, self, girl_1)
			end
		end,
		-- 밤
		night = function()
			quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_constants_key)

			--레벨 제거
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(girl_1, field_ui_type.character_stats)

			if self.current_state == self.states.before_throw_letter_scene then

				start_coroutine(self.set_npc_night, self, girl_1)
			end
		end
	}, true)
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.time_conversion ~= nil then
		self.time_conversion.is_reset_control = true
		self.time_conversion:unregister_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key)
		self.time_conversion = nil
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.after_throw_letter_scene and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.object.letter_object()) then

		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_letter_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_state == self.states.before_throw_letter_scene and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, event_zone_name) then

		if self.time_conversion:is_daylight() then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.throw_letter_scene, self)
		else
			self.is_enter_event_zone = true
			self.time_conversion.is_reset_control = false
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local leader = self.leader

	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, leader, event_zone_name) then
		self.is_enter_event_zone = false
		self.time_conversion.is_reset_control = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_time_conversion_changed_event(_)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_throw_letter_scene and
			self.is_enter_event_zone and
			self.time_conversion.is_reset_control == false then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.throw_letter_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:throw_letter_scene()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1.5)

	local knight = self.npc.knight()
	local twins_younger = self.npc.twins_younger()
	local girl_1 = self.npc.girl_1()
	local man_1 = self.npc.man_1()

	--스테이트 변경해줌
	self.current_state = self.states.after_throw_letter_scene

	--여자 1 위치 기준
	local pivot_pos = self.marker.sh_pivot_pos()

	--플레이어 트리거 존 진입시 컨트롤 빼앗고 위 이미지 위치에 정렬 - 1.5초간
	if user_party:Contains(twins_younger) then
		wp_util.move(knight, pivot_pos + vector(-3.5, 0, 0.5), nil, 1.5, { last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_async(twins_younger, pivot_pos + vector(-3.5, 0, -0.5), nil, 1.5, { last_direction = 'right' })
	else
		wp_util.move_async(knight, pivot_pos + vector(-3.5, 0, 0), nil, 1.5, { last_direction = 'right' })
	end

	--여자1에게 카메라 포커스 전환 - 1.5초간
	camera_util.move_async(pivot_pos, 1.5)

	--여자1 (right, tired, nod 2회) : 이제 슬슬 출발해야지…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(girl_1, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'tired', 'dv_sub_shadow_house_pre_1')

	--여자1 (up, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(girl_1, 'up', false)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--여자1 (up, idle, idle) 캐릭터 shake (0.03,1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(girl_1, 0.03, 1)
	scene_util.set_direction(girl_1, 'up', false)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--여자 1 오른쪽 1.5타일 이동 - 속도 2
	wp_util.move_async(girl_1, girl_1.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0), 2)

	local door_open = self.object.house_door_open()
	local door_close = self.object.house_door_close()

	--다음 동작 동시 실행 (여자1 목표 지점 도착 직후)
	do

		--카메라 shake (0.3,0.3)
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

		--여 (left, surprise, idle) jump 2회 - 표정 유지
		scene_util.set_direction(girl_1, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(girl_1, self, 'surprise')
		character_util.remove_anim(girl_1)
		character_util.normal_jump(girl_1)

		--롯데마트 오픈
		field_object_util.set_active_state(door_open, active_state_type.enabled)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(door_close, active_state_type.disabled)

		--남자1 (shout 말풍선) : 잠깐!
		--화면비 기준 x:0.5 / y:0.25

local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageShadowHouseSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DreamVillageShadowHouse @
		Comment = @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type DreamVillageShadowHouseController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = { 'substage_20_2' }

	self.npc = {
		-- 기사(파티리더)
		knight = function()
			return get_party_leader()
		end,

		--할멈
		grandma = function()
			return get_character('grandma')
		end,

		--하인 1~3
		servant = function(idx)
			return get_character('servant_' .. idx)
		end,
	}

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		before_grandma = 2,
		after_grandma = 3,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_grandma

	self.marker = {
		s1_pivot_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_pivot_pos')
		end,
		s2_pivot_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_center_pos_1')
		end,
		nowhere = function()
			return vector(999, 0, 999)
		end,
	}

	self.is_enter_event_zone = false
	self.cached_leader = nil
	self.time_conversion_event_key = 'shadow_house_s1'
	self.is_on_enter = true

	self.sp_controller = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent), 'on_time_conversion_changed_event')

	self:set_npc_init()

	self:time_conversion_setting()
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

	if self.current_state == self.states.before_grandma and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.cached_leader, 's1_trigger_zone') then

		if self.time_conversion:is_daylight() then
			self.current_state = self.states.after_grandma
			self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.grandma_scene, self)
		else
			self.is_enter_event_zone = true
			self.time_conversion.is_reset_control = false
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)

	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, self.cached_leader, 's1_trigger_zone') then
		self.is_enter_event_zone = false
		self.time_conversion.is_reset_control = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_time_conversion_changed_event(_)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_grandma and
			self.is_enter_event_zone and
			self.time_conversion.is_reset_control == false then
		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.grandma_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start()
	self.cached_leader = self.npc.knight()

	local created, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:time_conversion_setting()
	self.time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')
	self.is_on_enter = false

function local_class:set_npc_by_list(npc_info_list)
	for name, info_list in pairs(npc_info_list) do
		local npc = nil
		local pos = info_list.pos
		local direction = info_list.direction
		local anim = info_list.anim
		local emotion = info_list.emotion
		local remove_anim_and_emotion = info_list.remove_anim_and_emotion
		local hide_weapon = info_list.hide_weapon
		local oneline = info_list.oneline
		local alpha = info_list.alpha
		local crash_behaviour = info_list.crash_behaviour
		local tint = info_list.tint
		local remove_tint = info_list.remove_tint

		if name == 'china_hero' then
			npc = user_util.get_china_hero_character('china_hero_boy', 'china_hero_girl')
		elseif name == 'knight' then
			npc = user_util.get_knight_character('knight_female', 'knight_male')
		elseif name == 'party_leader' then
			npc = get_party_leader()
		else
			npc = get_character(name)
		end

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)

		if pos ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
		end

		if direction ~= nil then
			character_util.set_direction(npc, direction)
		end

		if anim ~= nil then
			if type_util.is_table(anim) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, anim)
			else

	--region Sprite
	self.sprite = {
		sprite_info = {
			wedding_dress = 21394,

		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}
	--endregion Sprite

	self.wait_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)

--region Event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if self.current_state == self.states.start and self.time_conversion:is_daylight() and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.trigger_zone_name .. 1) then
		self.current_state = self.states.scene_1

		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.trigger_first_scene, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.scene_3 and self.time_conversion:is_daylight() and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.trigger_zone_name .. 5) then
		self.current_state = self.states.scene_4

		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.servant_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_time_conversion_changed_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_state == self.states.start and self.time_conversion:is_daylight() and
			zone_util.contains_fo(field:GetZone(self.trigger_zone_name .. 1), leader) then
		self.current_state = self.states.scene_1

		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.trigger_first_scene, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.scene_3 and self.time_conversion:is_daylight() and
			zone_util.contains_fo(field:GetZone(self.trigger_zone_name .. 5), leader) then
		self.current_state = self.states.scene_4

		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.servant_event, self)

		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.scene_1 and self.time_conversion:is_daylight() and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_character.grandma()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.scene_2

		local is_entered = self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.activity_tutorial_scene, self)

		if is_entered then
			quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')
		else
			self.current_state = self.states.scene_1
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_brazier_on_off_event(e)
	local brazier_1 = self.get_brazier(1)
	local brazier_2 = self.get_brazier(2)

	for i = 1, 2 do
		--  화로 꺼짐 체크
		if self.current_state == self.states.scene_4 and
				not self.is_daylight and
				not e.IsTurningOn and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.BrazierObject, self.get_brazier(i)) then
			if not brazier_1.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning and
					not brazier_2.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then
				self.current_state = self.states.scene_5

				self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.ending_scene, self)
			end

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:activity_tutorial_scene()
	local grandma = self.get_character.grandma()

	local center_pos = self.get_center_pos(1)
	--운동 QTE 개요
	--할멈이 처음에 위,아래,좌,우 기준으로 동작을 하나씩 알려주고 이후 동작을 외워서 3회 진행하면 성공
	--월드 19-3스테이지의 훈련 이벤트와 비슷하지만 대사로 알려주는 것이 아닌 동작을 외워서 그대로 따라하는 형태.

	if self.current_choose_state == self.choose_state.disable_control then
		party_util.align_party(center_pos, 'left', 1)

		self:failed_choose()
	else
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--다음 동작 동시 실행
		--카메라 값 3으로 줌 인 - 1초
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 1)

		--카메라 포커스 할멈, 기사 사이로 이동 - 1초
		--x : 35 / z: 1
		camera_util.move_async(center_pos, 1)

		--할멈 (left, idle, idle) : 제가 동작을 알려드릴테니 그대로 따라하시면 됩니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				'dv_sub_shadow_house_s2_20')

		--할멈 (left, idle, cross_arm) : 이 늙은이도 하는 운동인데 설마 젊은 분이 못따라오시진 않겠죠?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self,
				nil,
				'cross_arm',
				nil,
				'dv_sub_shadow_house_s2_21')

		self.current_choose_state = self.choose_state.tutorial
	end

	while true do
		--여기
		--이후 바로 다음 동작으로 넘어감.
		local choose_result

		if self.current_choose_state == self.choose_state.tutorial then
			if stage_camera.Size ~= 3 then
				--다음 동작 동시 실행
				--카메라 값 3으로 줌 인 - 1초
				camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 1)

				--카메라 포커스 할멈, 기사 사이로 이동 - 1초
				--x : 35 / z: 1
				camera_util.move_async(center_pos, 1)
			end

			self:tutorial_start()

			--기사 선택지
			choose_result = choose_util.play_async({
				--(mercy) 시작할게요.
				{ 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s2_choose_5', 'mercy' },
				--(forced) 동작을 못외웠어요…
				{ 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s2_choose_6', 'forced' },
			})
		elseif self.current_choose_state == self.choose_state.tutorial_skip then
			choose_result = 1

		elseif self.current_choose_state == self.choose_state.disable_control then
			self.current_state = self.states.scene_1

			camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
			camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

			return
		end

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--(mercy) 시작할게요.
			--이후 액티비티 바로 시작
			local is_clear = self:activity_start()

			if is_clear then
				self.current_state = self.states.scene_3

				quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
					{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.get_center_pos(3) + vector(0, 0.5, 0) },
				})

				--루프 종료
				break
			end
		else
			--(forced) 동작을 못외웠어요…
			--할멈 (left, idle, idle) : 그럼 제가 특별히 다시 알려드리겠습니다.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self,
					{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
					nil,
					nil,
					'dv_sub_shadow_house_s2_28')

			--이후 여기 위치부터 다시 시작.
			self.current_choose_state = self.choose_state.tutorial

			camera_util.move_async(center_pos, 1)
		end
	end
end

		--1초대기
		--할멈 동작 시범
		--할멈 (up, idle, dance_voodoo) - 2초
		--할멈 (right, idle, dualgun_attack_right) -2초
		--할멈 (left, idle, dualgun_attack_left) -2초
		--플레이어 ↓→ ← 수행 성공시
		--기사 (down, idle, dance_voodoo) - 2초
		--기사 (right, idle, dualgun_attack_right) -2초
		--기사 (left, idle, dualgun_attack_left) -2초
		{
			target = leader,
			instructor = grandma,
			string_key = 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s2_29',
			bubble_wait_sec = 1,
			pattern = {
				{ data = dir_anim.down, duration = 2 },
				{ data = dir_anim.right, duration = 1.5 },
				{ data = dir_anim.left, duration = 1.5 },
			},
			cb_2 = function()
				local grandma = self.get_character.grandma()
				local leader = get_party_leader()

				--1초 대기
				wait_for_sec(1)

				--기사 (right, idle, idle)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
				scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)

				--다음 동작 동시 실행
				--할멈 (down, idle, idle)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(grandma)
				scene_util.set_direction(grandma, 'down', false)

				--카메라 포커스 할멈에게로 이동 - 1초.
				camera_util.move_async(grandma.Position, 1)
			end
		},
		--2차
		--할멈 (down, idle, idle) : 두 번째 차례입니다!
		--할멈 (up, idle, dualgun_reload_start) - 2초
		--할멈 (down, idle, dance_voodoo) - 2초
		--할멈 (up, idle, dualgun_reload_start) - 2초
		--플레이어 ↑ ↓ ↑수행 성공시
		--기사 (up, idle, dualgun_reload_start) - 2초
		--기사 (down, idle, dance_voodoo) - 2초
		--기사 (up, idle, dualgun_reload_start) - 2초
		{
			target = leader,
			instructor = grandma,
			string_key = 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s2_30',
			bubble_wait_sec = 1,
			pattern = {
				{ data = dir_anim.up, duration = 2 },
				{ data = dir_anim.down, duration = 2 },

				wait_for_sec(1)

				--기사 (right, idle, idle)

				--할멈 (down, idle, idle)

				--카메라 포커스 할멈에게로 이동 - 1초.
				camera_util.move_async(grandma.Position, 1)
			end
		},
		--3차
		--할멈 (down, idle, idle) : 마지막은 더 분발해서 합시다!
		--할멈 (left, attack, dualgun_attack_left) -2초
		--할멈 (up, idle, dualgun_reload_start) -2초
		--할멈 (right, attack, gauntlet_handskill2) -2초
		--할멈 (down, attack, dance_voodoo) -2초
		--할멈 (up, idle, dualgun_reload_start) -리얼타임 2초 / 동작만 타임스케일 0.5
		--플레이어  ← ↑ →  ↓ ↑ 수행 성공시
		--기사 (left, idle, dualgun_attack_left) -2초
		--기사 (up, idle, dance_voodoo) -2초
		--기사 (right, idle, dualgun_attack_right) -2초
		--기사 (down, attack, dance_voodoo) -2초
		--기사 (up, idle, dualgun_reload_start) -리얼타임 2초 / 동작만 타임스케일 0.5
		{
			target = leader,
			instructor = grandma,
			string_key = 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s2_31',
			bubble_wait_sec = 1,
			pattern = {
				{ data = dir_anim.left, duration = 1.5 },
				{ data = dir_anim.up, duration = 2 },
				{ data = dir_anim.right, duration = 1.5 },
				{ data = dir_anim.down, duration = 2 },
				{ data = dir_anim.up, duration = 2 },
			},
			cb_2 = function()
				local grandma = self.get_character.grandma()
				local leader = get_party_leader()

				--1초 대기
				wait_for_sec(1)

				--기사 (right, awesome, success)
				scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'awesome')
				scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'success')

				wait_for_sec(1)

				--기사 (right, idle, idle)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

				--다음 동작 동시 실행
				--할멈 (left, smile, clap)
