				scene_util.set_emotion(grandma, self, 'smile')
				scene_util.set_anim(grandma, self, 'clap')

				--서클로 페이드 아웃 - 1.5초
				screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1.5, interpolations_constants.linear)

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(grandma)
			end
		},
	}

	local swipe_success = true

	--서클로 페이드 아웃 - 1.5초
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1.5, interpolations_constants.linear)

	--카메라 값 2.5 / 포커스는 할멈으로 세팅된 상태.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(2.5, 0)

	local camera_pos = self.get_center_pos(1)
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--서클로 페이드 인 -1.5초
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1.5, interpolations_constants.linear)

	for idx = 1, #pattern_datas do
		local pattern_data = pattern_datas[idx]
		local target = pattern_data.target
		local instructor = pattern_data.instructor
		local pattern_list = pattern_data.pattern
		local string_key = pattern_data.string_key
		local bubble_wait_sec = pattern_data.bubble_wait_sec
		local callback_1 = pattern_data.cb_1
		local callback_2 = pattern_data.cb_2

		--할멈 (down, idle, idle) : n 번째 세트입니다!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self,
				{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = string_key, skip = false, force_sfx = true })

		if callback_1 then
			callback_1()
		end

		--n초 대기
		if bubble_wait_sec then
			wait_for_sec(bubble_wait_sec)
		end

		for _, pattern in pairs(pattern_list) do
			local anim = pattern.data.anim
			local emo = pattern.data.emo
			local dir = pattern.data.dir
			local duration = pattern.duration

			scene_util.play_wait_action(instructor, self,
					{ dir = dir, sfx = false },
					anim,
					emo,
					duration)
		end

		--다음 동작 동시 실행
		--할멈 (left, idle, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(instructor, 'left', false)

		--카메라 포커스 기사로 이동 - 1초.
		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

		local first_darken = false
		local is_darken = true

		for _, pattern in pairs(pattern_list) do
			local anim = pattern.data.anim
			local emo = pattern.data.emo
			local dir = pattern.data.dir
			local swipe_dir = pattern.data.swipe_dir
			local duration = pattern.duration

			if first_darken then
				is_darken = false
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_complete_01')
			swipe_success = qte_play_util.swipe(swipe_dir, {
				is_possible_wrong_swipe = true, show_tutorial_spine = false, darken = is_darken })

			first_darken = true

			if swipe_success then
				scene_util.play_wait_action(target, self,
						{ dir = dir, sfx = false },
						anim,
						emo,
						duration)
			else
				break
			end
		end

		if not swipe_success then
			break
		end

		if callback_2 then
			callback_2()
		end
	end

	if swipe_success then
		self:activity_success_scene()

		return true
	else
		self:activity_failed_scene()

		return false
	end
end

	local grandma = self.get_character.grandma()

	--카메라 포커스 1타일 오른쪽 이동된 상태.

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1.5, interpolations_constants.linear)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)

	--액티비티 성공 후 연출

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			'clap',
			'smile',
			'dv_sub_shadow_house_s2_35')

	--할멈 (left, smile, idle) : 처음엔 걱정이 됐지만…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			'smile',
			'dv_sub_shadow_house_s2_36')

	--할멈 (left, smile, idle) : 이렇게 계속 수업을 진행한다면 분명 신부의 조건을 모두 충족하실 수 있을 것 같군요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			'smile',
			'dv_sub_shadow_house_s2_37')

	--기사 (right, smile, victory_get)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true, loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	--할멈 (left, idle, idle) : 그럼 저는 두 번째 수업을 준비하고 있을테니 조금 휴식을 취한 뒤 어두워지기 전에 돌아와주세요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'dv_sub_shadow_house_s2_38')

	--다음 동작 동시 실행
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--카메라값 4로 줌아웃 - 1.5초
				camera_util.resize_to_default_async(1.5)

			end,
			function()
				--할멈 아래 경로로 퇴장 후 그리드 벗어나면 삭제 처리 - 속도 4
				local move_pos_list = {
					grandma.Position + vector(0, 0, -2),
					grandma.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, -2),
					grandma.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, -8)
				}
				wp_util.move_async(grandma, move_pos_list, 4)
			end
	)

	grandma.Position = self.wait_pos

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	--플레이어 컨트롤 해제.

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.custom_data.key, self.custom_data.clear_val)
end

function local_class:ending_scene()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local bride = self.get_character.bride()

	local rich_male = self.get_character.rich_male()

	local center_pos = self.get_center_pos(3)

	local align_pos = vector(45, 0, -15)

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

	--이후 트리거존에 진입하면 기사 컨트롤 빼앗고 위 이미지 위치에 정렬 - 1초

	--화로 불이 모두 꺼지면 플레이어 위 이미지 위치에 정렬 (right, idle, idle) - 1.5초

	--다음 동작 동시 실행

	--신부, 영주 페이드 인으로 등장 - 1.5초
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(bride, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(rich_male, 0, 0)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(bride, active_state_type.enabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(rich_male, active_state_type.enabled)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(bride, 1, 1.5)

	--다음 동작 동시 실행 - 1.5초
	--카메라 포커스 신부에게로 이동
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(bride, 1.5)

	--다음 동작 동시 실행
	--기사 (신부 방향, scared, embarrassed) - 1.5초
	character_util.look_at(leader, bride)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	--화면 shake (0.1,0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--플레이어 x:45 /z :-15 위치로 이동후 정렬 - 1.5초
	--정렬은 (right, scared, cast)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	local wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(leader, align_pos, false)
	wp_util.move_async(leader, wp, nil, 1.5, { run = false, last_direction = 'right' })

	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'cast' })

	--다음 동작 동시 실행 - 1.5초
	--카메라 포커스 신부에게로 이동
	--카메라 값 2.5로 줌 인
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(2.5, 1.5)

	--신부 2타일 우측으로 이동 - 속도 1
	--신부 (right, idle, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bride)
	wp_util.move_async(bride, bride.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), 1)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--신부 2타일 좌측으로 이동 - 속도 1
	wp_util.move_async(bride, bride.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0), 1)

	--신부 (left, doyagao, idle)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(bride, self, 'doyagao')
	character_util.remove_anim(bride)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--영주 아래 이미지의 경로로 이동 - 속도 4
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(rich_male, 1, 0.5)

	wp_util.move_async(rich_male, center_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 0), 4, nil, { run = true })

	--신부 (right, idle, cast) 점프 1회
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bride)
	scene_util.set_direction(bride, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(bride, self, 'cast')
	character_util.normal_jump(bride, '01_small_jump_01')

	--영주 (left, smile, release 2회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(rich_male, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(rich_male, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

	--영주 신부 앞으로 꽃 아이템 던짐
	--영주 (left, idle, throw 1회)
	scene_util.set_anim(rich_male, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

			daylight = function()
				self:show_daylight()
			end,

				self:hide_night()
			end
		}, true)
	end

function local_class:show_daylight()
	self.is_daylight = true
end

function local_class:hide_night()
	self.is_daylight = false
end

function local_class:npc_setting(npc_data)
	for _, target_data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local target = target_data.target
		local target_pos = target_data.pos
		local target_dir = target_data.dir
		local target_emo = target_data.emo
		local target_anim = target_data.anim
		local target_tint = target_data.tint
		local target_shake = target_data.shake
		local target_is_anim_loop = target_data.is_anim_loop
		local target_effect = target_data.effect
		local target_alpha = target_data.alpha
		local target_function = target_data.coroutine_function
		local target_active_state = target_data.active

		field_object_util.set_active_state(target, target_active_state)

		target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()

		character_util.set_position(target, target_pos)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

		scene_util.set_direction(target, target_dir, false)

		if target_emo then
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, target_emo)
		end

		if target_anim then
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = target_anim, loop = target_is_anim_loop, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		if target_shake then
			scene_util.shake(target, 0.03, 9999, false)
		end

		if target_tint then
			character_util.add_color(target, 'dark_tint', target_tint.color, target_tint.magnitude, 0)
		end

		if target_alpha then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(target, target_alpha, 0)
		end

		if target_effect then
			local fx = target_effect():Instantiate(target.Position)
			self.fx_list[target.Name] = fx
		end

		if target_function then
			start_coroutine(function()
				target_function(target)
			end)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:fx_dispose_all()
	if self.fx_list then
		for _, target in pairs(self.fx_list) do
			if target then
				target:Dispose()
				target = nil
			end
		end

		self.fx_list = nil
	end
end
--endregion Setting

		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}
	--endregion Sprite

	--region Etc
	self.wait_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)

	-- 밤낮 이벤트 키
	self.time_conversion_event_key = 'sub_shadow_house_s3'

	-- 메인 퀘스트 id
	self.main_quest_id = 442

	self.time_conversion = nil

	--밤/낮 체크
	self.is_daylight = nil

	self.sp_controller = nil
	--endregion Etc

	--region GrandmaRacing
	self.grandma_manager = nil

	self.is_playing = false

	self.is_clear = false

	self.s3_state_save_key = 's3_state_save_key'

	self.time_conversion = nil
	--endregion GrandmaRacing
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.grandma_manager = grandma_manager(self)

end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BrazierOnOffEvent), 'on_brazier_on_off_event')

	self:start_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
	self.time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

	if not (self.time_conversion.time_zone.daylight == self.time_conversion.current_time_zone) then
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.get_character.grandma(), active_state_type.disabled)
	end

	local created, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)

	self.is_daylight = true

	self.stage_event_controller = get_stage_event_controller('DreamVillageShadowHouseController')

	self.stage_event_controller.bookcase_list.s3.target.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.grandma_manager:exit()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BrazierOnOffEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region Event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'minigame_success' then
		self.current_state = self.states.scene_4

		self.sp_controller:start_coroutine_delayed(self.minigame_success_scene, self)

		return true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'minigame_failed' then
		self.current_state = self.states.scene_2

		self.sp_controller:start_coroutine_delayed(self.minigame_failed_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.start and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_character.grandma()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.scene_1

		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest_1')

		self.sp_controller:try_start_coroutine(self.interact_first_scene, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.scene_2 and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_character.grandma()) then

		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest_1')

		self.sp_controller:try_start_coroutine(self.activity_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_brazier_on_off_event(e)
	local brazier_1 = self.get_brazier(1)
	local brazier_2 = self.get_brazier(2)
	local brazier_3 = self.get_brazier(3)
	local brazier_4 = self.get_brazier(4)

	for i = 1, 2 do
		--  화로 꺼짐 체크
		if self.current_state == self.states.scene_4 and
				not self.is_daylight and
				not e.IsTurningOn and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.BrazierObject, self.get_brazier(i)) then
			if not brazier_1.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning and
					not brazier_2.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then
				self.current_state = self.states.scene_5

				quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest_1')

				self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.trigger_5_scene, self)

				--self.current_state = self.states.scene_4

				--sp_util.start_scene(self.brazier_on_scene, self)
			end

			return true
		end
	end

	for i = 3, 4 do
		if self.current_state == self.states.scene_5 and
				not self.is_daylight and
				not e.IsTurningOn and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.BrazierObject, self.get_brazier(i)) then
			if not brazier_3.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning and
					not brazier_4.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then
				self.current_state = self.states.scene_6

				quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest_2')

				self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.trigger_6_scene, self)
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 미니게임 시작 함수
function local_class:activity_start()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local grandma = self.get_character.grandma()

	local center_pos = self.get_center_pos(1)

	local align_pos = center_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0)

	local activity_pos = self.get_activity_pos(1)

	--서클로 페이드 아웃 - 1.5초
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1.5, 'linear')

	--서클로 페이드 인 되며 위 이미지와 같은 상태에서 시작. - 페이드인 1.5초
	--할멈 주변의 범위는 생성된 상태.
	grandma.Position = activity_pos

	leader.Position = activity_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)

	self.grandma_manager:enter()

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1.5, 'linear')

	--액티비티 시작
	--할멈 (down, idle, idle) : 저를 잘 따라오세요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			'dv_sub_shadow_house_s3_16')

	--sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

	self.grandma_manager:start()

	self:hide_ui()

	self.is_playing = true

	self.is_clear = false

	start_coroutine(self.update_routine, self)
end

-- 미니게임 시작 시 실행 및 체크
function local_class:update_routine()
	local time_passed = 0

	while self.is_playing do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		if not self.grandma_manager:update(dt) then
			self.is_playing = false
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.grandma_manager:exit()

	self:show_ui()

	if self.is_clear then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { 'minigame_success' }))
	else
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { 'minigame_failed' }))
	end
end

-- 미니게임 시 사용 버튼만 활성화 (그 외 비활성화)
function local_class:hide_ui()

			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	--리더로 Dpad 설정 (SetUI를 하지 않을 경우 에러 발생)
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(get_party_leader(), CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)

	self.time_conversion:conversion_active_setting(false)

	coroutine.yield()

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
end

			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
end

-- 미니 게임 성공 연출
function local_class:minigame_success_scene()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	self.time_conversion:conversion_active_setting(true)

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local grandma = self.get_character.grandma()
	grandma.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

	local align_pos = self.get_activity_move_pos(14)

	local center_pos = self.get_center_pos(4)

	----해당 위치로 정렬 - 1초간
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader,
			align_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
			4,
			nil,
			self,
			'wp_key',
			{ last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(grandma,
			align_pos,
			4,
			nil,
			self,
			'wp_key',
			{ last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, 'wp_key')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(grandma)

	--할멈 (right, idle, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(grandma)

	--기사 (left, smile, victory_get)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')

	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true, loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--페이드 아웃 - 1.5초
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--바위 오브젝트 모두 제거
	for idx = 1, 5 do
		local rock = self.get_rock(idx)
		if rock then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(rock, active_state_type.disabled)
		end
	end

	--카메라값 3 상태
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 0)

	leader.Position = center_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)
	grandma.Position = center_pos

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(grandma, 'right', false)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(grandma)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--페이드 인 - 1.5초
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--할멈 (right, idle, idle) : 잘하셨습니다! 앞으로도 이 감각을 기억해서 걸으셔야 합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'dv_sub_shadow_house_s3_20')

	--할멈 (right, idle, nod 2회) : 영주님은 딱 이정도 걸음걸이를 가진 분을 좋아하십니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
			nil,
			'dv_sub_shadow_house_s3_21')

	--기사 선택지
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_async({
		--(brutal) 그럼 할멈이 영주님하고 혼인하면 되겠네요!
		{ 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s3_choose_7', 'brutal' },
		--(forced) 딱 기다려 영주님. 내가 간다!
		{ 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s3_choose_8', 'forced' },
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--(brutal) 그럼 할멈이 영주님하고 혼인하면 되겠네요!
		--기사 (left, idle, bomb_idle)
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bomb_idle')

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		--할멈 (right, idle, idle) silence 이모티콘 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(grandma, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				'silence')

		--할멈 (right, idle, idle) : 그런 농담은 별로 재미 없습니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				'dv_sub_shadow_house_s3_22')
	else
		--(forced) 딱 기다려 영주님. 내가 간다!
		--기사 (left, smile, victory_get)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')

		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true, loop = false })

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		--할멈 (right, tired, idle) annoyed 이모티콘 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(grandma, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				'tired',
				'annoyed')

		--할멈 (right, tired, idle) : 방금 전까지도 기품을 강조했건만…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				'tired',
				'dv_sub_shadow_house_s3_23')
	end

	--할멈 (right, idle, idle) : 그래도 지금까지 수업을 잘 따라와주고 계시는군요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'dv_sub_shadow_house_s3_24')

	--할멈 (right, idle, idle) : 아마 다음이 마지막 수업이 될 것 같습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'dv_sub_shadow_house_s3_25')

	--할멈 (right, idle, idle) : 그럼 저는 다시 다음 수업을 준비하러 갈 테니 잠깐 휴식을 취하시다 어두워지기 전에만 와주세요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'dv_sub_shadow_house_s3_26')

	--할멈 아래 경로로 이동 후 그리드 벗어나면 삭제 - 속도 7 / walk 자세
	local grandma_exit_pos = {
		screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', grandma.Position, -1)
	}

	wp_util.move_async(grandma, grandma_exit_pos, 7)

	grandma.Position = self.wait_pos

	--카메라 값 4로 복귀 - 1.5초
	camera_util.resize_to_default_async(1.5)

	--신부 마커
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest_1', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = get_field_object('exit_inner_1_1').Position,
		  zone = 'activity_field', target = self.get_character.bride().Bounds.center + vector(0, 0, 0.5) },
	})

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.s3_state_save_key, 1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- 미니게임 실패 연출
function local_class:minigame_failed_scene()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self.time_conversion:conversion_active_setting(true)

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local grandma = self.get_character.grandma()

	local center_pos = self.get_center_pos(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(grandma)

	--할멈과 기사의 거리가 1.5타일이 초과되면 그 자리에서 컨트롤 빼앗고 실패 연출
	--다음 동작 동시 실행

	--할멈 (기사 방향, idle, idle)
	character_util.look_at(grandma, leader)

	character_util.set_side_direction(leader)

	--기사 (멈춘 방향, damaged, cliff) - 1초
	scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self,
			nil,
			'cliff',
			'damaged',
			1)

	--다음 동작 동시 실행
	--기사 (멈춘 방향, damaged, prostrate)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'prostrate')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

	--피격 연출 damaged squish - 기본값
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(leader)

	--캐릭터 하단에 fx_hit, fx_lasthit 동시 출력
	self.fx.hit():Instantiate(leader.Position)
	self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(leader.Position)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--기사 (멈춘 방향, tired, prostrate) sweat 이모티콘 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			'tired',
			'sweat')

	--서클로 페이드 아웃 - 1.5초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1.5, 'linear')

	--할멈 (right, idle, idle)
	--기사 (left, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(grandma, 'right', false)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(grandma)

	leader.Position = center_pos

	grandma.Position = center_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--서클로 페이드 인 되며 아래 위치로 세팅 - 1.5초
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1.5, 'linear')

	--할멈 (right, idle, idle) : 보폭을 맞추는 게 중요합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'dv_sub_shadow_house_s3_17')

	--할멈 (right, idle, ilde) : 다시 해보실까요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'dv_sub_shadow_house_s3_18')

	--기사 선택지 출력
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_async({
		--(mercy) 다시 출발!!
		{ 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s3_choose_5', 'mercy' },
		--(brutal) 조금만 쉴래요…
		{ 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s3_choose_6', 'brutal' },
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--(mercy) 다시 출발!!
		--기사 (left, attack, release) - 1초
		scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self,
				nil,
				'release',
				'attack',
				1)

		--걷기 수업 액티비티 재시작
		self:activity_start()
	else
		--(brutal) 조금만 쉴래요…
		--기사 (left, tired, cast) - 1초
		scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self,
				nil,
				'cast',
				'tired',
				1)

		--할멈 (right, idle, idle) : 시간이 별로 없으니 빨리 돌아와주세요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				'dv_sub_shadow_house_s3_19')

		--플레이어 컨트롤 해제.
		--이후 재 인터랙트시 할멈 (다시 해보실까요?) 부터 출력
		character_util.add_listener(grandma, self.controller)

		grandma.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

		--할멈 마커
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest_1', {
			{ zone = 'main_field', target = get_field_object('exit_inner_1_1').Position,
			  zone = 'activity_field', target = self.get_character.grandma().Bounds.center + vector(0, 0, 0.5) },
		})

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end

end

-- 첫 번째 유령 연출
function local_class:trigger_5_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local bride = self.get_character.bride()

	local rich_male = self.get_character.rich_male()

	local center_pos = self.get_center_pos(2)
	local rich_male_end_pos = center_pos + vector(6.5, 0, 0)
	local bride_end_pos = center_pos + vector(5.5, 0, 0)

	local align_pos = center_pos + vector(7, 0, 2)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	--다음 동작 동시 실행
	--신부, 영주 페이드 인으로 등장 - 1.5초
	field_object_util.set_active_state(bride, active_state_type.enabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(rich_male, active_state_type.enabled)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(bride, 0.5, 1.5)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(rich_male, 0.5, 1.5)

	--카메라 포커스 신부에게로 이동 - 1.5초
	camera_util.move_async(bride.Position, 1.5, { end_target = bride })

	--다음 동작 동시 실행
	--화면 shake (0.1,0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	--기사 (신부 방향, scared, embarrassed) - 1.5초
	character_util.look_at(leader, bride)

	scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self,
			nil,
			'embarrassed',
			{ name = 'scared', keep = true },
			1.5)

	--플레이어 이미지 위치로 이동후 정렬 - 1.5초
	--기사 (left, scared, case)
	local move_pos = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(leader, align_pos, false)

	wp_util.move_async(leader, move_pos, nil, 1.5, { last_direction = 'left' })

	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast')

	--영주, 신부 이동 연출
	--카메라는 신부 포커스에 두고 따라감

	--영주 속도 2 / 신부 속도 1로 / walk 자세로 오른쪽으로 이동 시작
	wp_util.move(rich_male, rich_male_end_pos, 2)
	wp_util.move(bride, bride_end_pos, 1)

	--이동 시작 1초 후 신부 그 자리에 멈춤 (async 아님, 영주는 계속 이동중)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.stop(bride)

	--신부 (right, attack, idle) jump 1회
	scene_util.set_emotion(bride, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(bride, '01_small_jump_01')

	--신부 속도 2로 / run 자세로 다시 이동 시작.
	--신부 표정 attack 유지
	wp_util.move(bride, bride_end_pos, 2, nil, { run = true })

	--다음 동작 동시 연출
	--1초 후 신부 그 자리에 멈춰서 자세 전환
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--신부 (right, damaged, cliff)
	character_util.stop(bride)
	scene_util.set_emotion(bride, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(bride, self, 'cliff')

	--영주 (left, attack, idle) notice 이모티콘 출력
	character_util.stop(rich_male)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(rich_male, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			'attack',
			'notice')

	--영주 속도 4/ run 자세로 좌측 이동
	--목표 지점 : 신부 현재 위치 0.5타일 오른쪽
	wp_util.move_async(rich_male, bride.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 4, nil, { run = true })

	--다음 동작 동시 연출
	--영주 (left, attack, push)
	scene_util.set_emotion(rich_male, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(rich_male, self, 'push')

	--신부 (right, tired, cast)
	scene_util.set_emotion(bride, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(bride, self, 'cast')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--영주 뒷걸음질로 0.5타일 우측 이동 후 (left, idle, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rich_male)
	wp_util.move_async(rich_male, rich_male.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 1, nil,
			{ last_direction = 'left', locked_dir = 'left' })

	--신부 (right, smile, cast) rowdy 이모티콘 출력
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(bride, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cast', keep = true },
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			'rowdy')

	--신부 (right, smile, cast) jump 2회
	character_util.normal_jump_async(bride, '01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(bride, '01_small_jump_01')

	--영주 (left, smile, nod 2회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(rich_male, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(rich_male, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bride)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rich_male)

	--이후 다시 아래 위치로 이동 후 신부, 영주 페이드 아웃 - 1.5초
	local rich_male_exit_move_pos_list = {
		rich_male_end_pos,
		rich_male_end_pos + vector(0, 0, -2.5),
	}

	local bride_exit_move_pos_list = {
		bride_end_pos,
		bride_end_pos + vector(0, 0, -2.5),
	}

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(rich_male,
			rich_male_exit_move_pos_list,
			4,
			nil,
			self,
			'wp_key_1')

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(bride,
			bride_exit_move_pos_list,
			4,
			nil,
			self,
			'wp_key_2')

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, 'wp_key_1')

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(rich_male, 0, 0.5)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, 'wp_key_2')

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(bride, 0, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(bride, active_state_type.disabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(rich_male, active_state_type.disabled)

	--도어 열림 연출 (focus)
	local door = get_field_object('s3_puzzle_door_2')

	camera_util.move_async(door.Position, 1)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('s3_puzzle_door_2', false))

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--다음 씬 연출 세팅
	local scene_6_center_pos = self.get_center_pos(3)

	bride.Position = scene_6_center_pos + vector(-4, 0, 0)
	rich_male.Position = scene_6_center_pos + vector(-3, 0, 0)

	--신부, 영주 (right, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(bride, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(rich_male, 'right', false)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bride)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rich_male)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest_2', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.get_center_pos(3) + vector(4.5, 0, 1.5) },
	})

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
	--이후 다시 아래 경로로 이동하여 B 도어로 들어감
end

function local_class:npc_setting(npc_data)
	for _, target_data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local target = target_data.target
		local target_pos = target_data.pos
		local target_dir = target_data.dir
		local target_emo = target_data.emo
		local target_anim = target_data.anim
		local target_tint = target_data.tint
		local target_shake = target_data.shake
		local target_is_anim_loop = target_data.is_anim_loop
		local target_effect = target_data.effect
		local target_alpha = target_data.alpha
		local target_function = target_data.coroutine_function
		local target_listener = target_data.listener
		local target_is_not_active = target_data.is_not_active

		if target_is_not_active then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.disabled)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()

		character_util.set_position(target, target_pos)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

		scene_util.set_direction(target, target_dir, false)

		if target_emo then
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, target_emo)
		end

		if target_listener then
			character_util.add_listener(target, self.controller)
		end

		if target_anim then
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = target_anim, loop = target_is_anim_loop, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		if target_shake then
			scene_util.shake(target, 0.03, 9999, false)
		end

		if target_tint then
			character_util.add_color(target, 'dark_tint', target_tint.color, target_tint.magnitude, 0)
		end

		if target_alpha then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(target, target_alpha, 0)
		end

		if target_effect then
			local fx = target_effect():Instantiate(target.Position)
			self.fx_list[target.Name] = fx
		end

		if target_function then
			start_coroutine(function()
				target_function(target)
			end)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:fx_dispose_all()
	if self.fx_list then
		for _, target in pairs(self.fx_list) do
			if target then
				target:Dispose()
				target = nil
			end
		end

		self.fx_list = nil
	end
end

-- 미니게임 매니저
function grandma_manager:init(controller)
	self.controller = controller
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.grandma = nil
	self.cur_direction = nil
end

function grandma_manager:enter()
	self.grandma = self.controller.get_character.grandma()
	self.leader = get_party_leader()
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.grandma_state = {
		none = 1,
		wait = 2,
		move = 3,
	}

	self.grandma_current_state = self.grandma_state.none

	self.activity_pattern_data = {
		{ pos = self.controller.get_activity_move_pos(2), speed = 1 },
		{ pos = self.controller.get_activity_move_pos(3) },
		{ pos = self.controller.get_activity_move_pos(4) },
		{ pos = self.controller.get_activity_move_pos(5) },
		{ pos = self.controller.get_activity_move_pos(6), speed = 4, wait_duration = 1 },
		{ pos = self.controller.get_activity_move_pos(7), speed = 2 },
		{ pos = self.controller.get_activity_move_pos(8) },
		{ pos = self.controller.get_activity_move_pos(9) },
		{ pos = self.controller.get_activity_move_pos(10), speed = 4, wait_duration = 1, wait_dir = 'left' },
		{ pos = self.controller.get_activity_move_pos(11), speed = 3 },
		{ pos = self.controller.get_activity_move_pos(12) },
		{ pos = self.controller.get_activity_move_pos(13) },
		{ pos = self.controller.get_activity_move_pos(14) },
	}

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.pattern_count = nil
	self.cur_pattern_number = nil
	self.cur_speed = nil
	self.cur_pos = nil
	self.game_end = false
	self.max_dist = 0
	self.max_dist = 1.5

	--어택 레인지
	local start_pos = self.grandma.Position

	--self.attack_range = attack_range_util.create_circle(start_pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0),
	--		self.max_dist, color_info.dark_color, nil, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

	self.attack_range = attack_range_util.create_circle_by_color_key(
			'green', start_pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0), self.max_dist, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

	attack_range_util.show(self.attack_range)
end

function grandma_manager:start()
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.pattern_count = #self.activity_pattern_data
	self.cur_pattern_number = (self.pattern_count > 0) and 1 or 0

	self.cur_speed = self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].speed and
			self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].speed or self.cur_speed

	self.cur_pos = self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].pos

	self.game_end = false

	self.grandma.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	self.grandma_current_state = self.grandma_state.move

	scene_util.set_anim(self.grandma, self.controller, 'walk')
end

function grandma_manager:update(dt)
	if self:check_next_move_routine() then
		self.time_passed = 0

		self.cur_pattern_number = (self.pattern_count > self.cur_pattern_number)
				and self.cur_pattern_number + 1 or nil

		if not self.cur_pattern_number then
			self.game_end = true
			self.controller.is_clear = true

			return false
		else
			self.cur_speed = self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].speed and
					self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].speed or self.cur_speed

			self.cur_pos = self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].pos
		end

		if self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].wait_duration then
			self.grandma_current_state = self.grandma_state.wait
			local wait_duration = self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].wait_duration
			local wait_dir = self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].wait_dir

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.grandma)

			scene_util.shake(self.grandma, 0.03, wait_duration)

			if wait_dir then
				scene_util.set_direction(self.grandma, wait_dir, false)
			end
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	--거리 체크
	if self:distance_check() then
		self.controller.is_clear = false

		return false
	end

	if self.game_end then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.grandma)

		return false
	end

	if self.grandma_current_state == self.grandma_state.wait then
		-- 대기 시간 만큼 대기 후 무브로 변경
		if self.time_passed >= self.activity_pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_number].wait_duration then
			self.grandma_current_state = self.grandma_state.move

			scene_util.set_anim(self.grandma, self.controller, 'walk')
		end

		return true
	elseif self.grandma_current_state == self.grandma_state.move then
		self.cur_direction = (self.cur_pos - self.grandma.Position).normalized

		self.grandma.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.cur_direction)

		local velocity = self.cur_direction * self.cur_speed * dt

		local change_pos = self.grandma.Position + velocity

		self.grandma.Position = change_pos
		self.attack_range.transform.localPosition = change_pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0)
		--CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.grandma, self.cur_direction, self.cur_speed * dt)

		return true
	end
end

function grandma_manager:check_next_move_routine()
	if (self.grandma.Position - self.cur_pos).magnitude < 0.15 then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function grandma_manager:distance_check()
	local distance = (self.leader.Position - self.grandma.Position).magnitude

	if distance > self.max_dist then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

function grandma_manager:exit()
	if self.attack_range then
		attack_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range)
		self.attack_range = nil
	end

	if self.grandma then
		self.grandma.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end
end
--endregion GrandmaRacing

return local_class

	self.main_quest_id = 442

	self.time_conversion = nil
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestItemGetEvent), 'on_quest_item_get_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BrazierOnOffEvent), 'on_brazier_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent), 'on_time_conversion_changed_event')

	self.time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

	local _, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)
end

function local_class:start()
	self.stage_event_controller = get_stage_event_controller('DreamVillageShadowHouseController')
	self.stage_event_controller.bookcase_list.s4.target.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(function()
		self:set_npc_presets_for_state()

		local value = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.interact_item_data.custom_data.key)

		if value == 1 then
			self.current_state = self.states.interacting_item_event_clear

			self.quest_marker:add({
				{
					zone = 'main_field',
					target = self.pivot_pos.night_event_pos(1)
				},
			})

			self:remove_box()
		else
			self.quest_marker:add({
				{
					zone = 'main_field',
					target = self.pivot_pos.quest_marker_pos_1()
				},
			})
		end

		self:set_npc_with_data(self.npc_presets[self.current_state])

		if not self.time_conversion:is_daylight() then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(self.character.grandma, active_state_type.disabled)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(self.character.servant_1, active_state_type.disabled)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(self.character.servant_2, active_state_type.disabled)
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestItemGetEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BrazierOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent))

	self.time_conversion = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_state == self.states.before_interacting_item_event and self.time_conversion:is_daylight() and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's4_interacting_event_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.interacting_item_event_start

		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.interacting_item_event_start_scene, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.interacting_item_event_start and not self.is_in_zone.block_zone and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's4_block_zone') then
		self.is_in_zone.block_zone = true

		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.block_zone_event, self):Then(function()
			self.is_in_zone.block_zone = false
		end)

		return true
	elseif not self.is_in_zone.servant_event and self.time_conversion:is_daylight() and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's4_servant_event_zone') then
		self.is_in_zone.servant_event = true

		start_coroutine(self.servant_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_time_conversion_changed_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_state == self.states.before_interacting_item_event and self.time_conversion:is_daylight() and
			zone_util.contains_fo(field:GetZone('s4_interacting_event_zone'), leader) then
		self.current_state = self.states.interacting_item_event_start

		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.interacting_item_event_start_scene, self)

		return true
	elseif not self.is_in_zone.servant_event and self.time_conversion:is_daylight() and
			zone_util.contains_fo(field:GetZone('s4_servant_event_zone'), leader) then
		self.is_in_zone.servant_event = true

		start_coroutine(self.servant_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.interacting_item_event_start  then
		if not self.is_interacted.grandma and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.character.grandma) then
			self.is_interacted.grandma = true

			local is_entered = self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.interacting_item_choose_event, self)

			if not is_entered then
				self.is_interacted.grandma = false
			end

			return true
		else
			if not self.is_interacted.items then
				self.is_interacted.items = true

				for gimmick_name, _ in pairs(self.interact_item_data.items) do
					local gimmick_fo = get_field_object(gimmick_name)

					if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, gimmick_fo) then

						local is_entered = self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(self.interact_item, self, gimmick_name)

						if not is_entered then
							self.is_interacted.items = false
						end

						return true
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_item_get_event(e)
	for _, data in pairs(self.interact_item_data.items) do
		if e.ItemId == data.id and data.is_get then
			self.interact_item_data.item_get_complete = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_brazier_on_off_event(e)
	local brazier_1 = self.get_brazier(1)
	local brazier_2 = self.get_brazier(2)

	for i = 1, 2 do
		--  화로 꺼짐 체크
		if self.current_state == self.states.interacting_item_event_clear and
				not e.IsTurningOn and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.BrazierObject, self.get_brazier(i)) then

			if not brazier_1.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning and
					not brazier_2.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then

				self.current_state = self.states.book_event

				self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.night_event_scene, self)
			end

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_npc_with_data(data)
	for i = 1, #data do
		local npc_preset = data[i]

		local npc
		if npc_preset.type == 'static' then
			if npc_preset.name == 'leader' then
				npc = get_party_leader()
			else
				npc = get_character(npc_preset.name)
			end
		else
			npc = self.dynamic_npcs:get(npc_preset.name)
		end

		character_util.hide_weapon(npc, true)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

		if data[i].pos ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(npc, data[i].pos)
		end

		if data[i].dir ~= nil then
			character_util.set_direction(npc, data[i].dir)
		end

		if data[i].emo ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, data[i].emo)
		end

		if data[i].anim ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = data[i].anim, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		if data[i].tint ~= nil then
			character_util.add_color(npc, npc.Name, data[i].tint, 1, 0)
		end

		if data[i].active ~= nil then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, data[i].active)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_item_with_data()
	for gimmick_name, data in pairs(self.interact_item_data.items) do
		local gimmick_fo = get_field_object(gimmick_name)
		gimmick_fo.Position = data.pos

		local twinkle_fx = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(data.pos + data.fx_offset)
		self.interact_item_data.items[gimmick_name].fx = twinkle_fx
	end
end

function local_class:interact_item(gimmick_name)
	local data = self.interact_item_data.items[gimmick_name]
	local gimmick_fo = get_field_object(gimmick_name)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	--up, down 방향으로 인터랙트할 경우에는 right 방향으로 진행
	if gimmick_fo.Position.x > leader.Position.x then
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, direction_constants.right, false)
	else
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, direction_constants.left, false)
	end

	local eat_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
		parent = leader,
		loop = true,
		type_priority = 'loop',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})

	--인터랙트한 위치에서 컨트롤 빼앗고 (바라본 방향, idle, eat) 자세-1초
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'eat' })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	local item
	item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = data.pos,
		target = leader.Position,
		item_id = data.id,
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		show_on_character = false,
		spr_scale = data.scale,
		bounce_callback = function()
			quest_drop_item_util.consumed(item, leader)
		end
	})

	data.is_get = true

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_holdup_01')

	while not self.interact_item_data.item_get_complete do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.interact_item_data.item_get_complete = false

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_loop_sfx)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	gimmick_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	gimmick_fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	data.fx:Dispose()
	data.fx = nil

	self.is_interacted.items = false
end

function local_class:interacting_item_event_start_scene()
	local grandma = self.character.grandma
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	self.quest_marker:remove()

	local wp = grandma.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, 0)
	wp_util.move_async(leader, wp, nil, 2, { run = false })

	--기사 (right, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)

	--할멈 (left, idle, idle) : 이제 마지막 수업입니다. 아니, 시험이라고 말하는 게 좋겠군요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s4_1')

	--할멈 (left, idle, idle) : 혼례날 신부는 그 누구보다 아름다워야합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s4_2')

	--할멈 (left, idle, release) : 제가 저택 곳곳에 신부에게 필요한 물건들을 숨겨두었습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self, 'left',
			'release', nil, 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s4_3')

	--할멈 (left, idle, idle) : 혼례날 자신을 아름답게 만들어 줄 수 있는 물건 세 가지를 찾아 제게 가져오세요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s4_4')

	--할멈 (left, idle, idle) : 모두 신부를 치장하는데 필요한 물건들입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s4_5')

	--할멈 (left, idle, idle) : 부디 엉뚱한 물건을 가져오시진 마시길…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s4_6')

	--플레이어 컨트롤 해제
	character_util.add_listener(grandma, self.controller)

	self:set_item_with_data()
end

function local_class:block_zone_event()
	local grandma = self.character.grandma
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	--다음 동작 동시 출력
	--플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗음

	if self.time_conversion:is_daylight() then
		--카메라 shake (0.1,0.3)
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

		--할멈 (right, idle, idle) : 그쪽은 아직 준비중이라 들어가시면 안됩니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self, 'right',
				nil, nil, 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s4_block')

		--할멈 (right, idle, release 2회)
		scene_util.set_anim_async(grandma, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

		scene_util.set_direction(grandma, direction_constants.left, false)
	else
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s4_block_night' })
	end

	--기사 1타일 좌측으로 이동
	local return_pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter('s4_block_zone', leader, 'left', 0.5)
	wp_util.move_async(leader, return_pos, nil, 1, { run = false })

	--플레이어 컨트롤 해제.
end

function local_class:throw_item(item_id)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local grandma = self.character.grandma

	--아이템 던지기 공통 연출
	--기사가 아이템을 던지는 연출
	--기사 (right, idle, throw 1회)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')

	-- item (선택지에 따른 아이템)
	--아이템 생성 위치 : 현재 기사 위치
	--아이템 도착 위치 : 현재 기사 위치에서 1타일 오른쪽
	local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = leader.Position + vector(0.2, 0.5, 0),
		target = grandma.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
		item_id = item_id,
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		show_on_character = false,
		bounce_callback = function()
			self.interact_item_data.bounce_callback = true
			character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		end
	})

	return item
end

	local grandma = self.character.grandma
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	--물건을 찾으면 할멈에게 인터랙트.
	--인터랙트 하면 아래와 같이 정렬 - 1초

	wp_util.move_async(leader, wp, nil, 1, { run = false, last_direction = 'right' })

	--할멈 (left, idle, idle) : 물건은 모두 찾아오셨습니까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s4_7')

	local exit_choose = false

	local choose_callback = {
		{
			'dv_sub_shadow_item_choose_1',

				wait_for_sec(1)

					coroutine.yield()
				end

				music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_loop_sfx)

				character_util.remove_anim(grandma)

				self.interact_item_data.item_get_complete = false
			end
		},
		{
			'dv_sub_shadow_item_choose_2',
			'normal',
			function()

				--아이템 던지기 공통 연출 출력
				self.interact_item_data.bounce_callback = false
				local item = self:throw_item(self.interact_item_data.items.s4_interact_item_2.id)
				self.interact_item_data.items.s4_interact_item_2.choose_end = true

				while not self.interact_item_data.bounce_callback do

			function()

				self.interact_item_data.bounce_callback = false
				local item = self:throw_item(self.interact_item_data.items.s4_interact_item_3.id)
				self.interact_item_data.items.s4_interact_item_3.choose_end = true

				while not self.interact_item_data.bounce_callback do
					coroutine.yield()
				end

				self.interact_item_data.bounce_callback = false

				--할멈 (left, idle, nod 2회)
				scene_util.set_anim(grandma, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

				--1초 대기
				wait_for_sec(1)

				--할멈 (right, smile, idle) : 분첩은 신부를 화사하게 만들어줄뿐만 아니라 좋은 향기도 나게 한답니다.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self, 'left',

				--할멈 (left, idle, eat) - 0.5초 / 끝날때까지 대기

					sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
					parent = grandma,
					loop = true,
					type_priority = 'loop',
					player_priority = 'npc'
				})

				scene_util.set_anim(grandma, self, { name = 'eat' })

				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				--할멈에게 아이템 흡수되며 획득 연출
				quest_drop_item_util.consumed(item, grandma)

				while not self.interact_item_data.item_get_complete do
					coroutine.yield()
				end

				music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_loop_sfx)

				character_util.remove_anim(grandma)

				self.interact_item_data.item_get_complete = false
			end
		},
		{
			'dv_sub_shadow_item_choose_4',
			'normal',
			function()
				--(normal) 고기
				--아이템 던지기 공통 연출 출력
				self.interact_item_data.bounce_callback = false
				local item = self:throw_item(self.interact_item_data.items.s4_interact_item_4.id)
				self.interact_item_data.items.s4_interact_item_4.choose_end = true

				while not self.interact_item_data.bounce_callback do
					coroutine.yield()
				end

				self.interact_item_data.bounce_callback = false

				--기사 (right, smile, sing) rowdy 이모티콘 출력 / 끝날때까지 대기
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
				scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self,
						{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
						{ name = 'sing' },
						{ name = 'smile' },
						'rowdy')

				--할멈 (left, attack, idle) jump 1회 , annoyed 이모티콘 출력 /끝날때까지 대기
				character_util.normal_jump(grandma, '01_small_jump_01')

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
				scene_util.play_emoticon_action(grandma, self,
						{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
						nil,
						{ name = 'attack' },
						'annoyed')

				--할멈 (left, mad, release) : 다이어트 끝난 지 얼마나 됐다고 고기입니까!
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self, 'left',
						'release', { name = 'mad', keep = true }, 'dv_sub_shadow_item_event_4')

				--다음 동작 동시 실행
				--고기 아이템 135도 방향으로 날아가며 알파값 0%로 페이드 아웃 - 1초
				quest_drop_item_util.set_alpha_fade(item, 0, 1)

				local move_pos = item.Position + vector(-15, 0, 15)
				quest_drop_item_util.move(item, move_pos, { duration = 1 })

				--화면 shake (0.3,0.3)
				camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

				wait_all_lua(
						function()
							--할멈 (left, mad, gauntlet_kick) 자세로 0.5타일 좌측 이동 - 속도 2
							music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
							scene_util.set_anim_async(grandma, self, { name = 'gauntlet_kick', loop = false })
						end,
						function()
							local wp = grandma.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
							wp_util.move_async(grandma, wp, 2, nil, { run = false })
						end
				)

				--할멈 0.5타일 우측 이동 후 (left, idle, idle) 정렬 - 속도2
				local wp = grandma.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
				wp_util.move_async(grandma, wp, 2, nil, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(grandma)
				quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)
			end
		},
		{
			'dv_sub_shadow_item_choose_5',
			'normal',
			function()
				--(normal) 노리개
				--아이템 던지기 공통 연출 출력
				self.interact_item_data.bounce_callback = false
				local item = self:throw_item(self.interact_item_data.items.s4_interact_item_5.id)
				self.interact_item_data.items.s4_interact_item_5.choose_end = true

				while not self.interact_item_data.bounce_callback do
					coroutine.yield()
				end

				self.interact_item_data.bounce_callback = false

				--할멈 (left, idle, nod 2회)
				scene_util.set_anim(grandma, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

				--1초 대기
				wait_for_sec(1)

				--할멈 (left, idle, cast) : 이 노리개는 저택에 대대로 내려오는 귀한 물건이랍니다.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandma, self, 'left',
						'cast', nil, 'dv_sub_shadow_item_event_5')

				--할멈 (left, idle, eat) - 0.5초 / 끝날때까지 대기
				local eat_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
					sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
					parent = grandma,
					loop = true,
					type_priority = 'loop',
					player_priority = 'npc'
				})

				scene_util.set_anim(grandma, self, { name = 'eat' })

				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				--할멈에게 아이템 흡수되며 획득 연출
				quest_drop_item_util.consumed(item, grandma)

				while not self.interact_item_data.item_get_complete do
					coroutine.yield()
				end

				music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_loop_sfx)

				character_util.remove_anim(grandma)

				self.interact_item_data.item_get_complete = false
			end
		},
		{
			'dv_sub_shadow_item_choose_6',
			'normal',
			function()
				--(normal) 아직 더 찾아봐야 해요.
				--플레이어 컨트롤 해제.
				local item_count = 3
				for idx = 1, 5, 2 do
					local data = self.interact_item_data.items['s4_interact_item_' .. idx]
					if data.choose_end then
						item_count = item_count - 1
					end
				end

				if item_count > 0 then
					--선택지에서 머리장식, 분첩, 노리개 선택 횟수를 카운트하여 상황에 따라 아래 대사 출력
					--할멈 (left, idle, idle) : 물건 3개를 더 찾아와야 합니다.
					--할멈 (left, idle, idle) : 물건 2개를 더 찾아와야 합니다.
					--할멈 (left, idle, idle) : 물건 1개를 더 찾아와야 합니다.

					scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(grandma, 'dv_sub_shadow_item_count_' .. item_count, true)
				end

				--1초 대기
				wait_for_sec(1)

				exit_choose = true
			end
		},
	}

	local choose_list = {}

	for _, data in pairs(self.interact_item_data.items) do
		if data.is_get and not data.choose_end then
			table.insert(choose_list, choose_callback[data.choose_id])
		end
	end

	table.insert(choose_list, choose_callback[6])

	--기사 선택지 출력 (획득한 아이템 선택지만 출력)
	local is_playing = true
	local result
	local is_clear = false

	while is_playing and not exit_choose and not is_clear do
		result = choose_util.play_async(choose_list)

		table.remove(choose_list, result)

		for idx = 1, 5, 2 do
			local data = self.interact_item_data.items['s4_interact_item_' .. idx]
			if data.choose_end then
				is_clear = true
			else
				is_clear = false

				break
			end
		end

		if #choose_list == 0 then
			is_playing = false
		end
	end

	if exit_choose then
		self.is_interacted.grandma = false

		return
	end

	if is_clear then
		self:interacting_item_event_clear_scene()
	end
end

	--다음 동작 동시 실행
	--상자 오브젝트 위로 FX_dead 출력
	--상자 오브젝트 삭제 처리.
	--할멈 오른쪽으로 이동 후 그리드 밖으로 벗어나면 삭제.
	--포커스 플레이어로 복귀 - 1.5초
	local wp = self.pivot_pos.grandma_pos(2)

	end })

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1.5)
	grandma.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.current_state = self.states.interacting_item_event_clear

	self:set_npc_with_data(self.npc_presets[self.current_state])

function local_class:remove_box()
	for idx = 1, 4 do
		local box = get_field_object('s4_box_' .. idx)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(box, active_state_type.disabled)
	end
end

function local_class:servant_event()
	local servant_1 = self.character.servant_1
	local servant_2 = self.character.servant_2

	--해당 트리거존에 진입하면 하인 1,2 비강제 대화 이벤트 시작

	if not self.time_conversion:is_daylight() then
		self.is_in_zone.servant_event = false

		return
	end

	--하인 1 (right, tired, cross_arm) : 매번 새로오는 신부들만 불쌍하게 됐지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(servant_1, self, 'right',
			'cross_arm', 'tired', { key = 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s4_servant_event_1' })

	if not self.time_conversion:is_daylight() then
		self.is_in_zone.servant_event = false

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(servant_1)

		return
	end

	--하인 1 (right, tired, bomb_idle) : 이런 집에 시집을 보내는 가족들도 참 문제야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(servant_1, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', 'tired', { key = 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s4_servant_event_2' })

	if not self.time_conversion:is_daylight() then
		self.is_in_zone.servant_event = false

		return
	end

	--하인 2 (left, scared, cast) : 조용히 해. 마님이 들으시면 우릴 가만 안둘거야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(servant_2, self, 'left',
			'cast', 'scared', { key = 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s4_servant_event_3' })

	servant_1.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	servant_1.Interactable.Talk = 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s4_servant_oneline_1'

	servant_2.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	servant_2.Interactable.Talk = 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s4_servant_oneline_2'
end

function local_class:night_event_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local bride = self.character.bride
	local rich_male = self.character.rich_male
	local shadow_male = self.character.shadow_male

	local pivot_pos_1 = self.pivot_pos.night_event_pos(1)
	local pivot_pos_2 = self.pivot_pos.night_event_pos(2)

	self.quest_marker:remove()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	--카메라 포커스 신부에게로 이동 - 1.5초
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(bride, 0, 0)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(bride, active_state_type.enabled)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(rich_male, 0, 0)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(rich_male, active_state_type.enabled)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(bride, 1, 1.5)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(rich_male, 1, 1.5)

		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
		parent = bride,
		loop = true,
		type_priority = 'loop',
		player_priority = 'npc',
		fade_in_time = 1
	})

	camera_util.move_to_target_async(bride, 1.5)

	--다음 동작 동시 실행

	character_util.look_at(leader, bride)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	--화면 shake (0.1,0.3)

	scene_util.set_emotion(rich_male, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(rich_male, self, 'release')

	scene_util.set_emotion(bride, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(bride, self, 'cast')

	--1초 대기

local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageShadowHouseSection5')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DreamVillageShadowHouse @
		Comment = @
		Index = 4 @
		NextSections = 5 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type DreamVillageShadowHouseController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'substage_20_2'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		change_clothes = 2,
		start_puzzle = 3,
		clear_puzzle = 4
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.character = setmetatable({
		spec = {
			grandma = 'grandma',
			knight_bride = 'knight_bride',
			bride = 'bride',
			shadow = 'shadow_male',
		}
	}, {
		__index = function(this, key)
			return get_character(this.spec[key])
		end
	})

	self.marker = setmetatable({
		spec = {
			main_center = 's5_main_center_pos',
			puzzle_center = 's5_puzzle_center_pos',
			shadow = 's5_shadow_pos',
		}
	}, {
		__index = function(this, key)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos(this.spec[key])
		end
	})

	self.puzzle_switch = {
		name = 's5_puzzle_switch_',
		get = function(this, index)
			return get_field_object(this.name .. index)
		end,
		count = 6,
		clear_switch_index = { 1, 3, 5 },
		turn_on_list = create_lua_hashset(),
		reset = function(this)
			for i = 1, this.count do
				local switch = this:get(i)
				message_system:SendSync(switch.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
			end

			this.turn_on_list:clear()
		end,
		is_clear = function(this)
			for _, index in pairs(this.clear_switch_index) do
				if not this.turn_on_list:contains(this:get(index)) then
					return false
				end
			end

			return true
		end
	}

	self.puzzle_mirror = {
		name = 's5_puzzle_mirror_',
		count = 2,
		reset = function(this)
			for i = 1, this.count do
				local mirror = get_field_object(this.name .. i)
				message_system:SendSync(mirror.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
			end
		end
	}

	self.puzzle_door = {
		name = 's5_puzzle_door',
		get = function(this)
			return get_field_object(this.name)
		end,
		open_async = function(this)
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(this.name, false))
			wait_for_sec(2)
		end,
		focus_open = function(this)
			local door = this:get()
			camera_util.move_to_target_async(door, 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })

			this:open_async()
		end,
		close = function(this)
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(this.name, false))
		end
	}

	self.shadow_door = {
		name = 's5_shadow_door',
		get = function(this)
			return get_field_object(this.name)
		end,
		open_async = function(this)
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(this.name, false))
			wait_for_sec(2)
		end,
		focus_open = function(this)
			local door = this:get()
			camera_util.move_to_target_async(door, 1)

			this:open_async()

			camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
		end,
		close = function(this)
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(this.name))
		end
	}

	self.get_interactable = function()
		return get_field_object('s5_interactable')
	end

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		spec = {
			dead = 'FX_dead',
			twinkle = 'FX_Object_Twinkle',
		},
		create_all = function(this)
			for _, name in pairs(this.spec) do
				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(name)
			end
		end
	}, {
		__index = function(this, key)
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(this.spec[key])
		end
	})
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent), 'on_time_conversion_changed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	self.time_conversion_manager = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')
end

function local_class:start()
	local created, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)

	self.twinkle_effect = self.fx.twinkle:Instantiate(self.get_interactable().Position + vector(0, 2, -0.3))

	-- 할멈 세팅
	local grandma = self.character.grandma
	character_util.set_direction(grandma, 'right')
	grandma.Position = self.marker.main_center + vector(-1, 0, 0)

	if self.time_conversion_manager:is_daylight() then
		field_object_util.set_active_state(grandma, active_state_type.enabled)
	else
		field_object_util.set_active_state(grandma, active_state_type.disabled)
	end

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.character.grandma.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.75) },
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self:timer_finished()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
		self.time_conversion_manager:is_daylight() and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's5_change_clothes_zone') then

		self.current_state = self.states.change_clothes

		self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.change_clothes, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_time_conversion_changed_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none then
		if self.time_conversion_manager:is_daylight() then

		end

		if zone_util.contains_fo(field:GetZone('s5_change_clothes_zone'), get_party_leader()) then

			self.current_state = self.states.change_clothes

			self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.change_clothes, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false

	if self.current_state == self.states.none then
		return false
	end

	if e.IsTurningOn then
		self.puzzle_switch.turn_on_list:add(e.SwitchObject)

		self.puzzle_switch.turn_on_list:remove(e.SwitchObject)

	if self.current_state == self.states.change_clothes and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_interactable()) then

function local_class:start_puzzle()
	--힌트 오브젝트에 FX_Object_Twinkle 출력 , 한 번 인터랙트 하고 나면 사라짐
	if self.twinkle_effect then
		self.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
		self.twinkle_effect = nil
	end

	--동쪽의 태양, 서쪽의 달, 남쪽의 일식. 세 개의 빛이 뜰 때 문이 열리리라.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'dv_sub_shadow_house_s5_puzzle_1', mintotalduration = 1 })

	local narration_interactable = CS.Oak.NarrationInteractable()
	narration_interactable.StringKeys = {
		'dv_sub_shadow_house_s5_puzzle_1'
	}

	self.get_interactable().Interactable = narration_interactable

	local shadow = self.character.shadow

	--그림자 요괴 보여주는 연출 시작
	--그림자 요괴로 카메라 포커스 - 1초
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(shadow, 1)

	--그림자 요괴 (left, empty, prostrate) shake (0.05,1)
	character_util.stop_shake(shadow)
	character_util.shake(shadow, 0.05, 1)

	--그림자 요괴 (left, empty, idle) / 끝날 때까지 대기
	scene_util.set_anim(shadow, self, { name = 'idle', mix_duration = 0.5, scale = 0.1 })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--다음 동작 동시 실행
	--그림자 요괴 (left, mad, idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(shadow, self, 'mad')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_12')

	--화면 shake (0.1,0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--카메라 플레이어 복귀 - 1초
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--타이머 연출 시작
	start_coroutine(self.puzzle_routine, self)
end

function local_class:puzzle_routine()
	--타이머
	timer_util.start_timer({
		duration = 60,
		handler = self,
		callback = 'timer_finished'
	})

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	while #self.puzzle_switch.turn_on_list < 3 and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < 60 do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self:timer_finished()

	self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.check_puzzle, self)
end

--- 퍼즐 상태 확인
function local_class:check_puzzle()
	self.time_conversion_manager.is_reset_control = false

	if self.puzzle_switch:is_clear() then
		self:success_puzzle()
	else
		self:fail_puzzle()
	end

	self.time_conversion_manager.is_reset_control = true
end

--- 퍼즐 성공 연출
function local_class:success_puzzle()
	self.current_state = self.states.clear_puzzle

	local knight = get_party_leader()

	--정답 스위치 3개 활성화 되었다면 A 도어 오픈 연출
	--Is Focus, Is Full Opening
	self.puzzle_door:focus_open()

	--다음 동작 동시 실행 - 1.5초간
	--카메라 값 5.5로 줌 아웃
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5.5, 1.5)

	camera_util.move_async(self.marker.puzzle_center, 1.5)

	--밤 상태일 경우 해당 위치에서 낮으로 전환 연출 / 끝날때까지 대기
	if self.time_conversion_manager.current_time_zone == self.time_conversion_manager.time_zone.night then
		--기사 (left, attack, nod 2회)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

		--피리부는 연출 진행
		self.time_conversion_manager:changed_time_conversion(true)

		--1.5초 대기
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
	end

	--B 도어 오픈
	self.shadow_door:open_async()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)

	-- 기사 (right, attack, idle) jump 1회
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	character_util.normal_jump(knight)

	--카메라 4로 줌아웃 - 1초
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	local grandma = self.character.grandma

	--기사 11타일 왼쪽으로 이동 - 속도 7
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	local wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(knight, grandma.Position + vector(2.5, 0, 0))
	wp_util.move_async(knight, wp, 7, nil, { play_sfx = true, run = true })

	--이후에는 바로 마지막 이벤트 진행
	self:ending()
end

--- 퍼즐 실패 연출
function local_class:fail_puzzle()
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local shadow = self.character.shadow

	--실패 연출로 B 도어 오픈 연출 진행
	--Is Focus, Is Full Opening
	self.shadow_door:focus_open()

	--기사 x:71 , z:17.5 위치까지 scared 표정으로 이동 - 속도 7
	local target_pos = self.marker.puzzle_center + vector(-5, 0, 0)
	local wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(knight, target_pos)

	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'scared')
	wp_util.move_async(knight, wp, 7)

	--다음 동작 동시 실행
	--그림자 요괴 (기사 방향, mad, idle) 상태로 해당 위치에 생성 - 즉시
	shadow.Position = knight.Position + vector(2, 0, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

	--카메라 shake ( 0.3,0.3 )
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

	--기사 (right, scared, embarrassed) - 1초 / 표정 유지
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'embarrassed')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--그림자 요괴 (기사 방향, idle, idle)
	character_util.remove_emotion(shadow)

	--그림자 요괴 기사 방향으로 달려들며 attack 애니메이션 출력

local controller_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Base/QuestControllerBase')

---@class DreamVillageVampireidolController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageVampireidolController', controller_base)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	-- 사용할 섹션 스크립트 정보. 주석 해제하고 사용
	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = false,
		NormalSectionCount = 1,
		HasPostSection = false
	}
	self.time_conversion = nil
	self.time_conversion_event_key = 'vi_controller'

	self.npc = {
		-- 도화
		twins_younger = function()
			return get_character('twins_younger')
		end,

		--꼬마
		yokai = function()
			return get_character('vi_yokai')
		end,
	}

	self.day_states = {
		daylight = 1,
		night = 2,
	}
	self.current_day_state = self.day_states.daylight

	self.bgm_idol_zone = 'vi_sound_zone'
	self.is_in_bgm_idol_zone = false
	self.is_play_bgm_idol = false
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangingEvent), 'on_time_conversion_changing_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent), 'on_time_conversion_changed_event')
	message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_stage_start_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangingEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))

	self.super:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.bgm_idol_zone) then
		self.is_in_bgm_idol_zone = true
		if self.current_day_state == self.day_states.daylight then
			self:play_bgm_idol()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.bgm_idol_zone) then
		self.is_in_bgm_idol_zone = false
		if self.is_play_bgm_idol then
			self.is_play_bgm_idol = false
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
		end
	end
end


function local_class:on_time_conversion_changing_event(e)
	if self.is_play_bgm_idol and
			self.current_day_state == self.day_states.daylight then
		self.is_play_bgm_idol = false
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 1, volume = 0 })
	end

	return true
end
function local_class:on_time_conversion_changed_event(e)
	if self.is_in_bgm_idol_zone and
			self.current_day_state == self.day_states.daylight then
		self:play_bgm_idol()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event(e)
	self:time_conversion_setting()
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
	self.time_conversion:unregister_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key)
end

function local_class:time_conversion_setting()
	do
		-- 밤/낮 세팅
		self.time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

		-- 콜백 등록
		self.time_conversion:register_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key, {
			-- 낮
			daylight = function()
				self.current_day_state = self.day_states.daylight
				start_coroutine(self.set_npc_daylight, self, self.npc.yokai())
			end,
			-- 밤
			night = function()
				self.current_day_state = self.day_states.night
				start_coroutine(self.set_npc_night, self, self.npc.yokai())
			end
		}, true)
	end
end

function local_class:play_bgm_idol()
	self.is_play_bgm_idol = true
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_idol_lyric', state = 'event', volume = 1 })
end


function local_class:set_npc_daylight(npc)
	character_util.stop(npc)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)

	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1, 1)
end

function local_class:set_npc_night(npc)
	character_util.stop(npc)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.disabled)
end

return local_class

			end
		}
	})
