function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_hold_up_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent), 'on_throw_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrownEndEvent), 'on_throw_end_event')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent), 'on_time_conversion_changed_event')

	self:first_yokai_setting()
	self:block_cliff()
	self:time_conversion_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
	self.cached_leader = user_party.Leader
	self.is_in_time_change = false

	local created, dv_sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()
	self.sp_controller = dv_sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_section)
end

function local_class:time_conversion_setting()
	do
		-- 밤/낮 세팅
		self.time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

		-- 콜백 등록
		self.time_conversion:register_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key, {
			-- 낮
			daylight = function()
				self.current_day_state = self.day_states.daylight
				self.is_in_time_change = true

				start_coroutine(self.daylight_yokai_check, self)
				start_coroutine(self.set_yokai_daylight, self)
			end,
			-- 밤
			night = function()
				self.current_day_state = self.day_states.night
				self.is_in_time_change = true

				self:disable_stair_block()
			end
		}, true)
	end
end

function local_class:daylight_yokai_check()
	if self.is_daylight_yokai_check then
		return
	end

	self.is_daylight_yokai_check = true

	while self.is_in_time_change do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.before_start and
			self.is_in_start_zone then
		start_coroutine(self.enter_first_zone, self)
	end

	--계단 봉쇄!
	if self.current_state == self.states.in_activity and
			self.is_in_start_zone then
		self:enable_stair_block()
	end

	if self.yokai_state.is_in_goal then
		self.sp_controller:start_coroutine_delayed(self.clear_scene, self)
	end

	self.is_daylight_yokai_check = false
end

function local_class:first_yokai_setting()
	local yokai = self.npc.yokai()

	if self.star_piece_fx == nil then
		self.star_piece_fx = self.fx.star_piece():Instantiate(
				yokai.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, yokai.Transform)
	end

	field_object_util.set_active_state(yokai, active_state_type.enabled)
	yokai.Position = self.marker.start_pos()
	yokai.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	yokai.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance

	--요괴(left, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(yokai, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(yokai, self, 'idle')
	character_util.set_direction(yokai, 'down')

	self:init_yokai_state()
	self.current_state = self.states.before_start
end

function local_class:init_yokai_state()
	self.yokai_state = {
		is_held_before = false,
		is_land = true,
		is_grid = true,
		is_throw_end = true,
		is_in_goal = false,
	}
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrownEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent))

	self.virtual_wall_list:dispose_all()
	if self.stair_virtual_wall ~= nil then
		self.stair_virtual_wall:Dispose()
		self.stair_virtual_wall = nil
	end

	if self.star_piece_fx ~= nil then
		self.star_piece_fx:Dispose()
		self.star_piece_fx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sp_controller then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

-- 요괴가 들렸을 때 체크
function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	local yokai = self.npc.yokai()
	if self.current_state == self.states.in_activity and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, yokai) then
		start_coroutine(self.on_holdup_yokai, self, yokai)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 요괴가 던져졌을 때 체크
function local_class:on_throw_event(e)
	local yokai = self.npc.yokai()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, yokai) then
		start_coroutine(self.on_throw_yokai, self, e.Direction)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

--요괴가 바닥에 닿았을 때 체크
function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, self.npc.yokai()) then
		self.yokai_state.is_land = true
	end
	return false
end

--요괴 던져지고 완전히 멈췄을 때 체크
function local_class:on_throw_end_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.yokai()) then
		self.yokai_state.is_throw_end = true

		--벽에 겹쳐서 리셋 될 때 예외 처리
		if not self.yokai_state.is_land then
			self:prostrate_yokai()
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.npc.yokai(), self.zone_name.sound) then
		self.yokai_state.is_grid = true
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.cached_leader, self.zone_name.start) then
		self.is_in_start_zone = true

		if self.current_state == self.states.before_start and
				self.current_day_state == self.day_states.daylight then
			start_coroutine(self.enter_first_zone, self)
		end

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.in_activity and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.npc.yokai(), self.zone_name.goal) then

		self.yokai_state.is_in_goal = true

		if self.current_day_state == self.day_states.daylight then
			self.sp_controller:start_coroutine_delayed(self.clear_scene, self)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, self.npc.yokai(), self.zone_name.sound) then
		self.yokai_state.is_grid = false
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, self.cached_leader, self.zone_name.start) then
		self.is_in_start_zone = false
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.in_activity and
			type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, self.npc.yokai(), self.zone_name.goal) then
		self.yokai_state.is_in_goal = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_time_conversion_changed_event(e)
	self.is_in_time_change = false

	return true
end

function local_class:enter_first_zone()
	local yokai = self.npc.yokai()

	--밤낮 상관없이 빨간 네모 1번 구간 진입 시 퀘스트 진행
	self.current_state = self.states.in_conversation

	--요괴 대사 출력
	--요괴(down, tired, idle): 뒤통수 밖에 안보이잖아?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(yokai, self, 'down',
			nil, 'tired', { key = 'dv_vampireidol_s1_1', skip = false })

	if self.current_day_state == self.day_states.night or
			self.is_in_time_change then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_start
		return
	end

	--요괴(down, tired, idle): 앞에서 공연하는 걸 보고 싶은데….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(yokai, self, 'down',
			nil, 'tired', { key = 'dv_vampireidol_s1_2', skip = false })

	if self.current_day_state == self.day_states.night or
			self.is_in_time_change then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_start
		return
	end

	--대사 출력 이후 요괴는 holdable 처리
	yokai.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	yokai.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance

	--이후 빨간 네모 1번 구간은 비활성화

	self.current_state = self.states.in_activity
end

function local_class:on_holdup_yokai(yokai)
	--holdable 연출
	self.yokai_state.is_land = false
	self.yokai_state.is_throw_end = false
	self.yokai_state.is_held_before = true

	--요괴 (down, damaged, embarrassed) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(yokai, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(yokai, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(yokai, self, 'embarrassed')

	--던지기 가능
end

function local_class:on_throw_yokai(direction_vector)
	local yokai = self.npc.yokai()

	-- 해당 루틴이 겹치는 것을 방지하기 위해 Hold 불가하도록 설정
	yokai.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance

	-- Y축 0의 상태에 도달할 때까지 대기...해야하지만
	-- 현재 언덕이 있기 때문에 이 방법을 쓸 수 없다!
	-- 따라서, 데미지 이벤트 받아서 체크하는 것으로 변경
	while not self.yokai_state.is_land do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.yokai_state.is_land = true

	local direction_string = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(
			direction_vector.x > 0, 'right', 'left')

	--던져서 Y축 0의 상태에 도달하면 (던져진 방향, damaged, prostrate) 출력
	self:prostrate_yokai(direction_string)
end

function local_class:prostrate_yokai(direction_string)
	local yokai = self.npc.yokai()
	direction_string = lua_helper.get_or_default(direction_string, 'left')

	character_util.set_direction(yokai, direction_string)
	scene_util.set_emotion(yokai, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(yokai, self, 'prostrate')

	yokai.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()

	--요괴 (던져진 방향, damaged, prostrate): 으악!
	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(yokai, self,
				nil, nil, nil,
				{ key = 'dv_vampireidol_s1_3', skip = false })
	end)
end

function local_class:clear_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local twins_younger = self.npc.twins_younger()
	local yokai = self.npc.yokai()
	local goal_pivot = self.marker.end_pos()

	self.current_state = self.states.clear_activity

	sp_util.enter_scene({ release_hold = false })

	--세실(사운드 발생지) 사운드 볼륨 0.6으로 재생	bgm_idol
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.6)

	local current_state = leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState

	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		if user_party:Contains(twins_younger) then
			wp_util.move(twins_younger, goal_pivot + vector(0, 0, -1), 4, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })
		end
		wp_util.move_async(leader, goal_pivot + vector(-1, 0, -1), 4, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		local hold_target = current_state.HoldTarget

		if hold_target ~= nil then
			command_util.publish_throw(leader, hold_target, direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction),
					leader.Position, 4, false)

		end
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	local wait_time = 2
	while (not self.yokai_state.is_throw_end) or
			time_passed < wait_time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--꼬마 1번 위치에 도착하면 강제 이벤트 진행
	--카메라 꼬마 위치로 1초에 걸쳐 포커스 이동
	camera_util.move_async(yokai.Position, 1, { end_target = yokai })
	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--꼬마 (던져진 방향, damaged, prostrate) 상태에서 shake (0.03/1초간 출력)
	local throw_direction = yokai.Direction

	local get_direction_string = function(direction)
		if direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
			return 'left'
		elseif direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
			return 'right'
		elseif direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
			return 'up'
		elseif direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
			return 'down'
		else
			return 'error'
		end
	end

	local throw_direction_string = get_direction_string(throw_direction)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_direction(yokai, throw_direction_string)
	scene_util.set_emotion(yokai, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(yokai, self, 'prostrate')
	character_util.shake(yokai, 0.03, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--요괴 (던져진 방향, idle, jump)와 동시에 normal_jump 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(yokai, self, 'idle')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(yokai, throw_direction_string)

	--y축 0에 도달하면 (던져진 방향, idle, idle) 출력
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(yokai)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local vi = get_character('pooled_dv_vampireidol_1')
	local direction_string = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(
			yokai.Position.x < vi.Position.x, 'right', 'left')

	--꼬마 (세실 방향으로 right/left 전환, smile, idle) 상태로 (notice)출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.set_direction(yokai, direction_string)
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(yokai, self, nil,
			'idle', 'smile', 'notice')

	--꼬마 (세실 방향으로 right/left 전환, smile, idle): 우와! 엄청 앞이잖아!

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(yokai, self, direction_string,
			nil, 'smile', 'dv_vampireidol_s1_4')

	--꼬마 위의 위치에 3의 속도로 walk 이동 후
	wp_util.move_async(yokai, goal_pivot, 3, nil,
			{ last_direction = 'down', run = true })

	--(left, smile, idle) 출력
	character_util.set_direction(yokai, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(yokai, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(yokai, self, 'idle')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if self.star_piece_fx ~= nil then
		self.star_piece_fx:Dispose()
		self.star_piece_fx = nil
	end

	--초록색 별 위치에 스타피스 투척
	scene_util.set_anim(yokai, self, { name = 'get', loop = false })
	star_piece_util.appear(self.get_star_piece(), yokai.Position, self.get_star_piece().Position)

	wait_for_sec(3)

	--꼬마 (left, smile, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim(yokai)
	scene_util.set_direction(yokai, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(yokai, self, 'smile')

	--1초에 걸쳐 플레이어 카메라 포커스 이동
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--꼬마 원라인 대사 : 와… 사랑에 빠지는 기분이 이런 걸까?
	character_util.remove_relate_event(yokai, self)

	yokai.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	yokai.Interactable.Talk = 'dv_vampireidol_s1_5'
	yokai.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
	yokai.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)

	--컨트롤 해제 / 클리어
	self.controller:complete_hidden_quest_default()
	self.time_conversion:unregister_callback(self.time_conversion_event_key)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, self.cached_leader)
end

function local_class:block_cliff()
	--언덕에서 다른곳에 yokai 못 던지도록 막음.
	local pivot_pos = self.marker.start_pos()
	self.virtual_wall_list:create_wall(pivot_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -1), CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(8, 1, 1)))
	self.virtual_wall_list:create_wall(pivot_pos + vector(1, 0, 3), CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(13, 1, 1)))
	self.virtual_wall_list:create_wall(pivot_pos + vector(-6, 0, 1), CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1, 1, 4)))
	self.virtual_wall_list:create_wall(pivot_pos + vector(8, 0, 1), CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1, 1, 4)))
end

function local_class:set_yokai_daylight()
	local npc = self.npc.yokai()

	if self.current_state == self.states.in_activity then
		if npc.Position.y > 0 then
			if npc.Direction == character_util.get_direction('up') or
					npc.Direction == character_util.get_direction('down') then
				scene_util.set_direction(npc, 'left', false)
			end
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'damaged')
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'prostrate')

			--땅에 붙이기 위해서 강제로 y_mode를 floor로 잠깐 이동함.
			wp_util.move(npc, npc.Position, nil, 0.01,
					{ y_mode = 'floor', run = false })
		end

		local reset_limit_pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('vi_daylight_pos_8')
		local reset_limit = {
			x_min = reset_limit_pivot_pos.x -0.5,
			x_max = reset_limit_pivot_pos.x +1.5,
			z_min = reset_limit_pivot_pos.z -0.5,
			z_max = reset_limit_pivot_pos.z +0.5,
		}
		if reset_limit.x_min < npc.Position.x and npc.Position.x < reset_limit.x_max and
				reset_limit.z_min < npc.Position.z and npc.Position.z < reset_limit.z_max then
			local reset_pos = reset_limit_pivot_pos + vector(0.5,0,1)
			npc.Position = reset_pos
		end

		npc.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	end
end

function local_class:enable_stair_block()
	if self.stair_virtual_wall == nil then
		local stair_virtual_wall_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('vi_daylight_pos_8') + vector(0.5, 0, -1)
		self.stair_virtual_wall = field_object_util.create_virtual_field_object(stair_virtual_wall_pos, { vector(2, 1, 1) })
	else
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.stair_virtual_wall, active_state_type.enabled)
	end
end

function local_class:disable_stair_block()
	if self.stair_virtual_wall ~= nil then
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.stair_virtual_wall, active_state_type.disabled)
	end
end

return local_class

---@class DreamVillageYokaiAttackingStatueStateBase
local state_base = newclass('DreamVillageYokaiAttackingStatueStateBase')

---@class DreamVillageYokaiAttackingStatueState : DreamVillageYokaiAttackingStatueStateBase
---@field super DreamVillageYokaiAttackingStatueStateBase

---@return DreamVillageYokaiAttackingStatueState
local function declare_class(name)
	return newclass('DreamVillageYokaiAttackingStatueState' .. name, state_base)
end

local states = {
	awaking = declare_class('Awaking'),
	floating = declare_class('Floating'),
	following = declare_class('Following'),
	chasing = declare_class('Chasing'),
	waiting_attack = declare_class('WaitingAttack'),
	falling = declare_class('Falling'),
	waiting_awake = declare_class('WaitingAwake'),
	stopped = declare_class('Stopped'),
}

---@class IDreamVillageYokaiAttackingStatueController
---@field change_state fun(self:self, fo:IFieldObject, next_state_name:string)
---@field fx table
---@field execute_damage fun(self:self, fo:IFieldObject, position:Vector3, ratio:number)
---@field attack_range table

function state_base:init(controller, args)
	-- 인터페이스를 별도로 구성했으니 상호참조가 아님
	---@type IDreamVillageYokaiAttackingStatueController
	self.controller = controller
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.duration = args.duration
	self.next_state_name = args.next_state_name
	self.fo = nil
end

function state_base:enter(fo)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.fo = fo
end

function state_base:exit(forced)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.fo = nil
end

function state_base:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
end

function state_base:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
end

function state_base:proceed_state()
	self.controller:change_state(self.fo, self.next_state_name)
end

do
	local state = states.awaking

	function state:init(controller, args)
		self.super:init(controller, args)
	end

	function state:enter(fo)
		self.super:enter(fo)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_earthquake_02',
			play_pos = self.fo.Position,
			type_priority = sfx_type_priority.gimmick,
			player_priority = sfx_player_priority.object,
		})

		--요괴 석상 1초간 스파인 shake.(async)
		character_util.shake(self.fo, 0.03, self.duration)
	end

	function state:exit(forced)
		if forced then
			character_util.stop_shake(self.fo)
		end

		self.super:exit(forced)
	end

	function state:update(dt)
		self.super:update(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
			self:proceed_state()
		end
	end
end

do
	local state = states.floating

	function state:init(controller, args)
		self.super:init(controller, args)

		--0.5초간 요괴 석상 y 높이만 2까지 올라간다
		self.target_height = 2

		self.start_pos = nil
	end

	function state:enter(fo)
		self.super:enter(fo)

		self.start_pos = self.fo.Position

		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.fo, active_state_type.visible)
	end

	function state:exit(forced)
		self.start_pos = nil

		self.super:exit(forced)
	end

	function state:update(dt)
		self.super:update(dt)

		if self.time_passed < self.duration then
			--올라갈 때, 처음에는 빠르게 움직이다 갈수록 속도 줄어들면서 이동하도록 처리.
			local height = interpolations_constants.ease_out_quad(self.time_passed, 0, self.target_height, self.duration)

			--그림자는 제자리 유지.
			character_util.set_position(self.fo, self.start_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * height, true)
		else
			character_util.set_position(self.fo, self.start_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * self.target_height, true)

			self:proceed_state()
		end
	end
end

do
	local state = states.following

	function state:init(controller, args)
		self.super:init(controller, args)

		--최대 6의 속도로 추적, 플레이어 이동하는 것도 따라가며 추적
		self.max_speed = args.max_speed

		self.follow_target = nil

		self.can_stop_validator = args.can_stop_validator

		self.position_adder = nil
	end

	function state:dispose()
		self.can_stop_validator = nil

		self.super:dispose()
	end

	function state:enter(fo)
		self.super:enter(fo)

		self.follow_target = user_party.Leader
		self.position_adder = unity_class.vector3.up * self.fo.Position.y

		--도착한 위치에 원형 붉은색 attackrange 생성, 반지름 2.5
		--차오르는 attackrange로 사용.(최초에는 아예 안 채워진채로 배치, 2.5초간 서서히 차오른다.)
		self.controller.attack_range:show(self.fo, self.fo.Position, self.duration)
	end

	function state:exit(forced)
		if forced then
			self.controller.attack_range:hide(self.fo)
		end

		self.follow_target = nil
		self.position_adder = nil

		self.super:exit(forced)
	end

	function state:update(dt)
		self.super:update(dt)

		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.follow_target.Position - self.fo.Position)
		local move_dist = dt * self.max_speed

		if not float_util.is_almost_zero(diff.x) then
			if diff.x < 0 then
				character_util.set_direction(self.fo, direction_constants.left)
			else
				character_util.set_direction(self.fo, direction_constants.right)
			end
		end

		if diff.sqrMagnitude < move_dist * move_dist then
			character_util.set_position(self.fo,
					self.follow_target.Position + self.position_adder, true)
		else
			-- 해당 방향으로 이동
			local target_xz = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo.Position) + diff.normalized * move_dist

			character_util.set_position(self.fo, target_xz + self.position_adder, true)
		end

		self.controller.attack_range:set_position(self.fo, self.fo.Position)

		-- 계속 이동을 원한다면 상태 전환을 실행하지 않을 것
		if self.can_stop_validator ~= nil and not self.can_stop_validator(self.fo) then
			return
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
			self:proceed_state()
		end
	end
end

do
	local state = states.waiting_attack

	function state:init(controller, args)
		self.super:init(controller, args)

	function state:exit(forced)
		if forced then
			self.controller.attack_range:hide(self.fo)

end

do

	function state:init(controller, args)
		self.super:init(controller, args)

		self.start_height = 0

		self.damage_ratio = args.damage_ratio
	end

	function state:enter(fo)
		self.super:enter(fo)

		self.start_height = self.fo.Position.y
	end

	function state:exit(forced)
		--원형 붉은색 attackrange 제거.
		self.controller.attack_range:hide(self.fo)

		self.start_height = 0

		self.super:exit(forced)
	end

	function state:update(dt)
		self.super:update(dt)

		if self.time_passed < self.duration then
			local progress = self.time_passed / self.duration
			local cur_height = self.start_height * (1 - progress)
			local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo.Position, cur_height)

			character_util.set_position(self.fo, cur_pos, true)

local controller_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Base/QuestControllerBase')

---@class DreamVillageYokaiController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageYokaiController', controller_base)

local nowhere = vector(999, 0, 999)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	-- 사용할 섹션 스크립트 정보. 주석 해제하고 사용
	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = false,
		NormalSectionCount = 4,
		HasPostSection = true
	}

	self.stage_cleared_value = 1

	self.states = {
		before_loaded = 1,
		before_activate = 2,

		before_open = 5,
		in_opening = 6,
		before_destroy_statue = 7,
		statue_destroyed = 8,
		done = 99,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_loaded

	---@type DreamVillageYokaiStatueEventManager
	self.statue_event_manager = nil

	self.time_conversion = metatable_helper.inherit({
		key = 'yokai_',

		is_changing = false,
	}, {
		is_using = function(this)
			-- 스테이지 1에서는 존재하지 않는 기능임
			return stage.Name ~= 'dreamvillage_1'
		end,

		try_get = function(this)
			if this:is_using() then
				return true, get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')
			end

			return false, nil
		end,

		is_daylight = function(this)
			local is_using, manager = this:try_get()

			if is_using then
				return manager:is_daylight()
			end

			return true
		end,

		is_scene_playable = function(this)
			return this:is_daylight() and not this.is_changing
		end,

		deactivate_blocking_ghost = function(this)
			local is_using, manager = this:try_get()

			if not is_using then
				return
			end

			manager.element_controller:add_ban_list('ghost_event_yokai_blocking')
		end
	})

	self.zone_enter_manager = metatable_helper.inherit({
		callbacks = {
			[true] = {},
			[false] = {},
		},

		zone_name = 'yokai_open'
	}, {
		dispose = function(this)
			local callbacks = this.callbacks[true]

			for key, _ in pairs(callbacks) do
				callbacks[key] = nil
			end

			callbacks = this.callbacks[false]

			for key, _ in pairs(callbacks) do
				callbacks[key] = nil
			end
		end,

		register = function(this, key, has_high_priority, callback)
			this.callbacks[has_high_priority][key] = callback
		end,

		unregister = function(this, key)
			this.callbacks[true][key] = nil
			this.callbacks[false][key] = nil
		end,

		is_zone_entered = function(this, e)
			return type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, this.zone_name)
		end,

		is_zone_contained = function(this)
			return zone_util.contains_fo(this.zone_name, user_party.Leader)
		end,

		on_zone_enter = function(this)
			for _, callback in pairs(this.callbacks[true]) do
				local consumed = callback()

				if consumed then
					return true
				end
			end

			for _, callback in pairs(this.callbacks[false]) do
				local consumed = callback()

				if consumed then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end,

		get_zone = function(this)
			return field_util.get_zone(this.zone_name)
		end
	})

	self.callback_keys = {
		time_conversion = {
			change_tracker = 'change_tracker',
			fos = 'fos',
		},

		scene = {
			opening = 'opening_scene',
		}
	}

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		--FX_explosion_boss
		explosion_boss = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_explosion_boss')
		end,

		--fx_librarian2_basic_1st_proj_01
		statue_leftover_loop = nil,

		--fx_librarian2_basic_hit_01
		statue_leftover_end = nil,

		--FX_shockwave
		shockwave = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_shockwave')
		end
	})

	self.star_piece = metatable_helper.inherit({
		name = 'yokai_star_piece'
	}, {
		get = function(this)
			return get_field_object(this.name)
		end,

		cleared_enable = function(this)
			if star_piece_util.has_star_piece(this.name) then
				return
			end

			local fo = this:get()

			fo.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsHidden = false
			field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.enabled)
		end,

		appear_async = function(this, from)
			local fo = this:get()

			star_piece_util.appear(fo, from)

			wait_for_sec(1.5)
		end
	})

	self.fo_conversion = metatable_helper.inherit({
		current_routine_id = 0,

		npc_mix_duration = 1,
		fo_mix_duration = 1.5,

		npcs = create_lua_hashset(),

		npc_grid = nil,
	}, {
		init = function(this, grid_position)
			this.npc_grid = field_util.get_camera_grid_contains_point(grid_position)
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			this.npc_grid = nil

			this.npcs:clear()
		end,

		register_npc = function(this, npc)
			this.npcs:add(npc)
		end,

		unregister_npc = function(this, npc)
			this.npcs:remove(npc)
		end,

		create_routine_request_id = function(this)
			this.current_routine_id = this.current_routine_id + 1

			return this.current_routine_id
		end,

		is_routine_valid = function(this, req_id)
			return req_id == this.current_routine_id
		end,

		stop_routine = function(this)
			this:create_routine_request_id()
		end,

		is_npc_grid_contains = function(this, point)
			return this.npc_grid:Contains(point)
		end,

		on_daylight = function(this)
			local req_id = this:create_routine_request_id()
			local immediately = not this:is_npc_grid_contains(user_party.Leader.Position)

			if #this.npcs > 0 then
				for npc in pairs(this.npcs) do
					field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)

					if immediately then
						character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1, 0)
						character_util.force_update_spines(npc, 0.1)
					else
						character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1, this.npc_mix_duration)
					end
				end
			end
		end,

		on_night = function(this)
			local req_id = this:create_routine_request_id()
			local immediately = not this:is_npc_grid_contains(user_party.Leader.Position)

			if #this.npcs > 0 then
				if immediately then
					for npc in pairs(this.npcs) do
						speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(npc)
						character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 0)
						character_util.force_update_spines(npc, 0.1)
						field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.disabled)
					end
				else
					start_coroutine(this.fade_out_npc_routine, this, req_id, this.npcs)
				end
			end
		end,

		fade_out_npc_routine = function(this, req_id, npcs)
			local start_time = unity_class.time.time

			for npc in pairs(npcs) do
				speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(npc)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, this.npc_mix_duration)
			end

			while unity_class.time.time - start_time < this.npc_mix_duration and this:is_routine_valid(req_id) do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			if this:is_routine_valid(req_id) then
				for npc in pairs(npcs) do
					character_util.force_update_spines(npc, 0.1)
					field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.disabled)
				end
			end
		end,
	})

	---@type DreamVillageScreenplayController
	self.sp_controller = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	local leftover_number = 1

	local quest_progress = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.cs_controller.QuestId)

	if quest_progress == nil then
		leftover_number = 1
	elseif quest_progress.IsComplete then
		return
	else
		leftover_number = quest_progress.InnerProgress + 1
	end

	self.fx.statue_leftover_loop = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_yokai_statue_leftover_loop_' .. leftover_number)
	end

	self.fx.statue_leftover_end = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_yokai_statue_leftover_end_' .. leftover_number)
	end

	self.fx:load_async()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangingEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent))

	self.zone_enter_manager:dispose()
	self.fo_conversion:dispose()

	if self.sp_controller ~= nil then
		self.sp_controller:dispose()
		self.sp_controller = nil
	end

	self.super:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
	self.current_state = self.states.done

	self.fo_conversion:stop_routine()

	self.zone_enter_manager:unregister(self.callback_keys.scene.opening)

	if self.statue_event_manager ~= nil then
		self.statue_event_manager:dispose()

		self.statue_event_manager = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.zone_enter_manager:is_zone_entered(e) then
		return self.zone_enter_manager:on_zone_enter()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_time_conversion_changing_event(e)
	self.time_conversion.is_changing = true

	if e.IsDaylight then
		self.fo_conversion:on_daylight()
	else
		self.fo_conversion:on_night()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_time_conversion_changed_event(e)
	self.time_conversion.is_changing = false

	if self.zone_enter_manager:is_zone_contained() then
		return self.zone_enter_manager:on_zone_enter()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_enter()
	if self:is_cleared_on_here() then
		self.current_state = self.states.done

		self.star_piece:cleared_enable()

		self.time_conversion:deactivate_blocking_ghost()

		return
	end

	local _, sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()

	self.sp_controller = sp_manager:get_sp_controller(self.cs_controller)

	do
		local npc_zone = self.zone_enter_manager:get_zone()
		local position = vector(npc_zone.Bounds.min.x, 0, npc_zone.Bounds.center.z)

		self.fo_conversion:init(position)
	end

	if self:can_activate_quest() then
		local load_statue_event = function()
			local creator = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Main/DreamVillage/Yokai/StatueEventManager')

			self.statue_event_manager = creator()
			self.statue_event_manager:on_pre_load()
		end

		local enter_statue_event_async = function()
			yield_return_func(unity_object_pool.WaitAll)

			-- StatueEventManager는 석상 캐릭터를 requester로 사용하고 있음
			-- 1. 연출 중에 이 콜백이 호출되는 Stage2, 4에서, 종료 연출은 StatueEventManager의 요청이 끝난 이후 실행을 시작할 것
			-- 2. 컨트롤이 풀린 상태에서 이 콜백이 호출되는 Stage1, 3에서,
			self.statue_event_manager:enter(function()
				if self.current_state ~= self.states.before_destroy_statue then
					return
				end

				self.current_state = self.states.statue_destroyed

				local section = self.cs_controller.CurrentLuaSection

				self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(function()
					local resources = {
						character = {
							statue = self.statue_event_manager:get_statue()
						},
						effect = {},
						position = {
							center = self.statue_event_manager:get_statue_origin_pos()
						},
					}

					self:statue_destroyed_scene(resources)

					self.statue_event_manager:exit()

					section:after_statue_destroyed_scene(resources)

					quest_util.set_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, stage.Name, self.stage_cleared_value)

					-- 해당 섹션 종료
					if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress + 1 < self.script_config.NormalSectionCount then
						self:progress_section()
					else
						self:complete_hidden_quest_default()
					end
				end)
			end)

		end

		self.zone_enter_manager:register(self.callback_keys.scene.opening, false, function()
			-- 기믹 작동이 먼저인 경우
			-- 1. 낮 -> 밤 전환 시, 기믹 작동 문맥에서 ChangingEvent 수신으로 is_scene_playable이 false
			-- 밤에는 연출이 실행되지 않아야 하기 때문에, 제대로 처리됨
			-- 2. 밤 -> 낮 전환 시, zone_enter_manager에서 등록해둔 콜백보다 ZoneEnter를 수신한 결과가 더 먼저 불림
			-- 현재 대기 중일 것이고, 스테이트 전환으로 중복 호출은 불가능
			if self.current_state == self.states.before_open and self.time_conversion:is_scene_playable() then
				self.current_state = self.states.in_opening

				local section = self.cs_controller.CurrentLuaSection

				self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(function()
					load_statue_event()

					section:opening_scene()

					--이 이벤트 본 이후에는 밤에도 길막는 오브젝트가 존재하지 않도록 처리.
					self.time_conversion:deactivate_blocking_ghost()

					enter_statue_event_async()

					--이후, 오른쪽 방으로 진입해서 요괴 석상 퇴치가 가능.
					self.current_state = self.states.before_destroy_statue
				end)

				return true
			end

			return false
		end)

		self.current_state = self.states.before_open
	else
		--세팅 등은 섹션에서 처리할 것임
		self.current_state = self.states.before_activate
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	if self.time_conversion:is_using() then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangingEvent), 'on_time_conversion_changing_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent), 'on_time_conversion_changed_event')
	end
end

function local_class:can_activate_quest()
	local akayuki_quest_id = 68
	local quest_progress = quest_util.get_started_quest(akayuki_quest_id)

	return quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.IsComplete
end

function local_class:is_cleared_on_here()
	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress == nil then
		return false
	end

	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.IsComplete then
		return true
	end

	local value = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, stage.Name)

	return value == self.stage_cleared_value
end

function local_class:double_jump(character)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(character, true)
	character_util.cancel_jump(character)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(character, true)
end

function local_class:statue_destroyed_scene(resources)
	local statue = resources.character.statue
	local center = resources.position.center

	--요괴 퇴치 조건이 만족되는 순간 컨트롤 뺏고 이벤트 진행.

	do
		local duration = 0.5

		camera_util.resize_to_default(duration)

		--카메라 포커스 0.5초만에 요괴 위치로 이동.
		camera_util.move_to_target_async(statue, duration)
	end

	local boss_die_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_boss_die_01',
		type_priority = sfx_type_priority.event,
		player_priority = sfx_player_priority.object,
	})

	do
		local duration = 5

		--요괴 스파인 shake 시작.
		scene_util.normal_shake(statue, duration, false)

		--FX_explosion_boss 이펙트 요괴 스파인 위치에 배치.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_boss_die_01')
		self.fx.explosion_boss():Instantiate(statue.Bounds.center)

		--카메라 사이즈 6초간 사이즈 2.8로 줌인.
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.8, duration)

		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(boss_die_sfx, 0.3)

	--아래 연출 동시에 진행
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_dark_04')

	--카메라 shake 0.1, 0.3
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	--카메라 사이즈 4로 0.5초만에 복귀.
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)

	--요괴 스파인 화면에서 제거.
	field_object_util.set_active_state(statue, active_state_type.disabled)

	--스타피스가 요괴 스파인 위치에서 튀어나와 위 그림의 위치까지 이동한다.
	self.star_piece:appear_async(statue.Bounds.center)

	--각 연출 끝난 후 다음 진행.

function local_class:hero_appear_async(character, target_pos)
	local start_height = 10

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_prologue_wind_01')

	--캐릭터 세팅
	--스미레는 화면에 없는 상태.
	--스미레 상태는 left, sleep_deep, kunoichi/attack3 999배속으로 빠르게 돌려서 마지막 자세를 유지한 채로 설정.
	field_object_util.set_active_state(character, active_state_type.enabled)

	--아래 연출 동시에 진행.
	do
		local duration = 0.4
		local start_scale = 0
		local target_scale = character.SpineController.ShadowScale

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
			local cur_scale = start_scale * (1 - progress) + target_scale * progress

			--그림자가 스미레 등장 위치에 1초간 사이즈 0에서 1까지 커지며 생겨난다.
			character.SpineController.ShadowScale = cur_scale

			local cur_height = start_height * (1 - progress)
			local cur_pos = target_pos  + unity_class.vector3.up * cur_height

			--스미레가 카메라 위쪽 바깥에서 0.7초만에 수직으로 떨어지며 등장한다.
			character_util.set_position(character, cur_pos, true)
		end)
	end
	--각 연출 끝난 후 다음 진행.

	--아래 연출 동시에 진행.(스미레 착지 시 효과 연출입니다.)
	--카메라 shake 0.1, 0.3
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	--FX_shockwave 스미레 착지 위치에 배치.
	self.fx.shockwave():Instantiate(target_pos)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
end

function local_class:hero_disappear_async(character)
	local start_pos = character.Position

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_prologue_wind_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')

	--스미레 right, attack, get
	scene_util.set_emotion(character, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(character, self, 'get')

	--FX_shockwave 스미레 스파인 위치에 배치.
	self.fx.shockwave():Instantiate(start_pos)

	do
		local height = 10
		local duration = 0.4
		local start_scale = character.SpineController.ShadowScale
		local target_scale = 0

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
			local cur_scale = start_scale * (1 - progress) + target_scale * progress

			--스미레 그림자 0.7초간 사이즈 1에서 0 까지 작아진다.
			character.SpineController.ShadowScale = cur_scale

			local cur_height = height * progress
			local cur_pos = start_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * cur_height

			--스미레 0.7초간 카메라 위쪽으로 수직 이동해서 카메라 바깥까지 이동한다.
			--그림자는 둔 채로, 스파인만 이동한다.
			character_util.set_position(character, cur_pos, true)
		end)

		character.SpineController.ShadowScale = start_scale

		character_util.set_position(character, nowhere)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(character, active_state_type.disabled)
	end
end

return local_class

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DreamVillageYokai @
		Comment = @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type DreamVillageYokaiController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	self.character = {
		akayuki = function()
			return get_character('yokai_akayuki')
		end,
		knight = function()
			return user_party.Leader
		end
	}
end

function local_class:enter()
	if not self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		return
	end

	self.controller:on_enter()
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.controller.fo_conversion:unregister_npc(self.character.akayuki())
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:opening_scene()
	local akayuki = self.character.akayuki()

	self:opening_scene_inner()

	--아카유키는 원라인으로 남는다.
	--아카유키(left, smile, bomb_idle) : 요기가 가득한 석상 처리… 도와줄 수 있을까?
	akayuki.Interactable.Talk = 'dv_yokai_s2_39'

	self.controller.fo_conversion:register_npc(akayuki)
end

function local_class:opening_scene_inner()
	local akayuki = self.character.akayuki()
	local knight = self.character.knight()
	local zone = self.controller.zone_enter_manager:get_zone()

	do
		local target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(zone.Bounds.center)

		--카메라 포커스 1초간 아카유키 등장 위치로 이동.

		character_util.set_direction(akayuki, direction_constants.left)
		scene_util.set_emotion(akayuki, self, 'sleep_deep')
		scene_util.set_anim(akayuki, self, {
			name = 'walk4legs',
			loop = false,
			scale = 999,
		})

function local_class:after_statue_destroyed_scene(resources)
	local akayuki = self.character.akayuki()
	local knight = self.character.knight()
	local center = resources.position.center

	--아카유키 왼쪽 카메라 바깥에서 속도 5로 run 애니메이션으로 뛰어들어와 위 위치에 선다.
	do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(akayuki)

		--표정 smile, 달리기 구름 나오도록.
		scene_util.set_emotion(akayuki, self, 'smile')
		stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(akayuki)

		--아카유키 왼쪽 카메라 바깥에서 속도 5로 run 애니메이션으로 뛰어들어와 위 위치에 선다.
		local target_pos = center + unity_class.vector3.left
		local start_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', target_pos)

		character_util.set_position(akayuki, start_pos)

		wp_util.move_async(akayuki, target_pos, 5, nil, {
			run = true,
			play_sfx = true,
		})

		stage.SmokeManager:UnsetCharacterSmoke(akayuki)
	end

	--아카유키(right, smile, idle, jump 2회) : 해치웠구나!

			function()

				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(akayuki, self, 'right',
						nil, nil, 'dv_yokai_s2_40')

	--가디언 선택지
	choose_util.play_async({
		--(intellect)상대가 나잖아.

local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageYokaiSection4')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DreamVillageYokai @
		Comment = @
		Index = 3 @
		NextSections = 4 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type DreamVillageYokaiController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	self.character = {
		kunoichi = function()
			return get_character('yokai_kunoichi')
		end,

		ninja_leader = function()
			return get_character('yokai_ninja_leader')
		end,

		knight = function()
			return user_party.Leader
		end,
	}
end

function local_class:enter()
	if not self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		return
	end

	self.controller:on_enter()

	if self.controller.current_state == self.controller.states.done then
		return
	end

	do
		local zone = self.controller.zone_enter_manager:get_zone()
		local pivot = vector_util.get_x0z(zone.Bounds.center)
		local x_offset = 0.5

		local ninja_leader = self.character.ninja_leader()
		local kunoichi = self.character.kunoichi()

		--캐릭터 세팅
		--나츠메 left, smile, idle
		field_object_util.set_active_state(ninja_leader, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.set_direction(ninja_leader, direction_constants.left)
		character_util.set_position(ninja_leader, pivot + unity_class.vector3.right * x_offset)
		scene_util.set_emotion(ninja_leader, self, 'smile')

		--스미레 right, idle, idle
		field_object_util.set_active_state(kunoichi, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.set_direction(kunoichi, direction_constants.right)
		character_util.set_position(kunoichi, pivot + unity_class.vector3.left * x_offset)

		self.controller.fo_conversion:register_npc(ninja_leader)
		self.controller.fo_conversion:register_npc(kunoichi)
	end
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.character.ninja_leader(), self)

	self.controller.fo_conversion:unregister_npc(self.character.ninja_leader())
	self.controller.fo_conversion:unregister_npc(self.character.kunoichi())
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.character.ninja_leader()) then
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(e.Target)

			--나츠메(right, tired, idle, 말풍선 크기 0.7배) : 스미레 님에게 인정받을 기회였는데….
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(e.Target, { key = 'dv_yokai_s4_32', scale = 0.7 })

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:opening_scene()
	local ninja_leader = self.character.ninja_leader()
	local kunoichi = self.character.kunoichi()

	self:opening_scene_inner()

	--스미레, 나츠메는 원라인으로 남는다.
	do
		--나츠메(right, tired, idle, 말풍선 크기 0.7배) : 스미레 님에게 인정받을 기회였는데….
		scene_util.set_emotion(ninja_leader, self, 'tired')

		character_util.add_listener(ninja_leader, self)
	end

	--표정 애니 유지.
	--스미레(left, tired, cast) : 미안하지만 한번만 더 부탁할게, $name.
	kunoichi.Interactable.Talk = 'dv_yokai_s4_31'
end

function local_class:opening_scene_inner()
	local ninja_leader = self.character.ninja_leader()

	local knight = self.character.knight()
	local zone = self.controller.zone_enter_manager:get_zone()

	--존 엔터하면 컨트롤 뺏고 이벤트 진행.

	character_util.normal_jump(ninja_leader, true)

			nil, nil, 'dv_yokai_s4_1')
	--표정 유지.

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(kunoichi, 'left')

		--1초간 위 위치로 기사(+ 일행) 정렬.
		--도착하면 right, idle, idle.
		user_party:PositionParty(align_pivot, direction_constants.right, duration, CS.Oak.Party.AlignType.Linear, true)

	end

	--스미레(left, tired, nod 1회 0.4배속) : 너도… 탐색하는 능력이 엄청 뛰어난 것 같네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kunoichi, self, 'left',

	--스미레(left, sleep_deep, idle) : …아카유키 님 옆에 있기에 적합한 실력….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kunoichi, self, 'left',
			nil, { name = 'sleep_deep', keep = true }, 'dv_yokai_s4_3')
	--표정 유지.

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--기사 right, idle, idle.
	character_util.remove_emotion(kunoichi)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(kunoichi, 'right')

	--나츠메(left, attack, idle) : 스미레 님! 그러고 보니 아카유키 님이 계신 곳으로 안 가시고 왜 여기에…

			nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'dv_yokai_s4_4')

	--스미레(right, idle, idle) : 네가 무리할까봐 걱정 됐거든.

	--나츠메(right, attack, bomb_idle) : 저런 석상 따위는 제가 금방 처리하고 오겠습니다!

				--스미레(left, tired, bomb_idle) : 우리는 모르는 무언가가 있나 보네.

function local_class:after_statue_destroyed_scene(resources)
	local ninja_leader = self.character.ninja_leader()
	local kunoichi = self.character.kunoichi()
	local knight = self.character.knight()
	local center = resources.position.center

	--아래 연출 동시에 진행
	do
		local target_pivot = center + unity_class.vector3.left
		local start_pivot = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', target_pivot, -1.5)
		local z_offset = 0.5
		local speed = 5

		stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(ninja_leader)
		stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(kunoichi)

		do
			local offset = unity_class.vector3.forward * z_offset

			--표정 smile, 달리기 구름 나오도록.
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ninja_leader)
			scene_util.set_emotion(ninja_leader, self, 'smile')

			--나츠메 왼쪽 카메라 바깥에서 속도 5로 run 애니메이션으로 뛰어들어와 위 위치에 선다.
			character_util.set_position(ninja_leader, start_pivot + offset)

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(ninja_leader, target_pivot + offset,
					speed, nil, self, nil, {
						run = true,
						play_sfx = true,
					})
		end

		do
			local offset = unity_class.vector3.back * z_offset

			--표정 attack, 달리기 구름 나오도록.
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(kunoichi)
			scene_util.set_emotion(kunoichi, self, 'attack')

			--스미레 왼쪽 카메라 바깥에서 속도 5로 run 애니메이션으로 뛰어들어와 위 위치에 선다.
			character_util.set_position(kunoichi, start_pivot + offset)

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(kunoichi, target_pivot + offset,
					speed, nil, self, nil, {
						run = true,
						play_sfx = true,
					})
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

		stage.SmokeManager:UnsetCharacterSmoke(ninja_leader)
		stage.SmokeManager:UnsetCharacterSmoke(kunoichi)
	end

	--스미레 : 해냈구나.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kunoichi, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'dv_yokai_s4_33')

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
		type_priority = sfx_type_priority.event,
		player_priority = sfx_player_priority.npc,
	})

	--스미레 right, attack, eat
	scene_util.set_emotion(kunoichi, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(kunoichi, self, 'eat')

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--아래 연출 동시에 진행.
	do
		local loop_effect = resources.effect.statue_leftover

		--fx_librarian2_basic_hit_01(임시) 이펙트를 fx_librarian2_basic_1st_proj_01(임시) 이펙트 배치된 곳에 배치.
		self.controller.fx.statue_leftover_end():Instantiate(loop_effect.transform.position)

		--x_librarian2_basic_1st_proj_01(임시) 이펙트 제거.
		loop_effect:Dispose()

		resources.effect.statue_leftover = nil
	end
	--각 연출 끝난 후 다음 진행.

	--0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_sfx)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(kunoichi)

	--스미레 : 이걸로 마지막이네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kunoichi, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'dv_yokai_s4_34')

	--가디언 선택지
	choose_util.play_async({
		--(forced)결국엔 일은 내가 다 했네.
		{
			'dv_yokai_s4_35',
			'forced',
			function()
				--기사 left, tired, bomb_idle
				--1초 대기.
				scene_util.play_wait_action(knight, self, 'left',
						'bomb_idle', { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 1)
				--기사 left, tired, idle.

				--스미레(right, sleep_deep, nod 1회, 0.5배속.) : 고맙게 생각하고 있어.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kunoichi, self, 'right',
						{ name = 'nod', count = 1, scale = 0.5 },
						'sleep_deep',
						'dv_yokai_s4_37')

				--나츠메(right, attack, release 3회.) : 하, 일 많이 했으면 좋은 거지!
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ninja_leader, self, 'right',
						{ name = 'release', count = 3 }, 'attack', 'dv_yokai_s4_38')
			end
		},
		--(mercy)고생했어, 둘 다.
		{
			'dv_yokai_s4_36',
			'mercy',
			function()
				--기사 left, smile, clap 3회
				scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')
				scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, {
					name = 'clap',
					count = 3,

---@class DreamVillageYokaiStatueEventManager
local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageYokaiStatueEventManager')

---@class DreamVillageYokaiStatueEventControllerBase
local statue_event_controller_base = newclass('DreamVillageYokaiStatueEventControllerBase')

---@class DreamVillageYokaiStatueEventController : DreamVillageYokaiStatueEventControllerBase
---@field super DreamVillageYokaiStatueEventControllerBase

---@return DreamVillageYokaiStatueEventController
local function declare_statue_event(name)
	return newclass('DreamVillageYokaiStatueEventController' .. name, statue_event_controller_base)
end

local statue_event_controllers = {
	dreamvillage_1 = declare_statue_event(1),
	dreamvillage_2 = declare_statue_event(2),
	dreamvillage_3 = declare_statue_event(3),
	dreamvillage_4 = declare_statue_event(4),
}

function local_class:init()
	---@type DreamVillageYokaiStatueEventControllerBase
	self.statue_event_controller = statue_event_controllers[stage.Name]()

	self.entered = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.statue_event_controller ~= nil then
		if self.entered then
			self:exit()
		end

		self.statue_event_controller:dispose()
		self.statue_event_controller = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.statue_event_controller:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter(on_statue_destroyed_callback)
	self.entered = true

	self.statue_event_controller:enter(on_statue_destroyed_callback)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.statue_event_controller:exit()

	self.entered = false
end

function local_class:get_statue()
	return self.statue_event_controller:get_statue()
end

function local_class:get_statue_origin_pos()
	return self.statue_event_controller:get_statue_origin_pos()
end

do
	function statue_event_controller_base:init(statue)
		if statue == nil then
			statue = self:get_statue()
		end

		local _, sp_manager = global_table_util.try_create_dream_village_screenplay_manager()

		self.sp_controller = sp_manager:get_sp_controller(statue)

		-- 멤버로 캐싱하게 되면 newclass의 callup이 불리는 문제가 있음.
		-- 중복호출 체크 겸사겸사 wrapping
		self.on_done = metatable_helper.inherit({
			callback = nil,
		}, {
			call = function(this)
				if this.callback == nil then
					return
				end

				this.callback()

				this:dispose()
			end,

			dispose = function(this)
				this.callback = nil
			end
		})

		self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

		self.cached_statue = nil
	end

	function statue_event_controller_base:on_pre_load()
	end

	function statue_event_controller_base:dispose()
		self.cached_statue = nil

		if self.sp_controller ~= nil then
			self.sp_controller:dispose()

			self.sp_controller = nil
		end
	end

	function statue_event_controller_base:enter(on_statue_destroyed_callback)
		self.on_done.callback = on_statue_destroyed_callback

		local statue = self:get_statue()

		self:set_statue(statue)
	end

	function statue_event_controller_base:exit()
		self.on_done:dispose()
	end

	function statue_event_controller_base:get_statue()
		if self.cached_statue == nil then
			self.cached_statue = get_character('yokai_statue')
		end

		return self.cached_statue
	end

	function statue_event_controller_base:get_statue_origin_pos()
		return self:get_statue().Position
	end

	function statue_event_controller_base:set_statue(statue)
		statue.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		statue.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1.5, 1, 1.5))
		character_util.spine_scale(statue, unity_class.vector3.one * 1.5, 0)
		statue.SpineController.ShadowScale = 2
		statue.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance

		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(statue, field_ui_type.character_stats)

		-- 폭탄 등에 Squish + Red Pulse 연출이 발생할 수 있기 때문에 DamagedBehaviour 교체
		statue.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance

		field_object_util.set_active_state(statue, active_state_type.enabled)
	end
end

do
	local statue_event = statue_event_controllers.dreamvillage_1

	function statue_event:init()
		self.super:init()

		self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
			--FX_minotaur_buttbounce
			buttbounce = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_minotaur_buttbounce')
			end,

			--FX_reset_object
			reset = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object')
			end,

			damaged_smoke = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_yokai_statue_damaged_smoke')
			end
		})

		self.brazier = metatable_helper.inherit({
			fo_name = 'yokai_statue_brazier',
		}, {
			get = function(this)
				return get_field_object(this.fo_name)
			end,

			turn_on = function(this)
				command_util.publish_burn(user_party.Leader, this:get())
			end,

			turn_off = function(this)
				command_util.publish_extinguish(user_party.Leader, this:get())
			end,
		})

		self.attack_range = metatable_helper.inherit({
			instance = nil,

			radius = 2.5,
		}, {
			init = function(this)
				if this.instance ~= nil then
					return
				end

				this.instance = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(this.radius, attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward)
			end,

			dispose = function(this)
				attack_range_util.destroy(this.instance)
				this.instance = nil
			end,

			show = function(this, fo, xz, duration)
				attack_range_util.setup_by_position(this.instance, xz, 0)

				attack_range_util.show(this.instance, duration)
			end,

			set_position = function(this, fo, xz)
				attack_range_util.setup_by_position(this.instance, xz, 0)
			end,

			hide = function(this, fo)
				attack_range_util.hide(this.instance)
			end,

			contains = function(this, fo, point)
				local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - point)

				return diff.sqrMagnitude < this.radius * this.radius
			end
		})

		self.states = {
			before_enter = 1,
			started = 2,
			in_area = 3,
			done = 99
		}

		self.current_state = self.states.before_enter

		self.zone_name = 'yokai_statue'

		self.origin_pos = nil

		local state_creators = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Main/DreamVillage/Yokai/AttackingStatueStates')

		self.monster_states = {}

		local monster_state_args = {
			awaking = {
				duration = 1,
				next_state_name = 'floating',
			},
			floating = {
				duration = 0.5,
				next_state_name = 'following',
			},
			following = {
				duration = 2.5,
				max_speed = 7,
				next_state_name = 'waiting_attack',
			},
			waiting_attack = {
				duration = 0.5,
				next_state_name = 'falling',
			},
			falling = {
				duration = 0.3,
				damage_ratio = 0.15,
				next_state_name = 'waiting_awake',
			},
			waiting_awake = {
				duration = 2,
				next_state_name = 'awaking',
			}
		}

		for key, creator in pairs(state_creators) do
			local args = monster_state_args[key]

			-- 원하는 스테이트들만 사용
			if args ~= nil then
				self.monster_states[key] = creator(self, monster_state_args[key])
			end
		end

		self.current_monster_state = nil

		self.lighting = metatable_helper.inherit({
			is_receiving = false,
			time_passed = 0,
			target_duration = 2,

			gimmick_manager = nil,
		}, {
			get_gimmick_manager = function(this)
				if this.gimmick_manager == nil then
					local is_valid, manager = global_table_util.try_get('Gimmick/LightGimmickManager')

					if is_valid then
						this.gimmick_manager = manager
					else
						logger_util.error('LightGimmickManager is not created!')
					end
				end

				return this.gimmick_manager
			end,

			dispose = function(this)
				this.gimmick_manager = nil
			end,

			reset = function(this)
				this.is_receiving = false
				this.time_passed = 0
			end,

			update = function(this, fo, dt)
				-- FIXME : get_received_light가 모종의 조건으로 빛을 받고있다는 사실이 끊기지 않는 문제가 있는 듯. 임시 조치
				if this:get_gimmick_manager():get_received_light(fo) ~= nil
						and fo.ActiveState == active_state_type.enabled then
					if not this.is_receiving then
						this.is_receiving = true
					end

					this.time_passed = this.time_passed + dt
				else
					-- 받고 있는 상태였다면 데이터 초기화
					if this.is_receiving then
						this:reset()
					end
				end
			end,

			is_satisfied = function(this)
				return this.time_passed >= this.target_duration
			end
		})

		local max_hp = 4

		self.hp = metatable_helper.inherit({
			max = max_hp,
			current = max_hp,

			top_hp_bar = nil,
			-- 맥스 hp가 백만으로 보이도록
			hp_factor = 250000,

			damaging = false,
		}, {
			reset = function(this)
				--석상 스파인 데미지 받았던 횟수 초기화
				this.current = this.max
			end,

			dispose = function(this)
				this.top_hp_bar = nil
			end,

			on_damaged = function(this)
				this.current = this.current - 1

				this:damage_hp_bar()
			end,

			is_dead = function(this)
				return this.current == 0
			end,

			show_hp_bar = function(this)
				this.top_hp_bar = field_ui_manager:GetUIByKey(field_ui_type.top_hp_bar_for_boss, user_party)

				if this.top_hp_bar == nil then
					logger_util.warning('Cannot find TopHpBar on UserParty.')
					return
				end

				this.top_hp_bar:SetName(game_string:GetString('dv_yokai_stage1_statue'))
				this.top_hp_bar.MaxHP = this.max * this.hp_factor
				this.top_hp_bar.HP = this.top_hp_bar.MaxHP
				this.top_hp_bar.Diff = this.top_hp_bar.MaxHP

				this.top_hp_bar.gameObject:SetActive(true)
			end,

			damage_hp_bar = function(this)
				if this.top_hp_bar == nil then
					return
				end

				local origin_value = this.top_hp_bar.HP
				local target_value = this.current * this.hp_factor

				this.top_hp_bar.HP = target_value
				this.top_hp_bar.Diff = origin_value
			end,

			hide_hp_bar = function(this)
				if this.top_hp_bar == nil then
					return
				end

				this.top_hp_bar.gameObject:SetActive(false)

				this.top_hp_bar = nil
			end
		})

		self.damage_tint = metatable_helper.inherit({
			magnitude = 0.75,

			color_base = unity_class.color.red,

			key = 'yokai_stage1_statue_',
		}, {
			add_color = function(this, character, duration)
				character_util.add_color(character, this.key, this.color_base, this.magnitude, duration)
			end,

			remove_color = function(this, character, duration)
				duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 0)

				character_util.remove_color(character, this.key, duration)
			end,
		})
	end
