		self.fx:create_all()
	end

	function statue_event:enter(on_statue_destroyed_callback)
		self.super:enter(on_statue_destroyed_callback)

		self.attack_range:init()

		self.origin_pos = self:get_statue().Position

		self.current_state = self.states.started

		update_util.add_late_update(self, CS.Oak.UpdatePriorities.StageEvent, 'late_update_frame')

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent), 'on_field_object_revived_event')
	end

	function statue_event:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent))

		update_util.remove_late_update(self, CS.Oak.UpdatePriorities.StageEvent, 'late_update_frame')

		self.current_state = self.states.done

		do
			local fo = self:get_statue()

			self:change_state(fo, nil, true)

			self.damage_tint:remove_color(fo)
		end

		self.attack_range:dispose()

		self.lighting:dispose()

		self.origin_pos = nil

		self.hp:dispose()

		self.super:exit()
	end

	function statue_event:dispose()
		if self.monster_states ~= nil then
			for _, state in pairs(self.monster_states) do
				state:dispose()
			end

			self.monster_states = nil
		end

		self.super:dispose()
	end

	function statue_event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		if self.current_state == self.states.started and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.zone_name) then
			self.current_state = self.states.in_area

			self:change_state(self:get_statue(), 'awaking')

			self.brazier:turn_on()

			--0.5초간 카메라 사이즈 5로 변경.
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 0.5)

			self.hp:show_hp_bar()

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function statue_event:on_zone_leave_event(e)
		if self.current_state == self.states.in_area and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject,  user_party.Leader) and
				not e.FullLeave and
				e.Zone.Name == self.zone_name then
			self.current_state = self.states.started

			self:reset_monster(true)

			--0.5초간 카메라 사이즈 4로 복귀.
			camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)

			self.hp:hide_hp_bar()

			self.brazier:turn_off()

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function statue_event:on_field_object_revived_event(e)
		if self.current_state == self.states.in_area and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			self:reset_monster(false)

			camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 0.5)

			self:change_state(self:get_statue(), 'awaking')

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function statue_event:get_statue_origin_pos()
		return self.origin_pos
	end

	function statue_event:late_update_frame(dt)
		if self.current_monster_state == nil then
			return
		end

		if user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			return
		end

		local fo = self:get_statue()

		self.current_monster_state:update(dt)

		self.lighting:update(fo, dt)

		if self.lighting.is_receiving then
			if not self.hp.damaging then
				self.hp.damaging = true

				self.damage_tint:add_color(fo, self.lighting.target_duration)
			end
		else
			if self.hp.damaging then
				self.hp.damaging = false

				self.damage_tint:remove_color(fo, 0.3)
			end
		end

		if self.lighting:is_satisfied() then
			self.lighting:reset()

			music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '02_hit_earth_02',
				play_pos = fo.Position,
				type_priority = sfx_type_priority.gimmick,
				player_priority = sfx_player_priority.object,
			})

			self.hp:on_damaged()

			local duration = 1

			--카메라 shake 0.1, 1
			camera_util.shake(0.1, duration)

			--석상 스파인 shake 1초간, 세기 0.06
			character_util.shake(fo, 0.06, duration)

			--fx_qc_minigame_stairs_stone_smoke 이펙트 배치.
			self.fx.damaged_smoke():Instantiate(fo.Bounds.center)

			if not self.hp:is_dead() then
				--석상 스파인 0.3초간 틴트 제거.
				self.damage_tint:remove_color(fo, 0.3)
			else
				-- 강제로 끊어버려서 업데이트가 동작하지 않도록 막음
				self:change_state(fo, nil, true)

				--클리어 시, 고정화로 2개 꺼지도록 처리.(이벤트 내내 폭탄 터지는 게 없도록 처리.)
				self.brazier:turn_off()

				self.hp:hide_hp_bar()

				self.on_done:call()

				return
			end
		end
	end

	function statue_event:change_state(fo, next_state_name, forced)
		forced = lua_helper.get_or_default(forced, false)

		if self.current_monster_state ~= nil then
			self.current_monster_state:exit(forced)
			self.current_monster_state = nil
		end

		if next_state_name == nil then
			return
		end

		local next_state = self.monster_states[next_state_name]

		if next_state == nil then
			logger_util.error('Cannot find StatueState named ' .. next_state_name)

			return
		end

		self.current_monster_state = next_state
		self.current_monster_state:enter(fo)
	end

	function statue_event:execute_damage(fo, ratio)
		if not self.attack_range:contains(fo, user_party.Leader.Position) then
			return
		end

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()

		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
		damage_info.sender = fo
		damage_info.target = user_party.Leader
		damage_info.damage = math.ceil(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * ratio)

		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end

	function statue_event:reset_monster(show_effect)
		local statue = self:get_statue()

		if show_effect and not vector_util.almost_close_to(statue.Position, self.origin_pos) then
			--FX_reset_object 이펙트를 석상 스파인 위치에 배치.
			self.fx.reset():Instantiate(statue.Position)
			self.fx.reset():Instantiate(self.origin_pos)
		end

		--패턴 루틴 돌던 것 멈춤.
		self:change_state(statue, nil, true)

		--석상 스파인을 최초 위치로 복귀 시킨다.
		character_util.set_position(statue, self.origin_pos)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(statue, active_state_type.enabled)

		--석상 스파인 데미지 받았던 횟수 초기화
		self.hp:reset()

		--석상 스파인 틴트 초기화
		self.damage_tint:remove_color(statue)

		self.lighting:reset()
	end
end

do
	local statue_event = statue_event_controllers.dreamvillage_2

	function statue_event:init()
		self.super:init()

		self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
			--FX_Blockaura_Red_Boss
			red_aura = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_yokai_statue_red_aura')
			end,

			--FX_Blockaura_Char
			statue_aura = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_yokai_statue_aura')
			end,

			--fx_boss_priscilla_knockwave_red
			red_wave = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_yokai_statue_red_wave')
			end
		})

		self.brazier = metatable_helper.inherit({
			prefix = 'yokai_statue_brazier_',
			fake_prefix = 'yokai_statue_fake_brazier_',
			count = 4,
			container = {},
		}, {
			init = function(this)
				if #this.container > 0 then
					return
				end

				for i = 1, this.count do
					local fo = get_field_object(this.prefix .. i)
					local fake_fo = get_field_object(this.fake_prefix .. i)

					this.container[i] = fo

					fo.Position = fake_fo.Position
					fake_fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				end
			end,

			dispose = function(this)
				for index, _ in pairs(this.container) do
					this.container[index] = nil
				end
			end,

			reset = function(this)
				for _, fo in pairs(this.container) do
					if fo.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then
						command_util.publish_extinguish(user_party.Leader, fo)
					end
				end
			end,

			is_all_burning = function(this)
				for _, fo in pairs(this.container) do
					-- 비활성화 되어있다면 얘는 이미 스왑당했음
					if fo.ActiveState == active_state_type.disabled then
						return true
					end

					if not fo.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then
						return false
					end
				end

				return true
			end,

			swap_to_fake = function(this)
				for i = 1, this.count do
					local fo = this.container[i]
					local fake_fo = get_field_object(this.fake_prefix .. i)

					-- 비활성화되어있다면 이미 이 처리를 지난 것이므로 뱉어버림
					if fo.ActiveState == active_state_type.disabled then
						return
					end

					fake_fo.Position = fo.Position

					field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.disabled)
					fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				end
			end
		})

		self.camera_grid = nil

		self.time_conversion = nil

		self.states = {
			none = 1,
			before_enter_area = 2,
			in_area = 3,
			in_reset = 4,
			wait_done = 5,
			done = 99,
		}

		self.current_state = self.states.none

		self.zone_name = 'yokai_statue'
	end

	function statue_event:on_pre_load()
		self.fx:create_all()
	end

	function statue_event:enter(on_statue_destroyed_callback)
		self.super:enter(on_statue_destroyed_callback)

		self.current_state = self.states.before_enter_area

		self.brazier:init()

		self.camera_grid = field_util.get_camera_grid('yokai_statue')

		self.time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent), 'on_time_conversion_changed_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BurnEvent), 'on_burn_event')
	end

	function statue_event:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BurnEvent))

		self.current_state = self.states.done

		self.brazier:dispose()

		self.camera_grid = nil
		self.time_conversion = nil

		self.super:exit()
	end

	function statue_event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		if self.current_state == self.states.before_enter_area and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.zone_name) then
			self.current_state = self.states.in_area

			-- 만약 낮->밤 전환한 타이밍에 존에 들어오는 경우, is_daylight가 이미 false일 것임
			-- 낮->밤 전환 이후 밤인데도 리셋되는 상황은 나오지 않을 것
			if self.time_conversion:is_daylight() then
				self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.reset_scene, self):Then(function()
					self.current_state = self.states.before_enter_area
					self.brazier:reset()
				end)

				return true
			end

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function statue_event:on_time_conversion_changed_event(e)
		-- 불이 4개가 다 들어왔다면 on_burn_event를 탔을 것이므로, in_area라면 불이 다 안붙었다는 얘기
		-- 따라서 리셋시켜도 무방함
		if self.time_conversion:is_daylight() then
			if self.current_state == self.states.in_area then
				self.current_state = self.states.in_reset

				self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.reset_scene, self):Then(function()
					self.current_state = self.states.before_enter_area
					self.brazier:reset()
				end)

				return true
			elseif self.current_state == self.states.wait_done then
				self.current_state = self.states.done

				-- 여기서는 밤->낮 전환이 이미 완료된 시점이므로, 굳이 트랜지션을 실행할 필요가 없음
				self.sp_controller:start_coroutine_delayed(function()
					sp_util.enter_scene()

					self:succeed_scene()

					self.on_done:call()
				end)
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	function statue_event:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
		if self.current_state == self.states.in_area and
				type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.camera_grid.name) then
			self.current_state = self.states.before_enter_area
			self.brazier:reset()

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function statue_event:on_burn_event(e)
		-- 1. Burn이 먼저 들어오고, 버튼으로 인한 TimeConversion 연출을 다음에 실행하는 경우
		-- TimeConversion쪽에서 연출 상태로 전환하는게 막히고, 이쪽에서 밤->낮으로 전환함
		-- 2. 버튼으로 인한 TimeConversion이 먼저 실행되고, Burn 이벤트가 나중에 수신된 경우
		-- 이쪽 이벤트가 막히고, TimeConversion이 이미 실행되었기 때문에 밤->낮으로 변경해줄 필요 없이 succeed로 넘어가면 됨
		if self.current_state == self.states.in_area and self.brazier:is_all_burning() then
			self.brazier:swap_to_fake()

			local is_entered = self.sp_controller:try_start_coroutine(function()
				sp_util.enter_scene()

				do
					local prev_value = self.time_conversion.is_reset_control

					--플레이어가 피리를 불어 낮으로 전환한다.
					self.time_conversion.is_reset_control = false

					self.time_conversion:changed_time_conversion(true)

					-- 복구
					self.time_conversion.is_reset_control = prev_value
				end

				self:succeed_scene()

				self.on_done:call()
			end)

			if is_entered then
				self.current_state = self.states.done
			else
				-- 만약 불 붙이는 시점에 밤->낮 변경이 일어난다면 밤낮 변경이 끝나는걸 대기
				-- FIXME : 확실하게 처리하려면, TimeConversion이 진행 중인지를 파악하는 게 더 좋음
				-- 상황상 밤낮 기믹 외에는 try에서 뱉게 만들만한 것이 없기 때문에, 체크하지 않고 넘어감
				self.current_state = self.states.wait_done
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	function statue_event:reset_scene()
		--존 진입 후 그 자리에서 컨트롤 빼앗김.
		local statue = self:get_statue()

		for i = 1, user_party.Count do
			local member = user_party[i - 1]

			--기사, 도화 (요괴 방향, attack, idle)
			scene_util.set_direction_by_args(member, {
				look_target = statue,
				look_mode = 'side'
			})
		end

		local effects = {}

		do
			local duration = 1

			--요괴 석상 (down, idle, idle) shake (0.05,1)
			character_util.shake(statue, 0.05, duration)

			do
				local start_scale = 0.1
				local target_scale = 0.7

				--요괴 석상 위로 FX_Blockaura_Red_Boss 이펙트 출력
				--크기 0.1에서 0.7까지 1초만에 커진다.
				local aura_effect = self.fx.red_aura():Instantiate(statue.Bounds.center)
				aura_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * start_scale

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_slash_03')

				coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
					local cur_scale = start_scale * (1 - progress) + target_scale * progress

					aura_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * cur_scale
				end)

				table.insert(effects, aura_effect)
			end
		end

		--기사 , 도화 위로  FX_Blockaura_Char 출력
		for i = 1, user_party.Count do
			local member = user_party[i - 1]

			scene_util.set_emotion(member, self, 'attack')

			local effect = self.fx.statue_aura():Instantiate(member.Position)

			effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.8

			table.insert(effects, effect)
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--나레이션 박스 출력
		--요기가 사방으로 퍼지며 의식이 몽롱해진다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({
			key = 'dv_yokai_stage2_narration',
		})

		--다음 동작 동시 실행
		--기사, 팔로워 (right, sleep_deep, dead1 1회, 마지막 프레임 유지)
		party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'sleep_deep' })
		party_util.set_anim({ name = 'dead1', loop = false })

		local in_routine = true

		start_coroutine(function()
			local execute_red_wave = function()
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
				self.fx.red_wave():Instantiate(statue.Bounds.center)
			end

			--fx_boss_priscilla_knockwave_red 이펙트 석상요괴 위치에 배치.
			execute_red_wave()

			--1초 대기
			wait_for_sec(1)

			if not in_routine then
				return
			end

			--fx_boss_priscilla_knockwave_red 이펙트 석상요괴 위치에 배치.
			execute_red_wave()
		end)

		--화면 페이드 아웃 - 1.5초
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black)

		in_routine = false

		--기사, 팔로워 (right, idle, idle)
		--플레이어 컨트롤 해제.
		party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

		do
			local align_pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('yokai_statue_party_reset')

			--아래 위치로 세팅된 상태
			user_party:PositionParty(align_pivot, direction_constants.right, 0, CS.Oak.Party.AlignType.Linear, true)
		end

		for _, effect in pairs(effects) do
			effect:Dispose()
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		--화면 페이드 인 - 1.5초
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black)
	end

	function statue_event:succeed_scene()
		--플레이어 컨트롤 뺐음
		local statue = self:get_statue()

		--기사, 팔로워 (석상 방향, idle, idle) 정렬.
		for i = 1, user_party.Count do
			local member = user_party[i - 1]

			scene_util.set_direction_by_args(member, {
				look_target = statue,
				look_mode = 'side'
			})
		end

		--요괴 석상 위로 FX_Blockaura_Char 출력
		local aura_effect = self.fx.statue_aura():Instantiate(statue.Position)

		aura_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 1.2

		--1초 대기
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--FX_Blockaura_Char 페이드 아웃으로 사라짐 - 1.5초
		aura_effect:Dispose()
	end
end

do
	local statue_event = statue_event_controllers.dreamvillage_3

	function statue_event:init()
		self.monsters = metatable_helper.inherit({
			container = {},
			count = 2,
			crash_xz_extents = unity_class.vector3.one * 1.7,
		}, {
			dispose = function(this)
				for i = 1, this.count do
					this.container[i] = nil
				end
			end,

			get = function(this, index)
				if this.container[index] == nil then
					this.container[index] = get_character('yokai_statue_' .. index)
				end

				return this.container[index]
			end,

			is_crashed = function(this)
				local following = this:get(1)
				local fixed = this:get(2)
				local diff = following.Position - fixed.Position

				return diff.x > -this.crash_xz_extents.x and diff.x < this.crash_xz_extents.x and
						diff.z > -this.crash_xz_extents.z and diff.z < this.crash_xz_extents.z
			end,

			foreach = function(this, action)
				for i = 1, this.count do
					local fo = this:get(i)

					action(i, fo)
				end
			end,
		})

		self.super:init(self:get_statue())

		self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
			--FX_explosion_boss
			explosion_boss = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_explosion_boss')
			end,

			--FX_minotaur_buttbounce
			buttbounce = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_minotaur_buttbounce')
			end,

			--FX_reset_object
			reset = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object')
			end,

			--fx_archaic_golem_crash
			statue_crash = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_yokai_statue_crash')
			end,

			hit = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
			end,

			lasthit = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
			end
		})

		-- 추적 요괴만 사용
		self.attack_range = metatable_helper.inherit({
			instance = nil,

			radius = 2.5,

			follow_range = 20
		}, {
			init = function(this)
				if this.instance ~= nil then
					return
				end

				this.instance = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(this.radius, attack_range_show_type.none)
			end,

			dispose = function(this)
				attack_range_util.destroy(this.instance)
				this.instance = nil
			end,

			-- 아래 두 기능은 Fake.
			-- 비주얼은 스테이트에서 관리되는 것이 아니라 이 컨트롤러에서 관리할 것임
			show = function(this, fo, xz, duration)
			end,

			hide = function(this, fo)
			end,

			set_position = function(this, fo, xz)
				attack_range_util.setup_by_position(this.instance, xz, 0)
			end,

			activate = function(this)
				attack_range_util.show(this.instance)
			end,

			deactivate = function(this)
				attack_range_util.hide(this.instance)
			end,

			contains = function(this, fo, point)
				local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - point)

				return diff.sqrMagnitude < this.radius * this.radius
			end,

			is_in_follow_range = function(this, fo, point)
				local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - point)

				return diff.sqrMagnitude < this.follow_range * this.follow_range
			end
		})

		self.center_zone = metatable_helper.inherit({
			zone = nil,

			crash_extents = vector(1.7, 0, 1.7)
		}, {
			init = function(this)
				this.zone = field_util.get_zone('yokai_statue')
			end,

			dispose = function(this)
				this.zone = nil
			end,

			get_center = function(this)
				return vector_util.get_x0z(this.zone.Bounds.center)
			end,

			contains = function(this, point)
				return this.zone:Contains(point)
			end,

			is_in_disable_area = function(this, point)
				-- 왼쪽으로 나간게 아니라면 구역 밖으로 나간 것으로 간주
				return not this:contains(point) and point.x < (this.zone.Bounds.min.x)
			end,
		})

		self.camera_grid = metatable_helper.inherit({
			name = 'yokai_statue',
			grid = nil,

			contains_player = false,
		}, {
			get = function(this)
				if this.grid == nil then
					this.grid = field_util.get_camera_grid(this.name)
				end

				return this.grid
			end,

			dispose = function(this)
				this.grid = nil
			end,
		})

		local state_creators = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Main/DreamVillage/Yokai/AttackingStatueStates')

		self.monster_states = {}

		local monster_state_args = {
			awaking = {
				duration = 0.5,
				next_state_name = 'floating',
			},
			floating = {
				duration = 0.5,
				next_state_name = 'following',
			},
			following = {
				duration = 1,
				next_state_name = 'waiting_attack',
				max_speed = 7,
				-- 바닥이 없으면 계속 추적하도록
				can_stop_validator = function(fo)
					return field:IsThereFloorAt(fo.Position)
				end
			},
			waiting_attack = {
				-- 이 스테이트는 following 상태가 종료되었는지를 판단하기 위함이므로, 단 한프레임만 대기한다.
				duration = 0,
				next_state_name = 'falling',
			},
			falling = {
				duration = 0.2,
				damage_ratio = 0.15,
				next_state_name = 'waiting_awake',
			},
			waiting_awake = {
				duration = 0.5,
				next_state_name = 'stopped',
			},
			stopped = {},
		}

		for key, creator in pairs(state_creators) do
			local args = monster_state_args[key]

			-- 원하는 스테이트들만 사용
			if args ~= nil then
				self.monster_states[key] = creator(self, monster_state_args[key])
			end
		end

		self.current_monster_state = nil
		self.origin_pos = nil

		self.time_conversion = metatable_helper.inherit({
			states = {
				daylight = 1,
				to_night = 2,
				night = 3,
				to_daylight = 4,
			},

			current_state = nil,
		}, {
			init = function(this)
				this.current_state = this.states.daylight
			end,

			is_daylight = function(this)
				return this.current_state == this.states.daylight
			end
		})

		self.states = {
			none = 1,
			in_acting = 2,
			done = 3,
		}

		self.current_state = self.states.none

		self.late_update_handler = metatable_helper.inherit({
			priority = CS.Oak.UpdatePriorities.StageEvent,
			callback_name = 'late_update_frame',
		}, {
			add = function(this, updater)
				update_util.add_late_update(updater, this.priority, this.callback_name)
			end,

			remove = function(this, updater)
				update_util.remove_late_update(updater, this.priority, this.callback_name)
			end,
		})
	end

	function statue_event:on_pre_load()
		self.fx:create_all()
	end

	function statue_event:dispose()
		self.current_state = self.states.done

		if self.monster_states ~= nil then
			for _, state in pairs(self.monster_states) do
				state:dispose()
			end

			self.monster_states = nil
		end

		self.monsters:dispose()

		self.super:dispose()
	end

	function statue_event:enter(on_statue_destroyed_callback)
		self.on_done.callback = on_statue_destroyed_callback

		self.center_zone:init()

		self.attack_range:init()
		self.attack_range:activate()

		self.monsters:foreach(function(_, fo)
			self:set_statue(fo)
		end)

		do
			local following_statue = self:get_statue()

			self.attack_range:set_position(following_statue, following_statue.Position)

			self.origin_pos = following_statue.Position
		end

		self.time_conversion:init()

		self.late_update_handler:add(self)

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangingEvent), 'on_time_conversion_changing_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent), 'on_time_conversion_changed_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent), 'on_field_object_revived_event')
	end

	function statue_event:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangingEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TimeConversionChangedEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent))

		self.late_update_handler:remove(self)

		self.attack_range:dispose()

		self.center_zone:dispose()

		self.camera_grid:dispose()

		self.origin_pos = nil

		self.super:exit()
	end

	function statue_event:on_time_conversion_changing_event(e)
		if e.IsDaylight then
			self.time_conversion.current_state = self.time_conversion.states.to_daylight

			return true
		else
			--이후 낮으로 전환하기 까지 쭉 정지 상태 유지.
			self.time_conversion.current_state = self.time_conversion.states.to_night

			--attackrange 제거
			self.attack_range:deactivate()

			if self.current_state == self.states.in_acting then
				local statue = self:get_statue()

				character_util.shake(statue, 0.03, 1)
			end

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function statue_event:on_time_conversion_changed_event(e)
		if self.time_conversion.current_state == self.time_conversion.states.to_night then
			self.time_conversion.current_state = self.time_conversion.states.night

			return true
		elseif self.time_conversion.current_state == self.time_conversion.states.to_daylight then
			self.time_conversion.current_state = self.time_conversion.states.daylight

			self.attack_range:activate()

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function statue_event:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
		if self.current_state == self.states.none and
				type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.camera_grid.name) then
			self.current_state = self.states.in_acting

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function statue_event:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
		if self.current_state == self.states.in_acting and
				type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.camera_grid.name) then
			self:reset_monster(false)

			self.current_state = self.states.none

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function statue_event:on_field_object_revived_event(e)
		if self.current_state == self.states.in_acting and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			do
				local reset_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('yokai_statue_party_reset')

				party_util.position_party(reset_pos, direction_constants.right)

				stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party.Leader)
				stage_camera:ResetPositionWithOutGridMove()
			end

			self:reset_monster(false)

			-- 부활 시 퍼즐 구간 거울 기믹 리셋
			for i = 1, 4 do
				local mirror = get_field_object('yokai_mirror_' .. i)
				message_system:SendSync(mirror.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
			end

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function statue_event:late_update_frame(dt)
		if self.current_state ~= self.states.in_acting or
				user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			return
		end

		local leader_pos = user_party.Leader.Position
		local statue = self:get_statue()

		-- 밤낮 관계없이 탈출하면 무조건 리셋해버림
		if self.current_monster_state ~= nil and
				(self.center_zone:is_in_disable_area(leader_pos) or
						not self.attack_range:is_in_follow_range(statue, leader_pos)) then
			self:reset_monster(true)

			return
		end

		if not self.time_conversion:is_daylight() then
			return
		end

		if self.current_monster_state == nil or self.current_monster_state == self.monster_states.stopped then
			-- 정지 상태일 때 리더가 어택레인지 안쪽으로 들어오는 경우 추적 시작
			if self.attack_range:contains(statue, leader_pos) then
				self:change_state(statue, 'awaking')
			end
		else
			self.current_monster_state:update(dt)
		end

		if self.current_monster_state == self.monster_states.waiting_attack and self.monsters:is_crashed() then
			self.current_state = self.states.done

			self.sp_controller:start_coroutine_delayed(function()
				sp_util.enter_scene()

				self.attack_range:deactivate()

				self:succeed_scene()

				--이후 마무리 연출 진행 (B-1 요괴 스스로 파괴)
				self.on_done:call()
			end)
		end
	end

	function statue_event:change_state(fo, next_state_name, forced)
		forced = lua_helper.get_or_default(forced, false)

		if self.current_monster_state ~= nil then
			self.current_monster_state:exit(forced)
			self.current_monster_state = nil
		end

		if next_state_name == nil then
			return
		end

		local next_state = self.monster_states[next_state_name]

		if next_state == nil then
			logger_util.error('Cannot find StatueState named ' .. next_state_name)

			return
		end

		self.current_monster_state = next_state
		self.current_monster_state:enter(fo)
	end

	function statue_event:reset_monster(show_effect)
		local fo = self:get_statue()
		local reset_pos = self.origin_pos

		if show_effect and not vector_util.almost_close_to(fo.Position, reset_pos) then
			--FX_reset_object 이펙트를 석상 스파인 위치에 배치.
			self.fx.reset():Instantiate(fo.Position)
			self.fx.reset():Instantiate(reset_pos)
		end

		self:change_state(fo, nil, true)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.set_direction(fo, direction_constants.left)
		character_util.set_position(fo, reset_pos)
		self.attack_range:set_position(fo, reset_pos)
	end

	function statue_event:execute_damage(fo, ratio)
		if not self.time_conversion:is_daylight() or
				self.current_state ~= self.states.in_acting then
			return
		end

		if not self.attack_range:contains(fo, user_party.Leader.Position) then
			return
		end

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()

		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
		damage_info.sender = fo
		damage_info.target = user_party.Leader
		damage_info.damage = math.ceil(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * ratio)

		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end

	function statue_event:succeed_scene()
		local following_statue = self.monsters:get(1)
		local fixed_statue = self.monsters:get(2)

		do
			local duration = 0.3

			field_object_util.set_active_state(following_statue, active_state_type.enabled)

			--추적 요괴 정지 상태에서 shake (0.01,0.3)
			character_util.shake(following_statue, 0.01, duration)

			wait_for_sec(duration)
		end

		local foreach_member = function(action)
			for i = 1, user_party.Count do
				local member = user_party[i - 1]

				action(i, member)
			end
		end

		local is_left = following_statue.Position.x > user_party.Leader.Position.x

		if user_party.Leader.Position.z < fixed_statue.Bounds.max.z and
				user_party.Leader.Position.z > fixed_statue.Bounds.min.z then
			is_left = fixed_statue.Position.x > user_party.Leader.Position.x
		end

		wait_all_lua(
				function()
					local duration = 0.3
					local offset = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_left,
							unity_class.vector3.left, unity_class.vector3.right) * 1.5
					local direction = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_left,
							direction_constants.left, direction_constants.right)

					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')

					foreach_member(function(index, member)
						local target_pos = member.Position + offset

						--기사 , 도화 (left, attack, prostrate) 상태로
						character_util.set_direction(member, direction)
						scene_util.set_emotion(member, self, 'attack')
						scene_util.set_anim(member, self, 'prostrate')

						--y축 최대 1.5 높이까지 올라가며,
						character_util.jump(member, 1.5, duration)

						--0.3초간 좌측 1.5타일로 포물선 이동.
						wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, target_pos, nil, duration, self, nil, {
							locked_dir = direction
						})
					end)

					wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

					do
						local position = user_party.Leader.Position

						--기사 y축이 0이 되면 캐릭터 하단에 (fx_hit) (fx_lasthit) 출력
						self.fx.hit():Instantiate(position + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.03)
						self.fx.lasthit():Instantiate(position)
					end

					foreach_member(function(index, member)
						--동시에 피격 연출 (character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse)
						character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(member)
						character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(member)

						--이후 기사, 도화 (left, damaged, prostrate) 자세 전환
						scene_util.set_emotion(member, self, 'damaged')
					end)
				end,
				function()
					-- 0.3초간 요괴 석상 y 높이 0으로 떨어진다.
					do
						local duration = 0.3
						local start_height = following_statue.Position.y

						--추적 요괴의 y값이 0 초과일경우
						-- 0.2초간 요괴 석상 y 높이 0으로 떨어진다.
						coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
							local cur_height = (1 - progress) * start_height
							local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(following_statue.Position, cur_height)

							character_util.set_position(following_statue, cur_pos, true)
						end)
					end

					--요괴 석상 y 높이 0이 되는 순간 아래 연출 동시에 진행.
					--FX_minotaur_buttbounce를 석상 위치에 배치
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wolf_boss_bomb_01')
					self.fx.buttbounce():Instantiate(following_statue.Position)

					--카메라 shake 0.1, 0.3
					camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

					--고정 석상에 fx_archaic_golem_crash 출력
					self.fx.statue_crash():Instantiate(fixed_statue.Position)

					--고정 요괴 삭제
					field_object_util.set_active_state(fixed_statue, active_state_type.disabled)
				end
		)

		--0.5초 대기
		--기사, 도화 shake, (0.03,1)
		do
			local duration = 1

			foreach_member(function(index, member)
				scene_util.normal_shake(member, duration, index == 1)
			end)

			wait_for_sec(duration)
		end

		--기사, 도화 mario jump로 일어남
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
		foreach_member(function(index, member)
			if index < user_party.Count then
				character_util.mario_jump_new(member, member.Direction)
			else
				character_util.mario_jump_async(member, member.Direction)
			end
		end)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--기사, 도화 (요괴 방향, attack, idle)
		foreach_member(function(index, member)
			scene_util.set_direction_by_args(member, {
				look_target = following_statue,
				look_mode = 'side',
			})

			scene_util.set_emotion(member, self, 'attack')
		end)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--요괴 스파인 shake 시작 (값 0.03)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_02')
		character_util.shake(following_statue, 0.03, 999)

		--기사 (요괴 방향, attack, idle) jump 2회
		foreach_member(function(index, member)
			if member.Position.x < following_statue.Position.x + constants.epsilon then
				character_util.set_direction(member, direction_constants.right)
			else
				character_util.set_direction(member, direction_constants.left)
			end

			scene_util.set_emotion(member, self, 'attack')

			if index < user_party.Count then
				character_util.normal_jump(member, index == 1)
			else
				character_util.normal_jump_async(member, index == 1)
			end
		end)

		foreach_member(function(index, member)
			character_util.cancel_jump(member)

			if index < user_party.Count then
				character_util.normal_jump(member, index == 1)
			else
				character_util.normal_jump_async(member, index == 1)
			end
		end)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.stop_shake(following_statue)
		party_util.remove_emotion()
	end

	function statue_event:get_statue()
		return self.monsters:get(1)
	end

	function statue_event:get_statue_origin_pos()
		return self.center_zone:get_center()
	end
end

			container = {},
		}, {
			add = function(this, key, effect, scale)
				if this:contains(key) then
					effect:Dispose()

					return
				end

				this.container[key] = effect
				effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * scale
			end,

			remove = function(this, key)
				local effect = this.container[key]

				this.container[key] = nil

				return effect
			end,

			contains = function(this, key)
				return this.container[key] ~= nil
			end,

			scale_async = function(this, key, to, duration)
				if not this:contains(key) then
					return
				end

				local effect = this.container[key]

				local start_scale = effect.transform.localScale
				local target_scale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

				coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
					local cur_scale = start_scale * (1 - progress) + target_scale * progress

					effect.transform.localScale = cur_scale
				end)
			end
		})

	function statue_event:on_pre_load()
		self.fx:create_all()
	end

	function statue_event:dispose()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

		self.custom_stage_music:dispose()

		self.book_item:dispose()

		self.super:dispose()
	end

	function statue_event:enter(on_statue_destroyed_callback)
		self.super:enter(on_statue_destroyed_callback)

		do
			local statue = self:get_statue()

			statue.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		end

		self.current_state = self.states.started

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	end

	function statue_event:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

		self.current_state = self.states.done

		self.super:exit()
	end

	function statue_event:on_interact_event(e)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.book_item:get_fo()) then
			return self.book_item:on_interact()
		elseif self.current_state == self.states.in_area and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self:get_statue()) then
			if self.book_item.seen_once then
				local is_entered = self.sp_controller:try_start_coroutine(function()
					sp_util.enter_scene()

					self.custom_stage_music:play_custom()

					self:align_to_statue()

					local resources = {
						red_aura_effect = nil,
						white_aura_effects = {}
					}

					local succeed = self:select_routine(resources)

					if not succeed then
						self:failed_scene(resources, function()
							self.custom_stage_music:play_field()
						end)

						self.current_state = self.states.in_area

						sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
					else
						self.custom_stage_music:play_field()

						self:succeed_scene(resources)

						self.on_done:call()
					end
				end)

				if is_entered then
					self.current_state = self.states.in_routine
				end
			else
				local is_entered = self.sp_controller:try_start_scene(function()
					self.custom_stage_music:play_custom()

					self:align_to_statue()

					local resources = {
						red_aura_effect = nil,
					}

					self:simple_talk_scene(resources)

					self:failed_scene(resources, function()
						self.custom_stage_music:play_field()
					end)

					self.current_state = self.states.in_area
				end)

				if is_entered then
					self.current_state = self.states.in_routine
				end
			end

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function statue_event:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
		if self.current_state == self.states.started and type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.camera_grid_name) then
			self.current_state = self.states.in_area

			self.tint:add(0.5)

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function statue_event:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
		if self.current_state == self.states.in_area and type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.camera_grid_name) then
			self.current_state = self.states.started

			self.tint:remove(0.5)

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function statue_event:align_to_statue()
		local statue = self:get_statue()
		local pivot = vector_util.get_xy0(statue.Position, statue.Bounds.min.z - 0.5)
		local duration = 1

		user_party:PositionParty(pivot, direction_constants.up, duration, CS.Oak.Party.AlignType.Linear, true)

		camera_util.move_to_target_async(statue, duration)
	end

	function statue_event:simple_talk_scene(resources)
		local statue = self:get_statue()

		resources.red_aura_effect = self.fx.red_aura():Instantiate(statue.Bounds.center)
		resources.red_aura_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

		local cur_effect_scaling_id = nil

		scene_util.set_anim(statue, self, 'attack')

		for i, info in pairs(self.statue_talk.infos) do
			cur_effect_scaling_id = i

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_slash_03')
			start_coroutine(self.scale_effect_async, self, resources.red_aura_effect, info.statue_effect_scale,
					self.statue_talk.statue_effect_scale_duration, function()
						return i == cur_effect_scaling_id
					end)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_01')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(statue, info.key, nil, {
				bubble_direction = 'rb',
				offset = vector(2, 0, 0)
			})
		end

		cur_effect_scaling_id = nil
	end

	function statue_event:select_routine(resources)
		local statue = self:get_statue()
		local failed = false
		local branches = {}
		local cs_branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
		local time_limit = 5
		local leader = user_party.Leader

		local current_selection = nil
		local is_overlay_running = false

		for index, text in pairs(self.book_item.texts) do
			local info = {
				value = CS.Oak.TalkBranch(),
				selected = false,
			}

			info.value.Text = game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(text)
			info.value.Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal
			info.value.Callback = function()
				current_selection = index
				is_overlay_running = false
				info.selected = true
			end

			branches[index] = info
		end

		resources.red_aura_effect = self.fx.red_aura():Instantiate(statue.Bounds.center)

		resources.red_aura_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

		local cur_effect_scaling_id = nil

		for i, info in pairs(self.statue_talk.infos) do
			cur_effect_scaling_id = i

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_slash_03')
			start_coroutine(self.scale_effect_async, self, resources.red_aura_effect, info.statue_effect_scale,
					self.statue_talk.statue_effect_scale_duration, function()
						return i == cur_effect_scaling_id
					end)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_01')
			scene_util.set_anim(statue, self, 'attack')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(statue, {
				key = info.key,
				skip = false,
				type_speed = 0,
				keep_display = true,
				bubble_direction = 'rb',
				offset = vector(2, 0, 0)
			})

			if not is_overlay_running then
				cs_branches:Clear()

				for _, branch_info in pairs(branches) do
					if not branch_info.selected then
						cs_branches:Add(branch_info.value)
					end
				end

				if cs_branches.Count > 0 then
					is_overlay_running = true

					ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(leader, cs_branches)
				end
			end

			local start_time = unity_class.time.time

			while current_selection == nil and unity_class.time.time - start_time < time_limit do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			-- 타겟 정보와 다르면 fail 처리
			failed = current_selection ~= info.target

			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(statue)

			if failed then
				-- 선택을 해야되는데 못했다면
				if current_selection == nil then
					ui_scene_manager:PopOverlay()
				end

				break
			end

			if current_selection ~= nil then
				character_util.remove_anim(statue)

				local duration = 1
				local end_time = unity_class.time.time + duration

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_02')
				camera_util.shake(0.1, duration)

				--석상 스파인 1초간 shake, 세기 0.05
				character_util.shake(statue, 0.05, duration)

				--올바른 선택지 누를 경우 플레이어 몸에 fx_obj_turret_debuff_atk_white 0.5초만에 사이즈 0에서 0.5까지 커지며 배치.
				do
					local effect_info = info.leader_effect
					local effect

					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fox_fire_01')

					if effect_info.use_new_one then
						effect = self.fx.white_aura():Instantiate(leader.Position)

						resources.white_aura_effects[#resources.white_aura_effects + 1] = effect
					else
						effect = resources.white_aura_effects[#resources.white_aura_effects]
					end

					if effect_info.scale ~= nil then
						effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * effect_info.scale.from

						self:scale_effect_async(effect, effect_info.scale.to, 0.5)
					end
				end

				while unity_class.time.time < end_time do
					coroutine.yield()
				end

				current_selection = nil
			end
		end

		cur_effect_scaling_id = nil

		return not failed
	end

	function statue_event:scale_effect_async(effect, target_scale_factor, duration, is_valid_checker)
		local start_scale = effect.transform.localScale
		local target_scale = unity_class.vector3.one * target_scale_factor

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
			if is_valid_checker ~= nil and not is_valid_checker() then
				return false
			end

			local cur_scale = start_scale * (1 - progress) + target_scale * progress

			effect.transform.localScale = cur_scale
		end)
	end

	function statue_event:failed_scene(resources, on_fade_callback)
		local knight = user_party.Leader
		local statue = self:get_statue()

		--FX_Blockaura_Red_Boss 이펙트 0.5초만에 사이즈 0.7까지 커진다.
		if resources.red_aura_effect.transform.localScale.x < 0.65 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_slash_03')
		end

		self:scale_effect_async(resources.red_aura_effect, 0.7, 0.5)

		local duration = 3

		--기사 left, damaged, dead 1회, 끝나고 자세 유지.
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'dead')

		--석상요괴(스킵 불가능, 한번에 모든 대사 등장, 3초간 유지.) : <color=#FF0000>왜 아직도 여기 있느냐?</color>
		scene_util.set_anim(statue, self, 'attack')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_horror_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(statue, {
			key = 'dv_yokai_stage4_statue_7',
			skip = false,
			type_speed = 0,
			keep_display = true,
			bubble_direction = 'rb',
			offset = vector(2, 0, 0)
		})

		--아래 연출 동시에 진행
		wait_all_lua(
				function()
					--이펙트 루틴
					--fx_boss_priscilla_knockwave_red 이펙트 석상요괴 위치에 배치.
					--1초 대기
					--fx_boss_priscilla_knockwave_red 이펙트 석상요괴 위치에 배치.
					--1초 대기
					--fx_boss_priscilla_knockwave_red 이펙트 석상요괴 위치에 배치.
					--1초 대기
					--fx_boss_priscilla_knockwave_red 이펙트 석상요괴 위치에 배치.
					local count = 3
					local delay = duration / count
					local start_time = unity_class.time.time

					for i = 1, count do
						local target_delay = (i - 1) * delay

						while unity_class.time.time < start_time + target_delay do
							coroutine.yield()
						end

						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
						self.fx.red_wave():Instantiate(statue.Bounds.center)
					end
				end,
				function()
					--카메라 shake 0.1, 3.1
					camera_util.shake(0.1, duration)

					--카메라 사이즈 3.1초간 2.1로 줌인.
					camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.1, duration)
					camera_util.move_to_target(knight, duration)

					--화면 3초간 빨갛게 페이드 아웃.
					screen_util.fade_out_async(duration, unity_class.color.red)
				end
		)

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(statue)
		character_util.remove_anim(statue)

		--화면 전환 전 세팅
		--기사 리셋 지점에 right, idle, idle로.
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

		do
			local pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('yokai_statue_party_reset')

			party_util.position_party(pivot, direction_constants.right)
		end

		--카메라 사이즈 4로.
		camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

		resources.red_aura_effect:Dispose()
		resources.red_aura_effect = nil

		if resources.white_aura_effects ~= nil then
			for _, effect in pairs(resources.white_aura_effects) do
				effect:Dispose()
			end

			resources.white_aura_effects = nil
		end

		--0.3초 대기.
		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		--석상에 붙어있던 이펙트 제거.
		on_fade_callback()

		--1초간 빨갛게 페이드 인.
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.red)
	end

	function statue_event:succeed_scene(resources)
		local knight = user_party.Leader

		--마무리 이벤트 호출 전 준비.
		--출력되고 있던 말풍선이 있다면 즉시 제거한다.
		--기사 up, idle, cast2
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'cast2')

		local duration = 3

		--아래 연출 동시에 진행.
		wait_all_lua(
				function()
					--기사 이펙트 루틴
					--fx_obj_turret_debuff_atk_white 이펙트 기사 몸에 배치.
					--1초 대기.
					--fx_obj_turret_debuff_atk_white 이펙트 기사 몸에 배치.
					--1초 대기.
					--fx_obj_turret_debuff_atk_white 이펙트 기사 몸에 배치.
					--1초 대기.
					local count = 3
					local delay = duration / count
					local start_time = unity_class.time.time

					for i = 1, count do
						local target_delay = (i - 1) * delay

						while unity_class.time.time < start_time + target_delay do
							coroutine.yield()
						end

						resources.white_aura_effects[i]:Dispose()
						resources.white_aura_effects[i] = nil

						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_light_01')
						self.fx.player_buff():Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Bounds.center)
					end

					-- 혹시라도 남아있는게 있다면 한번에 해제
					for _, effect in pairs(resources.white_aura_effects) do
						 effect:Dispose()
					end

					resources.white_aura_effects = nil
				end,
				function()
					--카메라 shake 0.1, 3.1
					camera_util.shake(0.1, duration)

					--3초간 필드 틴트 제거.
					self.tint:remove(duration)

					--요괴 석상에 붙은 FX_Blockaura_Red_Boss 이펙트 3초간 크기 0까지 줄어든다.
					self:scale_effect_async(resources.red_aura_effect, 0, duration)

					resources.red_aura_effect:Dispose()
					resources.red_aura_effect = nil
				end
		)

		character_util.remove_anim(knight)

		local time_conversion = get_stage_event_controller('TimeConversionManager')

		--현재 밤일 경우
		if not time_conversion:is_daylight() then
			local prev_value = time_conversion.is_reset_control

			--플레이어가 피리를 불어 낮으로 전환한다.
			time_conversion.is_reset_control = false

			time_conversion:changed_time_conversion(true)

			-- 복구
			time_conversion.is_reset_control = prev_value
		end
		--현재 낮일 경우
		--별도 처리 없음.
	end
end

function goblin_event:init(section)
	self.super:init(section)

	self.get_fx_dead = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
	end

	self.goblin_detected_key = 's3_goblin_detected'
	self.quest_marker_name = 'night_museum_goblin'
	self.custom_state_key = 'goblin_event'
	self.goblin_count = 5

	local is_clear = self:get_custom_state(self.custom_state_key) > 0
	self:set_guard(is_clear == false)

	local controller = self:get_controller()
	local goblin_leader = nil

	if is_clear then
		goblin_leader = controller.get_museum_npc.goblin(6)

		local leader = get_party_leader()
		local manual_goblin = controller.get_museum_npc.goblin_leader()

		local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
		param.KeepParty = true
		param.HidePreviousParty = false

		manual_goblin.Position = leader.Position

		-- 플레이어 스파인 (dv_museum_goblin_leader) 로 변경.
		leader.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(manual_goblin)
		character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(manual_goblin, param)
		character_util.convert_to_npc(leader)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(leader, active_state_type.disabled)

		self:clear_event()
	else
		goblin_leader = controller.get_museum_npc.goblin_leader()
		character_util.add_listener(goblin_leader, self.section)
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(self.quest_marker_name, 448,
				false, goblin_leader)
	end

	local marker = field_util.get_marker('s3_goblin_pos_6')
	default_set_npc(goblin_leader, marker, { name = 'sleep' }, { name = 'sleep' })
end

function goblin_event:dispose()
	local controller = self:get_controller()

	local goblin_leader = controller.get_museum_npc.goblin_leader()
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(get_party_leader(), goblin_leader) then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(goblin_leader, self.section)
	end

	self.super:dispose()
end

function goblin_event:exit()
	local controller = self:get_controller()

	for i = 1, self.goblin_count do
		local goblin = controller.get_museum_npc.goblin(i)
		goblin.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(goblin)
	end

	self.super:exit()
end

function goblin_event:on_event(e)
	if self:is_clear_event() then
		return false
	end

	if not self.is_detected and lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		local detected_key = e.Params[0]

		if e.Params[0] == self.goblin_detected_key then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.be_found_by_goblin, self, e.Sender, detected_key)
		end

		return false
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('goblin_leader')) then
		start_coroutine(self.clear_goblin, self, e.Target)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function goblin_event:be_found_by_goblin(goblin, event_name)
	self.is_detected = true

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local chris = self:get_controller().get_museum_npc.chris()

	-- 해당 어택 레인지를 담당하는 고블린 현재 방향을 바라보며 attack, idle, jump 1회 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(goblin, true)
	character_util.look_at(goblin, leader)

	-- 플레이어 down, surprise, idle, jump 1회.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, '01_small_jump_01')

	-- 고블린 : [shout] 인간!
	-- 말풍선 크기 : 1.2배.
	-- x 0.5 / y 0.8 실행.
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(goblin, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_1', true,
			{ viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8), scale = 1.22 })

	-- 아래 연출 동시에 실행

	-- 어택 레인지 고블린 현재 방향을 바라보며 attack, idle, release 실행.
	scene_util.set_anim(goblin, self, 'release')

	-- 플레이어 down, scared, cast 실행.
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast')

	-- 고블린 : [shout] 잡는다!
	-- 말풍선 크기 : 1.2배.
	-- x 0.2 / y 0.5 실행.
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(goblin, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_2', true,
			{ viewport_pos = vector(0.2, 0.5), scale = 1.25 })

	-- 아래 연출 동시에 실행

	-- 플레이어 (down, scared, embarrassed) 상태를 실행 후 유지.
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'embarrassed')

	-- 화면 1초에 걸쳐 서큘러 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, interpolations_constants.linear)

	character_util.remove_anim(goblin)

	-- 검은 화면 상태에서 붉은색 지점 위치에 플레이어, 크리스 서로 마주본 채, damaged, prostrate 상태로 배치.
	local pos = vector(62, 0, 27.5)

	leader.Position = pos
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')

	chris.Position = pos - vector(1, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(chris, 'right')

	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'damaged' })
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'prostrate' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 서큘러 페이드 인 1초에 걸쳐 실행.
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, interpolations_constants.linear)

	common_game_over(self, leader, chris)

	-- 페이드 인 시 지정된 지점에서부터 컨트롤 복귀.
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(leader, { 'reset', event_name }))

	self.is_detected = false
end

function goblin_event:clear_goblin(goblin_leader)
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local chris = self:get_controller().get_museum_npc.chris()

	local goblin_normal = get_character('goblin_6')

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	character_util.set_direction(goblin_normal, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(goblin_normal, self, 'sleep')
	scene_util.set_anim(goblin_normal, self, 'sleep')
	goblin_normal.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.3)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(goblin_leader, self.section)

	-- 6번 고블린 인터렉트 시 플레이어 파티 모두 지정된 위치까지 left, idle, walk를 1초간 실행하여 이동 후 정렬.
	wp_util.move(chris, goblin_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_async(leader, goblin_leader.Position - vector(1, 0, 0),
			nil, 1, { last_direction = 'right' })

	-- 플레이어 right, smile, eat를 2초간 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self, nil, 'eat', nil, 2)
	equipping_sfx:Stop()

	-- 아래에 복장 변경 연출 동시에 실행
	stage_camera:SetTarget(nil)

	-- 플레이어 (left, smile, victory_get) 상태를 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	local leader_pos = leader.Position

	goblin_normal.Position = goblin_leader.Position

	-- 플레이어 스파인 (dv_museum_goblin_leader) 로 변경.
	leader.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	param.KeepParty = true
	param.HidePreviousParty = false

	character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(goblin_leader, param)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(leader)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(leader, active_state_type.disabled)

	-- 6번 고블린 스파인 (dv_museum_goblin) 로 변경.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wolf_boss_bomb_01')
	self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(goblin_leader.Position)
	goblin_leader.Position = leader_pos
	field_object_util.set_active_state(goblin_normal, active_state_type.enabled)

	self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(leader_pos)
	scene_util.set_direction(goblin_leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(goblin_leader, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(goblin_leader, self, 'victory_get')

	-- 해당 상태 유지.
	wait_for_sec(2)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(goblin_leader)

	-- 크리스 (left, idle, clap) : 대단한 변장 솜씨야! 물론 음….
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(chris, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_5')

	-- 크리스 (left, idle, cross_arm) : 고블린들의 생활 풍토에 맞게 살짝 고약한 냄새가 나는 것 같지만….
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(chris, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_6')

	-- 크리스 (left, idle, cast2) : 네 과학적 탐구심을 만족시키는 일이라면 값싼 일이지!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(chris, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_7')

	-- 크리스 (left, idle, idle) : 자, 이 냄새나는 모습으로 다시 탐험을 시작해 보자고!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(chris, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_8')

	-- 플레이어 (right smile, nod 2회) 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	scene_util.set_emotion(goblin_leader, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(goblin_leader, self, 'nod')
	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

	-- 나레이션 : 위엄 넘치는 고블린 부족장의 모습이 되었다!
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_9' })

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀. 복귀한 이후 플레이어는 (고블린 변장 상태) 로 설정된 상태입니다.
	self:set_guard(false)

	self:clear_event()
	self.section:check_all_clear()
	self:set_custom_state(self.custom_state_key, 1)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)
end

function goblin_event:set_guard(ignore_block)
	local controller = self:get_controller()

	local direction_list = {
		{
			dir = { CS.Oak.Direction.Up, CS.Oak.Direction.Down, },
			delay = 3
		},
		{
			dir = { CS.Oak.Direction.Down, CS.Oak.Direction.Up, },
			delay = 3
		},
		{
			dir = { CS.Oak.Direction.Left, CS.Oak.Direction.Right, },
			delay = 2
		},
		{
			dir = { CS.Oak.Direction.Down, CS.Oak.Direction.Right, },
			delay = 2
		},
		{
			dir = { CS.Oak.Direction.Left, CS.Oak.Direction.Up, },
			delay = 2
		},
	}

	for i = 1, self.goblin_count do
		local goblin = controller.get_museum_npc.goblin(i)
		local direction_info = direction_list[i]
		local marker = field_util.get_marker('s3_goblin_pos_' .. i)
		default_set_npc(goblin, marker, { name = 'attack' })

		goblin.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(goblin,
				direction_info.dir, direction_info.delay, self.goblin_detected_key, 5, 40, false, ignore_block)
	end
end

--region 거대 늑대 이벤트

function big_wolf_event:init(section)
	self.super:init(section)

	self.around_data_list = {
		{
			pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_wolf_move_pos_2'),
			dir = direction_constants.right
		},
		{
			pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_wolf_move_pos_3'),
			dir = direction_constants.right
		},
		{
			pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_wolf_move_pos_4'),
			dir = direction_constants.left
		},
		{
			pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_wolf_move_pos_1'),
			dir = direction_constants.left
		},
	}

	self.grid_name = 'center_grid'
	self.quest_marker_name = 'night_museum_wolf'

	self.cur_around_point = 1
	self.around_pos_count = #self.around_data_list

	self.cur_request_id = 1
	self.max_request_id = 15

	self.is_routine_active = false

	self.range_around = 2.5

	local wolf = self:get_controller().get_museum_npc.wolf()

	self.custom_state_key = 'big_wolf_event'
	local is_clear = self:get_custom_state(self.custom_state_key) > 0

	if is_clear then
		self:clear_event()
		wolf.Position = vector(52.5, 0, 50)
		scene_util.set_direction(wolf, 'left', false)
		wolf.Interactable = CS.Oak.EmoticonInteractable.Create(CS.Oak.EmoticonType.Heart)
		return
	end

	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(self.quest_marker_name, 448,
			false, wolf)

	do
		-- 늑대 세팅
		local start_pos_data = self.around_data_list[4]
		wolf.Position = start_pos_data.pos
		scene_util.set_direction(wolf, start_pos_data.dir, false)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(wolf, active_state_type.enabled)

		wolf.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.range_around,
			CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
end

function big_wolf_event:start()
	if self:is_clear_event() then
		return
	end

	-- 시작할 때 루틴이 돌고 있지 않으면서 체크 그리드 안에 있으면 로직 시작
	if not self.is_routine_active and
			field:IsInCameraGrid(get_party_leader().Position, self.grid_name) then
		start_coroutine(self.around_routine, self)
	end
end

function big_wolf_event:dispose()
	self.is_routine_active = false

	self:dispose_attack_range()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function big_wolf_event:on_event(e)
	if self:is_clear_event() then
		return false
	end

	if not lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.WatchingCameraGridChangedEvent) then
		return false
	end

	if e.CameraGrid.name ~= self.grid_name then
		self.is_routine_active = false
		return false
	end

	start_coroutine(self.around_routine, self)
	return false
end

function big_wolf_event:around_routine()
	local wolf = self:get_controller().get_museum_npc.wolf()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	self:set_request_id()
	local request_id = self.cur_request_id

	local state = {
		-- 이동 중
		search_next_point = 1,
		around = 2,
		search_leader = 3,
		search_goblin_leader = 4,
	}

	local cur_state = state.around

	local speed = 8
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 0
	local start_pos, end_pos
	local diff = 9999
	local growl_sfx = nil

	local function set_next_around_point()
		self.cur_around_point = self.cur_around_point >= self.around_pos_count and
				1 or (self.cur_around_point + 1)
	end

	local function reset_duration()
		time_passed = 0

		start_pos = wolf.Position
		end_pos = self.around_data_list[self.cur_around_point].pos

		duration = vector_util.get_x0z(end_pos - start_pos).magnitude / speed
	end

	local function walk_start()
		scene_util.set_direction(wolf, self.around_data_list[self.cur_around_point].dir, false)
		scene_util.set_anim(wolf, self, 'walk')
	end

	local function reset()
		reset_duration()
		walk_start()
		cur_state = state.around
	end

	local function stop_growl_sfx()
		if growl_sfx == nil then
			return
		end

		growl_sfx:Stop()
		growl_sfx = nil
	end

	local function play_growl_sfx()
		if growl_sfx ~= nil then
			stop_growl_sfx()
		end

		growl_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_growl_wolf_01', parent = wolf, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'npc',
			max_distance = 14, loop = true,
		})
	end

	self.is_routine_active = true
	reset()

	attack_range_util.show(self.attack_range)
	play_growl_sfx()

	while self.is_routine_active and request_id == self.cur_request_id do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if cur_state == state.search_next_point then
			-- 다음 이동 위치, 속도 세팅
			set_next_around_point()
			reset_duration()
			walk_start()

			cur_state = state.around
		elseif cur_state == state.around then
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			wolf.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

			if self.attack_range ~= nil then
				attack_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, wolf.Position, 0)
			end

			if time_passed > duration then
				cur_state = state.search_next_point
			end
		end

		diff = (leader.Position - wolf.Position).magnitude
		if diff <= self.range_around then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(leader, get_character('goblin_leader')) then
				stop_growl_sfx()

				self.is_routine_active = false
				self:clear_event_scene()
				break
			else
				-- 고블린 족장으로 변경하지 않았을 때
				stop_growl_sfx()

				self:game_over()

				play_growl_sfx()
				reset()
			end
		end
	end

	stop_growl_sfx()

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		attack_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
	end
end

function big_wolf_event:set_request_id()
	self.cur_request_id = self.cur_request_id + 1
	if self.cur_request_id >= self.max_request_id then
		self.cur_request_id = 1
	end
end

function big_wolf_event:game_over()
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local chris = self:get_controller().get_museum_npc.chris()
	local wolf = self:get_controller().get_museum_npc.wolf()

	-- 거대 늑대 (바라보는 방향, idle, attack_ready)를 1초간 실행.
	local wolf_look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(vector_util.get_xy0(leader.Position) -
			vector_util.get_xy0(wolf.Position))

	-- magnitude가 0이 나오면 none으로 뱉어서 noe일 경우 강제로 left right로 변환하도록 변경
	if wolf_look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		wolf_look_dir = wolf.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left and CS.Oak.Direction.Right or CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	end

	scene_util.set_direction(wolf, wolf_look_dir, false)
	scene_util.set_anim(wolf, self, { name = 'attack_ready' })

	-- 플레이어 (거대 늑대 방향, idle, embarrassed)를 1초간 실행.
	-- 크리스도 동일하게 처리.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	party_util.set_direction(direction_util.get_opposite(wolf.Direction))
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'embarrassed' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 위 연출 완료 후 다음 연출을 동시에 실행.

	-- 거대 늑대 (바라보는 방향, idle, attack)를 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wolf_boss_slash_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(wolf, self, { name = 'attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })

	-- 플레이어 일반 피격 연출 실행
	-- 크리스도 동일하게 처리.
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(leader)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(chris)

	-- 플레이어 (거대 늑대 방향, hurt, dead)를 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	-- 크리스도 동일하게 처리.
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'hurt')
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'dead', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01' })

	-- Fx_lasthit를 플레이어 중심으로 출력.

	-- 화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	-- 플레이어 dead가 모두 실행된 시점에서 화면 1초에 걸쳐 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, interpolations_constants.linear)

	self.cur_around_point = 1
	local start_pos_data = self.around_data_list[4]
	wolf.Position = start_pos_data.pos
	scene_util.set_direction(wolf, start_pos_data.dir, false)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(wolf, active_state_type.enabled)

	-- 검은 화면 상태에서 붉은색 지점 위치에 플레이어, 크리스 서로 마주본 채, damaged, prostrate 상태로 배치.
	local pos = vector(78, 0, 50)

	leader.Position = pos
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')

	chris.Position = pos - vector(1, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(chris, 'right')

	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'damaged' })
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'prostrate' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 서큘러 페이드 인 1초에 걸쳐 실행.
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, interpolations_constants.linear)

	common_game_over(self, leader, chris)

	-- 페이드 인 시 지정된 지점에서부터 컨트롤 복귀.
	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)
end

function big_wolf_event:clear_event_scene()
	-- 플레이어가 dv_museum_goblin_leader 상태로 거대 늑대의 중심으로부터 4x4 영역에 진입 시 실행합니다.
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local chris = self:get_controller().get_museum_npc.chris()
	local wolf = self:get_controller().get_museum_npc.wolf()

	attack_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)

	-- 거대 늑대 (바라보는 방향, idle, attack_ready)를 1초간 실행.
	local wolf_look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(vector_util.get_xy0(leader.Position) -
			vector_util.get_xy0(wolf.Position))

	-- magnitude가 0이 나오면 none으로 뱉어서 noe일 경우 강제로 left right로 변환하도록 변경
	if wolf_look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		wolf_look_dir = wolf.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left and CS.Oak.Direction.Right or CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_growl_wolf_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(wolf, wolf_look_dir, false)
	scene_util.set_anim(wolf, self, { name = 'attack_ready', loop = false })

	-- 플레이어 (거대 늑대 방향, idle, embarrassed)를 1초간 실행.
	-- 크리스(거대 늑대 방향, idle, embarrassed)를 1초간 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	party_util.set_direction(direction_util.get_opposite(wolf.Direction))
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'embarrassed' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 1초 대기
	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 크리스도 동일하게 처리.
	-- 플레이어 (거대 늑대 방향, idle, victory_get)를 1초간 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 1초 대기
	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 거대 늑대 (바라보는 방향, idle, idle) question 이모티콘 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(wolf)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(wolf, nil, 'question')

	-- 플레이어 (거대 늑대 방향, idle, release 2회)를 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	scene_util.set_anim(chris, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

	-- 거대 늑대 (바라보는 방향, idle, idle, jump 2회) heart 이모티콘 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_guild_dog_01')
	start_coroutine(character_util.normal_double_jump, wolf, '01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(wolf, nil, 'heart')

	-- 크리스 (거대 늑대 방향, idle, idle) : 오호라! 이 거대한 늑대가 널 인정한 것 같은데?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(chris, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_10')

	-- 크리스 (거대 늑대 방향, idle, idle) : 이 거대한 친구의 힘이 필요할 때 불러주면 될 것 같아!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(chris, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_11')

	-- 플레이어 (거대 늑대 방향, idle, nod 2회) 실행 후 완료까지 대기.
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, 'nod')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 거대 늑대 이동경로
	-- 거대 늑대가 현재 있는 위치에서부터, 도착한 위치까지 경로를 설정.
	-- 거대 늑대 (left, idle, run)을 8의 속도로 도착할 위치까지 이동.
	-- 거대 늑대 도착한 위치에서 (right, idle, idle) 상태로 정지.
	local target_pos = vector(52.5, 0, 50)

	local plan_path_done = false
	local plan_path

	field.PathFinder:FindNormalPath(wolf, target_pos, 300, wolf, 0, nil, function(path, req_key)
		if req_key == 0 then
			plan_path_done = true
			plan_path = path
		end
	end)

	while not plan_path_done do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local way_point_list = {}

	for i = 0, plan_path.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(way_point_list, plan_path[i])
	end

	table.insert(way_point_list, target_pos)

	local cur_count = 1

	while cur_count <= #way_point_list do
		-- 화면밖으로 나갔을 경우 바로 순간이동
		if cur_count > 2 and
				not screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(wolf.Position, { bonus_distance = -2 }) then
			break
		end

		wp_util.move_async(wolf, way_point_list[cur_count], 8, nil)
		cur_count = cur_count + 1
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local diff = (wolf.Position - target_pos).magnitude

	if diff > 5 then
		-- 화면밖에 있을 때 목표 지점보다 멀리 있다면 해당 위치로 순간이동
		wolf.Position = target_pos
	end

	wp_util.move_async(wolf, target_pos, 10, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
	scene_util.set_direction(wolf, 'left', false)
	wolf.Position = target_pos

	-- 나레이션 : 거대 늑대의 도움을 받을 수 있게 되었다!
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_12' })

	wolf.Interactable = CS.Oak.EmoticonInteractable.Create(CS.Oak.EmoticonType.Heart)
	wolf.Interactable.InteractingSfx = '01_guild_dog_01'

	-- 이후 다음 이벤트 진행까지 유지.
	-- 이후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀.
	self:clear_event()
	self.section:check_all_clear()
	self:set_custom_state(self.custom_state_key, 1)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)
end

function big_wolf_event:clear_event()
	self:dispose_attack_range()

	local wolf = self:get_controller().get_museum_npc.wolf()
	wolf.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

	self.super:clear_event()
end

function big_wolf_event:dispose_attack_range()
	if self.attack_range then
		attack_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range)
		self.attack_range = nil
	end
end

--region 고양이와 부호 이벤트
function cat_event:init(section)
	self.super:init(section)

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		enter_zone = 2,
		set_light = 3,
		ending = 4
	}

	self.cur_state = self.state.none

	self.get_cat_platform = function()
		return get_field_object('cat_platform')
	end

	self.cur_request_id = 1
	self.max_request_id = 15

	self.event_zone_name = 's3_cat_rich_man_zone'
	self.quest_marker_name = 'night_museum_cat'
	self.grid_name = 'cat_grid'

	self.quest_id = 448

	self.is_active_routine = false

	self.get_fx_twinkle = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_object_twinkle_single')
	end

	self.twinkle_effect = nil

	self.custom_state_key = 'cat_event'
	local is_clear = self:get_custom_state(self.custom_state_key) > 0

	if is_clear then
		self.cur_state = self.state.ending
		self:clear_event()
		self:set_complete_state()

		return
	end

	self.get_fx_twinkle()
	self:set_un_complete_state()
end

function cat_event:start()
	if self:is_clear_event() then
		return
	end

	local cat = self:get_controller().get_museum_npc.cat()
	self.twinkle_effect = self.get_fx_twinkle():Instantiate(cat.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0.25))
end

function cat_event:dispose()
	self.is_active_routine = false
	self:dispose_twinkle_effect()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function cat_event:exit()
	self.is_active_routine = false
	self.super:exit()
end

function cat_event:on_event(e)
	if self:is_clear_event() then
		return false
	end

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.cur_state < self.state.set_light and
			lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.WatchingCameraGridChangedEvent) then
		if e.CameraGrid.name ~= self.grid_name then
			self.is_routine_active = false
			return false
		end

		start_coroutine(self.check_cat_platform_light_received, self)
		return false
	end

	if self.cur_state < self.state.enter_zone and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.event_zone_name) then
		self.cur_state = self.state.enter_zone
		start_coroutine(self.enter_zone_event, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function cat_event:enter_zone_event()
	local controller = self:get_controller()
	local rich_male = controller.get_museum_npc.rich_male()

	-- 촌장 (right, tired, sing) : 아이고 고양아…! 왜 그런데 올라간겨…!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(rich_male, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_13', false)

	if self.cur_state ~= self.state.enter_zone then
		return
	end

	-- 촌장 (right, tired, sing) : 뭐 반짝이는 거라도 본겨? 응?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(rich_male, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_14', false)

	if self.cur_state ~= self.state.enter_zone then
		return
	end

	-- 촌장 (right, tired, sing) : 이 할애비가 반짝이는 거 줄테니. 어서 내려와아!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(rich_male, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_15', false)

	if self.cur_state ~= self.state.enter_zone then
		return
	end

	rich_male.Interactable.Talk = 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_15'
end

function cat_event:check_cat_platform_light_received()
	self:set_request_id()
	local request_id = self.cur_request_id

	local light_gimmick_manager = get_or_create_global_table('Gimmick/LightGimmickManager')
	local cat_platform = self.get_cat_platform()

	self.is_active_routine = true
	while self.is_active_routine and request_id == self.cur_request_id do
		-- 고양이 동상 플랫폼에 빛이 생겼을 때 이벤트 진행
		if light_gimmick_manager:get_received_light(cat_platform) then
			self:received_light_cat_platform()
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function cat_event:received_light_cat_platform()
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	self.is_active_routine = false
	self.cur_state = self.state.set_light
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lightsaber_03')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	local controller = self:get_controller()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local chris = controller.get_museum_npc.chris()
	local rich_male = controller.get_museum_npc.rich_male()
	local cat = controller.get_museum_npc.cat()

	-- 고양이 단상 위치에 달빛이 도착할 시 이벤트 진행.
	local viewport_pos = vector(0.2, 0.5)
	if screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(rich_male.Position, { bonus_distance = -1 }) then
		viewport_pos = nil
	end

	-- 촌장 : 아이구야! 드디어 내려왔구나! 고놈 참 할애비 속을…
	-- 위치 : x 0.2 / y 0.5
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0, 3)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(rich_male, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_17', true, {
		viewport_pos = viewport_pos
	})

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(cat)
	scene_util.set_emotion(cat, self, 'smile')

	-- 카메라 빛이 도착한 고양이 단상 중심으로 1초에 걸쳐 이동.
	camera_util.move_async(vector(85, 0, 86), 1)

	-- 고양이 (right, smile, get, jump) 를 1의 높이로 실행 후 자신의 단상까지 2초에 걸쳐 이동.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(cat, self, 'get')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(cat, 'right')
	character_util.jump(cat, 3, 2, 0.5)

function crow_event:start()

			field:IsInCameraGrid(get_party_leader().Position, self.grid_name) then
		start_coroutine(self.around_routine, self)
	end

end

function crow_event:on_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.WatchingCameraGridChangedEvent) then
		return false
	end

	if e.CameraGrid.name ~= self.grid_name then
		self.is_routine_active = false
		return false
	end

	start_coroutine(self.around_routine, self)
	return false
end

function crow_event:around_routine()
	local crow = self:get_controller().get_museum_npc.crow()

	self:set_request_id()
	local request_id = self.cur_request_id

	local state = {
		-- 이동 중
		search_next_point = 1,
		around = 2,
	}

	local cur_state = state.around

	local speed = 3
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 0
	local start_pos, end_pos

	local function set_next_around_point()
		self.cur_around_point = self.cur_around_point >= self.around_pos_count and
				1 or (self.cur_around_point + 1)
	end

	local function reset_duration()
		time_passed = 0

		start_pos = crow.Position
		end_pos = self.around_data_list[self.cur_around_point].pos

		duration = vector_util.get_x0z(end_pos - start_pos).magnitude / speed
	end

	local function walk_start()
		scene_util.set_direction(crow, self.around_data_list[self.cur_around_point].dir, false)
	end

	local function reset()
		reset_duration()
		walk_start()
		cur_state = state.around
	end

	self.is_routine_active = true
	reset()

	scene_util.set_anim(crow, self, 'walk')
	while self.is_routine_active and request_id == self.cur_request_id do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if cur_state == state.search_next_point then
			-- 다음 이동 위치, 속도 세팅
			set_next_around_point()
			reset_duration()
			walk_start()

			cur_state = state.around
		elseif cur_state == state.around then
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			character_util.set_position(crow, pos, true)

			if time_passed > duration then
				cur_state = state.search_next_point
			end
		end
	end

end

function crow_event:set_request_id()
	self.cur_request_id = self.cur_request_id + 1
	if self.cur_request_id >= self.max_request_id then
		self.cur_request_id = 1
	end
end

function crow_event:is_clear_event()
	return true
end

		}

		self:set_clear_state()

function ancient_event:start()
	if self:is_clear_event() then
		return
	end

	-- 이펙트 세팅
	self:set_effect_list()
end

function ancient_event:dispose()
	self.is_active_routine = false

	if self.effect_list ~= nil then
		for key, _ in pairs(self.effect_list) do
			self:dispose_effect(key)
		end

		self.effect_list = nil
	end

	self.offset_list = nil

	self.super:dispose()
end

function ancient_event:exit()
	self.is_active_routine = false
	self.cur_event_state = self.event_state.exit

	local controller = self:get_controller()

	for i = 1, self.elf_count do
		local elf = controller.get_museum_npc.ancient_desertelf(i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(elf)
		elf.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
	end

	for i = 1, self.snowman_count do
		local snowman = controller.get_museum_npc.ancient_snowman(i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(snowman)
		snowman.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
	end

	self.super:exit()
end
