function ancient_event:on_event(e)
	if self:is_clear_event() then
		return false
	end

	if not lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.WatchingCameraGridChangedEvent) then
		return false
	end

	if e.CameraGrid.name ~= self.grid_name then
		self.is_active_routine = false
		return false
	end

	self:set_request_id()
	self.is_active_routine = true

	if not self.is_show_talk_elf_event then
		self.is_show_talk_elf_event = true
		start_coroutine(self.talk_elf_snowman, self)
	end

	start_coroutine(self.check_all_light_received, self)
	return false
end

function ancient_event:check_all_light_received()
	local request_id = self.cur_request_id
	local light_gimmick_manager = get_or_create_global_table('Gimmick/LightGimmickManager')
	local is_all_received = false

	while self.is_active_routine and request_id == self.cur_request_id do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		for _, connect_data in ipairs(self.light_connect_data) do
			local received_light_type = light_gimmick_manager:get_received_light(connect_data.fo)
			local fo = connect_data.fo

			if connect_data.state == self.light_connect_state.enabled then
				-- 얼음 / 불꽃이 붙어 있는 상태일 때

				-- 원하는 light Type이랑 같을 때 불을 꺼줌
				if connect_data.light_type == received_light_type then
					-- 연결되지 않은 상태에서 같은 타입의 빛이 들어왔아면 이펙트 꺼줌
					connect_data.state = self.light_connect_state.wait
					self:show_end_effect(connect_data.light_type, fo.Bounds.center)
					self:dispose_effect(fo.Name)
				end
			elseif connect_data.state == self.light_connect_state.wait then
				-- 얼음 / 불꽃이 꺼져 있는 상태면서 올바른 빛의 타입이 들어오고 있을 때

				-- 중간에 들어오는 빛이 달라질 경우 disabled 상태로 변경
				if received_light_type ~= connect_data.light_type then
					connect_data.time_passed = 0
					connect_data.state = self.light_connect_state.disabled
				end
			elseif connect_data.state == self.light_connect_state.disabled then
				-- 얼음 / 불꽃이 꺼져 있는 상태면서 올바른 빛의 타입이 들어오지 않고 있을 때
				connect_data.time_passed = connect_data.time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				if connect_data.time_passed >= 2 then
					connect_data.state = self.light_connect_state.enabled
					self:set_effect(connect_data.fo, connect_data.light_type)
				else
					if received_light_type == connect_data.light_type then
						-- 시간이 다 되기전에 올바른 빛이 들어왔을 때 wait  상태로 변환
						connect_data.state = self.light_connect_state.wait
					end
				end
			end
		end

		-- 모든 빛이 연결되었는지 확인
		is_all_received = true
		for _, connect_data in ipairs(self.light_connect_data) do
			if connect_data.state == self.light_connect_state.enabled then
				is_all_received = false
				break
			end
		end

		-- 모든 빛이 연결이 되었으면 종료
		if is_all_received then
			self:received_all_light()
			break
		end
	end
end

function ancient_event:talk_elf_snowman()
	local controller = self:get_controller()
	local snowman = controller.get_museum_npc.ancient_snowman(1)
	local desertelf = controller.get_museum_npc.ancient_desertelf(1)

	self.func_list = {
		function()
			-- 설산 0번 (left, attack, push) : 또 네놈들이냐! 왜 매번 이글루를 불태우는 거야?!
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(snowman, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_30_1', false)
		end,
		function()
			-- 사막 0번 (right, attack, push) : 내가 할 소리! 우리 천막 얼어붙는 건 어쩔 건데!
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(desertelf, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_30_2', false)
		end,
		function()
			-- 설산 0번 (left, attack, push) : 그럼 이글루부터 되돌리고 말해!
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(snowman, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_30_3', false)
		end,
		function()
			-- 사막 0번 (right, attack, push) : 아니! 우리 천막이 먼저야! 먼저 되돌려놔!!
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(desertelf, 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_30_4', false)
		end,
	}

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.cur_index = 0

	while self.cur_event_state == self.event_state.none and
			self.cur_index < #self.func_list do
		self.cur_index = self.cur_index + 1
		self.func_list[self.cur_index]()
	end

	self:reset_bubble(desertelf)
	self:reset_bubble(snowman)

	if self.cur_event_state ~= self.event_state.none then
		return
	end

	snowman.Interactable.Talk = 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_30_3'
	desertelf.Interactable.Talk = 'dv_night_at_the_museum_s3_30_4'
end

end

-- 불 이펙트 및 얼음 이펙트 추가
function ancient_event:set_effect_list()
	self.effect_list = {}

	-- 빛이 연결되어야 하는 부분에 이펙트 추가
	for _, value in ipairs(self.light_connect_data) do
		self:set_effect(value.fo, value.light_type)
	end
end

function ancient_event:set_effect(fo, light_type)
	if self.effect_list[fo.Name] ~= nil then
		return
	end

	self.effect_list[fo.Name] = {}

	-- 빛이 연결되어야 하는 부분에 이펙트 추가
	local pos = fo.Bounds.center
	local name = fo.Name
	local offsets = self.offset_list[light_type]

	if light_type == 1 then
		for i = 1, #offsets do
			local target_pos = pos + offsets[i]
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_ice_03', loop = false, play_pos = target_pos })
			local effect = self.fx.ice_flower():Instantiate(target_pos)
			table.insert(self.effect_list[name], effect)
		end

		return
	end

	for i = 1, #offsets do
		local target_pos = pos + offsets[i]
		local effect = self.fx.fire():Instantiate(target_pos)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_catch_fire_01', loop = false, play_pos = target_pos })
		table.insert(self.effect_list[name], effect)
	end
end

function ancient_event:show_end_effect(light_type, pos)
	local offsets = self.offset_list[light_type]

	if light_type == 1 then
		for i = 1, #offsets do
			self.fx.ice_end():Instantiate(pos + offsets[i])
		end

		return
	end

	for i = 1, #offsets do
		self.fx.fire_end():Instantiate(pos + offsets[i])
	end
end


-- 불 이펙트 및 얼음 이펙트 제거
function ancient_event:dispose_effect(key)
	local effects = self.effect_list[key]

	if effects == nil then
		return
	end

	for _, effect in pairs(effects) do
		if effect ~= nil then
			effect:Dispose()
		end
	end

	self.effect_list[key] = nil
end

function ancient_event:reset_bubble(npc)
	local bubble = speech_bubble.instance:Get(npc)

	if bubble ~= nil then
		bubble:ResetBubble()
	end
end

--endregion 고대 사막 엘프 / 설인 이벤트

return {
	goblin_event = goblin_event,
	big_wolf_event = big_wolf_event,
	turtle_event = turtle_event,
	crow_event = crow_event,
	cat_event = cat_event,
	monkey_event = monkey_event,
	ancient_event = ancient_event,
}

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	self.touch = false

	if not is_unity_null(self.mural_prefab) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.mural_prefab)
		self.mural_prefab = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

end

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

			self.res_holder, self.mural_asset_bundle_name, self.mural_asset_name, function(prefab)
				self.mural_prefab = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				self.mural_prefab:SetActive(false)
			end)

	--이미지 경로
	--TODO 임시 어셋이므로 발주시 수정 필요!
	local image_infos = {
		first_mural = {
			target_name = 'show/first',
			asset_name = '22chapter_wall_1.png',
			order = 1,
		},
		second_mural = {
			target_name = 'show/second',
			asset_name = '22chapter_wall_2.png',
			order = 2,
		},
		third_mural = {
			target_name = 'show/third',
			asset_name = '22chapter_wall_3.png',
			order = 3,
		},
		fourth_mural = {
			target_name = 'show/fourth',
			asset_name = '22chapter_wall_4.png',
			order = 4,
		},
		fifth_mural = {
			target_name = 'show/fifth',
			asset_name = '22chapter_wall_5.png',
			order = 5,
		},
		sixth_mural = {
			target_name = 'show/sixth',
			asset_name = '22chapter_wall_6.png',
			order = 6,
		},
		seventh_mural = {
			target_name = 'show/seventh',
			asset_name = '22chapter_wall_7.png',
			order = 7,
		},
	}

	for key, info in pairs(image_infos) do
		local target_obj = self.mural_prefab.transform:Find(info.target_name).gameObject
		load_util.load_texture_byte(self.mural_asset_bundle_name, info.asset_name, target_obj, info.order)
		self.mural_show_data[key].target = target_obj
	end

	self.dialogue = self.mural_prefab.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.UISubtitle))
	self.dialogue.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	--카메라 셋팅
	local background = self.mural_prefab.transform:Find('back/wall_bg'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer))
	local camera = self.mural_prefab.transform:Find('Camera pivot'):GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
	local bgUnitWidth = background.size.x * background.transform.localScale.x
	-- 현재 해상도에서 배경이 보이는 높이
	local viewUnitHeight = bgUnitWidth / camera.aspect

	-- 현재 해상도에 맞춰 카메라 높이를 클램핑해준다
	camera.orthographicSize = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Clamp(viewUnitHeight * 0.35, 3.5, 4.7)

	--endregion

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
end

function local_class:show_theatre_async(scene_name, show_dialogue, start_fade, end_fade, bubble_data)
	start_fade = lua_helper.get_or_default(start_fade, true)
	end_fade = lua_helper.get_or_default(end_fade, true)
	show_dialogue = lua_helper.get_or_default(show_dialogue, false)

	local show_info = {}
	if type_util.is_string(scene_name) then
		show_info = self.mural_show_data[scene_name]
		if show_info == nil then
			return
		end
	end

	if start_fade then
		screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end

	--벽화 그리기
	self.mural_prefab:SetActive(true)
	show_info.target:SetActive(true)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if type_util.is_array(bubble_data) then
		local bubble_setting = {
			bubble_direction = 'none', viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2),
		}

		for i = 1, #bubble_data do
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(user_party[0], bubble_data[i], true, bubble_setting)
		end
	end

	--해당 벽화 텍스트 타이핑
	if show_dialogue then
		self.dialogue.gameObject:SetActive(true)

		local text_data = show_info.text_data
		for i = 1, #text_data do
			local routines = { self.dialogue:Show('nil', text_data[i], true) }

			wait_all(routines)
		end

		self.dialogue.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	else
		--나레이션 없을 경우 다음 터치 까지 대기
		self.touch = true
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

		while self.touch do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--벽화 지우기
	show_info.target:SetActive(false)
	self.mural_prefab:SetActive(false)

	if end_fade then
		screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	self.touch = false
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}
